verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਲਾਗੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੰਗੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jis bheTat laagai prabh ra(n)g ||1||
verses.translation: Meeting with them, love for God is embraced. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਓਇ ਆਨੰਦ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh oi aana(n)dh paavai ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, bliss is obtained.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jis simarat man hoi pragaasaa taa kee gat mit kahan na jaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meditating upon Him in remembrance, the mind is illumined; his state and condition cannot be described. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਮਜਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: varat nem majan tis poojaa ||
verses.translation: Fasts, religious vows, cleansing baths, and worship to Him;

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸੁਨੀਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: bedh puraan tin si(n)mirat suneejaa ||
verses.translation: listening to the Vedas, Puraanas, and Shaastras.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa puneet jaa kaa niramal thaan ||
verses.translation: Extremely pure is he, and immaculate is his place,

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat jaa kai har har naam ||2||
verses.translation: who meditates upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in the Saadh Sangat. ||2||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਗਲੇ ਭਵਨ ॥
verses.translit: pragaTio so jan sagale bhavan ||
verses.translation: That humble being becomes renowned all over the world.

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਰੇਨ ॥
verses.translit: patit puneet taa kee pag ren ||
verses.translation: Even sinners are purified, by the dust of his feet.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau bheTio har har rai ||
verses.translation: One who has met the Lord, the Lord our King,

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: taa kee gat mit kathan na jai ||3||
verses.translation: his condition and state cannot be described. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar kar joR dhiaavau ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, with palms pressed together, I meditate;

verses.original: ਉਨ ਸਾਧਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: aun saadhaa kaa dharasan paavau ||
verses.translation: I yearn to obtain the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of those Holy Saints.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਗਰੀਬ ਕਉ ਲੇਹੁ ਰਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: moh gareeb kau leh ralai ||
verses.translation: Merge me, the poor one, with You, O Lord;

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਇ ਪਏ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥੪॥੩੮॥੮੯॥
verses.translit: naanak aai pe saranai ||4||38||89||
verses.translation: Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary. ||4||38||89||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਉਦਕ ਇਸਨਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar udhak isanaanee ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, he takes his cleansing bath in water;

verses.original: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਭੋਗੁ ਲਗਾਇ ਸੁਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: sadh hee bhog lagai sugiaanee ||
verses.translation: he makes continual offerings to the Lord; he is a true man of wisdom.

verses.original: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕਾਹੂ ਛੋਡੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: birathaa kaahoo chhoddai naahee ||
verses.translation: He never leaves anything uselessly.

verses.original: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਾਗਹ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bahur bahur tis laageh paiee ||1||
verses.translation: Again and again, he falls at the Lord's Feet. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਲਗਿਰਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: saalagiraam hamaarai sevaa ||
verses.translation: Such is the Saalagraam, the stone idol, which I serve;

verses.original: ਪੂਜਾ ਅਰਚਾ ਬੰਦਨ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: poojaa arachaa ba(n)dhan dhevaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: such is my worship, flower-offerings and divine adoration as well. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਘੰਟਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ॥
verses.translit: gha(n)Taa jaa kaa suneeaai chahu ku(n)T ||
verses.translation: His bell resounds to the four corners of the world.

verses.original: ਆਸਨੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ॥
verses.translit: aasan jaa kaa sadhaa baiku(n)Th ||
verses.translation: His seat is forever in heaven.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਚਵਰੁ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਝੂਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kaa chavar sabh uoopar jhoolai ||
verses.translation: His chauri, his fly-brush, waves over all.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਧੂਪੁ ਸਦਾ ਪਰਫੁਲੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: taa kaa dhoop sadhaa parafulai ||2||
verses.translation: His incense is ever-fragrant. ||2||

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸੰਪਟੁ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਜਾ ਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT sa(n)paT hai re jaa kaa ||
verses.translation: He is treasured in each and every heart.

verses.original: ਅਭਗ ਸਭਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੈ ਸਾਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: abhag sabhaa sa(n)g hai saadhaa ||
verses.translation: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is His Eternal Court.

verses.original: ਆਰਤੀ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: aaratee keeratan sadhaa ana(n)dh ||
verses.translation: His Aartee, his lamp-lit worship service, is the Kirtan of His Praises, which brings lasting bliss.

verses.original: ਮਹਿਮਾ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸਦਾ ਬੇਅੰਤ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mahimaa su(n)dhar sadhaa bea(n)t ||3||
verses.translation: His Greatness is so beautiful, and ever limitless. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਲਹਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jiseh paraapat tis hee lahanaa ||
verses.translation: He alone obtains it, who is so pre-ordained;

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨ ਓਹੁ ਆਇਓ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t charan oh aaio saranaa ||
verses.translation: he takes to the Sanctuary of the Saints' Feet.

verses.original: ਹਾਥਿ ਚੜਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਗਿਰਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: haath chaRio har saalagiraam ||
verses.translation: I hold in my hands the Saalagraam of the Lord.

verses.translit: kahu naanak gur keeno dhaan ||4||39||90||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Guru has given me this Gift. ||4||39||90||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਪੰਚਪਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa pa(n)chapadhaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Panch-Pada:

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਪੈਡੈ ਲੂਟੀ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jeh paiddai looTee panihaaree ||
verses.translation: That highway, upon which the water-carrier is plundered

verses.original: ਸੋ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਦੂਰਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: so maarag sa(n)tan dhooraaree ||1||
verses.translation: - that way is far removed from the Saints. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur poorai saach kahiaa ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has spoken the Truth.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਬੀਥੀ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam tere kee mukate beethee jam kaa maarag dhoor rahiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Your Name, O Lord, is the Way to Salvation; the road of the Messenger of Death is far away. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਲਾਲਚ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਘਾਟ ॥
verses.translit: jeh laalach jaagaatee ghaaT ||
verses.translation: That place, where the greedy toll-collector dwells

verses.original: ਦੂਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਉਹ ਜਨ ਤੇ ਬਾਟ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhoor rahee uh jan te baaT ||2||
verses.translation: - that path remains far removed from the Lord's humble servant. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਆਵਟੇ ਬਹੁਤ ਘਨ ਸਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: jeh aavaTe bahut ghan saath ||
verses.translation: There, where so very many caravans of men are caught,

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇ ਸੰਗੀ ਸਾਧ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: paarabraham ke sa(n)gee saadh ||3||
verses.translation: the Holy Saints remain with the Supreme Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਸਭ ਲਿਖਤੇ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: chitr gupat sabh likhate lekhaa ||
verses.translation: Chitra and Gupat, the recording angels of the conscious and the unconscious, write the accounts of all mortal beings,

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਪੇਖਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: bhagat janaa kau dhirasaT na pekhaa ||4||
verses.translation: but they cannot even see the Lord's humble devotees. ||4||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak jis satigur pooraa ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, one whose True Guru is Perfect

verses.original: ਵਾਜੇ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰਾ ॥੫॥੪੦॥੯੧॥
verses.translit: vaaje taa kai anahadh tooraa ||5||40||91||
verses.translation: - the unblown bugles of ecstasy vibrate for him. ||5||40||91||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa dhupadhaa 1 ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Du-Pada 1:

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਿਖਾਇਓ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo sa(n)g sikhaio naam ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Naam is learned;

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sarab manorath pooran kaam ||
verses.translation: all desires and tasks are fulfilled.

verses.original: ਬੁਝਿ ਗਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸਹਿ ਅਘਾਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: bujh giee tirasanaa har jaseh aghaane ||
verses.translation: My thirst has been quenched, and I am satiated with the Lord's Praise.

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਸਾਰਿਗਪਾਨੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jap jap jeevaa saarigapaane ||1||
verses.translation: I live by chanting and meditating upon the Lord, the Sustainer of the earth. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: karan karaavan saran pariaa ||
verses.translation: I have entered the Sanctuary of the Creator, the Cause of all causes.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਚੰਦੁ ਚੜਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh sahaj ghar paiaa miTiaa a(n)dheraa cha(n)dh chaRiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I have entered the home of celestial bliss. Darkness is dispelled, and the moon of wisdom has risen. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਲਾਲ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: laal javehar bhare bha(n)ddaar ||
verses.translation: My treasure-house is overflowing with rubies and jewels;

verses.original: ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: toT na aavai jap nira(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: I meditate on the Formless Lord, and so they never run short.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਬਦੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat sabadh peevai jan koi ||
verses.translation: How rare is that humble being, who drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥੪੧॥੯੨॥
verses.translit: naanak taa kee param gat hoi ||2||41||92||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he attains the state of highest dignity. ||2||41||92||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੭ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ghar satvaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Seventh House, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam ridhai nit dhiaaiee ||
verses.translation: Meditate continually on the Name of the Lord within your heart.

verses.original: ਸੰਗੀ ਸਾਥੀ ਸਗਲ ਤਰਾਂਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)gee saathee sagal taraa(n)iee ||1||
verses.translation: Thus you shall save all your companions and associates. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur merai sa(n)g sadhaa hai naale ||
verses.translation: My Guru is always with me, near at hand.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: simar simar tis sadhaa sam(h)aale ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on Him, I cherish Him forever. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: teraa keeaa meeThaa laagai ||
verses.translation: Your actions seem so sweet to me.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ॥੨॥੪੨॥੯੩॥
verses.translit: har naam padhaarath naanak maa(n)gai ||2||42||93||
verses.translation: Nanak begs for the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||42||93||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo sa(n)gat tariaa sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: The world is saved by the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam maneh aadhaar ||1||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is the Support of the mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal gurdhev piaare ||
verses.translation: The Saints worship and adore the Lotus Feet of the Divine Guru;

verses.original: ਪੂਜਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: poojeh sa(n)t har preet piaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: they love the Beloved Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai masatak likhiaa bhaag ||
verses.translation: She who has such good destiny written upon her forehead,

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ॥੨॥੪੩॥੯੪॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak taa kaa thir sohaag ||2||43||94||
verses.translation: says Nanak, is blessed with the eternal happy marriage with the Lord. ||2||43||94||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੀਠੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਪਿਰ ਕੀ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: meeThee aagiaa pir kee laagee ||
verses.translation: The Order of my Husband Lord seems so sweet to me.

verses.original: ਸਉਕਨਿ ਘਰ ਕੀ ਕੰਤਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: saukan ghar kee ka(n)t tiaagee ||
verses.translation: My Husband Lord has driven out the one who was my rival.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ਕਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: pria sohaagan seegaar karee ||
verses.translation: My Beloved Husband has decorated me, His happy soul-bride.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਤਪਤਿ ਹਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: man mere kee tapat haree ||1||
verses.translation: He has quieted the burning thirst of my mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਲੋ ਭਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਕਹਿਆ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhalo bhio pria kahiaa maaniaa ||
verses.translation: It is good that I submitted to the Will of my Beloved Lord.

verses.original: ਸੂਖੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਇਸੁ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sookh sahaj is ghar kaa jaaniaa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have realized celestial peace and poise within this home of mine. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬੰਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਖਿਜਮਤਦਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: hau ba(n)dhee pria khijamatadhaar ||
verses.translation: I am the hand-maiden, the attendant of my Beloved Lord.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: oh abinaasee agam apaar ||
verses.translation: He is eternal and imperishable, inaccessible and infinite.

verses.original: ਲੇ ਪਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਝਲਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: le pakhaa pria jhalau paae ||
verses.translation: Holding the fan, sitting at His Feet, I wave it over my Beloved.

verses.original: ਭਾਗਿ ਗਏ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਲਾਵੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhaag ge pa(n)ch dhoot laave ||2||
verses.translation: The five demons who tortured me have run away. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਮੈ ਕੁਲੁ ਨਾ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: naa mai kul naa sobhaava(n)t ||
verses.translation: I am not from a noble family, and I am not beautiful.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਾ ਕਿਉ ਭਾਨੀ ਕੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa jaanaa kiau bhaanee ka(n)t ||
verses.translation: What do I know? Why am I pleasing to my Beloved?

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਗਰੀਬ ਨਿਮਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: moh anaath gareeb nimaanee ||
verses.translation: I am a poor orphan, destitute and dishonored.

verses.original: ਕੰਤ ਪਕਰਿ ਹਮ ਕੀਨੀ ਰਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ka(n)t pakar ham keenee raanee ||3||
verses.translation: My Husband took me in, and made me His queen. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: jab mukh preetam saajan laagaa ||
verses.translation: When I saw my Beloved's face before me,

verses.original: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਮੇਰਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: sookh sahaj meraa dhan sohaagaa ||
verses.translation: I became so happy and peaceful; my married life was blessed.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੋਰੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak moree pooran aasaa ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, my desires are fulfilled.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੇਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੯੫॥
verses.translit: satigur melee prabh gunataasaa ||4||1||95||
verses.translation: The True Guru has united me with God, the treasure of excellence. ||4||1||95||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਥੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: maathai tirakuTee dhirasaT karoor ||
verses.translation: A frown creases her forehead, and her look is evil.

verses.original: ਬੋਲੈ ਕਉੜਾ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਕੀ ਫੂੜਿ ॥
verses.translit: bolai kauRaa jihabaa kee fooR ||
verses.translation: Her speech is bitter, and her tongue is rude.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਭੂਖੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sadhaa bhookhee pir jaanai dhoor ||1||
verses.translation: She is always hungry, and she believes her Husband to be far away. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸੀ ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਇਕ ਰਾਮਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aaisee isatree ik raam upaiee ||
verses.translation: Such is Maya, the woman, which the One Lord has created.

verses.original: ਉਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਖਾਇਆ ਹਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aun sabh jag khaiaa ham gur raakhe mere bhaiee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: She is devouring the whole world, but the Guru has saved me, O my Siblings of Destiny. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਾਇ ਠਗਉਲੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਜੋਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: pai Thagaulee sabh jag johiaa ||
verses.translation: Administering her poisons, she has overcome the whole world.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹਾਦੇਉ ਮੋਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: brahamaa bisan mahaadheau mohiaa ||
verses.translation: She has bewitched Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੇ ਸੇ ਸੋਹਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam lage se sohiaa ||2||
verses.translation: Only those Gurmukhs who are attuned to the Naam are blessed. ||2||

verses.original: ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਪੁਨਹਚਰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: varat nem kar thaake punahacharanaa ||
verses.translation: Performing fasts, religious observances and atonements, the mortals have grown weary.

verses.original: ਤਟ ਤੀਰਥ ਭਵੇ ਸਭ ਧਰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: taT teerath bhave sabh dharanaa ||
verses.translation: They wander over the entire planet, on pilgrimages to the banks of sacred rivers.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: se ubare j satigur kee saranaa ||3||
verses.translation: But they alone are saved, who seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਭੋ ਜਗੁ ਬਾਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh sabho jag baadhaa ||
verses.translation: Attached to Maya, the whole world is in bondage.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਪਚੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂਰਾਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: haumai pachai manmukh mooraakhaa ||
verses.translation: The foolish self-willed manmukhs are consumed by their egotism.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਹਮ ਰਾਖਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੯੬॥
verses.translit: gur naanak baeh pakar ham raakhaa ||4||2||96||
verses.translation: Taking me by the arm, Guru Nanak has saved me. ||4||2||96||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਦੂਖ ਜਬ ਬਿਸਰਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: sarab dhookh jab bisareh suaamee ||
verses.translation: Everything is painful, when one forgets the Lord Master.

verses.original: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: e'eehaa uoohaa kaam na praanee ||1||
verses.translation: Here and hereafter, such a mortal is useless. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧੵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t tirapataase har har dhayeai ||
verses.translation: The Saints are satisfied, meditating on the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਏ ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa apunai nai laae sarab sookh prabh tumaree rajai || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Bestowing Your Mercy, God, You attach us to Your Name; all peace comes by Your Will. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਵਤ ਕਉ ਜਾਨਤ ਦੂਰਿ ॥ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਮਰਤਾ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਝੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sa(n)g hovat kau jaanat dhoor || so jan marataa nit nit jhoor ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord is Ever-present; one who deems Him to be far away, dies again and again, repenting. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੀਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin sabh kichh dheeaa tis chitavat naeh ||
verses.translation: The mortals do not remember the One, who has given them everything.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mahaa bikhiaa meh dhin rain jaeh ||3||
verses.translation: Engrossed in such terrible corruption, their days and nights waste away. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਏਕ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak prabh simarahu ek ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, meditate in remembrance of the One Lord God.

verses.original: ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਟੇਕ ॥੪॥੩॥੯੭॥
verses.translit: gat paieeaai gur poore Tek ||4||3||97||
verses.translation: Salvation is obtained, in the Shelter of the Perfect Guru. ||4||3||97||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: naam japat man tan sabh hariaa ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind and body are totally rejuvenated.

verses.original: ਕਲਮਲ ਦੋਖ ਸਗਲ ਪਰਹਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kalamal dhokh sagal parahariaa ||1||
verses.translation: All sins and sorrows are washed away. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਦਿਵਸੁ ਭਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: soiee dhivas bhalaa mere bhaiee ||
verses.translation: How blessed is that day, O my Siblings of Destiny,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har gun gai param gat paiee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: when the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung, and the supreme status is obtained. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਜੇ ਪੈਰ ॥
verses.translit: saadh janaa ke pooje pair ||
verses.translation: Worshipping the feet of the Holy Saints,

verses.original: ਮਿਟੇ ਉਪਦ੍ਰਹ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਬੈਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: miTe upadhreh man te bair ||2||
verses.translation: troubles and hatred are eliminated from the mind. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਝਗਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur poore mil jhagar chukaiaa ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Perfect Guru, conflict is ended,

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਸਭਿ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch dhoot sabh vasagat aaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: and the five demons are totally subdued. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis man vasiaa har kaa naam ||
verses.translation: One whose mind is filled with the Name of the Lord,

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੪॥੪॥੯੮॥
verses.translit: naanak tis uoopar kurabaan ||4||4||98||
verses.translation: O Nanak - I am a sacrifice to him. ||4||4||98||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗਾਵਿ ਲੇਹਿ ਤੂ ਗਾਵਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaav leh too gaavanahaare ||
verses.translation: O singer, sing of the One,

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਪਿੰਡ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jeea pi(n)dd ke praan adhaare ||
verses.translation: who is the Support of the soul, the body and the breath of life.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kee sevaa sarab sukh paaveh ||
verses.translation: Serving Him, all peace is obtained.

verses.original: ਅਵਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਪਹਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: avar kaahoo peh bahuR na jaaveh ||1||
verses.translation: You shall no longer go to any other. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਅਨੰਦੀ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਜਾਪੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa ana(n)dh ana(n)dhee saahib gun nidhaan nit nit jaapeeaai ||
verses.translation: My Blissful Lord Master is forever in bliss; meditate continually and forever, on the Lord, the treasure of excellence.

verses.original: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਸੀਐ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: balihaaree tis sa(n)t piaare jis prasaadh prabh man vaaseeaai || rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Beloved Saints; by their kind favor, God comes to dwell in the mind. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਿਖੂਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kaa dhaan nikhooTai naahee ||
verses.translation: His gifts are never exhausted.

verses.original: ਭਲੀ ਭਾਤਿ ਸਭ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: bhalee bhaat sabh sahaj samaahee ||
verses.translation: In His subtle way, He easily absorbs all.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਖਸ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kee bakhas na meTai koiee ||
verses.translation: His benevolence cannot be erased.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਵਾਸਾਈਐ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: man vaasaieeaai saachaa soiee ||2||
verses.translation: So enshrine that True Lord within your mind. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਨ ॥
verses.translit: sagal samagree gireh jaa kai pooran ||
verses.translation: His house is filled with all sorts of articles;

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਦੂਖ ਨ ਝੂਰਨ ॥
verses.translit: prabh ke sevak dhookh na jhooran ||
verses.translation: God's servants never suffer pain.

verses.original: ਓਟਿ ਗਹੀ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: oT gahee nirabhau padh paieeaai ||
verses.translation: Holding to His Support, the state of fearless dignity is obtained.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸੋ ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saas saas so gun nidh gaieeaai ||3||
verses.translation: With each and every breath, sing of the Lord, the treasure of excellence. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: dhoor na hoiee katahoo jaieeaai ||
verses.translation: He is not far from us, wherever we go.

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: nadhar kare taa har har paieeaai ||
verses.translation: When He shows His Mercy, we obtain the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਰੀ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: aradhaas karee poore gur paas ||
verses.translation: I offer this prayer to the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੫॥੯੯॥
verses.translit: naanak ma(n)gai har dhan raas ||4||5||99||
verses.translation: Nanak begs for the treasure of the Lord's Name. ||4||5||99||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਤਨ ਕਾ ਦੂਖ ॥
verses.translit: prathame miTiaa tan kaa dhookh ||
verses.translation: First, the pains of the body vanish;

verses.original: ਮਨ ਸਗਲ ਕਉ ਹੋਆ ਸੂਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: man sagal kau hoaa sookh ||
verses.translation: then, the mind becomes totally peaceful.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰ ਦੀਨੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa gur dheeno naau ||
verses.translation: In His Mercy, the Guru bestows the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bal bal tis satigur kau jaau ||1||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to that True Guru. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਓ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur pooraa paio mere bhaiee ||
verses.translation: I have obtained the Perfect Guru, O my Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਸਭ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: rog sog sabh dhookh binaase satigur kee saranaiee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: All illness, sorrows and sufferings are dispelled, in the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur ke charan hiradhai vasaae ||
verses.translation: The feet of the Guru abide within my heart;

verses.original: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਤਤ ਸਗਲੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: man chi(n)tat sagale fal paae ||
verses.translation: I have received all the fruits of my heart's desires.

verses.original: ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਸਭ ਹੋਈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: agan bujhee sabh hoiee saa(n)t ||
verses.translation: The fire is extinguished, and I am totally peaceful.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa gur keenee dhaat ||2||
verses.translation: Showering His Mercy, the Guru has given this gift. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: nithaave kau gur dheeno thaan ||
verses.translation: The Guru has given shelter to the shelterless.

verses.original: ਨਿਮਾਨੇ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: nimaane kau gur keeno maan ||
verses.translation: The Guru has given honor to the dishonored.

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan kaaT sevak kar raakhe ||
verses.translation: Shattering his bonds, the Guru has saved His servant.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਨੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਚਾਖੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat baanee rasanaa chaakhe ||3||
verses.translation: I taste with my tongue the Ambrosial Bani of His Word. ||3||

verses.original: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪੂਜ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: vaddai bhaag pooj gur charanaa ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, I worship the Guru's feet.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਪਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: sagal tiaag paiee prabh saranaa ||
verses.translation: Forsaking everything, I have obtained God's Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਇਆ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੦੦॥
verses.translit: gur naanak jaa kau bhiaa dhiaalaa || so jan hoaa sadhaa nihaalaa ||4||6||100||
verses.translation: That humble being, O Nanak, unto whom the Guru grants His Mercy, is forever enraptured. ||4||6||100||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੈ ਦੀਆ ਭੇਜਿ ॥
verses.translit: satigur saachai dheeaa bhej ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has truly given a child.

verses.original: ਚਿਰੁ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: chir jeevan upajiaa sa(n)jog ||
verses.translation: The long-lived one has been born to this destiny.

verses.original: ਉਦਰੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਆਇ ਕੀਆ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: audharai maeh aai keeaa nivaas ||
verses.translation: He came to acquire a home in the womb,

verses.original: ਮਾਤਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਿਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: maataa kai man bahut bigaas ||1||
verses.translation: and his mother's heart is so very glad. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੰਮਿਆ ਪੂਤੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: ja(n)miaa poot bhagat govi(n)dh kaa ||
verses.translation: A son is born - a devotee of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰ ਕਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pragaTiaa sabh meh likhiaa dhur kaa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: This pre-ordained destiny has been revealed to all. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਦਸੀ ਮਾਸੀ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਬਾਲਕ ਜਨਮੁ ਲੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhasee maasee hukam baalak janam leeaa ||
verses.translation: In the tenth month, by the Lord's Order, the baby has been born.

verses.original: ਮਿਟਿਆ ਸੋਗੁ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: miTiaa sog mahaa ana(n)dh theeaa ||
verses.translation: Sorrow is dispelled, and great joy has ensued.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਸਖੀ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurbaanee sakhee ana(n)dh gaavai ||
verses.translation: The companions blissfully sing the songs of the Guru's Bani.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saache saahib kai man bhaavai ||2||
verses.translation: This is pleasing to the Lord Master. ||2||

verses.original: ਵਧੀ ਵੇਲਿ ਬਹੁ ਪੀੜੀ ਚਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: vadhee vel bahu peeRee chaalee ||
verses.translation: The vine has grown, and shall last for many generations.

verses.original: ਧਰਮ ਕਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਬਹਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: dharam kalaa har ba(n)dh bahaalee ||
verses.translation: The Power of the Dharma has been firmly established by the Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: man chi(n)dhiaa satiguroo dhivaiaa ||
verses.translation: That which my mind wishes for, the True Guru has granted.

verses.original: ਭਏ ਅਚਿੰਤ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bhe achi(n)t ek liv laiaa ||3||
verses.translation: I have become carefree, and I fix my attention on the One Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: jiau baalak pitaa uoopar kare bahu maan ||
verses.translation: As the child places so much faith in his father,

verses.original: ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ਬੋਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: bulaiaa bolai gur kai bhaan ||
verses.translation: I speak as it pleases the Guru to have me speak.

verses.original: ਗੁਝੀ ਛੰਨੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਾਤ ॥
verses.translit: gujhee chha(n)nee naahee baat ||
verses.translation: This is not a hidden secret;

verses.translit: gur naanak tuThaa keenee dhaat ||4||7||101||
verses.translation: Guru Nanak, greatly pleased, has bestowed this gift. ||4||7||101||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਦੇ ਹਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: gur poore raakhiaa dhe haath ||
verses.translation: Giving His Hand, the Perfect Guru has protected the child.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਭਇਆ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pragaT bhiaa jan kaa parataap ||1||
verses.translation: The glory of His servant has become manifest. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਜਪੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur gur japee guroo gur dhiaaiee ||
verses.translation: I contemplate the Guru, the Guru; I meditate on the Guru, the Guru.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਹਿ ਪਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeea kee aradhaas guroo peh paiee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: I offer my heart-felt prayer to the Guru, and it is answered. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੇ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: saran pare saache gurdhev ||
verses.translation: I have taken to the Sanctuary of the True Divine Guru.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pooran hoiee sevak sev ||2||
verses.translation: The service of His servant has been fulfilled. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd joban raakhai praan ||
verses.translation: He has preserved my soul, body, youth and breath of life.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੩॥੮॥੧੦੨॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak gur kau kurabaan ||3||8||102||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru. ||3||8||102||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਕਾਫੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
verses.translit: aasaa ghar atthvaa kaafee mahalaa panjavaa
verses.translation: Aasaa, Eighth House, Kaafee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮੈ ਬੰਦਾ ਬੈ ਖਰੀਦੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: mai ba(n)dhaa bai khareedh sach saahib meraa ||
verses.translation: I am Your purchased slave, O True Lord Master.

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh tis dhaa sabh kichh hai teraa ||1||
verses.translation: My soul and body, and all of this, everything is Yours. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ਤੂੰ ਧਣੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: maan nimaane too(n) dhanee teraa bharavaasaa ||
verses.translation: You are the honor of the dishonored. O Master, in You I place my trust.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਅਨ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਸੋ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਕਾਚਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bin saache an Tek hai so jaanahu kaachaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the True One, any other support is false - know this well. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਪਾਰ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: teraa hukam apaar hai koiee a(n)t na paae ||
verses.translation: Your Command is infinite; no one can find its limit.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਸੀ ਸੋ ਚਲੈ ਰਜਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jis gur pooraa bheTasee so chalai rajaae ||2||
verses.translation: One who meets with the Perfect Guru, walks in the Way of the Lord's Will. ||2||

verses.original: ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਕਿਤੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: chaturaiee siaanapaa kitai kaam na aaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Cunning and cleverness are of no use.

verses.original: ਤੁਠਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tuThaa saahib jo dhevai soiee sukh paieeaai ||3||
verses.translation: That which the Lord Master gives, by the Pleasure of His Will - that is pleasing to me. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਲਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਈਅਹਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਵੈ ਨ ਬੰਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: je lakh karam kamaie'eeh kichh pavai na ba(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: One may perform tens of thousands of actions, but attachment to things is not satisfied.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਰ ਹੋਰੁ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਧੰਧਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੦੩॥
verses.translit: jan naanak keetaa naam dhar hor chhoddiaa dha(n)dhaa ||4||1||103||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has made the Naam his Support. He has renounced other entanglements. ||4||1||103||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਮੈ ਭਾਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: sarab sukhaa mai bhaaliaa har jevadd na koiee ||
verses.translation: I have pursued all pleasures, but none is as great as the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੁਠੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur tuThe te paieeaai sach saahib soiee ||1||
verses.translation: By the Pleasure of the Guru's Will, the True Lord Master is obtained. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: balihaaree gur aapane sadh sadh kurabaanaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; I am forever and ever a sacrifice to Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਉ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਚਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਦਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam na visarau ik khin chasaa ih keejai dhaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Please, grant me this one blessing, that I may never, even for an instant, forget Your Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਭਾਗਠੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhaagaTh sachaa soi hai jis har dhan a(n)tar ||
verses.translation: How very fortunate are those who have the wealth of the Lord deep within the heart.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਛੂਟੈ ਮਹਾ ਜਾਲ ਤੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: so chhooTai mahaa jaal te jis gur sabadh nira(n)tar ||2||
verses.translation: They escape from the great noose of death; they are permeated with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਸਤ ਸਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee mahimaa kiaa kahaa gur bibek sat sar ||
verses.translation: How can I chant the Glorious Praises of the Guru? The Guru is the ocean of Truth and clear understanding.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: oh aadh jugaadhee jugeh jug pooraa paramesar ||3||
verses.translation: He is the Perfect Transcendent Lord, from the very beginning, and throughout the ages. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: naam dhiaavahu sadh sadhaa har har man ra(n)ge ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, forever and ever, my mind is filled with the Love of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੦੪॥
verses.translit: jeeau praan dhan guroo hai naanak kai sa(n)ge ||4||2||104||
verses.translation: The Guru is my soul, my breath of life, and wealth; O Nanak, He is with me forever. ||4||2||104||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਈ ਅਲਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਭੋਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: saiee alakh apaar bhoree man vasai ||
verses.translation: If the Invisible and Infinite Lord dwells within my mind, even for a moment,

verses.original: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਾਇ ਮੈਡਾ ਹਭੁ ਨਸੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhookh dharadh rog mai maiddaa habh nasai ||1||
verses.translation: then all my pains, troubles, and diseases vanish. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵੰਞਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਸਾਈ ਆਪਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: hau va(n)n(j)aa kurabaan saiee aapane ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Lord Master.

verses.original: ਹੋਵੈ ਅਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਜਾਪਣੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hovai anadh ghanaa man tan jaapane ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meditating on Him, a great joy wells up within my mind and body. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਿੰਦਕ ਗਾਲਿੑ ਸੁਣੀ ਸਚੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: bi(n)dhak gaali(h) sunee sache tis dhanee ||
verses.translation: I have heard only a little bit of news about the True Lord Master.

verses.original: ਸੂਖੀ ਹੂੰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ਮਾਇ ਨ ਕੀਮ ਗਣੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sookhee hoo(n) sukh pai mai na keem ganee ||2||
verses.translation: I have obtained the peace of all peace, O my mother; I cannot estimate its worth. ||2||

verses.original: ਨੈਣ ਪਸੰਦੋ ਸੋਇ ਪੇਖਿ ਮੁਸਤਾਕ ਭਈ ॥
verses.translit: nain pasa(n)dho soi pekh musataak bhiee ||
verses.translation: He is so beautiful to my eyes; beholding Him, I have been bewitched.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਣਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ਆਪਿ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ਲਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mai niragun meree mai aap laR lai liee ||3||
verses.translation: I am worthless, O my mother; He Himself has attached me to the hem of His robe. ||3||

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਹਭਾ ਹੂੰ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bedh kateb sa(n)saar habhaa hoo(n) baaharaa ||
verses.translation: He is beyond the world of the Vedas, the Koran and the Bible.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਜਾਹਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੦੫॥
verses.translit: naanak kaa paatisaahu dhisai jaaharaa ||4||3||105||
verses.translation: The Supreme King of Nanak is immanent and manifest. ||4||3||105||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਲਾਖ ਭਗਤ ਆਰਾਧਹਿ ਜਪਤੇ ਪੀਉ ਪੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: laakh bhagat aaraadheh japate peeau peeau ||
verses.translation: Tens of thousands of devotees worship and adore You, chanting, ""Beloved, Beloved.""

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਵਉ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਬਿਖਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kavan jugat melaavau niragun bikhiee jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: How shall You unite me, the worthless and corrupt soul, with Yourself. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ॥
verses.translit: teree Tek govi(n)dh gupaal dhiaal prabh ||
verses.translation: You are my Support, O Merciful God, Lord of the Universe, Sustainer of the World.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਥ ਤੇਰੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) sabhanaa ke naath teree sirasaT sabh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are the Master of all; the entire creation is Yours. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੰਤ ਪੇਖਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sahaiee sa(n)t pekheh sadhaa hajoor ||
verses.translation: You are the constant help and support of the Saints, who behold You Ever-present.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨੜਿਆ ਸੇ ਮਰਨਿੑ ਵਿਸੂਰਿ ਵਿਸੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naam bihoonaRiaa se marani(h) visoor visoor ||2||
verses.translation: Those who lack the Naam, the Name of the Lord, shall die, engulfed in sorrow and pain. ||2||

verses.original: ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਤਣ ਭਾਇ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਗਉਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhaas dhaasatan bhai miTiaa tinaa gaun ||
verses.translation: Those servants, who lovingly perform the Lord's service, are freed from the cycle of reincarnation.

verses.original: ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨਾੜਾ ਹਾਲੁ ਕਉਣੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: visariaa jin(h)aa naam tinaaRaa haal kaun ||3||
verses.translation: What shall be the fate of those who forget the Naam? ||3||

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਸੁ ਹਰਿੑਆਉ ਤੈਸਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਭ ॥
verses.translit: jaise pas hari(h)aau taisaa sa(n)saar sabh ||
verses.translation: As are the cattle which have strayed, so is the entire world.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੦੬॥
verses.translit: naanak ba(n)dhan kaaT milaavahu aap prabh ||4||4||106||
verses.translation: O God, please cut away Nanak's bonds, and unite him with Yourself. ||4||4||106||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਭੇ ਥੋਕ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਹਿਕੋ ਖਿਆਲੁ ਕਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: habhe thok visaar hiko khiaal kar ||
verses.translation: Forget all other things, and dwell upon the Lord alone.

verses.original: ਝੂਠਾ ਲਾਹਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jhooThaa laeh gumaan man tan arap dhar ||1||
verses.translation: Lay aside your false pride, and dedicate your mind and body to Him. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰ ਤੂੰ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar saalaeh sirajanahaar too(n) ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, praise the Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਾਂ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਮੂੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeevaa(n) teree dhaat kirapaa karahu moo(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I live by Your bountiful gifts - please, shower me with Your Mercy! ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਕੰਮੁ ਕਮਾਇ ਜਿਤੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: soiee ka(n)m kamai jit mukh ujalaa ||
verses.translation: So, do that work, by which your face shall be made radiant.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਲਗੈ ਸਚਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਅਲਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: soiee lagai sach jis too(n) dheh alaa ||2||
verses.translation: He alone becomes attached to the Truth, O Lord, unto whom You give it. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਨ ਢਹੰਦੋ ਮੂਲਿ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਕਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jo na ddaha(n)dho mool so ghar raas kar ||
verses.translation: So build and adorn that house, which shall never be destroyed.

verses.original: ਹਿਕੋ ਚਿਤਿ ਵਸਾਇ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਮਰਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: hiko chit vasai kadhe na jai mar ||3||
verses.translation: Enshrine the One Lord within your consciousness; He shall never die. ||3||

verses.original: ਤਿਨੑਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tin(h)aa piaaraa raam jo prabh bhaaniaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is dear to those, who are pleasing to the Will of God.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਅਕਥੁ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੦੭॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh akath naanak vakhaaniaa ||4||5||107||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, Nanak describes the indescribable. ||4||5||107||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੇ ਕਿਨੇਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h)aa na visarai naam se kinehiaa ||
verses.translation: What are they like - those who do not forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord?

verses.original: ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਸਾਂਈ ਜੇਹਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhedh na jaanahu mool saa(n)iee jehiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Know that there is absolutely no difference; they are exactly like the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਸੰਗਿ ਭੇਟਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: man tan hoi nihaal tum(h) sa(n)g bheTiaa ||
verses.translation: The mind and body are enraptured, meeting with You, O Lord.

verses.original: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਮੇਟਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sukh paiaa jan parasaadh dhukh sabh meTiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Peace is obtained, by the favor of the Lord's humble servant; all pains are taken away. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੇਤੇ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਤਿੰਨੑ ਖੇ ॥
verses.translit: jete kha(n)dd brahama(n)dd udhaare ti(n)n(h) khe ||
verses.translation: As many as are the continents of the world, so many have been saved.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਪਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jin(h) man vuThaa aap poore bhagat se ||2||
verses.translation: Those, in whose minds You Yourself dwell, O Lord, are the perfect devotees. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੰਨੇ ਆਪਿ ਸੋਈ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jis no ma(n)ne aap soiee maaneeaai ||
verses.translation: Those whom You approve, are approved.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: pragaT purakh paravaan sabh Thaiee jaaneeaai ||3||
verses.translation: Such a celebrated and honored person is known everywhere. ||3||

verses.original: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ਸਾਹ ਸਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: dhinas rain aaraadh sam(h)aale saeh saeh ||
verses.translation: Day and night, with every breath to worship and adore the Lord

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੦੮॥
verses.translit: naanak kee lochaa poor sache paatisaeh ||4||6||108||
verses.translation: - please, O True Supreme King, fulfill this, Nanak's desire. ||4||6||108||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਠਾਇ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: poor rahiaa srab Thai hamaaraa khasam soi ||
verses.translation: He, my Lord Master, is fully pervading all places.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਤੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ek saahib sir chhat dhoojaa naeh koi ||1||
verses.translation: He is the One Lord Master, the roof over our heads; there is no other than Him. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jiau bhaavai tiau raakh raakhanahaariaa ||
verses.translation: As it pleases Your Will, please save me, O Savior Lord.

verses.original: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tujh bin avar na koi nadhar nihaariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without You, my eyes see no other at all. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: pratipaale prabh aap ghaT ghaT saareeaai ||
verses.translation: God Himself is the Cherisher; He takes care of each and every heart.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਪਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jis man vuThaa aap tis na visaareeaai ||2||
verses.translation: That person, within whose mind You Yourself dwell, never forgets You. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਣ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh kare su aap aapan bhaaniaa ||
verses.translation: He does that which is pleasing to Himself.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bhagataa kaa sahaiee jug jug jaaniaa ||3||
verses.translation: He is known as the help and support of His devotees, throughout the ages. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਝੂਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jap jap har kaa naam kadhe na jhooreeaai ||
verses.translation: Chanting and meditating up the Lord's Name, the mortal never comes to regret anything.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰੀਐ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੦੯॥
verses.translit: naanak dharas piaas lochaa pooreeaai ||4||7||109||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I thirst for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; please, fulfill my desire, O Lord. ||4||7||109||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਸੋਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਗਾਫਲ ਗਹਿਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa soveh naam visaar gaafal gahiliaa ||
verses.translation: Why are you sleeping, and forgetting the Name, O careless and foolish mortal?

verses.original: ਕਿਤਂੀ ਇਤੁ ਦਰੀਆਇ ਵੰਞਨਿੑ ਵਹਦਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kita(n)ee it dhareeaai va(n)n(j)ni(h) vahadhiaa ||1||
verses.translation: So many have been washed away and carried off by this river of life. ||1||

verses.original: ਬੋਹਿਥੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਮਨ ਚੜਿ ਲੰਘੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: bohithaRaa har charan man chaR la(n)gheeaai ||
verses.translation: O mortal, get aboard the boat of the Lord's Lotus Feet, and cross over.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar gun gai saadhoo sa(n)geeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਭੋਗਹਿ ਭੋਗ ਅਨੇਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੁੰਞਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhogeh bhog anek vin naavai su(n)n(j)iaa ||
verses.translation: You may enjoy various pleasures, but they are useless without the Name.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਰੁੰਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har kee bhagat binaa mar mar ru(n)niaa ||2||
verses.translation: Without devotion to the Lord, you shall die in sorrow, again and again. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਪੜ ਭੋਗ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਤਨਿ ਮਰਦਨ ਮਾਲਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: kapaR bhog suga(n)dh tan maradhan maalanaa ||
verses.translation: You may dress and eat and apply scented oils to your body,

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਤਨੁ ਛਾਰੁ ਸਰਪਰ ਚਾਲਣਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bin simaran tan chhaar sarapar chaalanaa ||3||
verses.translation: but without the meditative remembrance of the Lord, your body shall surely turn to dust, and you shall have to depart. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਪੇਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa bikham sa(n)saar viralai pekhiaa ||
verses.translation: How very treacherous is this world-ocean; how very few realize this!

verses.original: ਛੂਟਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਖਿਆ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੧੦॥
verses.translit: chhooTan har kee saran lekh naanak lekhiaa ||4||8||110||
verses.translation: Salvation rests in the Lord's Sanctuary; O Nanak, this is your pre-ordained destiny. ||4||8||110||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਗਰਬੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: koi na kis hee sa(n)g kaahe garabeeaai ||
verses.translation: No one is anyone's companion; why take any pride in others?

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰਬੀਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ek naam aadhaar bhaujal tarabeeaai ||1||
verses.translation: With the Support of the One Name, this terrible world-ocean is crossed over. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਗਰੀਬ ਸਚੁ ਟੇਕ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: mai gareeb sach Tek too(n) mere satigur poore ||
verses.translation: You are the True Support of me, the poor mortal, O my Perfect True Guru.

verses.original: ਦੇਖਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਦਰਸਨੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhekh tum(h)aaraa dharasano meraa man dheere ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, my mind is encouraged. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ਕਾਜਿ ਨ ਕਿਤੈ ਗਨੋੁ ॥
verses.translit: raaj maal ja(n)jaal kaaj na kitai ganuo ||
verses.translation: Royal powers, wealth, and worldly involvements are of no use at all.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਹੁ ਧਨੋੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har keeratan aadhaar nihachal eh dhanuo ||2||
verses.translation: The Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is my Support; this wealth is everlasting. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੇਤੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਤੇਤ ਪਛਾਵਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jete maiaa ra(n)g tet pachhaaviaa ||
verses.translation: As many as are the pleasures of Maya, so many are the shadows they leave.

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sukh kaa naam nidhaan gurmukh gaaviaa ||3||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs sing of the Naam, the treasure of peace. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa gunee nidhaan too(n) prabh gahir ga(n)bheere ||
verses.translation: You are the True Lord, the treasure of excellence; O God, You are deep and unfathomable.

verses.original: ਆਸ ਭਰੋਸਾ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਜੀਅਰੇ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੧੧॥
verses.translit: aas bharosaa khasam kaa naanak ke jeeare ||4||9||111||
verses.translation: The Lord Master is the hope and support of Nanak's mind. ||4||9||111||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jis simarat dhukh jai sahaj sukh paieeaai ||
verses.translation: Remembering Him, suffering is removed, and celestial peace is obtained.

verses.original: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: rain dhinas kar joR har har dhiaaieeaai ||1||
verses.translation: Night and day, with your palms pressed together, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak kaa prabh soi jis kaa sabh koi ||
verses.translation: He alone is Nanak's God, unto whom all beings belong.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sarab rahiaa bharapoor sachaa sach soi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is totally pervading everywhere, the Truest of the True. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਗਿਆਨ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar baahar sa(n)g sahaiee giaan jog ||
verses.translation: Inwardly and outwardly, He is my companion and my helper; He is the One to be realized.

verses.original: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਮਨਾ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਸਗਲ ਰੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tiseh araadh manaa binaasai sagal rog ||2||
verses.translation: Adoring Him, my mind is cured of all its ailments. ||2||

verses.original: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: raakhanahaar apaar raakhai agan maeh ||
verses.translation: The Savior Lord is infinite; He saves us from the fire of the womb.

verses.original: ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤਪਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: seetal har har naam simarat tapat jai ||3||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is soothing and cool; remembering it in meditation, the inner fire is quenched. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਣਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sookh sahaj aana(n)dh ghanaa naanak jan dhooraa ||
verses.translation: Peace, poise, and immense bliss, O Nanak, are obtained, when one becomes the dust of the feet of the humble servants of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਿਧਿ ਭਏ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੧੧੨॥
verses.translit: kaaraj sagale sidh bhe bheTiaa gur pooraa ||4||10||112||
verses.translation: All of one's affairs are perfectly resolved, meeting with the Perfect Guru. ||4||10||112||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh gunee nidhaan gurmukh jaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the Universe is the treasure of excellence; He is known only to the Gurmukh.

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hoi kirapaal dhiaal har ra(n)g maaneeaai ||1||
verses.translation: When He shows His Mercy and Kindness, we revel in the Lord's Love. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਾਹ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: aavahu sa(n)t milaeh har kathaa kahaaneeaa ||
verses.translation: Come, O Saints - let us join together and speak the Sermon of the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਜਿ ਲਾਜ ਲੋਕਾਣੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin simareh naam taj laaj lokaaneeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Night and day, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and ignore the criticism of others. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jap jap jeevaa naam hovai anadh ghanaa ||
verses.translation: I live by chanting and meditating on the Naam, and so I obtain immense bliss.

verses.original: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਵਿਣਸਣਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mithiaa moh sa(n)saar jhooThaa vinasanaa ||2||
verses.translation: Attachment to the world is useless and vain; it is false, and perishes in the end. ||2||

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਨੇਹੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal sa(n)g neh kinai viralai laiaa ||
verses.translation: How rare are those who embrace love for the Lord's Lotus Feet.

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n suhaavaa mukh jin har dhiaaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: Blessed and beautiful is that mouth, which meditates on the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਲ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran dhukh kaal simarat miT jaaviee ||
verses.translation: The pains of birth, death and reincarnation are erased by meditating on the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੋਇ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਈ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੧੧੩॥
verses.translit: naanak kai sukh soi jo prabh bhaaviee ||4||11||113||
verses.translation: That alone is Nanak's joy, which is pleasing to God. ||4||11||113||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਵਹੁ ਮੀਤ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਹੋਇ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਸਭਿ ਭੁੰਚਹ ॥
verses.translit: aavahu meet ikatr hoi ras kas sabh bhu(n)cheh ||
verses.translation: Come, O friends: let us meet together and enjoy all the tastes and flavors.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਹ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਪਾ ਮੁੰਚਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam har har japeh mil paapaa mu(n)cheh ||1||
verses.translation: Let us join together and chant the Ambrosial Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and so wipe away our sins. ||1||

verses.original: ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: tat veechaarahu sa(n)t janahu taa te bighan na laagai ||
verses.translation: Reflect upon the essence of reality, O Saintly beings, and no troubles shall afflict you.

verses.original: ਖੀਨ ਭਏ ਸਭਿ ਤਸਕਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kheen bhe sabh tasakaraa gurmukh jan jaagai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: All of the thieves shall be destroyed, as the Gurmukhs remain wakeful. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬੁਧਿ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਖਰਚੁ ਲੈਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਰਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: budh gareebee kharach laih haumai bikh jaarahu ||
verses.translation: Take wisdom and humility as your supplies, and burn away the poison of pride.

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਹਟੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਹੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saachaa haT pooraa saudhaa vakhar naam vaapaarahu ||2||
verses.translation: True is that shop, and perfect the transaction; deal only in the merchandise of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਰਪਿਆ ਸੇਈ ਪਤਿਵੰਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd dhan arapiaa seiee pativa(n)te ||
verses.translation: They alone are accepted and approved, who dedicate their souls, bodies and wealth.

verses.original: ਆਪਨੜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਿਆ ਨਿਤ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੰਤੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aapanaRe prabh bhaaniaa nit kel kara(n)te ||3||
verses.translation: Those who are pleasing to their God, celebrate in happiness. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਦੁ ਜੋ ਪੀਵਤੇ ਬਿਖਲੀ ਪਤਿ ਕਮਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhuramat madh jo peevate bikhalee pat kamalee ||
verses.translation: Those fools, who drink in the wine of evil-mindedness, become the husbands of prostitutes.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚ ਅਮਲੀ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੧੧੪॥
verses.translit: raam rasain jo rate naanak sach amalee ||4||12||114||
verses.translation: But those who are imbued with the sublime essence of the Lord, O Nanak, are intoxicated with the Truth. ||4||12||114||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਉਦਮੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਾਇਆ ਆਰੰਭੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: audham keeaa karaiaa aara(n)bh rachaiaa ||
verses.translation: I made the effort; I did it, and made a beginning.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam jape jap jeevanaa gur ma(n)tr dhiraRaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: I live by chanting and meditating on the Naam. The Guru has implanted this Mantra within me. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਾਇ ਪਰਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: pai pareh satiguroo kai jin bharam bidhaariaa ||
verses.translation: I fall at the Feet of the True Guru, who has dispelled my doubts.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa prabh aapanee sach saaj savaariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Bestowing His Mercy, God has dressed me, and decorated me with the Truth. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਚੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kar geh leene aapane sach hukam rajaiee ||
verses.translation: Taking me by the hand, He made me His own, through the True Order of His Command.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦਿਤੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਸਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jo prabh dhitee dhaat saa pooran vaddiaaiee ||2||
verses.translation: That gift which God gave to me, is perfect greatness. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਅਹਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa gun gaie'eeh jap naam muraaree ||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and chant the Name of the Destroyer of ego.

verses.original: ਨੇਮੁ ਨਿਬਾਹਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: nem nibaahio satiguroo prabh kirapaa dhaaree ||3||
verses.translation: My vows have been honored, by the Grace of God and the True Guru, who has showered His Mercy. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ਲਾਭੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: naam dhan gun gaau laabh poorai gur dhitaa ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has given the wealth of the Naam, and the profit of singing the Lord's Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਅਮਿਤਾ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੧੧੫॥
verses.translit: vanajaare sa(n)t naanakaa prabh saahu amitaa ||4||13||115||
verses.translation: The Saints are the traders, O Nanak, and the Infinite Lord God is their Banker. ||4||13||115||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਤੁਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kaa Thaakur tuhee prabh taa ke vaddabhaagaa ||
verses.translation: One who has You as His Master, O God, is blessed with great destiny.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਸਦ ਸੁਖੀ ਸਭੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: oh suhelaa sadh sukhee sabh bhram bhau bhaagaa ||1||
verses.translation: He is happy, and forever at peace; his doubts and fears are all dispelled. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਚਾਕਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ham chaakar gobi(n)dh ke Thaakur meraa bhaaraa ||
verses.translation: I am the slave of the Lord of the Universe; my Master is the greatest of all.

verses.original: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਧਿ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: karan karaavan sagal bidh so satiguroo hamaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is the Creator, the Cause of causes; He is my True Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਉਰੁ ਕੋ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojaa naahee aaur ko taa kaa bhau kareeaai ||
verses.translation: There is no other whom I should fear.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਗੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur sevaa mahal paieeaai jag dhutar tareeaai ||2||
verses.translation: Serving the Guru, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is obtained, and the impassable world-ocean is crossed over. ||2||

verses.original: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhirasaT teree sukh paieeaai man maeh nidhaanaa ||
verses.translation: By Your Glance of Grace, peace is obtained, and the treasure fills the mind.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਭਏ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaa kau tum kirapaal bhe sevak se paravaanaa ||3||
verses.translation: That servant, unto whom You bestow Your Mercy, is approved and accepted. ||3||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੋ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਪੀਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat ras har keeratano ko viralaa peevai ||
verses.translation: How rare is that person who drinks in the Ambrosial Essence of the Lord's Kirtan.

verses.original: ਵਜਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੧੧੬॥
verses.translit: vajahu naanak milai ek naam ridh jap jap jeevai ||4||14||116||
verses.translation: Nanak has obtained the commodity of the One Name; he lives by chanting and meditating on it within his heart. ||4||14||116||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਹਉ ਚੇਰੁਲੀ ਸੋ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa prabh kee hau cherulee so sabh te uoochaa ||
verses.translation: I am God's maid-servant; He is the highest of all.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਾਂਢੀਐ ਥੋਰਾ ਅਰੁ ਮੂਚਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh taa kaa kaa(n)ddeeaai thoraa ar moochaa ||1||
verses.translation: All things, big and small, are said to belong to Him. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮੇਰਾ ਧਨੋ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੀ ਮਨੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: jeea praan meraa dhano saahib kee maneeaa ||
verses.translation: I surrender my soul, my breath of life, and my wealth, to my Lord Master.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਜਿਸੈ ਕੈ ਊਜਲੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਾਸੀ ਗਨੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam jisai kai uoojalee tis dhaasee ganeeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Through His Name, I become radiant; I am known as His slave. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਅਨੰਦ ਮੈ ਨਾਉ ਮਾਣਕ ਹੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: veparavaahu ana(n)dh mai naau maanak heeraa ||
verses.translation: You are Carefree, the Embodiment of Bliss. Your Name is a gem, a jewel.

verses.original: ਰਜੀ ਧਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਤੂੰ ਮੀਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: rajee dhaiee sadhaa sukh jaa kaa too(n) meeraa ||2||
verses.translation: One who has You as her Master, is satisfied, satiated and happy forever. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਰੀ ਸੰਗ ਕੀ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: sakhee saheree sa(n)g kee sumat dhiraRaavau ||
verses.translation: O my companions and fellow maidens, please implant that balanced understanding within me.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਤਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sevahu saadhoo bhaau kar tau nidh har paavau ||3||
verses.translation: Serve the Holy Saints lovingly, and find the treasure of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਗਲੀ ਦਾਸੀ ਠਾਕੁਰੈ ਸਭ ਕਹਤੀ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sagalee dhaasee Thaakurai sabh kahatee meraa ||
verses.translation: All are servants of the Lord Master, and all call Him their own.

verses.original: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੁਖਹਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੧੧੭॥
verses.translit: jiseh seegaare naanakaa tis sukheh baseraa ||4||15||117||
verses.translation: She alone dwells in peace, O Nanak, whom the Lord adorns. ||4||15||117||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸਰੀ ਏਹੁ ਅਚਾਰਾ ਸਿਖੁ ਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)taa kee hoi dhaasaree eh achaaraa sikh ree ||
verses.translation: Become the servant of the Saints, and learn this way of life.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਗੁਣਾ ਗੁਣ ਊਤਮੋ ਭਰਤਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਪਿਖੁ ਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sagal gunaa gun uootamo bharataa dhoor na pikh ree ||1||
verses.translation: Of all virtues, the most sublime virtue is to see your Husband Lord near at hand. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਜੀਠੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: eih man su(n)dhar aapanaa har naam majeeThai ra(n)g ree ||
verses.translation: So, dye this mind of yours with the color of the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਚਾਤੁਰੀ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣੁ ਗੁਪਾਲਹਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tiaag siaanap chaaturee too(n) jaan gupaaleh sa(n)g ree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Renounce cleverness and cunning, and know that the Sustainer of the world is with you. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਭਰਤਾ ਕਹੈ ਸੁ ਮਾਨੀਐ ਏਹੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇ ਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: bharataa kahai su maaneeaai eh seegaar banai ree ||
verses.translation: Whatever your Husband Lord says, accept that, and make it your decoration.

verses.original: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਏਹੁ ਤੰਬੋਲਾ ਖਾਇ ਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhoojaa bhaau visaareeaai eh ta(n)bolaa khai ree ||2||
verses.translation: Forget the love of duality, and chew upon this betel leaf. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਪਕੋ ਇਹ ਸਤ ਕੀ ਸੇਜ ਬਿਛਾਇ ਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh kar dheepako ieh sat kee sej bichhai ree ||
verses.translation: Make the Word of the Guru's Shabad your lamp, and let your bed be Truth.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਰਹੁ ਤਉ ਭੇਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar kar joR rahu tau bheTai har rai ree ||3||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, stand with your palms pressed together, and the Lord, your King, shall meet you. ||3||

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਚਜੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਈ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: tis hee chaj seegaar sabh saiee roop apaar ree ||
verses.translation: She alone is cultured and embellished, and she alone is of incomparable beauty.

verses.original: ਸਾਈ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜੋ ਭਾਣੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੧੧੮॥
verses.translit: saiee suohaagan naanakaa jo bhaanee karataar ree ||4||16||118||
verses.translation: She alone is the happy soul-bride, O Nanak, who is pleasing to the Creator Lord. ||4||16||118||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਡੀਗਨ ਡੋਲਾ ਤਊ ਲਉ ਜਉ ਮਨ ਕੇ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: ddeegan ddolaa tuoo lau jau man ke bharamaa ||
verses.translation: As long as there are doubts in the mind, the mortal staggers and falls.

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕਾਟੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਸਰਾਮਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhram kaaTe gur aapanai paae bisaraamaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Guru removed my doubts, and I have obtained my place of rest. ||1||

verses.original: ਓਇ ਬਿਖਾਦੀ ਦੋਖੀਆ ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੂਟੇ ॥
verses.translit: oi bikhaadhee dhokheeaa te gur te hooTe ||
verses.translation: Those quarrelsome enemies have been overcome, through the Guru.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਛੂਟੇ ਅਬ ਉਨੑਾ ਤੇ ਓਇ ਹਮ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ham chhooTe ab un(h)aa te oi ham te chhooTe ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have now escaped from them, and they have run away from me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਾਨਤਾ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਬੰਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: meraa teraa jaanataa tab hee te ba(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: He is concerned with 'mine and yours', and so he is held in bondage.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਟੀ ਅਗਿਆਨਤਾ ਤਬ ਛੁਟਕੇ ਫੰਧਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur kaaTee agiaanataa tab chhuTake fa(n)dhaa ||2||
verses.translation: When the Guru dispelled my ignorance, then the noose of death was cut away from my neck. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਤਾ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਲਉ ਦੁਖੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: jab lag hukam na boojhataa tab hee lau dhukheeaa ||
verses.translation: As long as he does not understand the Command of God's Will, he remains miserable.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੀਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur mil hukam pachhaaniaa tab hee te sukheeaa ||3||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Guru, he comes to recognize God's Will, and then, he becomes happy. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਦੋਖੀਆ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: naa ko dhusaman dhokheeaa naahee ko ma(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: I have no enemies and no adversaries; no one is wicked to me.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੇਵਕੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮੈ ਬੰਦਾ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੧੧੯॥
verses.translit: gur kee sevaa sevako naanak khasamai ba(n)dhaa ||4||17||119||
verses.translation: That servant, who performs the Lord's service, O Nanak, is the slave of the Lord Master. ||4||17||119||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sookh sahaj aanadh ghanaa har keeratan gaau ||
verses.translation: Peace, celestial poise and absolute bliss are obtained, singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

verses.original: ਗਰਹ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਅਪਣਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gareh nivaare satiguroo dhe apanaa naau ||1||
verses.translation: Bestowing His Name, the True Guru removes the evil omens. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: balihaaree gur aapane sadh sadh bal jaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੂ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: guroo viTahu hau vaariaa jis mil sach suaau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Guru; meeting Him, I am absorbed into the True Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਗੁਨ ਅਪਸਗੁਨ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਲਗਹਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sagun apasagun tis kau lageh jis cheet na aavai ||
verses.translation: Good omens and bad omens affect those who do not keep the Lord in the mind.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tis jam neR na aaviee jo har prabh bhaavai ||2||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death does not approach those who are pleasing to the Lord God. ||2||

verses.original: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਜੇਤੇ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: pu(n)n dhaan jap tap jete sabh uoopar naam ||
verses.translation: Donations to charity, meditation and penance - above all of them is the Naam.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har har rasanaa jo japai tis pooran kaam ||3||
verses.translation: One who chants with his tongue the Name of the Lord, Har, Har - his works are brought to perfect completion. ||3||

verses.original: ਭੈ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਗਏ ਕੋ ਦਿਸੈ ਨ ਬੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhai binase bhram moh ge ko dhisai na beeaa ||
verses.translation: His fears are removed, and his doubts and attachments are gone; he sees none other than God.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਖੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੧੨੦॥
verses.translit: naanak raakhe paarabraham fir dhookh na theeaa ||4||18||120||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Supreme Lord God preserves him, and no pain or sorrow afflicts him any longer. ||4||18||120||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੯ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
verses.translit: aasaa ghar nauvaa mahalaa panjavaa
verses.translation: Aasaa, Ninth House, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਚਿਤਵਉ ਚਿਤਵਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਉ ਆਗੈ ਭਾਵਉ ਕਿ ਨ ਭਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: chitavau chitav sarab sukh paavau aagai bhaavau k na bhaavau ||
verses.translation: Contemplating Him within my consciousness, I obtain total peace; but hereafter, will I be pleasing to Him or not?

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਹੈ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਦੂਸਰ ਕੈ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ek dhaataar sagal hai jaachik dhoosar kai peh jaavau ||1||
verses.translation: There is only One Giver; all others are beggars. Who else can we turn to? ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਮਾਗਉ ਆਨ ਲਜਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau maagau aan lajaavau ||
verses.translation: When I beg from others, I am ashamed.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਏਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਲਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sagal chhatrapat eko Thaakur kaun samasar laavau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The One Lord Master is the Supreme King of all; who else is equal to Him? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਊਠਉ ਬੈਸਉ ਰਹਿ ਭਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਖੋਜਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: uooThau baisau reh bh na saakau dharasan khoj khojaavau ||
verses.translation: Standing up and sitting down, I cannot live without Him. I search and search for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ ਸਨਕ ਸਨੰਦਨ ਸਨਾਤਨ ਸਨਤਕੁਮਾਰ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਮਹਲੁ ਦੁਲਭਾਵਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: brahamaadhik sanakaadhik sanak sana(n)dhan sanaatan sanatakumaar tin(h) kau mahal dhulabhaavau ||2||
verses.translation: Even Brahma and the sages Sanak, Sanandan, Sanaatan and Sanat Kumar, find it difficult to obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਆਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਰੈ ਨ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: agam agam aagaadh bodh keemat parai na paavau ||
verses.translation: He is unapproachable and unfathomable; His wisdom is deep and profound; His value cannot be appraised.

verses.original: ਤਾਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: taakee saran sat purakh kee satigur purakh dhiaavau ||3||
verses.translation: I have taken to the Sanctuary of the True Lord, the Primal Being, and I meditate on the True Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਾਟਿਓ ਬੰਧੁ ਗਰਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhio kirapaal dhiaal prabh Thaakur kaaTio ba(n)dh garaavau ||
verses.translation: God, the Lord Master, has become kind and compassionate; He has cut the noose of death away from my neck.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਉ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਤਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਉ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak jau saadhasa(n)g paio tau fir janam na aavau ||4||1||121||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, now that I have obtained the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I shall not have to be reincarnated again. ||4||1||121||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਾਵਉ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਉ ਗਾਵਉ ਜਾਗਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar gaavau baahar gaavau gaavau jaag savaaree ||
verses.translation: Inwardly, I sing His Praises, and outwardly, I sing His Praises; I sing His Praises while awake and asleep.

verses.original: ਸੰਗਿ ਚਲਨ ਕਉ ਤੋਸਾ ਦੀਨੑਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)g chalan kau tosaa dheen(h)aa gobi(n)dh naam ke biauhaaree ||1||
verses.translation: I am a trader in the Name of the Lord of the Universe; He has given it to me as my supplies, to carry with me. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਵਰ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: avar bisaaree bisaaree ||
verses.translation: I have forgotten and forsaken other things.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਓ ਮੈ ਏਹੋ ਆਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam dhaan gur poorai dheeo mai eho aadhaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has given me the Gift of the Naam; this alone is my Support. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੂਖਨਿ ਗਾਵਉ ਸੁਖਿ ਭੀ ਗਾਵਉ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪੰਥਿ ਸਮੑਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhookhan gaavau sukh bhee gaavau maarag pa(n)th sam(h)aaree ||
