verses.translation: I sing His Praises while suffering, and I sing His Praises while I am at peace as well. I contemplate Him while I walk along the Path.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਦੀਆ ਮੋਰੀ ਤਿਸਾ ਬੁਝਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naam dhiraR gur man meh dheeaa moree tisaa bujhaaree ||2||
verses.translation: The Guru has implanted the Naam within my mind, and my thirst has been quenched. ||2||

verses.original: ਦਿਨੁ ਭੀ ਗਾਵਉ ਰੈਨੀ ਗਾਵਉ ਗਾਵਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਰਸਨਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhin bhee gaavau rainee gaavau gaavau saas saas rasanaaree ||
verses.translation: I sing His Praises during the day, and I sing His Praises during the night; I sing them with each and every breath.

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਸਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਤ ਸੰਗਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat meh bisaas hoi har jeevat marat sa(n)gaaree ||3||
verses.translation: In the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, this faith is established, that the Lord is with us, in life and in death. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਇਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਵਉ ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kau ih dhaan dheh prabh paavau sa(n)t ren ur dhaaree ||
verses.translation: Bless servant Nanak with this gift, O God, that he may obtain, and enshrine in his heart, the dust of the feet of the Saints.

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰਵਨੀ ਕਥਾ ਨੈਨ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਉ ਮਸਤਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੨੨॥
verses.translit: sravanee kathaa nain dharas pekhau masatak gur charanaaree ||4||2||122||
verses.translation: Hear the Lord's Sermon with your ears, and behold the Blessed Vision of His Darshan with your eyes; place your forehead upon the Guru's Feet. ||4||2||122||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: Aasaa, Tenth House, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੧੦ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ghar dasvaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: Aasaa, Tenth House, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂੰ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਤੇ ਪਾਹੁਨ ਦੋ ਦਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis no too(n) asathir kar maaneh te paahun dho dhaahaa ||
verses.translation: That which you believe to be permanent, is a guest here for only a few days.

verses.original: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਸਭ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਅਸਨਾਹਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: putr kalatr gireh sagal samagree sabh mithiaa asanaahaa ||1||
verses.translation: Children, wives, homes, and all possessions - attachment to all of these is false. ||1||

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਹੈ ਹਾ ਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: re man kiaa kareh hai haa haa ||
verses.translation: O mind, why do you burst out laughing?

verses.original: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਇਕੁ ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨੁ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhirasaT dhekh jaise haricha(n)dhauree ik raam bhajan lai laahaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: See with your eyes, that these things are only mirages. So earn the profit of meditation on the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਸਤਰ ਦੇਹ ਓਢਾਨੇ ਦਿਨ ਦੋਇ ਚਾਰਿ ਭੋਰਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaise basatar dheh oddaane dhin dhoi chaar bhoraahaa ||
verses.translation: It is like the clothes which you wear on your body - they wear off in a few days.

verses.original: ਭੀਤਿ ਊਪਰੇ ਕੇਤਕੁ ਧਾਈਐ ਅੰਤਿ ਓਰਕੋ ਆਹਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bheet uoopare ketak dhaieeaai a(n)t orako aahaa ||2||
verses.translation: How long can you run upon a wall? Ultimately, you come to its end. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਅੰਭ ਕੁੰਡ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਪਰਤ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਗਲਿ ਜਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaise a(n)bh ku(n)dd kar raakhio parat si(n)dh gal jaahaa ||
verses.translation: It is like salt, preserved in its container; when it is put into water, it dissolves.

verses.original: ਆਵਗਿ ਆਗਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਮੁਹਤ ਚਸਾਹਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aavag aagiaa paarabraham kee uTh jaasee muhat chasaahaa ||3||
verses.translation: When the Order of the Supreme Lord God comes, the soul arises, and departs in an instant. ||3||

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਚਾਲਹਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਲੈਦਾ ਸਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: re man lekhai chaaleh lekhai baiseh lekhai laidhaa saahaa ||
verses.translation: O mind, your steps are numbered, your moments spent sitting are numbered, and the breaths you are to take are numbered.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਓਟਾਹਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨੩॥
verses.translit: sadhaa keerat kar naanak har kee ubare satigur charan oTaahaa ||4||1||123||
verses.translation: Sing forever the Praises of the Lord, O Nanak, and you shall be saved, under the Shelter of the Feet of the True Guru. ||4||1||123||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਪੁਸਟ ਬਾਤ ਤੇ ਭਈ ਸੀਧਰੀ ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਟ ਸਜਨਈ ॥
verses.translit: apusaT baat te bhiee seedharee dhoot dhusaT sajaniee ||
verses.translation: That which was upside-down has been set upright; the deadly enemies and adversaries have become friends.

verses.original: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਓ ਮਲੀਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਹਛਨਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhakaar meh ratan pragaasio maleen budh hachhaniee ||1||
verses.translation: In the darkness, the jewel shines forth, and the impure understanding has become pure. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਈ ॥
verses.translit: jau kirapaa gobi(n)dh bhiee ||
verses.translation: When the Lord of the Universe became merciful,

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sukh sa(n)pat har naam fal paae satigur miliee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I found peace, wealth and the fruit of the Lord's Name; I have met the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਕਿਰਪਨ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਨਤ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਈ ॥
verses.translit: moh kirapan kau koi na jaanat sagal bhavan pragaTiee ||
verses.translation: No one knew me, the miserable miser, but now, I have become famous all over the world.

verses.original: ਸੰਗਿ ਬੈਠਨੋ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਪਾਵਤ ਹੁਣਿ ਸਗਲ ਚਰਣ ਸੇਵਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sa(n)g baiThano kahee na paavat hun sagal charan seviee ||2||
verses.translation: Before, no one would even sit with me, but now, all worship my feet. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਢ ਆਢ ਕਉ ਫਿਰਤ ਢੂੰਢਤੇ ਮਨ ਸਗਲ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝਿ ਗਈ ॥
verses.translit: aadd aadd kau firat ddoo(n)ddate man sagal tirasan bujh giee ||
verses.translation: I used to wander in search of pennies, but now, all the desires of my mind are satisfied.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਬੋਲੁ ਭੀ ਖਵਤੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੀਤਲਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ek bol bhee khavato naahee saadhasa(n)gat seetaliee ||3||
verses.translation: I could not bear even one criticism, but now, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I am cooled and soothed. ||3||

verses.original: ਏਕ ਜੀਹ ਗੁਣ ਕਵਨ ਵਖਾਨੈ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮਈ ॥
verses.translit: ek jeeh gun kavan vakhaanai agam agam agamiee ||
verses.translation: What Glorious Virtues of the Inaccessible, Unfathomable, Profound Lord can one mere tongue describe?

verses.original: ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਕੋ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੨੪॥
verses.translit: dhaas dhaas dhaas ko kareeahu jan naanak har saraniee ||4||2||124||
verses.translation: Please, make me the slave of the slave of Your slaves; servant Nanak seeks the Lord's Sanctuary. ||4||2||124||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮੂੜੇ ਲਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਤੂੰ ਢੀਲਾ ਢੀਲਾ ਤੋਟੇ ਕਉ ਬੇਗਿ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: re mooRe laahe kau too(n) ddeelaa ddeelaa toTe kau beg dhaiaa ||
verses.translation: O fool, you are so slow to earn your profits, and so quick to run up losses.

verses.original: ਸਸਤ ਵਖਰੁ ਤੂੰ ਘਿੰਨਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਾਪੀ ਬਾਧਾ ਰੇਨਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sasat vakhar too(n) ghi(n)neh naahee paapee baadhaa renaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: You do not purchase the inexpensive merchandise; O sinner, you are tied to your debts. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur teree aasaiaa ||
verses.translation: O True Guru, You are my only hope.

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮੈ ਏਹਾ ਓਟਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: patit paavan tero naam paarabraham mai ehaa oTaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Your Name is the Purifier of sinners, O Supreme Lord God; You are my only Shelter. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੰਧਣ ਵੈਣ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਉਰਝਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਅਲਕਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ga(n)dhan vain suneh urajhaaveh naam lait alakaiaa ||
verses.translation: Listening to the evil talk, you are caught up in it, but you are hesitant to chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦ ਚਿੰਦ ਕਉ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਮਾਹਿਓ ਬੂਝੀ ਉਲਟਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dh chi(n)dh kau bahut umaahio boojhee ulaTaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: You are delighted by slanderous talk; your understanding is corrupt. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਪਰ ਤੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਅਖਾਧਿ ਖਾਹਿ ਹਰਕਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: par dhan par tan par tee ni(n)dhaa akhaadh khaeh harakaiaa ||
verses.translation: Others' wealth, others' wives and the slander of others - eating the uneatable, you have gone crazy.

verses.original: ਸਾਚ ਧਰਮ ਸਿਉ ਰੁਚਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ਸਤਿ ਸੁਨਤ ਛੋਹਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saach dharam siau ruch nahee aavai sat sunat chhohaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: You have not enshrined love for the True Faith of Dharma; hearing the Truth, you are enraged. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਗਤ ਟੇਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal kirapaal prabh Thaakur bhagat Tek har naiaa ||
verses.translation: O God, Merciful to the meek, Compassionate Lord Master, Your Name is the Support of Your devotees.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਹਿ ਸਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇਓ ਰਾਖੁ ਲਾਜ ਅਪਨਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨੫॥
verses.translit: naanak aaeh saran prabh aaio raakh laaj apanaiaa ||4||3||125||
verses.translation: Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary; O God, make him Your Own, and preserve his honor. ||4||3||125||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla

verses.original: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਪਟਾਏ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਧੇ ॥
verses.translit: mithiaa sa(n)g sa(n)g lapaTaae moh maiaa kar baadhe ||
verses.translation: They are attached to falsehood; clinging to the transitory, they are trapped in emotional attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਜਾਨੋ ਸੋ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਭਏ ਆਂਧੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jeh jaano so cheet na aavai aha(n)budh bhe aa(n)dhe ||1||
verses.translation: Wherever they go, they do not think of the Lord; they are blinded by intellectual egotism. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਕਿਉ ਨ ਅਰਾਧੇ ॥
verses.translit: man bairaagee kiau na araadhe ||
verses.translation: O mind, O renunciate, why don't you adore Him?

verses.original: ਕਾਚ ਕੋਠਰੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਬਸਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਖੈ ਕੀ ਬਿਆਧੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kaach koTharee maeh too(n) basataa sa(n)g sagal bikhai kee biaadhe ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You dwell in that flimsy chamber, with all the sins of corruption. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਪਲੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ ਅਰਜਾਧੇ ॥
verses.translit: meree meree karat dhin rain bihaavai pal khin chheejai arajaadhe ||
verses.translation: Crying out, ""Mine, mine"", your days and nights pass away; moment by moment, your life is running out.

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਮੀਠੈ ਸਾਦਿ ਲੋਭਾਏ ਝੂਠ ਧੰਧਿ ਦੁਰਗਾਧੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jaise meeThai saadh lobhaae jhooTh dha(n)dh dhuragaadhe ||2||
verses.translation: The sweet flavors tempt you, and you are occupied by your false and filthy business. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਰੁ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਇਹ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਰਸਿ ਲਪਟਾਧੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh ar lobh moh ieh i(n)dhree ras lapaTaadhe ||
verses.translation: Your senses are beguiled by sensual pleasures of sex, by anger, greed and emotional attachment.

verses.original: ਦੀਈ ਭਵਾਰੀ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਬਿਧਾਤੈ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਜਨਮਾਧੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dheeiee bhavaaree purakh bidhaatai bahur bahur janamaadhe ||3||
verses.translation: The All-powerful Architect of Destiny has ordained that you shall be reincarnated over and over again. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਉ ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਤਉ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਲਾਧੇ ॥
verses.translit: jau bhio kirapaal dheen dhukh bha(n)jan tau gur mil sabh sukh laadhe ||
verses.translation: When the Destroyer of the pains of the poor becomes merciful, then, as Gurmukh, you shall find absolute peace.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਧਿਆਵਉ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਾਢੀ ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਧੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak dhin rain dhiaavau maar kaaddee sagal upaadhe ||4||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, meditate on the Lord, day and night, and all your sickness shall be banished. ||4||

verses.original: ਇਉ ਜਪਿਓ ਭਾਈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: eiau japio bhaiee purakh bidhaate ||
verses.translation: Meditate in this way, O Siblings of Destiny, on the Lord, the Architect of Destiny.

verses.original: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੨੬॥
verses.translit: bhio kirapaal dheen dhukh bha(n)jan janam maran dhukh laathe ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||4||4||126||
verses.translation: The Destroyer of the pains of the poor has become merciful; He has removed the pains of birth and death. ||1||Second Pause||4||4||126||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਿਮਖ ਕਾਮ ਸੁਆਦ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਦਿਨਸ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: nimakh kaam suaadh kaaran koT dhinas dhukh paaveh ||
verses.translation: For a moment of sexual pleasure, you shall suffer in pain for millions of days.

verses.original: ਘਰੀ ਮੁਹਤ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gharee muhat ra(n)g maaneh fir bahur bahur pachhutaaveh ||1||
verses.translation: For an instant, you may savor pleasure, but afterwards, you shall regret it, again and again. ||1||

verses.original: ਅੰਧੇ ਚੇਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhe chet har har raiaa ||
verses.translation: O blind man, meditate on the Lord, the Lord, your King.

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: teraa so dhin neRai aaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Your day is drawing near. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਲਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲੋ ਆਕ ਨੀਮ ਕੋ ਤੂੰਮਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: palak dhirasaT dhekh bhoolo aak neem ko too(n)mar ||
verses.translation: You are deceived, beholding with your eyes, the bitter melon and swallow-wort.

verses.original: ਜੈਸਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਬਿਸੀਅਰ ਸਿਉ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਇਹੁ ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jaisaa sa(n)g biseear siau hai re taiso hee ih par girahu ||2||
verses.translation: But, like the companionship of a poisonous snake, so is the desire for another's spouse. ||2||

verses.original: ਬੈਰੀ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਤਾ ਬਸਤੁ ਰਹੀ ਅਮਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: bairee kaaran paap karataa basat rahee amaanaa ||
verses.translation: For the sake of your enemy, you commit sins, while you neglect the reality of your faith.

verses.original: ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੀ ਸਾਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਬੈਰਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: chhodd jaeh tin hee siau sa(n)gee saajan siau bairaanaa ||3||
verses.translation: Your friendship is with those who abandon you, and you are angry with your friends. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਇਹੈ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਓ ਸੋ ਉਬਰਿਓ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sagal sa(n)saar ihai bidh biaapio so ubario jis gur pooraa ||
verses.translation: The entire world is entangled in this way; he alone is saved, who has the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਓ ਭਏ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੨੭॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak bhav saagar tario bhe puneet sareeraa ||4||5||127||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I have crossed over the terrifying world-ocean; my body has become sanctified. ||4||5||127||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa dhupadhe ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla Dho-Padhay:

verses.original: ਲੂਕਿ ਕਮਾਨੋ ਸੋਈ ਤੁਮੑ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਮੁਕਰਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: look kamaano soiee tum(h) pekhio mooR mugadh mukaraanee ||
verses.translation: O Lord, You behold whatever we do in secrecy; the fool may stubbornly deny it.

verses.original: ਆਪ ਕਮਾਨੇ ਕਉ ਲੇ ਬਾਂਧੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aap kamaane kau le baa(n)dhe fir paachhai pachhutaanee ||1||
verses.translation: By his own actions, he is tied down, and in the end, he regrets and repents. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: prabh mere sabh bidh aagai jaanee ||
verses.translation: My God knows, ahead of time, all things.

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੇ ਮੂਸੇ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਤ ਪਰਦਾ ਪਾਛੈ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhram ke moose too(n) raakhat paradhaa paachhai jeea kee maanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Deceived by doubt, you may hide your actions, but in the end, you shall have to confess the secrets of your mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਰੈ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: jit jit laae tit tit laage kiaa ko karai paraanee ||
verses.translation: Whatever they are attached to, they remain joined to that. What can any mere mortal do?

verses.original: ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੨੮॥
verses.translit: bakhas laih paarabraham suaamee naanak sadh kurabaanee ||2||6||128||
verses.translation: Please, forgive me, O Supreme Lord Master. Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||2||6||128||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: apune sevak kee aape raakhai aape naam japaavai ||
verses.translation: He Himself preserves His servants; He causes them to chant His Name.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਕਾਜ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਤਹਾ ਤਹਾ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jeh jeh kaaj kirat sevak kee tahaa tahaa uTh dhaavai ||1||
verses.translation: Wherever the business and affairs of His servants are, there the Lord hurries to be. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਨਿਕਟੀ ਹੋਇ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sevak kau nikaTee hoi dhikhaavai ||
verses.translation: The Lord appears near at hand to His servant.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਤਤਕਾਲ ਹੋਇ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo jo kahai Thaakur peh sevak tatakaal hoi aavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whatever the servant asks of his Lord and Master, immediately comes to pass. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜੋ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: tis sevak kai hau balihaaree jo apane prabh bhaavai ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to that servant, who is pleasing to his God.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੋਇ ਸੁਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਸਣਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੨੯॥
verses.translit: tis kee soi sunee man hariaa tis naanak parasan aavai ||2||7||129||
verses.translation: Hearing of his glory, the mind is rejuvenated; Nanak comes to touch his feet. ||2||7||129||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੧੧ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
verses.translit: aasaa ghar gayaarvaa mahalaa panjavaa
verses.translation: Aasaa, Eleventh House, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਨਟੂਆ ਭੇਖ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜੈਸਾ ਹੈ ਓਹੁ ਤੈਸਾ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: naTooaa bhekh dhikhaavai bahu bidh jaisaa hai oh taisaa re ||
verses.translation: The actor displays himself in many disguises, but he remains just as he is.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸੁਖਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਰਵੇਸਾ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anik jon bhramio bhram bheetar sukheh naahee paravesaa re ||1||
verses.translation: The soul wanders through countless incarnations in doubt, but it does not come to dwell in peace. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਨੀਤਾ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: saajan sa(n)t hamaare meetaa bin har har aaneetaa re ||
verses.translation: O Saints, my friends and companions, without the Lord, Har, Har, you shall perish.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਇਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੀਤਾ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g mil har gun gaae ih janam padhaarath jeetaa re ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and win this precious treasure of human life. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਤਰੀਐ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: trai gun maiaa braham kee keen(h)ee kahahu kavan bidh tareeaai re ||
verses.translation: God has created Maya of the three qualities; tell me, how can it be crossed over?

verses.original: ਘੂਮਨ ਘੇਰ ਅਗਾਹ ਗਾਖਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੀਐ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ghooman gher agaeh gaakharee gur sabadhee paar utareeaai re ||2||
verses.translation: The whirlpool is awesome and unfathomable; only through the Word of the Guru's Shabad is one carried across. ||2||

verses.original: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਤਤੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਜਾਨਾ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: khojat khojat khoj beechaario tat naanak ih jaanaa re ||
verses.translation: Searching and searching endlessly, seeking and deliberating, Nanak has realized the true essence of reality.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਪਤੀਆਨਾ ਰੇ ॥੩॥੧॥੧੩੦॥
verses.translit: simarat naam nidhaan niramolak man maanak pateeaanaa re ||3||1||130||
verses.translation: Meditating on the invaluable treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the jewel of the mind is satisfied. ||3||1||130||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa dhupadhe ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Dho-Padhay:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਜੋ ਮਾਗਉ ਸੋ ਪਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh merai man vasiaa jo maagau so paavau re ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, He dwells within my mind; whatever I ask for, I receive.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨਾ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਧਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam ra(n)g ih man tirapataanaa bahur na katahoo(n) dhaavau re ||1||
verses.translation: This mind is satisfied with the Love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; it does not go out, anywhere, anymore. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਮਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: hamaraa Thaakur sabh te uoochaa rain dhinas tis gaavau re ||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master is the highest of all; night and day, I sing the Glories of His Praises.

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰਾ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਡਰਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: khin meh thaap uthaapanahaaraa tis te tujheh ddaraavau re ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes; through Him, I frighten you. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਦੇਖਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਉ ਅਵਰਹਿ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jab dhekhau prabh apunaa suaamee tau avareh cheet na paavau re ||
verses.translation: When I behold my God, my Lord and Master, I do not pay any attention to any other.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਪਹਿਰਾਇਆ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਮੇਟਿ ਲਿਖਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੩੧॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas prabh aap pahiraiaa bhram bhau meT likhaavau re ||2||2||131||
verses.translation: God Himself has adorned servant Nanak; his doubts and fears have been dispelled, and he writes the account of the Lord. ||2||2||131||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਚਾਰਿ ਬਰਨ ਚਉਹਾ ਕੇ ਮਰਦਨ ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਰ ਤਲੀ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: chaar baran chauhaa ke maradhan khaT dharasan kar talee re ||
verses.translation: The four castes and social classes, and the preachers with the six Shaastras on their finger-tips,

verses.original: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁਘਰ ਸਰੂਪ ਸਿਆਨੇ ਪੰਚਹੁ ਹੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਛਲੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: su(n)dhar sughar saroop siaane pa(n)chahu hee moh chhalee re ||1||
verses.translation: the beautiful, the refined, the shapely and the wise - the five passions have enticed and beguiled them all. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਪੰਚ ਸੂਰਬੀਰ ਐਸੋ ਕਉਨੁ ਬਲੀ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jin mil maare pa(n)ch soorabeer aaiso kaun balee re ||
verses.translation: Who has seized and conquered the five powerful fighters? Is there anyone strong enough?

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਪੰਚ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਿਦਾਰਿ ਗੁਦਾਰੇ ਸੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਇਹ ਕਲੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin pa(n)ch maar bidhaar gudhaare so pooraa ieh kalee re ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He alone, who conquers and defeats the five demons, is perfect in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਵਡੀ ਕੋਮ ਵਸਿ ਭਾਗਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੁਹਕਮ ਫਉਜ ਹਠਲੀ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: vaddee kom vas bhaageh naahee muhakam fauj haThalee re ||
verses.translation: They are so awesome and great; they cannot be controlled, and they do not run away. Their army is mighty and unyielding.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਨਿਰਦਲਿਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਝਲੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੩੨॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak tin jan niradhaliaa saadhasa(n)gat kai jhalee re ||2||3||132||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, that humble being who is under the protection of the Saadh Sangat, crushes those terrible demons. ||2||3||132||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨੀਕੀ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਊਤਮ ਆਨ ਸਗਲ ਰਸ ਫੀਕੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: neekee jeea kee har kathaa uootam aan sagal ras feekee re ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Sublime Sermon of the Lord is the best thing for the soul. All other tastes are insipid. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਗੁਨਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਖਟੁ ਬੇਤੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਿਛੁ ਲਾਈਕੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bahu gun dhun mun jan khaT bete avar na kichh laieekee re ||1||
verses.translation: The worthy beings, heavenly singers, silent sages and the knowers of the six Shaastras proclaim that nothing else is worthy of consideration. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਖਾਰੀ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ਅਪਾਰੀ ਸਹਜਾਰੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੀਕੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੩੩॥
verses.translit: bikhaaree niraaree apaaree sahajaaree saadhasa(n)g naanak peekee re ||2||4||133||
verses.translation: It is the cure for evil passions, unique, unequalled and peace-giving; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, drink it in. ||2||4||133||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਮਾਰੀ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਟਾਰੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hamaaree piaaree a(n)mirat dhaaree gur nimakh na man te Taaree re ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My Beloved has brought forth a river of nectar. The Guru has not held it back from my mind, even for an instant. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨ ਪਰਸਨ ਸਰਸਨ ਹਰਸਨ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗੀ ਕਰਤਾਰੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dharasan parasan sarasan harasan ra(n)g ra(n)gee karataaree re ||1||
verses.translation: Beholding it, and touching it, I am sweetened and delighted. It is imbued with the Creator's Love. ||1||

verses.original: ਖਿਨੁ ਰਮ ਗੁਰ ਗਮ ਹਰਿ ਦਮ ਨਹ ਜਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਰਿ ਹਾਰੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੩੪॥
verses.translit: khin ram gur gam har dham neh jam har ka(n)Th naanak ur haaree re ||2||5||134||
verses.translation: Chanting it even for a moment, I rise to the Guru; meditating on it, one is not trapped by the Messenger of Death. The Lord has placed it as a garland around Nanak's neck, and within his heart. ||2||5||134||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨੀਕੀ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਾਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: neekee saadh sa(n)gaanee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is exalted and sublime. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਹਰ ਮੂਰਤ ਪਲ ਗਾਵਤ ਗਾਵਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਵਖਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pahar moorat pal gaavat gaavat govi(n)dh govi(n)dh vakhaanee ||1||
verses.translation: Every day, hour and moment, I continually sing and speak of Govind, Govind, the Lord of the Universe. ||1||

verses.original: ਚਾਲਤ ਬੈਸਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਚਰਨ ਖਟਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: chaalat baisat sovat har jas man tan charan khaTaanee ||2||
verses.translation: Walking, sitting and sleeping, I chant the Lord's Praises; I treasure His Feet in my mind and body. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਂਉ ਹਉਰੋ ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਗਉਰੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥੩॥੬॥੧੩੫॥
verses.translit: ha(n)au hauro too Thaakur gauro naanak saran pachhaanee ||3||6||135||
verses.translation: I am so small, and You are so great, O Lord and Master; Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||3||6||135||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੨
verses.translit: raag aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ghar baarvaa
verses.translation: Raag Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Twelfth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਆਨਪਾ ਭਜੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: tiaag sagal siaanapaa bhaj paarabraham nira(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: Renounce all your cleverness and remember the Supreme, Formless Lord God.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਗਲ ਦੀਸੈ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ek saache naam baajhahu sagal dheesai chhaar ||1||
verses.translation: Without the One True Name, everything appears as dust. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਦ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: so prabh jaaneeaai sadh sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: Know that God is always with you.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਏਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadhee boojheeaai ek har kai ra(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, one understands, and is imbued with the Love of the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਏਕ ਕੇਰੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saran samarath ek keree dhoojaa naahee Thaau ||
verses.translation: Seek the Shelter of the One All-powerful Lord; there is no other place of rest.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਲੰਘੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mahaa bhaujal la(n)gheeaai sadhaa har gun gaau ||2||
verses.translation: The vast and terrifying world-ocean is crossed over, singing continually the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran nivaareeaai dhukh na jam pur hoi ||
verses.translation: Birth and death are overcome, and one does not have to suffer in the City of Death.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naam nidhaan soiee paae kirapaa kare prabh soi ||3||
verses.translation: He alone obtains the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, unto whom God shows His Mercy. ||3||

verses.original: ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਏਕੋ ਏਕ ਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ek Tek adhaar eko ek kaa man jor ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is my Anchor and Support; the One Lord alone is the power of my mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪੀਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਰੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੩੬॥
verses.translit: naanak japeeaai mil saadhasa(n)gat har bin avar na hor ||4||1||136||
verses.translation: O Nanak, joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate on Him; without the Lord, there is no other at all. ||4||1||136||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਦੀਏ ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau man tan praan prabh ke dhe'ee sabh ras bhog ||
verses.translation: The soul, the mind, the body and the breath of life belong to God. He has given all tastes and pleasures.

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਬੰਧਪ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਰਣਿ ਰਾਖਣ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dheen ba(n)dhap jeea dhaataa saran raakhan jog ||1||
verses.translation: He is the Friend of the poor, the Giver of life, the Protector of those who seek His Sanctuary. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mere man dhiaai har har naau ||
verses.translation: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸਹਾਇ ਸੰਗੇ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: halat palat sahai sa(n)ge ek siau liv laau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Here and hereafter, He is our Helper and Companion; embrace love and affection for the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਜਨ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤਰਣ ਕਉ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bedh saasatr jan dhiaaveh taran kau sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: They meditate on the Vedas and the Shaastras, to swim across the world-ocean.

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: karam dharam anek kiriaa sabh uoopar naam achaar ||2||
verses.translation: The many religious rituals, good deeds of karma and Dharmic worship - above all of these is the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh aha(n)kaar binasai milai satigur dhev ||
verses.translation: Sexual desire, anger, and egotism depart, meeting with the Divine True Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naam dhiraR kar bhagat har kee bhalee prabh kee sev ||3||
verses.translation: Implant the Naam within, perform devotional worship to the Lord and serve God - this is good. ||3||

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਦਇਆਲ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂੰ ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: charan saran dhiaal teree too(n) nimaane maan ||
verses.translation: I seek the Sanctuary of Your Feet, O Merciful Lord; You are the Honor of the dishonored.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੩੭॥
verses.translit: jeea praan adhaar teraa naanak kaa prabh taan ||4||2||137||
verses.translation: You are the Support of my soul, my breath of life; O God, You are Nanak's strength. ||4||2||137||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਡੋਲਿ ਡੋਲਿ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ॥
verses.translit: ddol ddol mahaa dhukh paiaa binaa saadhoo sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: He wavers and falters, and suffers such great pain, without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਖਾਟਿ ਲਾਭੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਇਕ ਰੰਗ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: khaaT laabh gobi(n)dh har ras paarabraham ik ra(n)g ||1||
verses.translation: The profit of the sublime essence of the Lord of the Universe is obtained, by the Love of the One Supreme Lord God. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਨੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: har ko naam japeeaai neet ||
verses.translation: Chant continually the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਅਵਰ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saas saas dhiaai so prabh tiaag avar pareet ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: With each and every breath, meditate on God, and renounce other love. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: karan kaaran samarath so prabh jeea dhaataa aap ||
verses.translation: God is the Doer, the All-powerful Cause of causes; He Himself is the Giver of life.

verses.original: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tiaag sagal siaanapaa aaTh pahar prabh jaap ||2||
verses.translation: So renounce all your cleverness, and meditate on God, twenty-four hours a day. ||2||

verses.original: ਮੀਤੁ ਸਖਾ ਸਹਾਇ ਸੰਗੀ ਊਚ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: meet sakhaa sahai sa(n)gee uooch agam apaar ||
verses.translation: He is our best friend and companion, our help and support; He is lofty, inaccessible and infinite.

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਬਸਾਇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜੀਅ ਕੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: charan kamal basai hiradhai jeea ko aadhaar ||3||
verses.translation: Enshrine His Lotus Feet within your heart; He is the Support of the soul. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa prabh paarabraham gun teraa jas gaau ||
verses.translation: Show Your Mercy, O Supreme Lord God, that I may sing Your Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੩੮॥
verses.translit: sarab sookh vaddee vaddiaaiee jap jeevai naanak naau ||4||3||138||
verses.translation: Total peace, and the greatest greatness, O Nanak, are obtained by living to chant the Name of the Lord. ||4||3||138||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਉ ਕਰਾਵਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪੇਖਤ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: audham karau karaavahu Thaakur pekhat saadhoo sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: I make the effort, as You cause me to do, my Lord and Master, to behold You in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਰਾਵਹੁ ਰੰਗਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har har naam charaavahu ra(n)gan aape hee prabh ra(n)g ||1||
verses.translation: I am imbued with the color of the Love of the Lord, Har, Har; God Himself has colored me in His Love. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: man meh raam naamaa jaap ||
verses.translation: I chant the Lord's Name within my mind.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਵਸਹੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹੋਇ ਸਹਾਈ ਆਪਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa vasahu merai hiradhai hoi sahaiee aap ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Bestow Your Mercy, and dwell within my heart; please, become my Helper. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੇਖਨ ਕਾ ਚਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sun sun naam tumaaraa preetam prabh pekhan kaa chaau ||
verses.translation: Listening continually to Your Name, O Beloved God, I yearn to behold You.

verses.original: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਮ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਇਹੈ ਮਨੋਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhiaa karahu kiram apune kau ihai manorath suaau ||2||
verses.translation: Please, be kind to me - I am just a worm. This is my object and purpose. ||2||

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਮਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: tan dhan teraa too(n) prabh meraa hamarai vas kichh naeh ||
verses.translation: My body and wealth are Yours; You are my God - nothing is in my power.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਣਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਦੀਆ ਖਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jiau jiau raakheh tiau tiau rahanaa teraa dheeaa khaeh ||3||
verses.translation: As You keep me, so do I live; I eat what You give me. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟੈ ਮਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: janam janam ke kilavikh kaaTai majan har jan dhoor ||
verses.translation: The sins of countless incarnations are washed away, by bathing in the dust of the Lord's humble servants.

verses.original: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਨਾਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੩੯॥
verses.translit: bhai bhagat bharam bhau naasai har naanak sadhaa hajoor ||4||4||139||
verses.translation: By loving devotional worship, doubt and fear depart; O Nanak, the Lord is Ever-present. ||4||4||139||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: agam agochar dharas teraa so paae jis masatak bhaag ||
verses.translation: The Blessed Vision of Your Darshan is unapproachable and incomprehensible; he alone obtains it, who has such good destiny recorded upon his forehead.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aap kirapaal kirapaa prabh dhaaree satigur bakhasiaa har naam ||1||
verses.translation: The Merciful Lord God has bestowed His Mercy, and the True Guru has granted the Lord's Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਲਿਜੁਗੁ ਉਧਾਰਿਆ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: kalijug udhaariaa gurdhev ||
verses.translation: The Divine Guru is the Saving Grace in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

verses.original: ਮਲ ਮੂਤ ਮੂੜ ਜਿ ਮੁਘਦ ਹੋਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਲਗੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mal moot mooR j mughadh hote sabh lage teree sev ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Even those fools and idiots, stained with feces and urine, have all taken to Your service. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: too aap karataa sabh sirasaT dharataa sabh meh rahiaa samai ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the Creator, who established the entire world. You are contained in all.

verses.original: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਜਾ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਭ ਪਈ ਪੈਰੀ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dharam raajaa bisamaadh hoaa sabh piee pairee aai ||2||
verses.translation: The Righteous Judge of Dharma is wonder-struck, at the sight of everyone falling at the Lord's Feet. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤਜੁਗੁ ਤ੍ਰੇਤਾ ਦੁਆਪਰੁ ਭਣੀਐ ਕਲਿਜੁਗੁ ਊਤਮੋ ਜੁਗਾ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: satajug tretaa dhuaapar bhaneeaai kalijug uootamo jugaa maeh ||
verses.translation: The Golden Age of Sat Yuga, the Silver Age of Trayta Yuga, and the Brass Age of Dwaapar Yuga are good; but the best is the Dark Age, the Iron Age, of Kali Yuga.

verses.original: ਅਹਿ ਕਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਅਹਿ ਕਰੁ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਪਕੜੀਐ ਕਿਸੈ ਥਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: eh kar kare su eh kar paae koiee na pakaReeaai kisai thai ||3||
verses.translation: As we act, so are the rewards we receive; no one can take the place of another. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿ ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਏਹੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau soiee kareh j bhagat tere jaacheh eh teraa biradh ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, whatever Your devotees ask for, You do. This is Your Way, Your very nature.

verses.original: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਨੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਅਪਣਿਆ ਸੰਤਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੪੦॥
verses.translit: kar joR naanak dhaan maagai apaniaa sa(n)taa dheh har dharas ||4||5||140||
verses.translation: With my palms pressed together, O Nanak, I beg for this gift; Lord, please bless Your Saints with Your Vision. ||4||5||140||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੩
verses.translit: raag aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ghar tayrvaa
verses.translation: Raag Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Thirteenth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur bachan tum(h)aare ||
verses.translation: O True Guru, by Your Words,

verses.original: ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: niragun nisataare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: even the worthless have been saved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਾਦੀ ਦੁਸਟ ਅਪਵਾਦੀ ਤੇ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਸੰਗਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mahaa bikhaadhee dhusaT apavaadhee te puneet sa(n)gaare ||1||
verses.translation: Even the most argumentative, vicious and indecent people, have been purified in Your company. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਭਵੰਤੇ ਨਰਕਿ ਪੜੰਤੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੇ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: janam bhava(n)te narak paRa(n)te tin(h) ke kul udhaare ||2||
verses.translation: Those who have wandered in reincarnation, and those who have been consigned to hell - even their families have been redeemed. ||2||

verses.original: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਸੇ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: koi na jaanai koi na maanai se paragaT har dhuaare ||3||
verses.translation: Those whom no one knew, and those whom no one respected - even they have become famous and respected at the Court of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਉਪਮਾ ਦੇਉ ਕਵਨ ਵਡਾਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਵਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੪੧॥
verses.translit: kavan upamaa dheau kavan vaddaiee naanak khin khin vaare ||4||1||141||
verses.translation: What praise, and what greatness should I attribute to You? Nanak is a sacrifice to You, each and every moment. ||4||1||141||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਾਵਰ ਸੋਇ ਰਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: baavar soi rahe ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The crazy people are asleep. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੋਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਬਿਖੈ ਰਸ ਮਾਤੇ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਗਹਨ ਗਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: moh kuTa(n)b bikhai ras maate mithiaa gahan gahe ||1||
verses.translation: They are intoxicated with attachment to their families and sensory pleasures; they are held in the grip of falsehood. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਿਥਨ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਸੁਪਨ ਆਨੰਦ ਉਲਾਸ ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mithan manorath supan aana(n)dh ulaas man mukh sat kahe ||2||
verses.translation: The false desires, and the dream-like delights and pleasures - these, the self-willed manmukhs call true. ||2||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਤਿਲੁ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਲਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit naam padhaarath sa(n)ge til maram na lahe ||3||
verses.translation: The wealth of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is with them, but they do not find even a tiny bit of its mystery. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖੇ ਸਤਸੰਗੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਆਹੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੪੨॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa raakhe satasa(n)ge naanak saran aahe ||4||2||142||
verses.translation: By Your Grace, O Lord, You save those, who take to the Sanctuary of the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||4||2||142||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਤਿਪਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa tipadhe ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Thi-Padhay:

verses.original: ਓਹਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ohaa prem piree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I seek the Love of my Beloved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਨਿਕ ਮਾਣਿਕ ਗਜ ਮੋਤੀਅਨ ਲਾਲਨ ਨਹ ਨਾਹ ਨਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kanik maanik gaj moteean laalan neh naeh nahee ||1||
verses.translation: Gold, jewels, giant pearls and rubies - I have no need for them. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਜ ਨ ਭਾਗ ਨ ਹੁਕਮ ਨ ਸਾਦਨ ॥
verses.translit: raaj na bhaag na hukam na saadhan ||
verses.translation: Imperial power, fortunes, royal command and mansions

verses.original: ਕਿਛੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਚਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kichh kichh na chaahee ||2||
verses.translation: - I have no desire for these. ||2||

verses.original: ਚਰਨਨ ਸਰਨਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਬੰਦਨ ॥
verses.translit: charanan saranan sa(n)tan ba(n)dhan ||
verses.translation: The Sanctuary of the Lord's Feet, and dedication to the Saints

verses.original: ਸੁਖੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: sukho sukh paahee ||
verses.translation: these bring me peace and pleasure.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਪਤਿ ਹਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: naanak tapat haree ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, my burning fire has been put out,

verses.translit: mile prem piree ||3||3||143||
verses.translation: obtaining the Love of the Beloved. ||3||3||143||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ਲੋਇਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gureh dhikhaio loinaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Guru has revealed Him to my eyes. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਈਤਹਿ ਊਤਹਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਮੋਹਿਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: e'eeteh uooteh ghaT ghaT ghaT ghaT too(n)hee too(n)hee mohinaa ||1||
verses.translation: Here and there, in each and every heart, and each and every being, You, O Fascinating Lord, You exist. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨਾ ਧਾਰਨ ਧਰਨਾ ਏਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਸੋਹਿਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kaaran karanaa dhaaran dharanaa ekai ekai sohinaa ||2||
verses.translation: You are the Creator, the Cause of causes, the Support of the earth; You are the One and only, Beauteous Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਨ ਪਰਸਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਦਰਸਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਇਨਾ ॥੩॥੪॥੧੪੪॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tan parasan balihaaree dharasan naanak sukh sukh soinaa ||3||4||144||
verses.translation: Meeting the Saints, and beholding the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, Nanak is a sacrifice to them; he sleeps in absolute peace. ||3||4||144||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam amolaa ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is priceless.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: oh sahaj suhelaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: It brings peace and poise. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਓਹੁ ਅਗਹ ਅਤੋਲਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)g sahaiee chhodd na jaiee oh ageh atolaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord is my Companion and Helper; He shall not forsake me or leave me. He is unfathomable and unequalled. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਭਾਈ ਬਾਪੁ ਮੋਰੋ ਮਾਈ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਓਲੑਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: preetam bhaiee baap moro maiee bhagatan kaa ol(h)aa ||2||
verses.translation: He is my Beloved, my brother, father and mother; He is the Support of His devotees. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਚੋਲੑਾ ॥੩॥੫॥੧੪੫॥
verses.translit: alakh lakhaiaa gur te paiaa naanak ih har kaa chol(h)aa ||3||5||145||
verses.translation: The Invisible Lord is seen through the Guru; O Nanak, this is the wondrous play of the Lord. ||3||5||145||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪੁਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਬਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: aapunee bhagat nibaeh ||
verses.translation: Please help me sustain my devotion.

verses.original: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਆਇਓ ਆਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: Thaakur aaio aaeh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Lord Master, I have come to You. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਕਾਰਥੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਚਰਨ ਬਸਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam padhaarath hoi sakaarath hiradhai charan basaeh ||1||
verses.translation: With the wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, life becomes fruitful. Lord, please place Your Feet within my heart. ||1||

verses.original: ਏਹ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਏਹ ਜੁਗਤਾ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: eh mukataa eh jugataa raakhahu sa(n)t sa(n)gaeh ||2||
verses.translation: This is liberation, and this is the best way of life; please, keep me in the Society of the Saints. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਹਿ ॥੩॥੬॥੧੪੬॥
verses.translit: naam dhiaavau sahaj samaavau naanak har gun gaeh ||3||6||146||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Naam, I am absorbed in celestial peace; O Nanak, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||6||146||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ॥
verses.translit: Thaakur charan suhaave ||
verses.translation: The Feet of my Lord and Master are so Beautiful!

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਪਾਵੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har sa(n)tan paave ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Saints obtain them. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਇਆ ਗੁਨ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਗਾਵੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aap gavaiaa sev kamaiaa gun ras ras gaave ||1||
verses.translation: They eradicate their self-conceit and serve the Lord; drenched in His Love, they sing His Glorious Praises. ||1||

verses.original: ਏਕਹਿ ਆਸਾ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਆਨ ਨ ਭਾਵੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ekeh aasaa dharas piaasaa aan na bhaave ||2||
verses.translation: They place their hopes in Him, and they thirst for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. Nothing else is pleasing to them. ||2||

verses.original: ਦਇਆ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ਕਿਆ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵੇ ॥੩॥੭॥੧੪੭॥
verses.translit: dhiaa tuhaaree kiaa ja(n)t vichaaree naanak bal bal jaave ||3||7||147||
verses.translation: This is Your Mercy, Lord; what can Your poor creatures do? Nanak is devoted, a sacrifice to You. ||3||7||147||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ek simar man maahee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Remember the One Lord in meditation within your mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam dhiaavahu ridhai basaavahu tis bin ko naahee ||1||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and enshrine Him within your heart. Without Him there is no other. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨੀ ਆਈਐ ਸਰਬ ਫਲ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: prabh saranee aaieeaai sarab fal paieeaai sagale dhukh jaahee ||2||
verses.translation: Entering God's Sanctuary, all rewards are obtained, and all pains are taken away. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੀਅਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਆਹੀ ॥੩॥੮॥੧੪੮॥
verses.translit: jeean ko dhaataa purakh bidhaataa naanak ghaT ghaT aahee ||3||8||148||
verses.translation: He is the Giver of all beings, the Architect of Destiny; O Nanak, He is contained in each and every heart. ||3||8||148||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਸੋ ਮੂਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har bisarat so mooaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: One who forgets the Lord is dead. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਸਰਬ ਫਲ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਹੂਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam dhiaavai sarab fal paavai so jan sukheeaa hooaa ||1||
verses.translation: One who meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, obtains all rewards. That person becomes happy. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਜੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਹਉ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਨਲਿਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਸੂਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: raaj kahaavai hau karam kamaavai baadhio nalinee bhram sooaa ||2||
verses.translation: One who calls himself a king, and acts in ego and pride, is caught by his doubts, like a parrot in a trap. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੩॥੯॥੧੪੯॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak jis satigur bheTiaa so jan nihachal theeaa ||3||9||149||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, one who meets the True Guru, becomes permanent and immortal. ||3||9||149||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੪
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ghar chaudavaa
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Fourteenth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਨੇਹੁ ਨਵੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: oh neh navelaa ||
verses.translation: That love is forever fresh and new,

verses.original: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: apune preetam siau laag rahai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: which is for the Beloved Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo prabh bhaavai janam na aavai ||
verses.translation: One who is pleasing to God shall not be reincarnated again.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਚੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har prem bhagat har preet rachai ||1||
verses.translation: He remains absorbed in the loving devotional worship of the Lord, in the Love of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh sa(n)g mileejai ih man dheejai ||
verses.translation: He is blended with God, by dedicating his mind to Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਅਪਨੀ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੫੦॥
verses.translit: naanak naam milai apanee dhiaa karahu ||2||1||150||
verses.translation: Bless Nanak with Your Name, O Lord - please, shower Your Mercy upon him! ||2||1||150||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਿਲੁ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੁਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਕੋ ਨ ਕਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mil raam piaare tum bin dheeraj ko na karai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Please, come to me, O Beloved Lord; without You, no one can comfort me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਦਰਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: si(n)mirat saasatr bahu karam kamaae prabh tumare dharas bin sukh naahee ||1||
verses.translation: One may read the Simritees and the Shaastras, and perform all sorts of religious rituals; and yet, without the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, God, there is no peace at all. ||1||

verses.original: ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਸਰਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਵਸੈ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੫੧॥
verses.translit: varat nem sa(n)jam kar thaake naanak saadh saran prabh sa(n)g vasai ||2||2||151||
verses.translation: People have grown weary of observing fasts, vows and rigorous self-discipline; Nanak abides with God, in the Sanctuary of the Saints. ||2||2||151||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੫ ਪੜਤਾਲ
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ghar pandaravaa paRataal
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Fifteenth House, Partaal:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਦਿ ਸੋਇਓ ਸੂਝ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: bikaar maiaa maadh soio soojh boojh na aavai ||
verses.translation: He sleeps, intoxicated by corruption and Maya; he does not come to realize or understand.

verses.original: ਪਕਰਿ ਕੇਸ ਜਮਿ ਉਠਾਰਿਓ ਤਦ ਹੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pakar kes jam uThaario tadh hee ghar jaavai ||1||
verses.translation: Seizing him by the hair, the Messenger of Death pulls him up; then, he comes to his senses. ||1||

verses.original: ਲੋਭ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਖੈ ਲਾਗੇ ਹਿਰਿ ਵਿਤ ਚਿਤ ਦੁਖਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: lobh bikhiaa bikhai laage hir vit chit dhukhaahee ||
verses.translation: Those who are attached to the poison of greed and sin grab at the wealth of others; they only bring pain on themselves.

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਭੰਗੁਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਾਨਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਅਸੁਰ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: khin bha(n)gunaa kai maan maate asur jaaneh naahee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: They are intoxicated by their pride in those things which shall be destroyed in an instant; those demons do not understand. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਜਨ ਪੁਕਾਰਹਿ ਸੁਨੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਡੋਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bedh saasatr jan pukaareh sunai naahee ddoraa ||
verses.translation: The Vedas, the Shaastras and the holy men proclaim it, but the deaf do not hear it.

verses.original: ਨਿਪਟਿ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰਿ ਮੂਕਾ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਓ ਮਨਿ ਭੋਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: nipaT baajee haar mookaa pachhutaio man bhoraa ||2||
verses.translation: When the game of life is over, and he has lost, and he breathes his last, then the fool regrets and repents in his mind. ||2||

verses.original: ਡਾਨੁ ਸਗਲ ਗੈਰ ਵਜਹਿ ਭਰਿਆ ਦੀਵਾਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਨ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: ddaan sagal gair vajeh bhariaa dheevaan lekhai na pariaa ||
verses.translation: He paid the fine, but it is in vain - in the Court of the Lord, his account is not credited.

verses.original: ਜੇਂਹ ਕਾਰਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਓਲੑਾ ਸੋਇ ਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: je(n)h kaaraj rahai ol(h)aa soi kaam na kariaa ||3||
verses.translation: Those deeds which would have covered him - those deeds, he has not done. ||3||

verses.original: ਐਸੋ ਜਗੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ਤਉ ਏਕ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aaiso jag moh gur dhikhaio tau ek keerat gaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru has shown me the world to be thus; I sing the Kirtan of the Praises of the One Lord.

verses.original: ਮਾਨੁ ਤਾਨੁ ਤਜਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫੨॥
verses.translit: maan taan taj siaanap saran naanak aaiaa ||4||1||152||
verses.translation: Renouncing his pride in strength and cleverness, Nanak has come to the Lord's Sanctuary. ||4||1||152||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਾਪਾਰਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਨਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: baapaar govi(n)dh naae ||
verses.translation: Dealing in the Name of the Lord of the Universe,

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤ ਮਨਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਪੰਚ ਨਾਦ ਤੂਰ ਬਜਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saadh sa(n)t manaae pria paae gun gaae pa(n)ch naadh toor bajaae ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: and pleasing the Saints and holy men, obtain the Beloved Lord and sing His Glorious Praises; play the sound current of the Naad with the five instruments. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਏ ਸਹਜਾਏ ਦਰਸਾਏ ਅਬ ਰਾਤਿਆ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਸਿਉ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa paae sahajaae dharasaae ab raatiaa govi(n)dh siau ||
verses.translation: Obtaining His Mercy, I easily gained the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; now, I am imbued with the Love of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਸੇਵਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਾਥ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਲਨ ਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t sev preet naath ra(n)g laalan laae ||1||
verses.translation: Serving the Saints, I feel love and affection for my Beloved Lord Master. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਰਹਸਾਏ ਨਹੀ ਆਏ ਸਹਜਾਏ ਮਨਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur giaan man dhiraRaae rahasaae nahee aae sahajaae man nidhaan paae ||
verses.translation: The Guru has implanted spiritual wisdom within my mind, and I rejoice that I shall not have to come back again. I have obtained celestial poise, and the treasure within my mind.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਤਜੀ ਮਨੈ ਕੀ ਕਾਮ ਕਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh tajee manai kee kaam karaa ||
verses.translation: I have renounced all of the affairs of my mind's desires.

verses.original: ਚਿਰੁ ਚਿਰੁ ਚਿਰੁ ਚਿਰੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਿਆਸ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: chir chir chir chir bhiaa man bahut piaas laagee ||
verses.translation: It has been so long, so long, so long, so very long, since my mind has felt such a great thirst.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੋ ਦਿਖਾਵਹੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: har dharasano dhikhaavahu moh tum bataavahu ||
verses.translation: Please, reveal to me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, and show Yourself to me.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਸਰਣਿ ਆਏ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਏ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੫੩॥
verses.translit: naanak dheen saran aae gal laae ||2||2||153||
verses.translation: Nanak the meek has entered Your Sanctuary; please, take me in Your embrace. ||2||2||153||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੋਊ ਬਿਖਮ ਗਾਰ ਤੋਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: kouoo bikham gaar torai ||
verses.translation: Who can destroy the fortress of sin,

verses.original: ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਧੋਹ ਮੋਹ ਭਰਮ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਹੋਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aas piaas dhoh moh bharam hee te horai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: and release me from hope, thirst, deception, attachment and doubt? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮਾਨ ਇਹ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਛੋਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lobh maan ieh biaadh chhorai ||1||
verses.translation: How can I escape the afflictions of sexual desire, anger, greed and pride? ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tasa(n)g naam ra(n)g gun govi(n)dh gaavau ||
verses.translation: In the Society of the Saints, love the Naam, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: anadhino prabh dhiaavau ||
verses.translation: Night and day, meditate on God.

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੀਤਿ ਜੀਤਿ ਮਿਟਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhram bheet jeet miTaavau ||
verses.translation: I have captured and demolished the walls of doubt.

verses.translit: nidh naam naanak morai ||2||3||154||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Naam is my only treasure. ||2||3||154||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਤਿਆਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lobh tiaag ||
verses.translation: Renounce sexual desire, anger and greed;

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: man simar gobi(n)dh naam ||
verses.translation: remember the Name of the Lord of the Universe in your mind.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਸਫਲ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har bhajan safal kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meditation on the Lord is the only fruitful action. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: taj maan moh vikaar mithiaa jap raam raam raam ||
verses.translation: Renounce pride, attachment, corruption and falsehood, and chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਸੰਤਨਾ ਕੈ ਚਰਨਿ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: man sa(n)tanaa kai charan laag ||1||
verses.translation: O mortal, attach yourself to the Feet of the Saints. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਜਾਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: prabh gopaal dheen dhiaal patit paavan paarabraham har charan simar jaag ||
verses.translation: God is the Sustainer of the world, Merciful to the meek, the Purifier of sinners, the Transcendent Lord God. Awaken, and meditate on His Feet.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਾਗੁ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੫੫॥
verses.translit: kar bhagat naanak pooran bhaag ||2||4||155||
verses.translation: Perform His devotional worship, O Nanak, and your destiny shall be fulfilled. ||2||4||155||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਅਨੰਦੀ ਖੇਲੁ ਰੀ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: harakh sog bairaag ana(n)dhee khel ree dhikhaio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Pleasure and pain, detachment and ecstasy - the Lord has revealed His Play. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਭੈ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: khinahoo(n) bhai nirabhai khinahoo(n) khinahoo(n) uTh dhaio ||
verses.translation: One moment, the mortal is in fear, and the next moment he is fearless; in a moment, he gets up and departs.

verses.original: ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਨ ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਖਿਨਹੂ ਤਜਿ ਜਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: khinahoo(n) ras bhogan khinahoo(n) khinahoo taj jaio ||1||
verses.translation: One moment, he enjoys pleasures, and the next moment, he leaves and goes away. ||1||

verses.original: ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਜੋਗ ਤਾਪ ਬਹੁ ਪੂਜਾ ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਭਰਮਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: khinahoo(n) jog taap bahu poojaa khinahoo(n) bharamaio ||
verses.translation: One moment, he practices Yoga and intense meditation, and all sorts of worship; the next moment, he wanders in doubt.

verses.original: ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੫੬॥
verses.translit: khinahoo(n) kirapaa saadhoo sa(n)g naanak har ra(n)g laio ||2||5||156||
verses.translation: One moment, O Nanak, the Lord bestows His Mercy and blesses him with His Love, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||5||156||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੭ ਆਸਾਵਰੀ
verses.translit: raag aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ghar sataaravaa aasaavaree
verses.translation: Raag Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Seventeenth House, Aasaavaree:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh gobi(n)dh kar haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Lord, the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: har har man piaar haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Cherish the Beloved Lord, Har, Har, in your mind.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਸੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਧਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: gur kahiaa su chit dhar haa(n) ||
verses.translation: The Guru says to install it in your consciousness.

verses.original: ਅਨ ਸਿਉ ਤੋਰਿ ਫੇਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: an siau tor fer haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Turn away from others, and turn to Him.

verses.original: ਐਸੇ ਲਾਲਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਰੀ ਸਖੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaise laalan paio ree sakhee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Thus you shall obtain your Beloved, O my companion. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪੰਕਜ ਮੋਹ ਸਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)kaj moh sar haa(n) ||
verses.translation: In the pool of the world is the mud of attachment.

verses.original: ਪਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਚਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: pag nahee chalai har haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Stuck in it, his feet cannot walk towards the Lord.

verses.original: ਗਹਡਿਓ ਮੂੜ ਨਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: gahaddio mooR nar haa(n) ||
verses.translation: The fool is stuck;

verses.original: ਅਨਿਨ ਉਪਾਵ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: anin upaav kar haa(n) ||
verses.translation: he cannot do anything else.

verses.original: ਤਉ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਸਰਨਿ ਪੈ ਰੀ ਸਖੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tau nikasai saran pai ree sakhee ||1||
verses.translation: Only by entering the Lord's Sanctuary, O my companion, will you be released. ||1||

verses.original: ਥਿਰ ਥਿਰ ਚਿਤ ਥਿਰ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: thir thir chit thir haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Thus your consciousness shall be stable and steady and firm.

verses.original: ਬਨੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: ban girahu samasar haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Wilderness and household are the same.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਏਕ ਪਿਰ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar ek pir haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Deep within dwells the One Husband Lord;

verses.original: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਧਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: baahar anek dhar haa(n) ||
verses.translation: outwardly, there are many distractions.

verses.original: ਰਾਜਨ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: raajan jog kar haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Practice Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੋਗ ਅਲੋਗੀ ਰੀ ਸਖੀ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੫੭॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak log alogee ree sakhee ||2||1||157||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, this is the way to dwell with the people, and yet remain apart from them. ||2||1||157||

verses.original: ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaavaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਸਾ ਏਕ ਮਾਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: manasaa ek maan haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Cherish one desire only:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਤ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: gur siau net dhiaan haa(n) ||
verses.translation: meditate continually on the Guru.

verses.original: ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਸੰਤ ਮੰਤ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: dhiraR sa(n)t ma(n)t giaan haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Install the wisdom of the Saints' Mantra.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਾਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: sevaa gur charaan haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Serve the Feet of the Guru,

verses.original: ਤਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tau mileeaai gur kirapaan mere manaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: and you shall meet Him, by Guru's Grace, O my mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਟੂਟੇ ਅਨ ਭਰਾਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: TooTe an bharaan haa(n) ||
verses.translation: All doubts are dispelled,

verses.original: ਰਵਿਓ ਸਰਬ ਥਾਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: ravio sarab thaan haa(n) ||
verses.translation: and the Lord is seen to be pervading all places.

verses.original: ਲਹਿਓ ਜਮ ਭਇਆਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: lahio jam bhiaan haa(n) ||
verses.translation: The fear of death is dispelled,

verses.original: ਪਾਇਓ ਪੇਡ ਥਾਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: paio pedd thaan haa(n) ||
verses.translation: and the primal place is obtained.

verses.original: ਤਉ ਚੂਕੀ ਸਗਲ ਕਾਨਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tau chookee sagal kaan ||1||
verses.translation: Then, all subservience is removed. ||1||

verses.original: ਲਹਨੋ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਥਾਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: lahano jis mathaan haa(n) ||
verses.translation: One who has such destiny recorded upon his forehead, obtains it;

verses.original: ਭੈ ਪਾਵਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: bhai paavak paar paraan haa(n) ||
verses.translation: he crosses over the terrifying ocean of fire.

verses.original: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਥਾਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: nij ghar tiseh thaan haa(n) ||
verses.translation: He obtains a place in the home of his own self,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਰਸਹਿ ਮਾਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: har ras raseh maan haa(n) ||
verses.translation: and enjoys the most sublime essence of the Lord's essence.

verses.original: ਲਾਥੀ ਤਿਸ ਭੁਖਾਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: laathee tis bhukhaan haa(n) ||
verses.translation: His hunger is appeased;

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਓ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੫੮॥
verses.translit: naanak sahaj samaio re manaa ||2||2||158||
verses.translation: Nanak, he is absorbed in celestial peace, O my mind. ||2||2||158||

verses.original: ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaavaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨੀ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: har har har gunee haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Sing the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਜਪੀਐ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨੀ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: japeeaai sahaj dhunee haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the celestial music.

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਰਸਨ ਭਨੀ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo rasan bhanee haa(n) ||
verses.translation: The tongues of the holy Saints repeat it.

verses.original: ਛੂਟਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਸੁਨੀ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: chhooTan bidh sunee haa(n) ||
verses.translation: I have heard that this is the way to emancipation.

verses.original: ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡ ਪੁਨੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: paieeaai vadd punee mere manaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: This is found by the greatest merit, O my mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਖੋਜਹਿ ਜਨ ਮੁਨੀ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: khojeh jan munee haa(n) ||
verses.translation: The silent sages search for Him.

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰਬ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਨੀ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: srab kaa prabh dhanee haa(n) ||
verses.translation: God is the Master of all.

verses.original: ਦੁਲਭ ਕਲਿ ਦੁਨੀ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: dhulabh kal dhunee haa(n) ||
verses.translation: It is so difficult to find Him in this world, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

verses.original: ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੀ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: dhookh binaasanee haa(n) ||
verses.translation: He is the Dispeller of distress.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਨੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: prabh pooran aasanee mere manaa ||1||
verses.translation: God is the Fulfiller of desires, O my mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਸੋ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: man so seveeaai haa(n) ||
verses.translation: O my mind, serve Him.

verses.original: ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵੀਐ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: alakh abheveeaai haa(n) ||
verses.translation: He is unknowable and inscrutable.

verses.original: ਤਾਂ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: taa(n) siau preet kar haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Enshrine love for Him.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਮਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: binas na jai mar haa(n) ||
verses.translation: He does not perish, or go away, or die.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: gur te jaaniaa haa(n) ||
verses.translation: He is known only through the Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੫੯॥
verses.translit: naanak man maaniaa mere manaa ||2||3||159||
verses.translation: Nanak, my mind is satisfied with the Lord, O my mind. ||2||3||159||

verses.original: ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaavaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਏਕਾ ਓਟ ਗਹੁ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: ekaa oT gahu haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Grab hold of the Support of the One Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਹੁ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh kahu haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Chant the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਆਗਿਆ ਸਤਿ ਸਹੁ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: aagiaa sat sahu haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Submit to the Order of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨਹਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਲਹੁ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: maneh nidhaan lahu haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Receive the treasure in your mind.

verses.original: ਸੁਖਹਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sukheh samaieeaai mere manaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Thus you shall be absorbed in peace, O my mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੀਵਤ ਜੋ ਮਰੈ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: jeevat jo marai haa(n) ||
verses.translation: One who is dead while yet alive,

verses.original: ਦੁਤਰੁ ਸੋ ਤਰੈ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: dhutar so tarai haa(n) ||
verses.translation: crosses over the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਕੀ ਰੇਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kee ren hoi haa(n) ||
verses.translation: One who becomes the dust of all

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਹਉ ਸੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: nirabhau kahau soi haa(n) ||
verses.translation: he alone is called fearless.

verses.original: ਮਿਟੇ ਅੰਦੇਸਿਆ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: miTe a(n)dhesiaa haa(n) ||
verses.translation: His anxieties are removed

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t upadhesiaa mere manaa ||1||
verses.translation: by the Teachings of the Saints, O my mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: jis jan naam sukh haa(n) ||
verses.translation: That humble being, who takes happiness in the Naam, the Name of the Lord

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਕਦੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: tis nikaT na kadhe dhukh haa(n) ||
verses.translation: pain never draws near him.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: jo har har jas sune haa(n) ||
verses.translation: One who listens to the Praise of the Lord, Har, Har,

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੰਨੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ko tis ma(n)ne haa(n) ||
verses.translation: is obeyed by all men.

verses.original: ਸਫਲੁ ਸੁ ਆਇਆ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: safalu su aaiaa haa(n) ||
verses.translation: How fortunate it is that he came into the world;

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੬੦॥
verses.translit: naanak prabh bhaiaa mere manaa ||2||4||160||
verses.translation: Nanak, he is pleasing to God, O my mind. ||2||4||160||

verses.original: ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaavaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: mil har jas gaieeaai haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Meeting together, let us sing the Praises of the Lord,

verses.original: ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: param padh paieeaai haa(n) ||
verses.translation: and attain the supreme state.

verses.original: ਉਆ ਰਸ ਜੋ ਬਿਧੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: auaa ras jo bidhe haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Those who obtain that sublime essence,

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਧੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: taa kau sagal sidhe haa(n) ||
verses.translation: obtain all of the spiritual powers of the Siddhas.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਿਆ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin jaagiaa haa(n) ||
verses.translation: They remain awake and aware night and day;

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਡਭਾਗਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naanak baddabhaagiaa mere manaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Nanak, they are blessed by great good fortune, O my mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪਗ ਧੋਈਐ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t pag dhoieeaai haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Let us wash the feet of the Saints;

verses.original: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਈਐ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: dhuramat khoieeaai haa(n) ||
verses.translation: our evil-mindedness shall be cleansed.

verses.original: ਦਾਸਹ ਰੇਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: dhaaseh ren hoi haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Becoming the dust of the feet of the Lord's slaves,

verses.original: ਬਿਆਪੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: biaapai dhukh na koi haa(n) ||
verses.translation: one shall not be afflicted with pain.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਾਂ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੁ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: bhagataa(n) saran par haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Taking to the Sanctuary of His devotees,

verses.original: ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਕਦੇ ਮਰੁ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: janam na kadhe mar haa(n) ||
verses.translation: he is no longer subject to birth and death.

verses.original: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਸੇ ਭਏ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: asathir se bhe haa(n) ||
verses.translation: They alone become eternal,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਿਨੑ ਜਪਿ ਲਏ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har har jin(h) jap le mere manaa ||1||
verses.translation: who chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਤੂੰ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: saajan meet too(n) haa(n) ||
verses.translation: You are my Friend, my Best Friend.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ਮੂੰ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: naam dhiraRai moo(n) haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Please, implant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: tis bin naeh koi haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Without Him, there is not any other.

verses.original: ਮਨਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਸੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: maneh araadh soi haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Within my mind, I worship Him in adoration.

verses.original: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: nimakh na veesarai haa(n) ||
verses.translation: I do not forget Him, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਸਰੈ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: tis bin kiau sarai haa(n) ||
verses.translation: How can I live without Him?

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ਜਾਉ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: gur kau kurabaan jaau haa(n) ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਪੇ ਨਾਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੬੧॥
verses.translit: naanak jape naau mere manaa ||2||5||161||
verses.translation: Nanak, chant the Name, O my mind. ||2||5||161||

verses.original: ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaavaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਤੂੰ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: kaaran karan too(n) haa(n) ||
verses.translation: You are the Creator, the Cause of causes.

verses.original: ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾ ਸੁਝੈ ਮੂੰ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: avar naa sujhai moo(n) haa(n) ||
verses.translation: I cannot think of any other.

verses.original: ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹੋਈਐ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: kareh su hoieeaai haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Whatever You do, comes to pass.

verses.original: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਈਐ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj sukh soieeaai haa(n) ||
verses.translation: I sleep in peace and poise.

verses.original: ਧੀਰਜ ਮਨਿ ਭਏ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: dheeraj man bhe haa(n) ||
verses.translation: My mind has become patient,

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਪਏ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kai dhar pe mere manaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: since I fell at God's Door, O my mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਮੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo sa(n)game haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,
