verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਸੰਜਮੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: pooran sa(n)jame haa(n) ||
verses.translation: I gained perfect control over my senses.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੇ ਆਪ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: jab te chhuTe aap haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Ever since I rid myself of my self-conceit,

verses.original: ਤਬ ਤੇ ਮਿਟੇ ਤਾਪ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: tab te miTe taap haa(n) ||
verses.translation: my sufferings have ended.

verses.original: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀਆ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa dhaareeaa haa(n) ||
verses.translation: He has showered His Mercy upon me.

verses.original: ਪਤਿ ਰਖੁ ਬਨਵਾਰੀਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pat rakh banavaareeaa mere manaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Creator Lord has preserved my honor, O my mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: eih sukh jaaneeaai haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Know that this is the only peace;

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਮਾਨੀਐ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: har kare su maaneeaai haa(n) ||
verses.translation: accept whatever the Lord does.

verses.original: ਮੰਦਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)dhaa naeh koi haa(n) ||
verses.translation: No one is bad.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ਹੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kee ren hoi haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Become the dust of the Feet of the Saints.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਖੈ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: aape jis rakhai haa(n) ||
verses.translation: He Himself preserves those

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੋ ਚਖੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har a(n)mrit so chakhai mere manaa ||2||
verses.translation: who taste the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord, O my mind. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: jis kaa naeh koi haa(n) ||
verses.translation: One who has no one to call his own

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: tis kaa prabhoo soi haa(n) ||
verses.translation: God belongs to him.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)taragat bujhai haa(n) ||
verses.translation: God knows the state of our innermost being.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੁਝੈ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh tis sujhai haa(n) ||
verses.translation: He knows everything.

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: patit udhaar leh haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Please, Lord, save the sinners.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਏਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੩॥੬॥੧੬੨॥
verses.translit: naanak aradhaas eh mere manaa ||3||6||162||
verses.translation: This is Nanak's prayer, O my mind. ||3||6||162||

verses.original: ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਇਕਤੁਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaavaree mahalaa panjavaa ikatukaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehla, Ek-Thukay:

verses.original: ਓਇ ਪਰਦੇਸੀਆ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: oi paradheseeaa haa(n) ||
verses.translation: O my stranger soul,

verses.original: ਸੁਨਤ ਸੰਦੇਸਿਆ ਹਾਂ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sunat sa(n)dhesiaa haa(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: listen to the call. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਸਿਉ ਰਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: jaa siau rach rahe haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Whatever you are attached to,

verses.original: ਸਭ ਕਉ ਤਜਿ ਗਏ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kau taj ge haa(n) ||
verses.translation: you shall have to leave it all behind.

verses.original: ਸੁਪਨਾ ਜਿਉ ਭਏ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: supanaa jiau bhe haa(n) ||
verses.translation: These things seem like only a dream,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨਿੑ ਲਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har naam jini(h) le ||1||
verses.translation: to one who takes the Lord's Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਤਜਿ ਅਨ ਲਗੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: har taj an lage haa(n) ||
verses.translation: Forsaking the Lord, and clinging to another,

verses.original: ਜਨਮਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਭਗੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: janameh mar bhage haa(n) ||
verses.translation: they run toward death and reincarnation.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਿ ਲਹੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: har har jan lahe haa(n) ||
verses.translation: But those humble beings, who attach themselves to the Lord, Har, Har,

verses.original: ਜੀਵਤ ਸੇ ਰਹੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: jeevat se rahe haa(n) ||
verses.translation: continue to live.

verses.original: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: jiseh kirapaal hoi haa(n) ||
verses.translation: One who is blessed with the Lord's Mercy,

verses.translit: naanak bhagat soi ||2||7||163||232||
verses.translation: O Nanak, becomes His devotee. ||2||7||163||232||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: raag aasaa mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Aasaa, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕਹਉ ਕਉਨ ਸਿਉ ਮਨ ਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: birathaa kahau kaun siau man kee ||
verses.translation: Who should I tell the condition of the mind?

verses.original: ਲੋਭਿ ਗ੍ਰਸਿਓ ਦਸ ਹੂ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵਤ ਆਸਾ ਲਾਗਿਓ ਧਨ ਕੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: lobh grasio dhas hoo dhis dhaavat aasaa laagio dhan kee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Engrossed in greed, running around in the ten directions, you hold to your hopes of wealth. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਤ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਤ ਜਨ ਜਨ ਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: sukh kai het bahut dhukh paavat sev karat jan jan kee ||
verses.translation: For the sake of pleasure, you suffer such great pain, and you have to serve each and every person.

verses.original: ਦੁਆਰਹਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਸੁਆਨ ਜਿਉ ਡੋਲਤ ਨਹ ਸੁਧ ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨ ਕੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhuaareh dhuaar suaan jiau ddolat neh sudh raam bhajan kee ||1||
verses.translation: You wander from door to door like a dog, unconscious of the Lord's meditation. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮ ਅਕਾਰਥ ਖੋਵਤ ਲਾਜ ਨ ਲੋਕ ਹਸਨ ਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: maanas janam akaarath khovat laaj na lok hasan kee ||
verses.translation: You lose this human life in vain, and You are not even ashamed when others laugh at you.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਿਉ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਵਤ ਕੁਮਤਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਤਨ ਕੀ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੩੩॥
verses.translit: naanak har jas kiau nahee gaavat kumat binaasai tan kee ||2||1||233||
verses.translation: O Nanak, why not sing the Lord's Praises, so that you may be rid of the body's evil disposition? ||2||1||233||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: raag aasaa mahalaa pehilaa asaTapadheeaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Raag Aasaa, First Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਉਤਰਿ ਅਵਘਟਿ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਨੑਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: autar avaghaT saravar n(h)aavai ||
verses.translation: He descends the treacherous precipice, to bathe in the cleansing pool;

verses.original: ਬਕੈ ਨ ਬੋਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: bakai na bolai har gun gaavai ||
verses.translation: without speaking or saying anything, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਲੁ ਆਕਾਸੀ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jal aakaasee su(n)n samaavai ||
verses.translation: Like water vapor in the sky, he remains absorbed in the Lord.

verses.original: ਰਸੁ ਸਤੁ ਝੋਲਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ras sat jhol mahaa ras paavai ||1||
verses.translation: He churns the true pleasures to obtain the supreme nectar. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਅਭ ਮੋਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa giaan sunahu abh more ||
verses.translation: Listen to such spiritual wisdom, O my mind.

verses.original: ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਠਉਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bharipur dhaar rahiaa sabh Thaure ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord is totally pervading and permeating all places. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਬ੍ਰਤੁ ਨੇਮੁ ਨ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sach brat nem na kaal sa(n)taavai ||
verses.translation: One who makes Truthfulness his fast and religious vows, does not suffer the pain of death.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਜਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sabadh karodh jalaavai ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he burns away his anger.

verses.original: ਗਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gagan nivaas samaadh lagaavai ||
verses.translation: He dwells in the Tenth Gate, immersed in the Samaadhi of deep meditation.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: paaras paras param padh paavai ||2||
verses.translation: Touching the philosopher's stone, he obtains the supreme status. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਮਨ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਤਤੁ ਬਿਲੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sach man kaaran tat bilovai ||
verses.translation: For the benefit of the mind, churn the true essence of reality;

verses.original: ਸੁਭਰ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: subhar saravar mail na dhovai ||
verses.translation: bathing in the over-flowing tank of nectar, filth is washed away.

verses.original: ਜੈ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤਾ ਤੈਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jai siau raataa taiso hovai ||
verses.translation: We become like the One with whom we are imbued.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aape karataa kare su hovai ||3||
verses.translation: Whatever the Creator does, comes to pass. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਹਿਵ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur hiv seetal agan bujhaavai ||
verses.translation: The Guru is cool and soothing like ice; He puts out the fire of the mind.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬਿਭੂਤ ਚੜਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sevaa surat bibhoot chaRaavai ||
verses.translation: Smear your body with the ashes of dedicated service,

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan aap sahaj ghar aavai ||
verses.translation: and live in the home of peace - make this your religious order.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਦੁ ਵਜਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: niramal baanee naadh vajaavai ||4||
verses.translation: Let the Immaculate Bani of the Word be your playing of the flute. ||4||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar giaan mahaa ras saaraa ||
verses.translation: Spiritual wisdom within is the supreme, sublime nectar.

verses.original: ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: teerath majan gur veechaaraa ||
verses.translation: Contemplation of the Guru is one's bathing at holy places of pilgrimage.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar poojaa thaan muraaraa ||
verses.translation: Worship and adoration within is the Lord's dwelling.

verses.original: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jotee jot milaavanahaaraa ||5||
verses.translation: He is the One who blends one's light with the Divine Light. ||5||

verses.original: ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿਆ ਮਤਿ ਏਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ras rasiaa mat ekai bhai ||
verses.translation: He delights in the delightful wisdom of loving the One Lord.

verses.original: ਤਖਤ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਪੰਚ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: takhat nivaasee pa(n)ch samai ||
verses.translation: He is one of the self-elect - he merges with the Lord, who occupies the throne.

verses.original: ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ਖਸਮ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kaar kamaiee khasam rajai ||
verses.translation: He performs his works in obedience to the Will of his Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਅਵਿਗਤ ਨਾਥੁ ਨ ਲਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: avigat naath na lakhiaa jai ||6||
verses.translation: The Unknowable Lord cannot be understood. ||6||

verses.original: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਜਲ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jal meh upajai jal te dhoor ||
verses.translation: The lotus originates in the water, and yet it remains distinct from the water.

verses.original: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jal meh jot rahiaa bharapoor ||
verses.translation: Just so, the Divine Light pervades and permeates the water of the world.

verses.original: ਕਿਸੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਾ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: kis neRai kis aakhaa dhoor ||
verses.translation: Who is near, and who is far away?

verses.original: ਨਿਧਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: nidh gun gaavaa dhekh hadhoor ||7||
verses.translation: I sing the Glories of the Lord, the treasure of virtue; I behold Him ever-present. ||7||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar baahar avar na koi ||
verses.translation: Inwardly and outwardly, there is none other than Him.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaavai so fun hoi ||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases Him, comes to pass.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਭਰਥਰਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sun bharathar naanak kahai beechaar ||
verses.translation: Listen, O Bharthari Yogi - Nanak speaks after deliberation;

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੧॥
verses.translit: niramal naam meraa aadhaar ||8||1||
verses.translation: the Immaculate Name is my only Support. ||8||1||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਜਪ ਸਭਿ ਤਪ ਸਭ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh jap sabh tap sabh chaturaiee ||
verses.translation: All meditation, all austerities, and all clever tricks,

verses.original: ਊਝੜਿ ਭਰਮੈ ਰਾਹਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: uoojhaR bharamai raeh na paiee ||
verses.translation: lead one to wander in the wilderness, but he does not find the Path.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਕੋ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bin boojhe ko thai na paiee ||
verses.translation: Without understanding, he is not approved;

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਣੈ ਮਾਥੇ ਛਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam bihoonai maathe chhaiee ||1||
verses.translation: without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, ashes are thrown upon one's head. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਚ ਧਣੀ ਜਗੁ ਆਇ ਬਿਨਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: saach dhanee jag aai binaasaa ||
verses.translation: True is the Master; the world comes and goes.

verses.original: ਛੂਟਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: chhooTas praanee gurmukh dhaasaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The mortal is emancipated, as Gurmukh, as the Lord's slave. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਗੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: jag moh baadhaa bahutee aasaa ||
verses.translation: The world is bound by its attachments to the many desires.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਇਕਿ ਭਏ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurmatee ik bhe udhaasaa ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, some become free of desire.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਮਲੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar naam kamal paragaasaa ||
verses.translation: Within them is the Naam, and their heart lotus blossoms forth.

verses.original: ਤਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tin(h) kau naahee jam kee traasaa ||2||
verses.translation: They have no fear of death. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਗੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਜਿਤੁ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jag tria jit kaaman hitakaaree ||
verses.translation: The men of the world are conquered by woman; they love the ladies.

verses.original: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਲਗਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: putr kalatr lag naam visaaree ||
verses.translation: Attached to children and wife, they forget the Naam.

verses.original: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: birathaa janam gavaiaa baajee haaree ||
verses.translation: They waste this human life in vain, and lose the game in the gamble.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: satigur seve karanee saaree ||3||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru is the best occupation. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: baaharahu haumai kahai kahaae ||
verses.translation: One who speaks egotistically in public,

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dharahu mukat lep kadhe na laae ||
verses.translation: never attains liberation within.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh gur sabadh jalaae ||
verses.translation: One who burns away his attachment to Maya, by the Word of the Guru's Shabad,

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: niramal naam sadh hiradhai dhiaae ||4||
verses.translation: meditates forever within his heart on the Immaculate Naam. ||4||

verses.original: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhaavat raakhai Thaak rahaae ||
verses.translation: He restrains his wandering mind, and keeps it under control.

verses.original: ਸਿਖ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sikh sa(n)gat karam milaae ||
verses.translation: The company of such a Sikh is obtained only by Grace.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਭੂਲੋ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur bin bhoolo aavai jaae ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, he goes astray and continues coming and going.

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: nadhar kare sa(n)jog milaae ||5||
verses.translation: Bestowing His Mercy, the Lord unites him in Union. ||5||

verses.original: ਰੂੜੋ ਕਹਉ ਨ ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: rooRo kahau na kahiaa jaiee ||
verses.translation: I cannot describe the Beauteous Lord.

verses.original: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਉ ਨਹ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: akath kathau neh keemat paiee ||
verses.translation: I speak the unspoken; I cannot estimate His value.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਦੁਖ ਤੇਰੇ ਸੂਖ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh dhukh tere sookh rajaiee ||
verses.translation: All pain and pleasure come by Your Will.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟੇ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sabh dhukh meTe saachai naiee ||6||
verses.translation: All pain is eradicated by the True Name. ||6||

verses.original: ਕਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਵਾਜਾ ਪਗ ਬਿਨੁ ਤਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: kar bin vaajaa pag bin taalaa ||
verses.translation: He plays the instrument without hands, and dances without feet.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੁਝੈ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: je sabadh bujhai taa sach nihaalaa ||
verses.translation: But if he understands the Word of the Shabad, then he shall behold the True Lord.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਭੇ ਸੁਖ ਨਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar saach sabhe sukh naalaa ||
verses.translation: With the True Lord within the self, all happiness comes.

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: nadhar kare raakhai rakhavaalaa ||7||
verses.translation: Showering His Mercy, the Preserving Lord preserves him. ||7||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੂਝੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: tirabhavan soojhai aap gavaavai ||
verses.translation: He understands the three worlds; he eliminates his self-conceit.

verses.original: ਬਾਣੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: baanee boojhai sach samaavai ||
verses.translation: He understands the Bani of the Word, and he is absorbed into the True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh veechaare ek liv taaraa ||
verses.translation: Contemplating the Shabad, he enshrines love for the One Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੮॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak dha(n)n savaaranahaaraa ||8||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, blessed is the Lord, the Embellisher. ||8||2||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਲੇਖ ਅਸੰਖ ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: lekh asa(n)kh likh likh maan ||
verses.translation: There are innumerable writings; those who write them take pride in them.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨਿਐ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਵਖਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: man maaniaai sach surat vakhaan ||
verses.translation: When one's mind accepts the Truth, he understands, and speaks of it.

verses.original: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kathanee badhanee paR paR bhaar ||
verses.translation: Words, spoken and read again and again, are useless loads.

verses.original: ਲੇਖ ਅਸੰਖ ਅਲੇਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: lekh asa(n)kh alekh apaar ||1||
verses.translation: There are innumerable writings, but the Infinite Lord remains unwritten. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਤੂੰ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa saachaa too(n) eko jaan ||
verses.translation: Know that such a True Lord is the One and only.

verses.original: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ja(n)man maranaa hukam pachhaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Understand that birth and death come according to the Lord's Will. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਜਗੁ ਬਾਧਾ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh jag baadhaa jamakaal ||
verses.translation: Because of attachment to Maya, the world is bound by the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਬਾਂਧਾ ਛੂਟੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: baa(n)dhaa chhooTai naam sam(h)aal ||
verses.translation: These bonds are released when one remembers the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur sukhadhaataa avar na bhaal ||
verses.translation: The Guru is the Giver of peace; do not look for any other.

verses.original: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਨਿਬਹੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: halat palat nibahee tudh naal ||2||
verses.translation: In this world, and the next, He shall stand by you. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਤਾਂ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh marai taa(n) ek liv laae ||
verses.translation: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad, embraces love for the One Lord.

verses.original: ਅਚਰੁ ਚਰੈ ਤਾਂ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: achar charai taa(n) bharam chukaae ||
verses.translation: One who eats the uneatable, has his doubts dispelled.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jeevan mukat man naam vasaae ||
verses.translation: He is Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive; the Naam abides in his mind.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hoi ta sach samaae ||3||
verses.translation: Becoming Gurmukh, he merges into the True Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਧਰ ਸਾਜੀ ਗਗਨੁ ਅਕਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin dhar saajee gagan akaas ||
verses.translation: The One who created the earth and the Akaashic ethers of the sky,

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭ ਥਾਪੀ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin sabh thaapee thaap uthaap ||
verses.translation: established all; He establishes and disestablishes.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: sarab nira(n)tar aape aap ||
verses.translation: He Himself is permeating all.

verses.original: ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਪੂਛੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਆਪਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: kisai na poochhe bakhase aap ||4||
verses.translation: He does not consult anyone; He Himself forgives. ||4||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਪੁਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਮਾਣਕ ਹੀਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: too pur saagar maanak heer ||
verses.translation: You are the Ocean, over-flowing with jewels and rubies.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: too niramal sach gunee gaheer ||
verses.translation: You are immaculate and pure, the true treasure of virtue.

verses.original: ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਭੇਟੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੀਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sukh maanai bheTai gur peer ||
verses.translation: Peace is enjoyed, meeting the Guru, the Spiritual Teacher.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਵਜੀਰੁ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: eko saahib ek vajeer ||5||
verses.translation: The Lord is the only Master; He is the only Minister. ||5||

verses.original: ਜਗੁ ਬੰਦੀ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਹਉ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jag ba(n)dhee mukate hau maaree ||
verses.translation: The world is held in bondage; he alone is emancipated, who conquers his ego.

verses.original: ਜਗਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਆਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jag giaanee viralaa aachaaree ||
verses.translation: How rare in the world is that wise person, who practices this.

verses.original: ਜਗਿ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jag pa(n)ddit viralaa veechaaree ||
verses.translation: How rare in this world is that scholar who reflects upon this.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਭ ਫਿਰੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: bin satigur bheTe sabh firai aha(n)kaaree ||6||
verses.translation: Without meeting the True Guru, all wander in ego. ||6||

verses.original: ਜਗੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jag dhukheeaa sukheeaa jan koi ||
verses.translation: The world is unhappy; only a few are happy.

verses.original: ਜਗੁ ਰੋਗੀ ਭੋਗੀ ਗੁਣ ਰੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jag rogee bhogee gun roi ||
verses.translation: The world is diseased, from its indulgences; it weeps over its lost virtue.

verses.original: ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jag upajai binasai pat khoi ||
verses.translation: The world wells up, and then subsides, losing its honor.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai boojhai soi ||7||
verses.translation: He alone, who becomes Gurmukh, understands. ||7||

verses.original: ਮਹਘੋ ਮੋਲਿ ਭਾਰਿ ਅਫਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: mahagho mol bhaar afaar ||
verses.translation: His price is so costly; His weight is unbearable.

verses.original: ਅਟਲ ਅਛਲੁ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aTal achhal gurmatee dhaar ||
verses.translation: He is immovable and undeceivable; enshrine Him in your mind, through the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਭਇਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhai milai bhaavai bhikaar ||
verses.translation: Meet Him through love, become pleasing to Him, and act in fear of Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak neech kahai beechaar ||8||3||
verses.translation: Nanak the lowly says this, after deep contemplation. ||8||3||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਮਰੈ ਪੰਚੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਰੋਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: ek marai pa(n)che mil roveh ||
verses.translation: When someone dies, the five passions meet and mourn his death.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: haumai jai sabadh mal dhoveh ||
verses.translation: Overcoming self-conceit, he washes off his filth with the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਮਝਿ ਸੂਝਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: samajh soojh sahaj ghar hoveh ||
verses.translation: One who knows and understands, enters the home of peace and poise.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਸਗਲੀ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bin boojhe sagalee pat khoveh ||1||
verses.translation: Without understanding, he loses all his honor. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਉਣੁ ਮਰੈ ਕਉਣੁ ਰੋਵੈ ਓਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaun marai kaun rovai ohee ||
verses.translation: Who dies, and who weeps for him?

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਭਸੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਤੋਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: karan kaaran sabhasai sir tohee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Lord, Creator, Cause of causes, You are over the heads of all. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੂਏ ਕਉ ਰੋਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: mooe kau rovai dhukh koi ||
verses.translation: Who weeps over the pain of the dead?

verses.original: ਸੋ ਰੋਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਬੇਦਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: so rovai jis bedhan hoi ||
verses.translation: Those who weep, do so over their own troubles.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਬੀਤੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jis beetee jaanai prabh soi ||
verses.translation: God knows the condition of those who are so affected.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aape karataa kare su hoi ||2||
verses.translation: Whatever the Creator does, comes to pass. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਣਾ ਤਾਰੇ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeevat maranaa taare taranaa ||
verses.translation: One who remains dead while yet alive, is saved, and saves others as well.

verses.original: ਜੈ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jai jagadhees param gat saranaa ||
verses.translation: Celebrate the Victory of the Lord; taking to His Sanctuary, the supreme status is obtained.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: hau balihaaree satigur charanaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the feet of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੈ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur bohith sabadh bhai taranaa ||3||
verses.translation: The Guru is the boat; through the Shabad of His Word, the terrifying world-ocean is crossed over. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: nirabhau aap nira(n)tar jot ||
verses.translation: He Himself is Fearless; His Divine Light is contained in all.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਜਗਿ ਛੋਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: bin naavai sootak jag chhot ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, the world is defiled and untouchable.

verses.original: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਿ ਰੋਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhuramat binasai kiaa keh rot ||
verses.translation: Through evil-mindedness, they are ruined; why should they cry out and weep?

verses.original: ਜਨਮਿ ਮੂਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਰੋਤਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: janam mooe bin bhagat sarot ||4||
verses.translation: They are born only to die, without hearing the music of devotional worship. ||4||

verses.original: ਮੂਏ ਕਉ ਸਚੁ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਮੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: mooe kau sach roveh meet ||
verses.translation: Only one's true friends mourn one's death.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਨੀਤਾ ਨੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: trai gun roveh neetaa neet ||
verses.translation: Those under the sway of the three dispositions continue to mourn on and on.

verses.original: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਚੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh sukh parahar sahaj sucheet ||
verses.translation: Disregarding pain and pleasure, center your consciousness on the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਉਪਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: tan man saupau kirasan pareet ||5||
verses.translation: Dedicate your body and mind to the Love of the Lord. ||5||

verses.original: ਭੀਤਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਸੰਖ ॥
verses.translit: bheetar ek anek asa(n)kh ||
verses.translation: The One Lord dwells within the various and countless beings.

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਬਹੁ ਸੰਖ ਅਸੰਖ ॥
verses.translit: karam dharam bahu sa(n)kh asa(n)kh ||
verses.translation: There are so many rituals and religious faiths, their number is innumerable.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ ਭਗਤੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਬਿਰੰਥ ॥
verses.translit: bin bhai bhagatee janam bira(n)th ||
verses.translation: Without the Fear of God, and devotional worship, one's life is in vain.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਰਮਾਰੰਥ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: har gun gaaveh mil paramaara(n)th ||6||
verses.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the supreme wealth is obtained. ||6||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਭੀ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: aap marai maare bhee aap ||
verses.translation: He Himself dies, and He Himself kills.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: aap upaae thaap uthaap ||
verses.translation: He Himself establishes, and having established, disestablishes.

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਜੋਤੀ ਤੂ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: sirasaT upaiee jotee too jaat ||
verses.translation: He created the Universe, and by His Divine Nature, instilled His Divine Light into it.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਨਹੀ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਿ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sabadh veechaar milan nahee bhraat ||7||
verses.translation: One who reflects upon the Word of the Shabad, meets the Lord, without doubt. ||7||

verses.original: ਸੂਤਕੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਭਖੈ ਜਗੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sootak agan bhakhai jag khai ||
verses.translation: Pollution is the burning fire, which is consuming the world.

verses.original: ਸੂਤਕੁ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਥਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sootak jal thal sabh hee thai ||
verses.translation: Pollution is in the water, upon the land, and everywhere.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੂਤਕਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: naanak sootak janam mareejai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, people are born and die in pollution.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੮॥੪॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee har ras peejai ||8||4||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, they drink in the Lord's sublime elixir. ||8||4||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: raag aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੈ ਸੁ ਪਰਖੇ ਹੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: aap veechaarai su parakhe heeraa ||
verses.translation: One who contemplates his own self, tests the worth of the jewel.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ek dhirasaT taare gur pooraa ||
verses.translation: With a single glance, the Perfect Guru saves him.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur maanai man te man dheeraa ||1||
verses.translation: When the Guru is pleased, one's mind comforts itself. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਰਾਫੀ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa saahu saraafee karai ||
verses.translation: He is such a banker, who tests us.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਤਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saachee nadhar ek liv tarai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By His True Glance of Grace, we are blessed with the Love of the One Lord, and are saved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: poo(n)jee naam nira(n)jan saar ||
verses.translation: The capital of the Naam is immaculate and sublime.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤਾ ਪੈਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: niramal saach rataa paikaar ||
verses.translation: That peddler is rendered pure, who is imbued with the Truth.

verses.original: ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sifat sahaj ghar gur karataar ||2||
verses.translation: Praising the Lord, in the house of poise, he attains the Guru, the Creator. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa manasaa sabadh jalaae ||
verses.translation: One who burns away hope and desire through the Word of the Shabad,

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਰਾਇਣੁ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: raam narain kahai kahaae ||
verses.translation: chants the Lord's Name, and inspires others to chant it as well.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਵਾਟ ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur te vaaT mahal ghar paae ||3||
verses.translation: Through the Guru, he finds the Path home, to the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||3||

verses.original: ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਨੂਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: ka(n)chan kaiaa jot anoop ||
verses.translation: His body becomes golden, by the Lord's Incomparable Light.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਦੇਵਾ ਸਗਲ ਸਰੂਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: tirabhavan dhevaa sagal saroop ||
verses.translation: He beholds the divine beauty in all the three worlds.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਖੂਟੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: mai so dhan palai saach akhooT ||4||
verses.translation: That inexhaustible wealth of Truth is now in my lap. ||4||

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਤੀਨਿ ਨਵ ਚਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch teen nav chaar samaavai ||
verses.translation: In the five elements, the three worlds, the nine regions and the four directions, the Lord is pervading.

verses.original: ਧਰਣਿ ਗਗਨੁ ਕਲ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: dharan gagan kal dhaar rahaavai ||
verses.translation: He supports the earth and the sky, exercising His almighty power.

verses.original: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਤਉ ਉਲਟਿ ਪਰਾਵੈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: baahar jaatau ulaT paraavai ||5||
verses.translation: He turns the outgoing mind around. ||5||

verses.original: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਆਖੀ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: moorakh hoi na aakhee soojhai ||
verses.translation: The fool does not realize what he sees with his eyes.

verses.original: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਰਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਕਹਿਆ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: jihavaa ras nahee kahiaa boojhai ||
verses.translation: He does not taste with his tongue, and does not understand what is said.

verses.original: ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਜਗ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: bikh kaa maataa jag siau loojhai ||6||
verses.translation: Intoxicated with poison, he argues with the world. ||6||

verses.original: ਊਤਮ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: uootam sa(n)gat uootam hovai ||
verses.translation: In the uplifting society, one is uplifted.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਕਉ ਧਾਵੈ ਅਵਗਣ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gun kau dhaavai avagan dhovai ||
verses.translation: He chases after virtue and washes off his sins.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: bin gur seve sahaj na hovai ||7||
verses.translation: Without serving the Guru, celestial poise is not obtained. ||7||

verses.original: ਹੀਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਲਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: heeraa naam javehar laal ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a diamond, a jewel, a ruby.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮੋਤੀ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: man motee hai tis kaa maal ||
verses.translation: The pearl of the mind is the inner wealth.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਖੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥੮॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak parakhai nadhar nihaal ||8||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord tests us, and blesses us with His Glance of Grace. ||8||5||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh giaan dhiaan man maan ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh obtains spiritual wisdom, meditation and satisfaction of the mind.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਹਲੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh mahalee mahal pachhaan ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh realizes the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gurmukh surat sabadh neesaan ||1||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is attuned to the Word of the Shabad, as his Insignia. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: aaise prem bhagat veechaaree ||
verses.translation: Such is the loving devotional worship of the Lord's contemplation.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh saachaa naam muraaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh realizes the True Name, the Destroyer of ego. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਥਾਨਿ ਸੁਥਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: ahinis niramal thaan suthaan ||
verses.translation: Day and night, he remains immaculately pure, and abides in the sublime place.

verses.original: ਤੀਨ ਭਵਨ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: teen bhavan nihakeval giaan ||
verses.translation: He gains the wisdom of the three worlds.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saache gur te hukam pachhaan ||2||
verses.translation: Through the True Guru, the Command of the Lord's Will is realized. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਹਰਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: saachaa harakh naahee tis sog ||
verses.translation: He enjoys true pleasure, and suffers no pain.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit giaan mahaa ras bhog ||
verses.translation: He enjoys the ambrosial wisdom, and the highest sublime essence.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਸਮਾਈ ਸੁਖੀ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch samaiee sukhee sabh log ||3||
verses.translation: He overcomes the five evil passions, and becomes the happiest of all men. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਗਲੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: sagalee jot teraa sabh koiee ||
verses.translation: Your Divine Light is contained in all; everyone belongs to You.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aape joR vichhoRe soiee ||
verses.translation: You Yourself join and separate again.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: aape karataa kare su hoiee ||4||
verses.translation: Whatever the Creator does, comes to pass. ||4||

verses.original: ਢਾਹਿ ਉਸਾਰੇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: ddaeh usaare hukam samaavai ||
verses.translation: He demolishes, and He builds; by His Order, he merges us into Himself.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: hukamo varatai jo tis bhaavai ||
verses.translation: Whatever is pleasing to His Will, happens.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: gur bin pooraa koi na paavai ||5||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, no one obtains the Perfect Lord. ||5||

verses.original: ਬਾਲਕ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਨ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਰਾਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: baalak biradh na surat paraan ||
verses.translation: In childhood and old age, he does not understand.

verses.original: ਭਰਿ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਬੂਡੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhar joban booddai abhimaan ||
verses.translation: In the prime of youth, he is drowned in his pride.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਲਹਸਿ ਨਿਦਾਨਿ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: bin naavai kiaa lahas nidhaan ||6||
verses.translation: Without the Name, what can the fool obtain? ||6||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਅਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis kaa an dhan sahaj na jaanaa ||
verses.translation: He does not know the One who blesses him with nourishment and wealth.

verses.original: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: bharam bhulaanaa fir pachhutaanaa ||
verses.translation: Deluded by doubt, he later regrets and repents.

verses.original: ਗਲਿ ਫਾਹੀ ਬਉਰਾ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gal faahee bauraa bauraanaa ||7||
verses.translation: The noose of death is around the neck of that crazy madman. ||7||

verses.original: ਬੂਡਤ ਜਗੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਤਉ ਡਰਿ ਭਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: booddat jag dhekhiaa tau ddar bhaage ||
verses.translation: I saw the world drowning, and I ran away in fear.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur raakhe se vaddabhaage ||
verses.translation: How very fortunate are those who have been saved by the True Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੮॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak gur kee charanee laage ||8||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they are attached to the feet of the Guru. ||8||6||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੀਤੇ ਚੀਤਿ ਅਨੀਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaaveh geete cheet aneete ||
verses.translation: They sing religious songs, but their consciousness is wicked.

verses.original: ਰਾਗ ਸੁਣਾਇ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ਬੀਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: raag sunai kahaaveh beete ||
verses.translation: They sing the songs, and call themselves divine,

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਝੂਠੁ ਅਨੀਤੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bin naavai man jhooTh aneete ||1||
verses.translation: but without the Name, their minds are false and wicked. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਹਾ ਚਲਹੁ ਮਨ ਰਹਹੁ ਘਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kahaa chalahu man rahahu ghare ||
verses.translation: Where are you going? O mind, remain in your own home.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ਖੋਜਤ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh raam naam tirapataase khojat paavahu sahaj hare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs are satisfied with the Lord's Name; searching, they easily find the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਮਨਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh man moh sareeraa ||
verses.translation: Sexual desire, anger and emotional attachment fill the mind and body;

verses.original: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਸੁ ਪੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: lab lobh aha(n)kaaru su peeraa ||
verses.translation: greed and egotism lead only to pain.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: raam naam bin kiau man dheeraa ||2||
verses.translation: How can the mind be comforted without the Lord's Name? ||2||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar naavan saach pachhaanai ||
verses.translation: One who cleanses himself within, knows the True Lord.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar kee gat gurmukh jaanai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh knows the condition of his innermost being.

verses.original: ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saach sabadh bin mahal na pachhaanai ||3||
verses.translation: Without the True Word of the Shabad, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is not realized. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: nira(n)kaar meh aakaar samaavai ||
verses.translation: One who merges his form into the Formless Lord,

verses.original: ਅਕਲ ਕਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਟਿਕਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: akal kalaa sach saach Tikaavai ||
verses.translation: abides in the True Lord, the Powerful, beyond power.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਨਰੁ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: so nar garabh jon nahee aavai ||4||
verses.translation: Such a person does not enter into the womb of reincarnation again. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਹਾਂ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਹ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jahaa(n) naam milai teh jaau ||
verses.translation: Go there, where you may obtain the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee karam kamaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, perform good deeds.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naame raataa har gun gaau ||5||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Naam, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||5||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur sevaa te aap pachhaataa ||
verses.translation: Serving the Guru, I have come to understand myself.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam vasiaa sukhadhaataa ||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Naam, the Giver of Peace, abides within my mind.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: anadhin baanee naame raataa ||6||
verses.translation: Night and day, I am imbued with the Word of the Guru's Bani, and the Naam. ||6||

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਾਏ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: meraa prabh laae taa ko laagai ||
verses.translation: When my God attaches someone to Him, only then is that person attached.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਸਬਦੇ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: haumai maare sabadhe jaagai ||
verses.translation: Conquering ego, he remains awake to the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: aaithai othai sadhaa sukh aagai ||7||
verses.translation: Here and hereafter, he enjoys lasting peace. ||7||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਚੰਚਲੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: man cha(n)chal bidh naahee jaanai ||
verses.translation: The fickle mind does not know the way.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੈਲਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh mailaa sabadh na pachhaanai ||
verses.translation: The filthy self-willed manmukh does not understand the Shabad.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: gurmukh niramal naam vakhaanai ||8||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh chants the Immaculate Naam. ||8||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਗੈ ਕਰੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau aagai karee aradhaas ||
verses.translation: I offer my prayer to the Lord,

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo jan sa(n)gat hoi nivaas ||
verses.translation: that I might dwell in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: kilavikh dhukh kaaTe har naam pragaas ||9||
verses.translation: There, sins and sufferings are erased, and one is illumined with the Lord's Name. ||9||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਆਚਾਰੁ ਪਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: kar beechaar aachaar paraataa ||
verses.translation: In reflective meditation, I have come to love good conduct.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: satigur bachanee eko jaataa ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the True Guru, I recognize the One Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੧੦॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak raam naam man raataa ||10||7||
verses.translation: O Nanak, my mind is imbued with the Lord's Name. ||10||7||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮੈਗਲੁ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: man maigal saakat dhevaanaa ||
verses.translation: The mind of the faithless cynic is like a crazy elephant.

verses.original: ਬਨ ਖੰਡਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਹੈਰਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: ban kha(n)dd maiaa moh hairaanaa ||
verses.translation: It wanders around the forest, distracted by attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਜਾਹਿ ਕਾਲ ਕੇ ਚਾਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: eit ut jaeh kaal ke chaape ||
verses.translation: It goes here and there, hounded by death.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹੈ ਘਰੁ ਆਪੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gurmukh khoj lahai ghar aape ||1||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh seeks, and finds his own home. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੈ ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਠਉਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur sabadhai man nahee Thauraa ||
verses.translation: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the mind finds no place of rest.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਵਰ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਉਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: simarahu raam naam at niramal avar tiaagahu haumai kauraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Remember in meditation the Lord's Name, the most pure and sublime; renounce your bitter egotism. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਰਹਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: eih man mugadh kahahu kiau rahasee ||
verses.translation: Tell me, how can this stupid mind be rescued?

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਮਝੇ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਹਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: bin samajhe jam kaa dhukh sahasee ||
verses.translation: Without understanding, it shall suffer the pains of death.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: aape bakhase satigur melai ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself forgives us, and unites us with the True Guru.

verses.original: ਕਾਲੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਪੇਲੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kaal ka(n)Tak maare sach pelai ||2||
verses.translation: The True Lord conquers and overcomes the tortures of death. ||2||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਰਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: eih man karamaa ih man dharamaa ||
verses.translation: This mind commits its deeds of karma, and this mind follows the Dharma.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਤੇ ਜਨਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: eih man pa(n)ch tat te janamaa ||
verses.translation: This mind is born of the five elements.

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੂੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: saakat lobhee ih man mooRaa ||
verses.translation: This foolish mind is perverted and greedy.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਮਨੁ ਰੂੜਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam japai man rooRaa ||3||
verses.translation: Chanting the Naam, the mind of the Gurmukh becomes beautiful. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਅਸਥਾਨੇ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh man asathaane soiee ||
verses.translation: The mind of the Gurmukh finds the Lord's home.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh tirabhavan sojhee hoiee ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh comes to know the three worlds.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਭੋਗੀ ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: eih man jogee bhogee tap taapai ||
verses.translation: This mind is a Yogi, an enjoyer, a practicer of austerities.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚੀਨੈੑ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gurmukh cheenai(h) har prabh aapai ||4||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh understands the Lord God Himself. ||4||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: man bairaagee haumai tiaagee ||
verses.translation: This mind is a detached renunciate, forsaking egotism.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਮਨਸਾ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT manasaa dhubidhaa laagee ||
verses.translation: Desire and duality afflict each and every heart.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: raam rasain gurmukh chaakhai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh drinks in the Lord's sublime essence;

verses.original: ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: dhar ghar mahalee har pat raakhai ||5||
verses.translation: at His Door, in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, He preserves his honor. ||5||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਸੂਰ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਾਮਿ ॥
verses.translit: eih man raajaa soor sa(n)graam ||
verses.translation: This mind is the king, the hero of cosmic battles.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ॥
verses.translit: eih man nirabhau gurmukh naam ||
verses.translation: The mind of the Gurmukh becomes fearless through the Naam.

verses.original: ਮਾਰੇ ਪੰਚ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਏ ॥
verses.translit: maare pa(n)ch apunai vas ke'ee ||
verses.translation: Overpowering and subduing the five passions,

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਗ੍ਰਾਸਿ ਇਕਤੁ ਥਾਇ ਕੀਏ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: haumai graas ikat thai ke'ee ||6||
verses.translation: holding ego in its grip, it confines them to one place. ||6||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਗ ਸੁਆਦ ਅਨ ਤਿਆਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh raag suaadh an tiaage ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh renounces other songs and tastes.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh ih man bhagatee jaage ||
verses.translation: The mind of the Gurmukh is awakened to devotion.

verses.original: ਅਨਹਦ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: anahadh sun maaniaa sabadh veechaaree ||
verses.translation: Hearing the unstruck music of the sound current, this mind contemplates the Shabad, and accepts it.

verses.original: ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਿੑ ਭਏ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: aatam cheeni(h) bhe nira(n)kaaree ||7||
verses.translation: Understanding itself, this soul becomes attuned to the Formless Lord. ||7||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: eih man niramal dhar ghar soiee ||
verses.translation: This mind becomes immaculately pure, in the Court and the Home of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਉ ਧੁਨਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh bhagat bhaau dhun hoiee ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh shows his love through loving devotional worship.

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ahinis har jas gur parasaadh ||
verses.translation: Night and day, by Guru's Grace, sing the Lord's Praises.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT so prabh aadh jugaadh ||8||
verses.translation: God dwells in each and every heart, since the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages. ||8||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: raam rasain ih man maataa ||
verses.translation: This mind is intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord;

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sarab rasain gurmukh jaataa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh realizes the essence of totality.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਹੇਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat het gur charan nivaasaa ||
verses.translation: For the sake of devotional worship, he dwells at the Guru's Feet.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੯॥੮॥
verses.translit: naanak har jan ke dhaasan dhaasaa ||9||8||
verses.translation: Nanak is the humble servant of the slave of the Lord's slaves. ||9||8||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਧਨੁ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: tan binasai dhan kaa ko kaheeaai ||
verses.translation: When the body perishes, whose wealth is it?

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਤ ਲਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur raam naam kat laheeaai ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, how can the Lord's Name be obtained?

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam dhan sa(n)g sakhaiee ||
verses.translation: The wealth of the Lord's Name is my Companion and Helper.

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ahinis niramal har liv laiee ||1||
verses.translation: Night and day, center your loving attention on the Immaculate Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam bin kavan hamaaraa ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord's Name, who is ours?

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sukh dhukh sam kar naam na chhoddau aape bakhas milaavanahaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I look upon pleasure and pain alike; I shall not forsake the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The Lord Himself forgives me, and blends me with Himself. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਹੇਤੁ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kanik kaamanee het gavaaraa ||
verses.translation: The fool loves gold and women.

verses.original: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਲਾਗੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhubidhaa laage naam visaaraa ||
verses.translation: Attached to duality, he has forgotten the Naam.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਬਖਸਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jis too(n) bakhaseh naam japai ||
verses.translation: O Lord, he alone chants the Naam, whom You have forgiven.

verses.original: ਦੂਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਿ ਸਕੈ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhoot na laag sakai gun gai ||2||
verses.translation: Death cannot touch one who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: har gur dhaataa raam gupaalaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Guru, is the Giver; the Lord, the Sustainer of the World.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: jiau bhaavai tiau raakh dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: If it is pleasing to Your Will, please preserve me, O Merciful Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh raam merai man bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, my mind is pleased with the Lord.

verses.original: ਰੋਗ ਮਿਟੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: rog miTe dhukh Thaak rahaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: My diseases are cured, and my pains are taken away. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਤੰਤ ਨ ਮੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: avar na aaukhadh ta(n)t na ma(n)taa ||
verses.translation: There is no other medicine, Tantric charm or mantra.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਹੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har simaran kilavikh ha(n)taa ||
verses.translation: Meditative remembrance upon the Lord, Har, Har, destroys sins.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) aap bhulaaveh naam visaar ||
verses.translation: You Yourself cause us to stray from the path, and forget the Naam.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: too(n) aape raakheh kirapaa dhaar ||4||
verses.translation: Showering Your Mercy, You Yourself save us. ||4||

verses.original: ਰੋਗੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭੇਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: rog bharam bhedh man dhoojaa ||
verses.translation: The mind is diseased with doubt, superstition and duality.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਜਪਹਿ ਜਪੁ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur bin bharam japeh jap dhoojaa ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, it dwells in doubt, and contemplates duality.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸ ਨ ਦੇਖਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: aadh purakh gur dharas na dhekheh ||
verses.translation: The Guru reveals the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the Primal Lord.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਕਿ ਲੇਖਹਿ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: vin gur sabadhai janam k lekheh ||5||
verses.translation: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, what use is human life? ||5||

verses.original: ਦੇਖਿ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਸਮਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhekh acharaj rahe bisamaadh ||
verses.translation: Beholding the Marvellous Lord, I am wonder-struck and astonished.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸੁਰ ਨਰ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT sur nar sahaj samaadh ||
verses.translation: In each and every heart, of the angels and holy men, He dwells in celestial Samaadhi.

verses.original: ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: bharipur dhaar rahe man maahee ||
verses.translation: I have enshrined the All-pervading Lord within my mind.

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: tum samasar avar ko naahee ||6||
verses.translation: There is no one else equal to You. ||6||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੇਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kee bhagat het mukh naam ||
verses.translation: For the sake of devotional worship, we chant Your Name.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t bhagat kee sa(n)gat raam ||
verses.translation: The Lord's devotees dwell in the Society of the Saints.

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋਰੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan tore sahaj dhiaan ||
verses.translation: Breaking his bonds, one comes to meditate on the Lord.

verses.original: ਛੂਟੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: chhooTai gurmukh har gur giaan ||7||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs are emancipated, by the Guru-given knowledge of the Lord. ||7||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਦੂਖੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: naa jamadhoot dhookh tis laagai ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death cannot touch him with pain;

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo jan raam naam liv jaagai ||
verses.translation: the Lord's humble servant remains awake to the Love of the Naam.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਭਗਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat vachhal bhagataa har sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the Lover of His devotees; He dwells with His devotees.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੮॥੯॥
verses.translit: naanak mukat bhe har ra(n)g ||8||9||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they are liberated, through the Love of the Lord. ||8||9||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਇਕਤੁਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ikatukee ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, First Mehla, Ik-Tukee:

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur seve so Thaakur jaanai ||
verses.translation: One who serves the Guru, knows his Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਦੂਖੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhookh miTai sach sabadh pachhaanai ||1||
verses.translation: His pains are erased, and he realizes the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਖੀ ਸਖੈਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: raam japahu meree sakhee sakhainee ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Lord, O my friends and companions.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੈਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sev dhekhahu prabh nainee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, you shall behold God with your eyes. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan maat pitaa sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: People are entangled with mother, father and the world.

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਸੁਤ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਅਰੁ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan sut ka(n)niaa ar naar ||2||
verses.translation: They are entangled with sons, daughters and spouses. ||2||

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਹਉ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan karam dharam hau keeaa ||
verses.translation: They are entangled with religious rituals, and religious faith, acting in ego.

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਬੀਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan put kalat man beeaa ||3||
verses.translation: They are entangled with sons, wives and others in their minds. ||3||

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਿਰਖੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਿਰਸਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan kirakhee kareh kirasaan ||
verses.translation: The farmers are entangled by farming.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਡੰਨੁ ਸਹੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: haumai dda(n)n sahai raajaa ma(n)gai dhaan ||4||
verses.translation: People suffer punishment in ego, and the Lord King exacts the penalty from them. ||4||

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਸਉਦਾ ਅਣਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan saudhaa anaveechaaree ||
verses.translation: They are entangled in trade without contemplation.

verses.original: ਤਿਪਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: tipat naahee maiaa moh pasaaree ||5||
verses.translation: They are not satisfied by attachment to the expanse of Maya. ||5||

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਸਾਹ ਸੰਚਹਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan saeh sa(n)cheh dhan jai ||
verses.translation: They are entangled with that wealth, amassed by bankers.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਪਵਈ ਥਾਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: bin har bhagat na paviee thai ||6||
verses.translation: Without devotion to the Lord, they do not become acceptable. ||6||

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਬੇਦੁ ਬਾਦੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan bedh baadh aha(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: They are entangled with the Vedas, religious discussions and egotism.

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਮੋਹ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan binasai moh vikaar ||7||
verses.translation: They are entangled, and perish in attachment and corruption. ||7||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: naanak raam naam saranaiee ||
verses.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਬੰਧੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੮॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: satigur raakhe ba(n)dh na paiee ||8||10||
verses.translation: One who is saved by the True Guru, does not suffer entanglement. ||8||10||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੩
verses.translit: raag aasaa mahalaa pehilaa asaTapadheeaa ghar teejaa
verses.translation: Raag Aasaa, First Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, Third House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਸਿਰਿ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਪਟੀਆ ਮਾਂਗੀ ਪਾਇ ਸੰਧੂਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin sir sohan paTeeaa maa(n)gee pai sa(n)dhoor ||
verses.translation: Those heads adorned with braided hair, with their parts painted with vermillion

verses.original: ਸੇ ਸਿਰ ਕਾਤੀ ਮੁੰਨੀਅਨਿੑ ਗਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਵੈ ਧੂੜਿ ॥
verses.translit: se sir kaatee mu(n)neeani(h) gal vich aavai dhooR ||
verses.translation: those heads were shaved with scissors, and their throats were choked with dust.

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੋਦੀਆ ਹੁਣਿ ਬਹਣਿ ਨ ਮਿਲਨਿੑ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mahalaa a(n)dhar hodheeaa hun bahan na milani(h) hadhoor ||1||
verses.translation: They lived in palatial mansions, but now, they cannot even sit near the palaces. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਦੇਸੁ ਬਾਬਾ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: aadhes baabaa aadhes ||
verses.translation: Hail to You, O Father Lord, Hail to You!

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਵੇਸ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aadh purakh teraa a(n)t na paiaa kar kar dhekheh ves ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Primal Lord. Your limits are not known; You create, and create, and behold the scenes. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਦਹੁ ਸੀਆ ਵੀਆਹੀਆ ਲਾੜੇ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: jadhahu seeaa veeaaheeaa laaRe sohan paas ||
verses.translation: When they were married, their husbands looked so handsome beside them.

verses.original: ਹੀਡੋਲੀ ਚੜਿ ਆਈਆ ਦੰਦ ਖੰਡ ਕੀਤੇ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: heeddolee chaR aaieeaa dha(n)dh kha(n)dd keete raas ||
verses.translation: They came in palanquins, decorated with ivory;

verses.original: ਉਪਰਹੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਾਰੀਐ ਝਲੇ ਝਿਮਕਨਿ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: auparahu paanee vaareeaai jhale jhimakan paas ||2||
verses.translation: water was sprinkled over their heads, and glittering fans were waved above them. ||2||

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਲਖੁ ਲਹਨਿੑ ਬਹਿਠੀਆ ਲਖੁ ਲਹਨਿੑ ਖੜੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: eik lakh lahani(h) bahiTheeaa lakh lahani(h) khaReeaa ||
verses.translation: They were given hundreds of thousands of coins when they sat, and hundreds of thousands of coins when they stood.

verses.original: ਗਰੀ ਛੁਹਾਰੇ ਖਾਂਦੀਆ ਮਾਣਨਿੑ ਸੇਜੜੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: garee chhuhaare khaa(n)dheeaa maanani(h) sejaReeaa ||
verses.translation: They ate coconuts and dates, and rested comfortably upon their beds.

verses.original: ਤਿਨੑ ਗਲਿ ਸਿਲਕਾ ਪਾਈਆ ਤੁਟਨਿੑ ਮੋਤਸਰੀਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tin(h) gal silakaa paieeaa tuTani(h) motasareeaa ||3||
verses.translation: But ropes were put around their necks, and their strings of pearls were broken. ||3||

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਵੈਰੀ ਹੋਏ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਰਖੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhan joban dhui vairee hoe jin(h)ee rakhe ra(n)g lai ||
verses.translation: Their wealth and youthful beauty, which gave them so much pleasure, have now become their enemies.

verses.original: ਦੂਤਾ ਨੋ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਲੈ ਚਲੇ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhootaa no furamaiaa lai chale pat gavai ||
verses.translation: The order was given to the soldiers, who dishonored them, and carried them away.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: je tis bhaavai dhe vaddiaaiee je bhaavai dhei sajai ||4||
verses.translation: If it is pleasing to God's Will, He bestows greatness; if is pleases His Will, He bestows punishment. ||4||

verses.original: ਅਗੋ ਦੇ ਜੇ ਚੇਤੀਐ ਤਾਂ ਕਾਇਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ago dhe je cheteeaai taa(n) kait milai sajai ||
verses.translation: If someone focuses on the Lord beforehand, then why should he be punished?

verses.original: ਸਾਹਾਂ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗਵਾਈਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਤਮਾਸੈ ਚਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: saahaa(n) surat gavaieeaa ra(n)g tamaasai chai ||
verses.translation: The kings had lost their higher consciousness, reveling in pleasure and sensuality.

verses.original: ਬਾਬਰਵਾਣੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਗਈ ਕੁਇਰੁ ਨ ਰੋਟੀ ਖਾਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: baabaravaanee fir giee kuir na roTee khai ||5||
verses.translation: Since Baabar's rule has been proclaimed, even the princes have no food to eat. ||5||

verses.original: ਇਕਨਾ ਵਖਤ ਖੁਆਈਅਹਿ ਇਕਨੑਾ ਪੂਜਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eikanaa vakhat khuaaie'eeh ikan(h)aa poojaa jai ||
verses.translation: The Muslims have lost their five times of daily prayer, and the Hindus have lost their worship as well.

verses.original: ਚਉਕੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਹਿੰਦਵਾਣੀਆ ਕਿਉ ਟਿਕੇ ਕਢਹਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: chauke vin hi(n)dhavaaneeaa kiau Tike kaddeh nai ||
verses.translation: Without their sacred squares, how shall the Hindu women bathe and apply the frontal marks to their foreheads?

verses.original: ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਹੁਣਿ ਕਹਣਿ ਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: raam na kabahoo chetio hun kahan na milai khudhai ||6||
verses.translation: They never remembered their Lord as Raam, and now they cannot even chant Khudaa-i||6||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਇਕਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪੁਛਹਿ ਸੁਖ ॥
verses.translit: eik ghar aaveh aapanai ik mil mil puchheh sukh ||
verses.translation: Some have returned to their homes, and meeting their relatives, they ask about their safety.

verses.original: ਇਕਨੑਾ ਏਹੋ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਬਹਿ ਬਹਿ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਦੁਖ ॥
verses.translit: eikan(h)aa eho likhiaa beh beh roveh dhukh ||
verses.translation: For some, it is pre-ordained that they shall sit and cry out in pain.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਨੁਖ ॥੭॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaavai so theeaai naanak kiaa maanukh ||7||11||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases Him, comes to pass. O Nanak, what is the fate of mankind? ||7||11||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਖੇਲ ਤਬੇਲਾ ਘੋੜੇ ਕਹਾ ਭੇਰੀ ਸਹਨਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kahaa su khel tabelaa ghoRe kahaa bheree sahanaiee ||
verses.translation: Where are the games, the stables, the horses? Where are the drums and the bugles?

verses.original: ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਤੇਗਬੰਦ ਗਾਡੇਰੜਿ ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਲਾਲ ਕਵਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kahaa su tegaba(n)dh gaadderaR kahaa su laal kavaiee ||
verses.translation: Where are the sword-belts and chariots? Where are those scarlet uniforms?

verses.original: ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਆਰਸੀਆ ਮੁਹ ਬੰਕੇ ਐਥੈ ਦਿਸਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahaa su aaraseeaa muh ba(n)ke aaithai dhiseh naahee ||1||
verses.translation: Where are the rings and the beautiful faces? They are no longer to be seen here. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: eih jag teraa too gosaiee ||
verses.translation: This world is Yours; You are the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਘੜੀ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ਜਰੁ ਵੰਡਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਭਾਂਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ek ghaRee meh thaap uthaape jar va(n)dd dhevai bhaa(n)iee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In an instant, You establish and disestablish. You distribute wealth as it pleases You. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਹਾਂ ਸੁ ਘਰ ਦਰ ਮੰਡਪ ਮਹਲਾ ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਬੰਕ ਸਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kahaa(n) su ghar dhar ma(n)ddap mahalaa kahaa su ba(n)k saraiee ||
verses.translation: Where are the houses, the gates, the hotels and palaces? Where are those beautiful way-stations?

verses.original: ਕਹਾਂ ਸੁ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਵੇਖਿ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kahaa(n) su sej sukhaalee kaaman jis vekh needh na paiee ||
verses.translation: Where are those beautiful women, reclining on their beds, whose beauty would not allow one to sleep?

verses.original: ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਪਾਨ ਤੰਬੋਲੀ ਹਰਮਾ ਹੋਈਆ ਛਾਈ ਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kahaa su paan ta(n)bolee haramaa hoieeaa chhaiee maiee ||2||
verses.translation: Where are those betel leaves, their sellers, and the haremees? They have vanished like shadows. ||2||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਜਰ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਘਣੀ ਵਿਗੁਤੀ ਇਨਿ ਜਰ ਘਣੀ ਖੁਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: eis jar kaaran ghanee vigutee in jar ghanee khuaaiee ||
verses.translation: For the sake of this wealth, so many were ruined; because of this wealth, so many have been disgraced.

verses.original: ਪਾਪਾ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੁਇਆ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: paapaa baajhahu hovai naahee muiaa saath na jaiee ||
verses.translation: It was not gathered without sin, and it does not go along with the dead.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਖੁਸਿ ਲਏ ਚੰਗਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jis no aap khuaae karataa khus le cha(n)giaaiee ||3||
verses.translation: Those, whom the Creator Lord would destroy - first He strips them of virtue. ||3||

verses.original: ਕੋਟੀ ਹੂ ਪੀਰ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਏ ਜਾ ਮੀਰੁ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: koTee hoo peer varaj rahaae jaa meer suniaa dhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Millions of religious leaders failed to halt the invader, when they heard of the Emperor's invasion.

verses.original: ਥਾਨ ਮੁਕਾਮ ਜਲੇ ਬਿਜ ਮੰਦਰ ਮੁਛਿ ਮੁਛਿ ਕੁਇਰ ਰੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: thaan mukaam jale bij ma(n)dhar muchh muchh kuir rulaiaa ||
verses.translation: He burned the rest-houses and the ancient temples; he cut the princes limb from limb, and cast them into the dust.

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਮੁਗਲੁ ਨ ਹੋਆ ਅੰਧਾ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਰਚਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: koiee mugal na hoaa a(n)dhaa kinai na parachaa laiaa ||4||
verses.translation: None of the Mugals went blind, and no one performed any miracle. ||4||

verses.original: ਮੁਗਲ ਪਠਾਣਾ ਭਈ ਲੜਾਈ ਰਣ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਗ ਵਗਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: mugal paThaanaa bhiee laRaiee ran meh teg vagaiee ||
verses.translation: The battle raged between the Mugals and the Pat'haans, and the swords clashed on the battlefield.

verses.original: ਓਨੑੀ ਤੁਪਕ ਤਾਣਿ ਚਲਾਈ ਓਨੑੀ ਹਸਤਿ ਚਿੜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: on(h)ee tupak taan chalaiee on(h)ee hasat chiRaiee ||
verses.translation: They took aim and fired their guns, and they attacked with their elephants.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਚੀਰੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਟੀ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਮਰਣਾ ਭਾਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jin(h) kee cheeree dharageh paaTee tin(h)aa maranaa bhaiee ||5||
verses.translation: Those men whose letters were torn in the Lord's Court, were destined to die, O Siblings of Destiny. ||5||

verses.original: ਇਕ ਹਿੰਦਵਾਣੀ ਅਵਰ ਤੁਰਕਾਣੀ ਭਟਿਆਣੀ ਠਕੁਰਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: eik hi(n)dhavaanee avar turakaanee bhaTiaanee Thakuraanee ||
verses.translation: The Hindu women, the Muslim women, the Bhattis and the Rajputs

verses.original: ਇਕਨੑਾ ਪੇਰਣ ਸਿਰ ਖੁਰ ਪਾਟੇ ਇਕਨੑਾ ਵਾਸੁ ਮਸਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: eikan(h)aa peran sir khur paaTe ikan(h)aa vaas masaanee ||
verses.translation: some had their robes torn away, from head to foot, while others came to dwell in the cremation ground.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਕੇ ਬੰਕੇ ਘਰੀ ਨ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਿਉ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jin(h) ke ba(n)ke gharee na aaiaa tin(h) kiau rain vihaanee ||6||
verses.translation: Their husbands did not return home - how did they pass their night? ||6||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: aape kare karaae karataa kis no aakh sunaieeaai ||
verses.translation: The Creator Himself acts, and causes others to act. Unto whom should we complain?

verses.original: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਸ ਥੈ ਜਾਇ ਰੂਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh sukh terai bhaanai hovai kis thai jai rooaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Pleasure and pain come by Your Will; unto whom should we go and cry?

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਏ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੭॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: hukamee hukam chalaae vigasai naanak likhiaa paieeaai ||7||12||
verses.translation: The Commander issues His Command, and is pleased. O Nanak, we receive what is written in our destiny. ||7||12||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਕਾਫੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa kaafee mahalaa pehilaa ghar atthvaa asaTapadheeaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Kaafee, First Mehla, Eighth House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਗੋਇਲਿ ਗੋਇਲੀ ਤੈਸੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaise goil goilee taise sa(n)saaraa ||
verses.translation: As the shepherd is in the field for only a short time, so is one in the world.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਆਦਮੀ ਬਾਂਧਹਿ ਘਰ ਬਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kooR kamaaveh aadhamee baa(n)dheh ghar baaraa ||1||
verses.translation: Practicing falsehood, they build their homes. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਾਗਹੁ ਜਾਗਹੁ ਸੂਤਿਹੋ ਚਲਿਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaagahu jaagahu sootiho chaliaa vanajaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Wake up! Wake up! O sleepers, see that the travelling merchant is leaving. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨੀਤ ਨੀਤ ਘਰ ਬਾਂਧੀਅਹਿ ਜੇ ਰਹਣਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: neet neet ghar baa(n)dhe'eeh je rahanaa hoiee ||
verses.translation: Go ahead and build your houses, if you think you will stay here forever and ever.

verses.original: ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਵੈ ਜੀਉ ਚਲਸੀ ਜੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pi(n)dd pavai jeeau chalasee je jaanai koiee ||2||
verses.translation: The body shall fall, and the soul shall depart; if only they knew this. ||2||

verses.original: ਓਹੀ ਓਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਸੀ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: ohee ohee kiaa karahu hai hosee soiee ||
verses.translation: Why do you cry out and mourn for the dead? The Lord is, and shall always be.

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਰੋਵਹੁਗੇ ਓਸ ਨੋ ਤੁਮੑ ਕਉ ਕਉਣੁ ਰੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tum rovahuge os no tum(h) kau kaun roiee ||3||
verses.translation: You mourn for that person, but who will mourn for you? ||3||

verses.original: ਧੰਧਾ ਪਿਟਿਹੁ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਤੁਮੑ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)dhaa piTih bhaieeho tum(h) kooR kamaavahu ||
verses.translation: You are engrossed in worldly entanglements, O Siblings of Destiny, and you are practicing falsehood.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਨ ਸੁਣਈ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਤੁਮੑ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਣਾਵਹੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: oh na suniee kat hee tum(h) lok sunaavahu ||4||
verses.translation: The dead person does not hear anything at all; your cries are heard only by other people. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਸੁਤਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਾਗਾਏ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jis te sutaa naanakaa jaagaae soiee ||
verses.translation: Only the Lord, who causes the mortal to sleep, O Nanak, can awaken him again.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਘਰੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਾਂ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: je ghar boojhai aapanaa taa(n) needh na hoiee ||5||
verses.translation: One who understands his true home, does not sleep. ||5||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਚਲਦਾ ਲੈ ਚਲਿਆ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: je chaladhaa lai chaliaa kichh sa(n)pai naale ||
verses.translation: If the departing mortal can take his wealth with him,

verses.original: ਤਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: taa dhan sa(n)chahu dhekh kai boojhahu beechaare ||6||
verses.translation: then go ahead and gather wealth yourself. See this, reflect upon it, and understand. ||6||

verses.original: ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਖਸੂਦੁ ਲੈਹੁ ਮਤ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: vanaj karahu makhasoodh laih mat pachhotaavahu ||
verses.translation: Make your deals, and obtain the true merchandise, or else you shall regret it later.

verses.original: ਅਉਗਣ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਰਹੁ ਐਸੇ ਤਤੁ ਪਰਾਵਹੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: aaugan chhoddahu gun karahu aaise tat paraavahu ||7||
verses.translation: Abandon your vices, and practice virtue, and you shall obtain the essence of reality. ||7||

verses.original: ਧਰਮੁ ਭੂਮਿ ਸਤੁ ਬੀਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਐਸੀ ਕਿਰਸ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: dharam bhoom sat beej kar aaisee kiras kamaavahu ||
verses.translation: Plant the seed of Truth in the soil of Dharmic faith, and practice such farming.

verses.original: ਤਾਂ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਜਾਣੀਅਹੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈ ਜਾਵਹੁ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: taa(n) vaapaaree jaaneeahu laahaa lai jaavahu ||8||
verses.translation: Only then will you be known as a merchant, if you take your profits with you. ||8||

verses.original: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: karam hovai satigur milai boojhai beechaaraa ||
verses.translation: If the Lord shows His Mercy, one meets the True Guru; contemplating Him, one comes to understand.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਸੁਣੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: naam vakhaanai sune naam naame biauhaaraa ||9||
verses.translation: Then, one chants the Naam, hears the Naam, and deals only in the Naam. ||9||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਲਾਹਾ ਤੋਟਾ ਤਿਵੈ ਵਾਟ ਚਲਦੀ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: jiau laahaa toTaa tivai vaaT chaladhee aaiee ||
verses.translation: As is the profit, so is the loss; this is the way of the world.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਾਈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧੦॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaavai naanakaa saiee vaddiaaiee ||10||13||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases His Will, O Nanak, is glory for me. ||10||13||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਢੂਢੀਆ ਕੋ ਨੀਮੑੀ ਮੈਡਾ ॥
verses.translit: chaare ku(n)ddaa ddooddeeaa ko neem(h)ee maiddaa ||
verses.translation: I have searched in the four directions, but no one is mine.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਤੂ ਮੈ ਹਉ ਤੈਡਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: je tudh bhaavai saahibaa too mai hau taiddaa ||1||
verses.translation: If it pleases You, O Lord Master, then You are mine, and I am Yours. ||1||

verses.original: ਦਰੁ ਬੀਭਾ ਮੈ ਨੀਮਿੑ ਕੋ ਕੈ ਕਰੀ ਸਲਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhar beebhaa mai neemi(h) ko kai karee salaam ||
verses.translation: There is no other door for me; where shall I go to worship?

verses.original: ਹਿਕੋ ਮੈਡਾ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
