verses.translit: hiko maiddaa too dhanee saachaa mukh naam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are my only Lord; Your True Name is in my mouth. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਿਧਾ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸਿਧ ਪੀਰ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ॥
verses.translit: sidhaa sevan sidh peer maageh ridh sidh ||
verses.translation: Some serve the Siddhas, the beings of spiritual perfection, and some serve spiritual teachers; they beg for wealth and miraculous powers.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਬੁਧਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mai ik naam na veesarai saache gur budh ||2||
verses.translation: May I never forget the Naam, the Name of the One Lord. This is the wisdom of the True Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋਗੀ ਭੋਗੀ ਕਾਪੜੀ ਕਿਆ ਭਵਹਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ॥
verses.translit: jogee bhogee kaapaRee kiaa bhaveh dhisa(n)tar ||
verses.translation: Why do the Yogis, the revellers, and the beggars wander in foreign lands?

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੑਹੀ ਤਤੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਤਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh na cheen(h)hee tat saar nira(n)tar ||3||
verses.translation: They do not understand the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and the essence of excellence within them. ||3||

verses.original: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪਾਧੇ ਜੋਇਸੀ ਨਿਤ ਪੜ੍ਹਹਿ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ddit paadhe joisee nit paRheh puraanaa ||
verses.translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars, the teachers and astrologers, and those who endlessly read the Puraanas,

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ ਘਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਲੁਕਾਣਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar vasat na jaanan(h)ee ghaT braham lukaanaa ||4||
verses.translation: do not know what is within; God is hidden deep within them. ||4||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਤਪਸੀ ਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਤਪੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਤੀਰਥ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: eik tapasee ban meh tap kareh nit teerath vaasaa ||
verses.translation: Some penitents perform penance in the forests, and some dwell forever at sacred shrines.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਹਿ ਤਾਮਸੀ ਕਾਹੇ ਭਏ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: aap na cheeneh taamasee kaahe bhe udhaasaa ||5||
verses.translation: The unenlightened people do not understand themselves - why have they become renunciates? ||5||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਦੇ ਸੇ ਜਤੀ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: eik bi(n)dh jatan kar raakhadhe se jatee kahaaveh ||
verses.translation: Some control their sexual energy, and are known as celibates.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਨ ਛੂਟਹੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: bin gur sabadh na chhooTahee bhram aaveh jaaveh ||6||
verses.translation: But without the Guru's Word, they are not saved, and they wander in reincarnation. ||6||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਾਧਿਕਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: eik girahee sevak saadhikaa gurmatee laage ||
verses.translation: Some are householders, servants, and seekers, attached to the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁ ਜਾਗੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: naam dhaan isanaan dhiraR har bhagat su jaage ||7||
verses.translation: They hold fast to the Naam, to charity, to cleansing and purification; they remain awake in devotion to the Lord. ||7||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸੋ ਜਾਇ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur te dhar ghar jaaneeaai so jai sin(j)aanai ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru, the Gate of the Lord's Home is found, and that place is recognized.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੮॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: naanak naam na veesarai saache man maanai ||8||14||
verses.translation: Nanak does not forget the Naam; his mind has surrendered to the True Lord. ||8||14||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਲੇ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਸਚਿ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: manasaa maneh samaile bhaujal sach taranaa ||
verses.translation: Stilling the desires of the mind, the mortal truly crosses over the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aadh jugaadh dhiaal too Thaakur teree saranaa ||1||
verses.translation: In the very beginning, and throughout the ages, You have been the Merciful Lord and Master; I seek Your Sanctuary. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਦਾਤੌ ਹਮ ਜਾਚਿਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: too dhaatau ham jaachikaa har dharasan dheejai ||
verses.translation: You are the Giver, and I am a mere beggar. Lord, please grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਨ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam dhiaaieeaai man ma(n)dhar bheejai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh meditates on the Naam; the temple of his mind resounds with joy. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੂੜਾ ਲਾਲਚੁ ਛੋਡੀਐ ਤਉ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: kooRaa laalach chhoddeeaai tau saach pachhaanai ||
verses.translation: Renouncing false greed, one comes to realize the Truth.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਪਰਮਾਰਥੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh samaieeaai paramaarath jaanai ||2||
verses.translation: So let yourself be absorbed in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and know this supreme realization. ||2||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਲੋਭੀਆ ਲੁਭਤਉ ਲੋਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: eih man raajaa lobheeaa lubhatau lobhaiee ||
verses.translation: This mind is a greedy king, engrossed in greed.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh lobh nivaareeaai har siau ban aaiee ||3||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh eliminates his greed, and comes to an understanding with the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਲਰਿ ਖੇਤੀ ਬੀਜੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: kalar khetee beejeeaai kiau laahaa paavai ||
verses.translation: Planting the seeds in the rocky soil, how can one reap a profit?

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਸਚਿ ਨ ਭੀਜਈ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੂੜਿ ਗਡਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: manmukh sach na bheejiee kooR kooR gaddaavai ||4||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh is not pleased with Truth; the false are buried in falsehood. ||4||

verses.original: ਲਾਲਚੁ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਅੰਧਿਹੋ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: laalach chhoddahu a(n)dhiho laalach dhukh bhaaree ||
verses.translation: So renounce greed - you are blind! Greed only brings pain.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੌ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: saachau saahib man vasai haumai bikh maaree ||5||
verses.translation: When the True Lord dwells within the mind, the poisonous ego is conquered. ||5||

verses.original: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਕੁਵਾਟੜੀ ਮੂਸਹੁਗੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhubidhaa chhodd kuvaaTaRee moosahuge bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Renounce the evil way of duality, or you shall be plundered, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: ahinis naam salaaheeaai satigur saranaiee ||6||
verses.translation: Day and night, praise the Naam, in the Sanctuary of the True Guru's protection. ||6||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਥਰੁ ਸੈਲੁ ਹੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਫੀਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh pathar sail hai dhirag jeevan feekaa ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh is a rock, a stone. His life is cursed and useless.

verses.original: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਕੇਤਾ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਅਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੂਕਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jal meh ketaa raakheeaai abh a(n)tar sookaa ||7||
verses.translation: No matter now long a stone is kept under water, it still remains dry at its core. ||7||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam nidhaan hai poorai gur dheeaa ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is the treasure; the Perfect Guru has given it to me.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਮਥਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ॥੮॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: naanak naam na veesarai math a(n)mrit peeaa ||8||15||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who does not forget the Naam, churns and drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||8||15||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਚਲੇ ਚਲਣਹਾਰ ਵਾਟ ਵਟਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: chale chalanahaar vaaT vaTaiaa ||
verses.translation: The travellers travel from one road to another.

verses.original: ਧੰਧੁ ਪਿਟੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dha(n)dh piTe sa(n)saar sach na bhaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: The world is engrossed in its entanglements, and does not appreciate the Truth. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਭਵੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਢੂਢੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa bhaveeaai kiaa ddooddeeaai gur sabadh dhikhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Why wander around, and why go searching, when the Guru's Shabad reveals Him to us?

verses.original: ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਿਸਰਜਿਆ ਅਪਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mamataa moh visarajiaa apanai ghar aaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Leaving behind egotism and attachment, I have arrived at my own home. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ਕੂੜਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: sach milai sachiaar kooR na paieeaai ||
verses.translation: Through Truth, one meets the True One; He is not obtained through falsehood.

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sache siau chit lai bahuR na aaieeaai ||2||
verses.translation: Centering your consciousness on the True Lord, you shall not have to come into the world again. ||2||

verses.original: ਮੋਇਆ ਕਉ ਕਿਆ ਰੋਵਹੁ ਰੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੂ ॥
verses.translit: moiaa kau kiaa rovahu roi na jaanahoo ||
verses.translation: Why do you weep for the dead? You do not know how to weep.

verses.original: ਰੋਵਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਹੂ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: rovahu sach salaeh hukam pachhaanahoo ||3||
verses.translation: Weep by praising the True Lord, and recognize His Command. ||3||

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਵਜਹੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ਆਇਆ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: hukamee vajahu likhai aaiaa jaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: Blessed is the birth of one who is destined to abide by the Lord's Command.

verses.original: ਲਾਹਾ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਿਞਾਣੀਐ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: laahaa palai pai hukam sin(j)aaneeaai ||4||
verses.translation: He obtains the true profit, realizing the Lord's Command. ||4||

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ ਦਰਗਹ ਭਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: hukamee paidhaa jai dharageh bhaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: If it pleases the Commander, one goes to His Court, robed in honor.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰ ਬੰਦਿ ਰਬਾਣੀਐ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: hukame hee sir maar ba(n)dh rabaaneeaai ||5||
verses.translation: By His Command, God's slaves are hit over the head. ||5||

verses.original: ਲਾਹਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਆਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: laahaa sach niaau man vasaieeaai ||
verses.translation: The profit is earned by enshrining Truth and justice in the mind.

verses.original: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ਗਰਬੁ ਵਞਾਈਐ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: likhiaa palai pai garab van(j)aieeaai ||6||
verses.translation: They obtain what is written in their destiny, and overcome pride. ||6||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੀਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰ ਵਾਦਿ ਖਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: manmukheeaa sir maar vaadh khapaieeaai ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are hit over the head, and consumed by conflict.

verses.original: ਠਗਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਬੰਨਿੑ ਚਲਾਈਐ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: Thag muThee kooRiaar ba(n)ni(h) chalaieeaai ||7||
verses.translation: The cheaters are plundered by falsehood; they are chained and led away. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਇ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: saahib ridhai vasai na pachhotaavahee ||
verses.translation: Enshrine the Lord Master in your mind, and you shall not have to repent.

verses.original: ਗੁਨਹਾਂ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਵਹੀ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: gunahaa(n) bakhasanahaar sabadh kamaavahee ||8||
verses.translation: He forgives our sins, when we practice the Teachings of the Guru's Word. ||8||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਘਾਲੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: naanak ma(n)gai sach gurmukh ghaaleeaai ||
verses.translation: Nanak begs for the True Name, which is obtained by the Gurmukh.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ॥੯॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: mai tujh bin avar na koi nadhar nihaaleeaai ||9||16||
verses.translation: Without You, I have no other at all; please, bless me with Your Glance of Grace. ||9||16||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਜੰਗਲੁ ਢੂਢੀ ਜਾਇ ਮੈ ਘਰਿ ਬਨੁ ਹਰੀਆਵਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa ja(n)gal ddooddee jai mai ghar ban hareeaavalaa ||
verses.translation: Why should I go searching in the forests, when the woods of my home are so green?

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਟਿਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਤਾਵਲਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sach Tikai ghar aai sabadh utaavalaa ||1||
verses.translation: The True Word of the Shabad has instantaneously come and settled in my heart. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਸੋਇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jeh dhekhaa teh soi avar na jaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, there He is; I know no other.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee kaar kamai mahal pachhaaneeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Working for the Guru, one realizes the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit: aap milaavai sach taa man bhaaviee ||
verses.translation: The True Lord blends us with Himself, when it is pleasing to His Mind.

verses.original: ਚਲੈ ਸਦਾ ਰਜਾਇ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: chalai sadhaa rajai a(n)k samaaviee ||2||
verses.translation: One who ever walks in accordance with His Will, merges into His Being. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa saahib man vasai vasiaa man soiee ||
verses.translation: When the True Lord dwells in the mind, that mind flourishes.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aape dhe vaddiaaieeaa dhe toT na hoiee ||3||
verses.translation: He Himself grants greatness; His Gifts are never exhausted. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਬੇ ਤਬੇ ਕੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਕਿਉ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: abe tabe kee chaakaree kiau dharageh paavai ||
verses.translation: Serving this and that person, how can one obtain the Lord's Court?

verses.original: ਪਥਰ ਕੀ ਬੇੜੀ ਜੇ ਚੜੈ ਭਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਬੁਡਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: pathar kee beRee je chaRai bhar naal buddaavai ||4||
verses.translation: If someone embarks on a boat of stone, he shall drown with its cargo. ||4||

verses.original: ਆਪਨੜਾ ਮਨੁ ਵੇਚੀਐ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: aapanaRaa man vecheeaai sir dheejai naale ||
verses.translation: So offer your mind, and surrender your head with it.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਅਪਨਾ ਘਰੁ ਭਾਲੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: gurmukh vasat pachhaaneeaai apanaa ghar bhaale ||5||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh realizes the true essence, and finds the home of his own self. ||5||

verses.original: ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: ja(n)man maranaa aakheeaai tin karatai keeaa ||
verses.translation: People discuss birth and death; the Creator created this.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਮਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: aap gavaiaa mar rahe fir maran na theeaa ||6||
verses.translation: Those who conquer their selfhood and remain dead, shall never have to die again. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਾਈ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: saiee kaar kamaavanee dhur kee furamaiee ||
verses.translation: Do those deeds which the Primal Lord has ordered for you.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਕਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: je man satigur dhe milai kin keemat paiee ||7||
verses.translation: If one surrenders his mind upon meeting the True Guru, who can estimate its value? ||7||

verses.original: ਰਤਨਾ ਪਾਰਖੁ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ratanaa paarakh so dhanee tin keemat paiee ||
verses.translation: That Lord Master is the Assayer of the jewel of the mind; He places the value on it.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੮॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: naanak saahib man vasai sachee vaddiaaiee ||8||17||
verses.translation: O Nanak, True is the Glory of that one, in whose mind the Lord Master dwells. ||8||17||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h)ee naam visaariaa dhoojai bharam bhulaiee ||
verses.translation: Those who have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are deluded by doubt and duality.

verses.original: ਮੂਲੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਡਾਲੀ ਲਗੇ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਛਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mool chhodd ddaalee lage kiaa paaveh chhaiee ||1||
verses.translation: Those who abandon the roots and cling to the branches, shall obtain only ashes. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਜੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: bin naavai kiau chhooTeeaai je jaanai koiee ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, how can one be emancipated? Who knows this?

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hoi ta chhooTeeaai manmukh pat khoiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh is emancipated; the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਏਕੋ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h)ee eko seviaa pooree mat bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Those who serve the One Lord become perfect in their understanding, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aadh jugaadh nira(n)janaa jan har saranaiee ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord's humble servant finds Sanctuary in Him, the Immaculate One, from the very beginning, and throughout the ages. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: saahib meraa ek hai avar nahee bhaiee ||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master is the One; there is no other, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਚੇ ਪਰਥਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kirapaa te sukh paiaa saache parathaiee ||3||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the True Lord, celestial peace is obtained. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਕੇਤੀ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur bin kinai na paio ketee kahai kahaae ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, no one has obtained Him, although many may claim to have done so.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਵਾਟੜੀਂ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: aap dhikhaavai vaaTaRee(n) sachee bhagat dhiraRaae ||4||
verses.translation: He Himself reveals the Way, and implants true devotion within. ||4||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਜੇ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਭੀ ਉਝੜਿ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh je samajhaieeaai bhee ujhaR jaae ||
verses.translation: Even if the self-willed manmukh is instructed, he stills goes into the wilderness.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਛੂਟਸੀ ਮਰਿ ਨਰਕ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: bin har naam na chhooTasee mar narak samaae ||5||
verses.translation: Without the Lord's Name, he shall not be emancipated; he shall die, and sink into hell. ||5||

verses.original: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਭਰਮਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲੇਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: janam marai bharamaieeaai har naam na levai ||
verses.translation: He wanders through birth and death, and never chants the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: taa kee keemat naa pavai bin gur kee sevai ||6||
verses.translation: He never realizes his own value, without serving the Guru. ||6||

verses.original: ਜੇਹੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਈਐ ਕਰਣੀ ਭੀ ਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jehee sev karaieeaai karanee bhee saiee ||
verses.translation: Whatever service the Lord causes us to do, that is just what we do.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: aap kare kis aakheeaai vekhai vaddiaaiee ||7||
verses.translation: He Himself acts; who else should be mentioned? He beholds His own greatness. ||7||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee sevaa so kare jis aap karaae ||
verses.translation: He alone serves the Guru, whom the Lord Himself inspires to do so.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੇ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੮॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: naanak sir dhe chhooTeeaai dharageh pat paae ||8||18||
verses.translation: O Nanak, offering his head, one is emancipated, and honored in the Court of the Lord. ||8||18||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਰੂੜੋ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮਾਹਰੋ ਰੂੜੀ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: rooRo Thaakur maaharo rooRee gurbaanee ||
verses.translation: Beautiful is the Supreme Lord and Master, and beautiful is the Word of the Guru's Bani.

verses.original: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: vaddai bhaag satigur milai paieeaai padh nirabaanee ||1||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, one meets the True Guru, and the supreme status of Nirvaanaa is obtained. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਓਲੑਗੀਆ ਓਲੑਗੀ ਹਮ ਛੋਰੂ ਥਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: mai ol(h)geeaa ol(h)gee ham chhoroo thaare ||
verses.translation: I am the lowest slave of Your slaves; I am Your most humble servant.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jiau too(n) raakheh tiau rahaa mukh naam hamaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: As You keep me, I live. Your Name is in my mouth. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਘਣੀ ਭਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan kee piaasaa ghanee bhaanai man bhaieeaai ||
verses.translation: I have such a great thirst for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; my mind accepts Your Will, and so You are pleased with me.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਾਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਭਾਣੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mere Thaakur haath vaddiaaieeaa bhaanai pat paieeaai ||2||
verses.translation: Greatness is in the Hands of my Lord and Master; by His Will, honor is obtained. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਚਉ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: saachau dhoor na jaaneeaai a(n)tar hai soiee ||
verses.translation: Do not think that the True Lord is far away; He is deep within.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਕਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jeh dhekhaa teh rav rahe kin keemat hoiee ||3||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, there I find Him pervading; how can I estimate His value? ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਹਰੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: aap kare aape hare vekhai vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: He Himself does, and He Himself undoes. He Himself beholds His glorious greatness.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ਇਉ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hoi nihaaleeaai iau keemat paiee ||4||
verses.translation: Becoming Gurmukh, one beholds Him, and so, His value is appraised. ||4||

verses.original: ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਲਾਹਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jeevadhiaa laahaa milai gur kaar kamaavai ||
verses.translation: So earn your profits while you are alive, by serving the Guru.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: poorab hovai likhiaa taa satigur paavai ||5||
verses.translation: If it is so pre-ordained, then one finds the True Guru. ||5||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤੋਟਾ ਨਿਤ ਹੈ ਭਰਮਹਿ ਭਰਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh toTaa nit hai bharameh bharamaae ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs continually lose, and wander around, deluded by doubt.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ ਕਿਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: manmukh a(n)dh na chetiee kiau dharasan paae ||6||
verses.translation: The blind manmukhs do not remember the Lord; how can they obtain the Blessed Vision of His Darshan? ||6||

verses.original: ਤਾ ਜਗਿ ਆਇਆ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਾਚੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: taa jag aaiaa jaaneeaai saachai liv laae ||
verses.translation: One's coming into the world is judged worthwhile only if one lovingly attunes oneself to the True Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਭਏ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gur bheTe paaras bhe jotee jot milaae ||7||
verses.translation: Meeting the Guru, one becomes invaluable; his light merges into the Light. ||7||

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੋ ਕਾਰ ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: ahinis rahai niraalamo kaar dhur kee karanee ||
verses.translation: Day and night, he remains detached, and serves the Primal Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ॥੮॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: naanak naam sa(n)tokheeaa raate har charanee ||8||19||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Lord's Lotus Feet, are content with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||8||19||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੇਤਾ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: ketaa aakhan aakheeaai taa ke a(n)t na jaanaa ||
verses.translation: No matter how much one may describe the Lord, His limits still cannot be known.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਨਿਧਰਿਆ ਧਰ ਏਕ ਤੂੰ ਮੈ ਤਾਣੁ ਸਤਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mai nidhariaa dhar ek too(n) mai taan sataanaa ||1||
verses.translation: I am without any support; You, O Lord, are my only Support; You are my almighty power. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਚ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: naanak kee aradhaas hai sach naam suhelaa ||
verses.translation: This is Nanak's prayer, that he may be adorned with the True Name.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮੇਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aap giaa sojhee piee gur sabadhee melaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: When self-conceit is eradicated, and understanding is obtained, one meets the Lord, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ਪਾਈਐ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: haumai garab gavaieeaai paieeaai veechaar ||
verses.translation: Abandoning egotism and pride, one obtains contemplative understanding.

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਦੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saahib siau man maaniaa dhe saach adhaar ||2||
verses.translation: When the mind surrenders to the Lord Master, He bestows the support of the Truth. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ahinis naam sa(n)tokheeaa sevaa sach saiee ||
verses.translation: Day and night, remain content with the Naam, the Name of the Lord; that is the true service.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ ਚਾਲੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: taa kau bighan na laagiee chaalai hukam rajaiee ||3||
verses.translation: No misfortune troubles one who follows the Command of the Lord's Will. ||3||

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਸੋ ਪਵੈ ਖਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: hukam rajaiee jo chalai so pavai khajaanai ||
verses.translation: One who follows the Command of the Lord's Will is taken into the Lord's Treasury.

verses.original: ਖੋਟੇ ਠਵਰ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਰਲੇ ਜੂਠਾਨੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: khoTe Thavar na painee rale jooThaanai ||4||
verses.translation: The counterfeit find no place there; they are mixed with the false ones. ||4||

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਖਰਾ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: nit nit kharaa samaaleeaai sach saudhaa paieeaai ||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, the genuine coins are treasured; with them, the true merchandise is purchased.

verses.original: ਖੋਟੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਨੀ ਲੇ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲਾਈਐ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: khoTe nadhar na aavanee le agan jalaieeaai ||5||
verses.translation: The false ones are not seen in the Lord's Treasury; they are seized and cast into the fire again. ||5||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਿਆ ਪਰਮਾਤਮੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jinee aatam cheeniaa paramaatam soiee ||
verses.translation: Those who understand their own souls, are themselves the Supreme Soul.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਫਲੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: eko a(n)mirat birakh hai fal a(n)mrit hoiee ||6||
verses.translation: The One Lord is the tree of ambrosial nectar, which bears the ambrosial fruit. ||6||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat fal jinee chaakhiaa sach rahe aghaiee ||
verses.translation: Those who taste the ambrosial fruit remain satisfied with Truth.

verses.original: ਤਿੰਨਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਭੇਦੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: ti(n)naa bharam na bhedh hai har rasan rasaiee ||7||
verses.translation: They have no doubt or sense of separation - their tongues taste the divine taste. ||7||

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਆਇਆ ਚਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: hukam sa(n)jogee aaiaa chal sadhaa rajaiee ||
verses.translation: By His Command, and through your past actions, you came into the world; walk forever according to His Will.

verses.original: ਅਉਗਣਿਆਰੇ ਕਉ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਨਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੮॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: aauganiaare kau gun naanakai sach milai vaddaiee ||8||20||
verses.translation: Please, grant virtue to Nanak, the virtueless one; bless him with the glorious greatness of the Truth. ||8||20||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: man raatau har nai sach vakhaaniaa ||
verses.translation: One whose mind is attuned to the Lord's Name speaks the truth.

verses.original: ਲੋਕਾ ਦਾ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਇ ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: lokaa dhaa kiaa jai jaa tudh bhaaniaa ||1||
verses.translation: What would the people lose, if I became pleasing to You, O Lord? ||1||

verses.original: ਜਉ ਲਗੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਰਾਣ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jau lag jeeau paraan sach dhiaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: As long as there is the breath of life, meditate on the True Lord.

verses.original: ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: laahaa har gun gai milai sukh paieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You shall receive the profit of singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and find peace. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਾਰ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਤੂੰ ॥
verses.translit: sachee teree kaar dheh dhiaal too(n) ||
verses.translation: True is Your Service; bless me with it, O Merciful Lord.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਮੈ ਟੇਕ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਤੂੰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: hau jeevaa tudh saalaeh mai Tek adhaar too(n) ||2||
verses.translation: I live by praising You; You are my Anchor and Support. ||2||

verses.original: ਦਰਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਦਰਵਾਨੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhar sevak dharavaan dharadh too(n) jaanahee ||
verses.translation: I am Your servant, the gate-keeper at Your Gate; You alone know my pain.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਹੈਰਾਨੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਗਵਾਵਹੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bhagat teree hairaan dharadh gavaavahee ||3||
verses.translation: How wonderful is Your devotional worship! It removes all pains. ||3||

verses.original: ਦਰਗਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: dharageh naam hadhoor gurmukh jaanasee ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs know that by chanting the Naam, they shall dwell in His Court, in His Presence.

verses.original: ਵੇਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਸੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: velaa sach paravaan sabadh pachhaanasee ||4||
verses.translation: True and acceptable is that time, when one recognizes the Word of the Shabad. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਉ ਤੋਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: sat sa(n)tokh kar bhaau tosaa har naam sei ||
verses.translation: Those who practice Truth, contentment and love, obtain the supplies of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਮਨਹੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: manahu chhodd vikaar sachaa sach dhei ||5||
verses.translation: So banish corruption from your mind, and the True One will grant you Truth. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਸਚੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sache sachaa neh sachai laiaa ||
verses.translation: The True Lord inspires true love in the truthful.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਆਉ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: aape kare niaau jo tis bhaiaa ||6||
verses.translation: He Himself administers justice, as it pleases His Will. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: sache sachee dhaat dheh dhiaal hai ||
verses.translation: True is the gift of the True, Compassionate Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: tis sevee dhin raat naam amol hai ||7||
verses.translation: Day and night, I serve the One whose Name is priceless. ||7||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਉਤਮੁ ਹਉ ਨੀਚੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਕਾਂਢੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) utam hau neech sevak kaa(n)ddeeaa ||
verses.translation: You are so sublime, and I am so lowly, but I am called Your slave.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਹੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਾਂਢੀਆ ॥੮॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: naanak nadhar kareh milai sach vaa(n)ddeeaa ||8||21||
verses.translation: Please, shower Nanak with Your Glance of Grace, that he, the separated one, may merge with You again, O Lord. ||8||21||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਮੇਲਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aavan jaanaa kiau rahai kiau melaa hoiee ||
verses.translation: How can coming and going, the cycle of reincarnation be ended? And how can one meet the Lord?

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਨਿਤ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: janam maran kaa dhukh ghano nit sahasaa dhoiee ||1||
verses.translation: The pain of birth and death is so great, in constant skepticism and duality. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਜੀਵਨਾ ਫਿਟੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bin naavai kiaa jeevanaa fiT dhirag chaturaiee ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, what is life? Cleverness is detestable and cursed.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur saadh na seviaa har bhagat na bhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: One who does not serve the Holy True Guru, is not pleased by devotion to the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਵਣੁ ਤਉ ਰਹੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: aavan jaavan tau rahai paieeaai gur pooraa ||
verses.translation: Coming and going is ended only when one finds the True Guru.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਦੇਇ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕੂਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: raam naam dhan raas dhei binasai bhram kooraa ||2||
verses.translation: He gives the wealth and capital of the Lord's Name, and false doubt is destroyed. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa kau mil rahai dhan dhan jas gaae ||
verses.translation: Joining the humble Saintly beings, let us sing the blessed, blessed Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aadh purakh apara(n)paraa gurmukh har paae ||3||
verses.translation: The Primal Lord, the Infinite, is obtained by the Gurmukh. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਟੂਐ ਸਾਂਗੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਬਾਜੀ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: naTooaai saa(n)g banaiaa baajee sa(n)saaraa ||
verses.translation: The drama of the world is staged like the show of a buffoon.

verses.original: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਬਾਜੀ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਉਝਰਤ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: khin pal baajee dhekheeaai ujharat nahee baaraa ||4||
verses.translation: For an instant, for a moment, the show is seen, but it disappears in no time at all. ||4||

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਚਉਪੜਿ ਖੇਲਣਾ ਝੂਠੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: haumai chaupaR khelanaa jhooThe aha(n)kaaraa ||
verses.translation: The game of chance is played on the board of egotism, with the pieces of falsehood and ego.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹਾਰੈ ਸੋ ਜਿਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sabh jag haarai so jinai gur sabadh veechaaraa ||5||
verses.translation: The whole world loses; he alone wins, who reflects upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||5||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਹਥਿ ਟੋਹਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: jiau a(n)dhulai hath Tohanee har naam hamaarai ||
verses.translation: As is the cane in the hand of the blind man, so is the Lord's Name for me.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਨਿਸਿ ਦਉਤ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: raam naam har Tek hai nis dhaut savaarai ||6||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is my Support, night and day and morning. ||6||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jiau too(n) raakheh tiau rahaa har naam adhaaraa ||
verses.translation: As You keep me, Lord, I live; the Lord's Name is my only Support.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: a(n)t sakhaiee paiaa jan mukat dhuaaraa ||7||
verses.translation: It is my only comfort in the end; the gate of salvation is found by His humble servants. ||7||

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran dhukh meTiaa jap naam muraare ||
verses.translation: The pain of birth and death is removed, by chanting and meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੮॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam na veesarai pooraa gur taare ||8||22||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who does not forget the Naam, is saved by the Perfect Guru. ||8||22||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa teejaa asaTapadheeaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Aasaa, Third Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਾਸਤੁ ਬੇਦੁ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਚਰਣ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: saasat bedh si(n)mirat sar teraa surasaree charan samaanee ||
verses.translation: The Shaastras, the Vedas and the Simritees are contained in the ocean of Your Name; the River Ganges is held in Your Feet.

verses.original: ਸਾਖਾ ਤੀਨਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਮਤਿ ਰਾਵੈ ਤੂੰ ਤਾਂ ਸਰਬ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saakhaa teen mool mat raavai too(n) taa(n) sarab viddaanee ||1||
verses.translation: The intellect can understand the world of the three modes, but You, O Primal Lord, are totally astounding. ||1||

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਜਪੈ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: taa ke charan japai jan naanak bole a(n)mirat baanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak meditates on His Feet, and chants the Ambrosial Word of His Bani. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੇਤੀਸ ਕਰੋੜੀ ਦਾਸ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: tetees karoRee dhaas tum(h)aare ridh sidh praan adhaaree ||
verses.translation: Three hundred thirty million gods are Your servants. You bestow wealth, and the supernatural powers of the Siddhas; You are the Support of the breath of life.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਲਖਣੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: taa ke roop na jaahee lakhane kiaa kar aakh veechaaree ||2||
verses.translation: His beauteous forms cannot be comprehended; what can anyone accomplish by discussing and debating? ||2||

verses.original: ਤੀਨਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੁਗ ਹੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਾਰੇ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਖਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: teen gunaa tere jug hee a(n)tar chaare tereeaa khaanee ||
verses.translation: Throughout the ages, You are the three qualities, and the four sources of creation.

verses.original: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਥੇ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: karam hovai taa param padh paieeaai kathe akath kahaanee ||3||
verses.translation: If You show Your Mercy, then one obtains the supreme status, and speaks the Unspoken Speech. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) karataa keeaa sabh teraa kiaa ko kare paraanee ||
verses.translation: You are the Creator; all are created by You. What can any mortal being do?

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਅਪਣੀ ਸਾਈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jaa kau nadhar kareh too(n) apanee saiee sach samaanee ||4||
verses.translation: He alone, upon whom You shower Your Grace, is absorbed into the Truth. ||4||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਲੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੀ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: naam teraa sabh koiee let hai jetee aavan jaanee ||
verses.translation: Everyone who comes and goes chants Your Name.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਹੋਰ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਇਆਣੀ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jaa tudh bhaavai taa gurmukh boojhai hor manmukh firai iaanee ||5||
verses.translation: When it is pleasing to Your Will, then the Gurmukh understands. Otherwise, the self-willed manmukhs wander in ignorance. ||5||

verses.original: ਚਾਰੇ ਵੇਦ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਕਉ ਦੀਏ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: chaare vedh brahame kau dhe'ee paR paR kare veechaaree ||
verses.translation: You gave the four Vedas to Brahma, for him to read and read continually, and reflect upon.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਅਵਤਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: taa kaa hukam na boojhai bapuRaa narak surag avataaree ||6||
verses.translation: The wretched one does not understand His Command, and is reincarnated into heaven and hell. ||6||

verses.original: ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗਹ ਕੇ ਰਾਜੇ ਕੀਏ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਅਵਤਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jugeh jugeh ke raaje ke'ee gaaveh kar avataaree ||
verses.translation: In each and every age, He creates the kings, who are sung of as His Incarnations.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਭੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: tin bhee a(n)t na paiaa taa kaa kiaa kar aakh veechaaree ||7||
verses.translation: Even they have not found His limits; what can I speak of and contemplate? ||7||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) sachaa teraa keeaa sabh saachaa dheh ta saach vakhaanee ||
verses.translation: You are True, and all that You do is True. If You bless me with the Truth, I will speak on it.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸਚੁ ਬੁਝਾਵਹਿ ਅਪਣਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੮॥੧॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: jaa kau sach bujhaaveh apanaa sahaje naam samaanee ||8||1||23||
verses.translation: One whom You inspire to understand the Truth, is easily absorbed into the Naam. ||8||1||23||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਮਰਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur hamaraa bharam gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has dispelled my doubts.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har naam nira(n)jan ma(n)n vasaiaa ||
verses.translation: He has enshrined the Immaculate Name of the Lord within my mind.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabadh cheen sadhaa sukh paiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Focusing on the Word of the Shabad, I have obtained lasting peace. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: sun man mere tat giaan ||
verses.translation: Listen, O my mind, to the essence of spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਦੇਵਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhevan vaalaa sabh bidh jaanai gurmukh paieeaai naam nidhaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Great Giver knows our condition completely; the Gurmukh obtains the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur bheTe kee vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: The great glory of meeting the True Guru is

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਮਮਤਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jin mamataa agan tirasanaa bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: that it has quenched the fire of possessiveness and desire;

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sahaje maataa har gun gaiee ||2||
verses.translation: imbued with peace and poise, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: vin gur poore koi na jaanee ||
verses.translation: Without the Perfect Guru, no one knows the Lord.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲੋਭਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh dhoojai lobhaanee ||
verses.translation: Attached to Maya, they are engrossed in duality.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam milai har baanee ||3||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh receives the Naam, and the Bani of the Lord's Word. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤਪਾਂ ਸਿਰਿ ਤਪੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur sevaa tapaa(n) sir tap saar ||
verses.translation: Service to the Guru is the most excellent and sublime penance of penances.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਭ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau man vasai sabh dhookh visaaranahaar ||
verses.translation: The Dear Lord dwells in the mind, and all suffering departs.

verses.original: ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: dhar saachai dheesai sachiaar ||4||
verses.translation: Then, at the Gate of the True Lord, one appears truthful. ||4||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur sevaa te tirabhavan sojhee hoi ||
verses.translation: Serving the Guru, one comes to know the three worlds.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aap pachhaan har paavai soi ||
verses.translation: Understanding his own self, he obtains the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: saachee baanee mahal paraapat hoi ||5||
verses.translation: Through the True Word of His Bani, we enter the Mansion of His Presence. ||5||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur sevaa te sabh kul udhaare ||
verses.translation: Serving the Guru, all of one's generations are saved.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: niramal naam rakhai ur dhaare ||
verses.translation: Keep the Immaculate Naam enshrined within your heart.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਾਚਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: saachee sobhaa saach dhuaare ||6||
verses.translation: In the Court of the True Lord, you shall be adorned with True Glory. ||6||

verses.original: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: se vaddabhaagee j gur sevaa laae ||
verses.translation: How very fortunate are they, who are committed to the Guru's service.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin bhagat sach naam dhiraRaae ||
verses.translation: Night and day, they are engaged in devotional worship; the True Name is implanted within them.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਕੁਲ ਸਬਾਏ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: naame udhare kul sabaae ||7||
verses.translation: Through the Naam, all of one's generations are saved. ||7||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak saach kahai veechaar ||
verses.translation: Nanak chants the true thought.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖਹੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam rakhahu ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: Keep the Name of the Lord enshrined within your heart.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੮॥੨॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: har bhagatee raate mokh dhuaar ||8||2||24||
verses.translation: Imbued with devotion to the Lord, the gate of salvation is found. ||8||2||24||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਆਸ ਕਰੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa aas kare sabh koiee ||
verses.translation: Everyone lives, hoping in hope.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: hukamai boojhai niraasaa hoiee ||
verses.translation: Understanding His Command, one becomes free of desire.

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੁਤੇ ਕਈ ਲੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa vich sute kiee loiee ||
verses.translation: So many are asleep in hope.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜਾਗੈ ਜਾਗਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: so jaagai jaagaavai soiee ||1||
verses.translation: He alone wakes up, whom the Lord awakens. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur naam bujhaiaa vin naavai bhukh na jaiee ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has led me to understand the Naam, the Name of the Lord; without the Naam, hunger does not go away.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naame tirasanaa agan bujhai naam milai tisai rajaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Through the Naam, the fire of desire is extinguished; the Naam is obtained by His Will. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਲਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: kal keerat sabadh pachhaan ||
verses.translation: In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, realize the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਏਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਚੂਕੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: ehaa bhagat chookai abhimaan ||
verses.translation: By this devotional worship, egotism is eliminated.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seviaai hovai paravaan ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, one becomes approved.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਆਸਾ ਕੀਤੀ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਜਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jin aasaa keetee tis no jaan ||2||
verses.translation: So know the One, who created hope and desire. ||2||

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਦੀਜੈ ਜਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: tis kiaa dheejai j sabadh sunaae ||
verses.translation: What shall we offer to one who proclaims the Word of the Shabad?

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa naam ma(n)n vasaae ||
verses.translation: By His Grace, the Naam is enshrined within our minds.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: eih sir dheejai aap gavaae ||
verses.translation: Offer your head, and shed your self-conceit.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: hukamai boojhe sadhaa sukh paae ||3||
verses.translation: One who understands the Lord's Command finds lasting peace. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aap kare tai aap karaae ||
verses.translation: He Himself does, and causes others to do.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aape gurmukh naam vasaae ||
verses.translation: He Himself enshrines His Name in the mind of the Gurmukh.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਵੈ ਆਪਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aap bhulaavai aap maarag paae ||
verses.translation: He Himself misleads us, and He Himself puts us back on the Path.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sachai sabadh sach samaae ||4||
verses.translation: Through the True Word of the Shabad, we merge into the True Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੀ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa sabadh sachee hai baanee ||
verses.translation: True is the Shabad, and True is the Word of the Lord's Bani.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jug jug aakh vakhaanee ||
verses.translation: In each and every age, the Gurmukhs speak it and chant it.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੋਲਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh moh bharam bholaanee ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are deluded by doubt and attachment.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਉਰਾਣੀ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: bin naavai sabh firai bauraanee ||5||
verses.translation: Without the Name, everyone wanders around insane. ||5||

verses.original: ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਨ ਮਹਿ ਏਕਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: teen bhavan meh ekaa maiaa ||
verses.translation: Throughout the three worlds, is the one Maya.

verses.original: ਮੂਰਖਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: moorakh paR paR dhoojaa bhaau dhiraRaiaa ||
verses.translation: The fool reads and reads, but holds tight to duality.

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bahu karam kamaavai dhukh sabaiaa ||
verses.translation: He performs all sorts of rituals, but still suffers terrible pain.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: satigur sev sadhaa sukh paiaa ||6||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, eternal peace is obtained. ||6||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit meeThaa sabadh veechaar ||
verses.translation: Reflective meditation upon the Shabad is such sweet nectar.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭੋਗੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin bhoge haumai maar ||
verses.translation: Night and day, one enjoys it, subduing his ego.

verses.original: ਸਹਜਿ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj ana(n)dh kirapaa dhaar ||
verses.translation: When the Lord showers His Mercy, we enjoy celestial bliss.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਚਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: naam rate sadhaa sach piaar ||7||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Naam, love the True Lord forever. ||7||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਪੜੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har jap paReeaai gur sabadh veechaar ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Lord, and read and reflect upon the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਪੜੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har jap paReeaai haumai maar ||
verses.translation: Subdue your ego and meditate on the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਭਇ ਸਚਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har japeeaai bhi sach piaar ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Lord, and be imbued with fear and love of the True One.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੮॥੩॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: naanak naam gurmat ur dhaar ||8||3||25||
verses.translation: O Nanak, enshrine the Naam within your heart, through the Guru's Teachings. ||8||3||25||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਕਾਫੀ ॥
verses.translit: raag aasaa mahalaa teejaa asaTapadheeaa ghar atthvaa kaafee ||
verses.translation: Raag Aasaa, Third Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, Eighth House, Kaafee:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur te saa(n)t uoopajai jin tirasanaa agan bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: Peace emanates from the Guru; He puts out the fire of desire.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur te naam paieeaai vaddee vaddiaaiee ||1||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is obtained from the Guru; it is the greatest greatness. ||1||

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: eko naam chet mere bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Keep the One Name in your consciousness, O my Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਜਗਤੁ ਜਲੰਦਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਭਜਿ ਪਏ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jagat jala(n)dhaa dhekh kai bhaj pe saranaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Seeing the world on fire, I have hurried to the Lord's Sanctuary. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਮਹਾ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur te giaan uoopajai mahaa tat beechaaraa ||
verses.translation: Spiritual wisdom emanates from the Guru; reflect upon the supreme essence of reality.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਭਗਤੀ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur te ghar dhar paiaa bhagatee bhare bha(n)ddaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: Through the Guru, the Lord's Mansion and His Court are attained; His devotional worship is overflowing with treasures. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਬੂਝੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam dhiaaieeaai boojhai veechaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh meditates on the Naam; he achieves reflective meditation and understanding.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਲਾਹ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh bhagat salaeh hai a(n)tar sabadh apaaraa ||3||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is the Lord's devotee, immersed in His Praises; the Infinite Word of the Shabad dwells within him. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੂਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sookh uoopajai dhukh kadhe na hoiee ||
verses.translation: Happiness emanates from the Gurmukh; he never suffers pain.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gurmukh haumai maareeaai man niramal hoiee ||4||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh conquers his ego, and his mind is immaculately pure. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaai aap giaa tirabhavan sojhee paiee ||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, self-conceit is removed, and understanding of the three worlds is obtained.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਸਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: niramal jot pasar rahee jotee jot milaiee ||5||
verses.translation: The Immaculate Divine Light is pervading and permeating everywhere; one's light merges into the Light. ||5||

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: poorai gur samajhaiaa mat uootam hoiee ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru instructs, and one's intellect becomes sublime.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar seetal saa(n)t hoi naame sukh hoiee ||6||
verses.translation: A cooling and soothing peace comes within, and through the Naam, peace is obtained. ||6||

verses.original: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਾਂ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾਂ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਈ ॥
verses.translit: pooraa satigur taa(n) milai jaa(n) nadhar kareiee ||
verses.translation: One meets the Perfect True Guru only when the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਸਭ ਕਟੀਅਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: kilavikh paap sabh kaTe'eeh fir dhukh bighan na hoiee ||7||
verses.translation: All sins and vices are eradicated, and one shall never again suffer pain or distress. ||7||

verses.original: ਆਪਣੈ ਹਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਦੇ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aapanai hath vaddiaaieeaa dhe naame laae ||
verses.translation: Glory is in His Hands; He bestows His Name, and attaches us to it.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪਾਏ ॥੮॥੪॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: naanak naam nidhaan man vasiaa vaddiaaiee paae ||8||4||26||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the treasure of the Naam abides within the mind, and glory is obtained. ||8||4||26||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sun man ma(n)n vasai too(n) aape aai milai mere bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Listen, O mortal: enshrine His Name within your mind; He shall come to meet with you, O my Sibling of Destiny.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anadhin sachee bhagat kar sachai chit laiee ||1||
verses.translation: Night and day, center your consciousness on true devotional worship of the True Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: eko naam dhiaai too(n) sukh paaveh mere bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the One Naam, and you shall find peace, O my Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: haumai dhoojaa dhoor kar vaddee vaddiaaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Eradicate egotism and duality, and your glory shall be glorious. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਨੋ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਲੋਚਦੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eis bhagatee no sur nar mun jan lochadhe vin satigur paiee na jai ||
verses.translation: The angels, humans and silent sages long for this devotional worship, but without the True Guru, it cannot be attained.

verses.original: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਦੇ ਜੋਤਿਕੀ ਤਿਨ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ddit paRadhe jotikee tin boojh na pai ||2||
verses.translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars, and the astrologers read their books, but they do not understand. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪੈ ਥੈ ਸਭੁ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aapai thai sabh rakhion kichh kahan na jaiee ||
verses.translation: He Himself keeps all in His Hand; nothing else can be said.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aape dhei su paieeaai gur boojh bujhaiee ||3||
verses.translation: Whatever He gives, is received. The Guru has imparted this understanding to me. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਸ ਦੇ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sabh tis dhe sabhanaa kaa soiee ||
verses.translation: All beings and creatures are His; He belongs to all.

verses.original: ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: ma(n)dhaa kis no aakheeaai je dhoojaa hoiee ||4||
verses.translation: So who can we call bad, since there is no other? ||4||

verses.original: ਇਕੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਏਕਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: eiko hukam varatadhaa ekaa sir kaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Command of the One Lord is pervading throughout; duty to the One Lord is upon the heads of all.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਭਵਾਲੀ ਦਿਤੀਅਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: aap bhavaalee dhiteean a(n)tar lobh vikaaraa ||5||
verses.translation: He Himself has led them astray, and placed greed and corruption within their hearts. ||5||

verses.original: ਇਕ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੀਤਿਅਨੁ ਬੂਝਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: eik aape gurmukh keetian boojhan veechaaraa ||
verses.translation: He has sanctified those few Gurmukhs who understand Him, and reflect upon Him.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਭੀ ਓਨਾ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੀਅਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: bhagat bhee onaa no bakhaseean a(n)tar bha(n)ddaaraa ||6||
verses.translation: He grants devotional worship to them, and within them is the treasure. ||6||

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਨੋ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: giaaneeaa no sabh sach hai sach sojhee hoiee ||
verses.translation: The spiritual teachers know nothing but the Truth; they obtain true understanding.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੇ ਨ ਭੁਲਨੑੀ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: oi bhulaae kisai dhe na bhulan(h)ee sach jaanan soiee ||7||
verses.translation: They are led astray by Him, but they do not go astray, because they know the True Lord. ||7||

verses.original: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਪੰਚ ਵਰਤਦੇ ਪੰਚੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: ghar meh pa(n)ch varatadhe pa(n)che veechaaree ||
verses.translation: Within the homes of their bodies, the five passions are pervading, but here, the five are well-behaved.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਸਿ ਨ ਆਵਨੑੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੮॥੫॥੨੭॥
verses.translit: naanak bin satigur vas na aavan(h)ee naam haumai maaree ||8||5||27||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the True Guru, they are not overcome; through the Naam, the ego is conquered. ||8||5||27||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਘਰੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਵਥੁ ਹੈ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: gharai a(n)dhar sabh vath hai baahar kichh naahee ||
verses.translation: Everything is within the home of your own self; there is nothing beyond it.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟ ਖੁਲਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee paieeaai a(n)tar kapaT khulaahee ||1||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, it is obtained, and the doors of the inner heart are opened wide. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur te har paieeaai bhaiee ||
verses.translation: From the True Guru, the Lord's Name is obtained, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar naam nidhaan hai poorai satigur dheeaa dhikhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The treasure of the Naam is within; the Perfect True Guru has shown this to me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਲਏ ਪਾਏ ਰਤਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa gaahak hovai so le paae ratan veechaaraa ||
verses.translation: One who is a buyer of the Lord's Name, finds it, and obtains the jewel of contemplation.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਖੋਲੈ ਦਿਬ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar kholai dhib dhisaT dhekhai mukat bha(n)ddaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: He opens the doors deep within, and through the Eyes of Divine Vision, beholds the treasure of liberation. ||2||

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲ ਅਨੇਕ ਹਹਿ ਜੀਉ ਕਰੇ ਵਸੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar mahal anek heh jeeau kare vaseraa ||
verses.translation: There are so many mansions within the body; the soul dwells within them.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: man chi(n)dhiaa fal paisee fir hoi na feraa ||3||
verses.translation: He obtains the fruits of his mind's desires, and he shall not have to go through reincarnation again. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਾਰਖੀਆ ਵਥੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਲਈ ਗੁਰ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: paarakheeaa vath samaal liee gur sojhee hoiee ||
verses.translation: The appraisers cherish the commodity of the Name; they obtain understanding from the Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਸਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naam padhaarath amul saa gurmukh paavai koiee ||4||
verses.translation: The wealth of the Naam is priceless; how few are the Gurmukhs who obtain it. ||4||

verses.original: ਬਾਹਰੁ ਭਾਲੇ ਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਲਹੈ ਵਥੁ ਘਰੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: baahar bhaale su kiaa lahai vath gharai a(n)dhar bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Searching outwardly, what can anyone find? The commodity is deep within the home of the self, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: bharame bhoolaa sabh jag firai manmukh pat gavaiee ||5||
verses.translation: The entire world is wandering around, deluded by doubt; the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor. ||5||

verses.original: ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਛੋਡੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਝੂਠਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ghar dhar chhodde aapanaa par ghar jhooThaa jaiee ||
verses.translation: The false one leaves his own hearth and home, and goes out to another's home.

verses.original: ਚੋਰੈ ਵਾਂਗੂ ਪਕੜੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: chorai vaa(n)goo pakaReeaai bin naavai choTaa khaiee ||6||
verses.translation: Like a thief, he is caught, and without the Naam, he is beaten and struck down. ||6||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h)ee ghar jaataa aapanaa se sukhe'ee bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Those who know their own home, are happy, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar braham pachhaaniaa gur kee vaddiaaiee ||7||
verses.translation: They realize God within their own hearts, through the glorious greatness of the Guru. ||7||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aape dhaan kare kis aakheeaai aape dhei bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: He Himself gives gifts, and He Himself bestows understanding; unto whom can we complain?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂੰ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥੮॥੬॥੨੮॥
verses.translit: naanak naam dhiaai too(n) dhar sachai sobhaa paiee ||8||6||28||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and you shall obtain glory in the True Court. ||8||6||28||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸਾਦੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aapai aap pachhaaniaa saadh meeThaa bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Those who recognize their own selves, enjoy the sweet flavor, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਚਾਖਿਐ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਏ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਸਾਚੋ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har ras chaakhiaai mukat bhe jin(h)aa saacho bhaiee ||1||
verses.translation: Those who drink in the sublime essence of the Lord are emancipated; they love the Truth. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau niramal niramalaa niramal man vaasaa ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Lord is the purest of the pure; He comes to dwell in the pure mind.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmatee saalaaheeaai bikhiaa maeh udhaasaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Praising the Lord, through the Guru's Teachings, one remains unaffected by corruption. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਸਭ ਅੰਧੀ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai aap na jaapiee sabh a(n)dhee bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Without the Word of the Shabad, they do not understand themselves -they are totally blind, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmatee ghaT chaananaa naam a(n)t sakhaiee ||2||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the heart is illuminated, and in the end, only the Naam shall be your companion. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਰਤਦੇ ਨਾਮੇ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: naame hee naam varatadhe naame varataaraa ||
verses.translation: They are occupied with the Naam, and only the Naam; they deal only in the Naam.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar naam mukh naam hai naame sabadh veechaaraa ||3||
verses.translation: Deep within their hearts is the Naam; upon their lips is the Naam; they contemplate the Word of God, and the Naam. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਨਾਮੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: naam suneeaai naam ma(n)neeaai naame vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: They listen to the Naam, believe in the Naam, and through the Naam, they obtain glory.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naam salaahe sadhaa sadhaa naame mahal paiee ||4||
verses.translation: They praise the Naam, forever and ever, and through the Naam, they obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||4||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: naame hee ghaT chaananaa naame sobhaa paiee ||
verses.translation: Through the Naam, their hearts are illumined, and through the Naam, they obtain honor.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naame hee sukh uoopajai naame saranaiee ||5||
verses.translation: Through the Naam, peace wells up; I seek the Sanctuary of the Naam. ||5||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bin naavai koi na ma(n)neeaai manmukh pat gavaiee ||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, no one is accepted; the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jam pur baadhe maare'eh birathaa janam gavaiee ||6||
verses.translation: In the City of Death, they are tied down and beaten, and they lose their lives in vain. ||6||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੈ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: naamai kee sabh sevaa karai gurmukh naam bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: Those Gurmukhs who realize the Naam, all serve the Naam.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਹੁ ਹੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਨਾਮੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: naamahu hee naam ma(n)neeaai naame vaddiaaiee ||7||
verses.translation: So believe in the Naam, and only the Naam; through the Naam, glorious greatness is obtained. ||7||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jis no dhevai tis milai gurmatee naam bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: He alone receives it, unto whom it is given. Through the Guru's Teachings, the Naam is realized.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਕੋ ਪਾਈ ॥੮॥੭॥੨੯॥
verses.translit: naanak sabh kichh naavai kai vas hai poorai bhaag ko paiee ||8||7||29||
verses.translation: O Nanak, everything is under the influence of the Naam; by perfect good destiny, a few obtain it. ||8||7||29||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੑੀ ਨ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhohaaganee mahal na pain(h)ee na jaanan pir kaa suaau ||
verses.translation: The deserted brides do not obtain the Mansion of their Husband's Presence, nor do they know His taste.

verses.original: ਫਿਕਾ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਨਾ ਨਿਵਹਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: fikaa boleh naa niveh dhoojaa bhaau suaau ||1||
verses.translation: They speak harsh words, and do not bow to Him; they are in love with another. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਵਸਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: eih manooaa kiau kar vas aavai ||
verses.translation: How can this mind come under control?

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਠਾਕੀਐ ਗਿਆਨ ਮਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee Thaakeeaai giaan matee ghar aavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, it is held in check; instructed in spiritual wisdom, it returns to its home. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੀਓਨੁ ਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sohaaganee aap savaareeon lai prem piaar ||
verses.translation: He Himself adorns the happy soul-brides; they bear Him love and affection.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲਦੀਆ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: satigur kai bhaanai chaladheeaa naame sahaj seegaar ||2||
verses.translation: They live in harmony with the Sweet Will of the True Guru, naturally adorned with the Naam. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਚੀ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa raaveh pir aapanaa sachee sej subhai ||
verses.translation: They enjoy their Beloved forever, and their bed is decorated with Truth.

verses.original: ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਮੋਹੀਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: pir kai prem moheeaa mil preetam sukh pai ||3||
verses.translation: They are fascinated with the Love of their Husband Lord; meeting their Beloved, they obtain peace. ||3||

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: giaan apaar seegaar hai sobhaava(n)tee naar ||
verses.translation: Spiritual wisdom is the incomparable decoration of the happy soul-bride.

verses.original: ਸਾ ਸਭਰਾਈ ਸੁੰਦਰੀ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: saa sabharaiee su(n)dharee pir kai het piaar ||4||
verses.translation: She is so beautiful - she is the queen of all; she enjoys the love and affection of her Husband Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਸਚੈ ਅਲਖਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sohaaganee vich ra(n)g rakhion sachai alakh apaar ||
verses.translation: The True Lord, the Unseen, the Infinite, has infused His Love among the happy soul-brides.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਚੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: satigur sevan aapanaa sachai bhai piaar ||5||
verses.translation: They serve their True Guru, with true love and affection. ||5||

verses.original: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਗਲਿ ਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sohaaganee seegaar banaiaa gun kaa gal haar ||
verses.translation: The happy soul-bride has adorned herself with the necklace of virtue.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਰਮਲੁ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਵਣਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: prem piramal tan laavanaa a(n)tar ratan veechaar ||6||
verses.translation: She applies the perfume of love to her body, and within her mind is the jewel of reflective meditation. ||6||

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਊਤਮਾ ਜਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat rate se uootamaa jat pat sabadhe hoi ||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with devotional worship are the most exalted. Their social standing and honor come from the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਨੀਚ ਜਾਤਿ ਹੈ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: bin naavai sabh neech jaat hai bisaTaa kaa keeRaa hoi ||7||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, all are low class, like maggots in manure. ||7||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਦੀ ਸਭ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਹਉ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: hau hau karadhee sabh firai bin sabadhai hau na jai ||
verses.translation: Everyone proclaims, ""Me, me!""; but without the Shabad, the ego does not depart.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਈ ਸਚੈ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੮॥੮॥੩੦॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate tin haumai giee sachai rahe samai ||8||8||30||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam lose their ego; they remain absorbed in the True Lord. ||8||8||30||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sache rate se niramale sadhaa sachee soi ||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with the True Lord are spotless and pure; their reputation is forever true.

verses.original: ਐਥੈ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਪਦੇ ਆਗੈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aaithai ghar ghar jaapadhe aagai jug jug paragaT hoi ||1||
verses.translation: Here, they are known in each and every home, and hereafter, they are famous throughout the ages. ||1||

verses.original: ਏ ਮਨ ਰੂੜੑੇ ਰੰਗੁਲੇ ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: e man rooR(h)e ra(n)gule too(n) sachaa ra(n)g chaRai ||
verses.translation: O beauteous and joyful mind, imbue yourself with your true color.

verses.original: ਰੂੜੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਜੇ ਰਪੈ ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: rooRee baanee je rapai naa ih ra(n)g lahai na jai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: If you imbue yourself with the Beauteous Word of the Guru's Bani, then this color shall never fade away. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਮੈਲੇ ਅਤਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: ham neech maile at abhimaanee dhoojai bhai vikaar ||
verses.translation: I am lowly, filthy, and totally egotistical; I am attached to the corruption of duality.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਰਸਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਏ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur paaras miliaai ka(n)chan hoe niramal jot apaar ||2||
verses.translation: But meeting with the Guru, the Philosopher's Stone, I am transformed into gold; I am blended with the Pure Light of the Infinite Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰੰਗੀਐ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur koi na ra(n)geeaai gur miliaai ra(n)g chaRaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, no one is imbued with the color of the Lord's Love; meeting with the Guru, this color is applied.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur kai bhai bhai jo rate sifatee sach samaau ||3||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with the Fear, and the Love of the Guru, are absorbed in the Praise of the True Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਲਾਗਿ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhai bin laag na lagiee naa man niramal hoi ||
verses.translation: Without fear, the cloth is not dyed, and the mind is not rendered pure.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਝੂਠੇ ਠਾਉ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: bin bhai karam kamaavane jhooThe Thaau na koi ||4||
verses.translation: Without fear, the performance of rituals is false, and one finds no place of rest. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗੇ ਸੁ ਰਪਸੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jis no aape ra(n)ge su rapasee satasa(n)gat milai ||
verses.translation: Only those whom the Lord imbues, are so imbued; they join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: poore gur te satasa(n)gat uoopajai sahaje sach subhai ||5||
verses.translation: From the Perfect Guru, the Sat Sangat emanates, and one easily merges into the Love of the True One. ||5||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਸਭਿ ਐਸੇ ਰਹਹਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਪਸੁ ਢੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: bin sa(n)gatee sabh aaise raheh jaise pas ddor ||
verses.translation: Without the Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all remain like beasts and animals.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿੑ ਕੀਤੇ ਤਿਸੈ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭਿ ਚੋਰ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jini(h) keete tisai na jaanan(h)ee bin naavai sabh chor ||6||
verses.translation: They do not know the One who created them; without the Name, all are thieves. ||6||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਹਾਝਹਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਵਿਕਣਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eik gun vihaajheh aaugan vikaneh gur kai sahaj subhai ||
verses.translation: Some purchase merits and sell off their demerits; through the Guru, they obtain peace and poise.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਇਆ ਵੁਠਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਆਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gur sevaa te naau paiaa vuThaa a(n)dhar aai ||7||
verses.translation: Serving the Guru, they obtain the Name, which comes to dwell deep within. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa kaa dhaataa ek hai sir dha(n)dhai lai ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is the Giver of all; He assigns tasks to each and every person.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਾਇ ਸਵਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੮॥੯॥੩੧॥
verses.translit: naanak naame lai savaarian sabadhe le milai ||8||9||31||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord embellishes us with the Name; attached to the Word of the Shabad, we are merged into Him. ||8||9||31||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਭ ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਲੋਚਦੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sabh naavai no lochadhee jis kirapaa kare so paae ||
verses.translation: Everyone longs for the Name, but he alone receives it, unto whom the Lord shows His Mercy.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bin naavai sabh dhukh hai sukh tis jis ma(n)n vasaae ||1||
verses.translation: Without the Name, there is only pain; he alone obtains peace, whose mind is filled with the Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) bea(n)t dhiaal hai teree saranaiee ||
verses.translation: You are infinite and merciful; I seek Your Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur poore te paieeaai naame vaddiaaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: From the Perfect Guru, the glorious greatness of the Naam is obtained. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar baahar ek hai bahu bidh sirasaT upaiee ||
verses.translation: Inwardly and outwardly, there is only the One Lord. He has created the world, with its many varieties.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਭਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: hukame kaar karaidhaa dhoojaa kis kaheeaai bhaiee ||2||
