verses.translation: According to the Order of His Will, He makes us act. What else can we talk about, O Siblings of Destiny? ||2||

verses.original: ਬੁਝਣਾ ਅਬੁਝਣਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਕੀਆ ਇਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: bujhanaa abujhanaa tudh keeaa ieh teree sir kaar ||
verses.translation: Knowledge and ignorance are all your making; You have control over these.

verses.original: ਇਕਨੑਾ ਬਖਸਿਹਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: eikan(h)aa bakhaseh mel laih ik dharageh maar kadde kooRiaar ||3||
verses.translation: Some, You forgive, and unite with Yourself; while others, the wicked, you strike down and drive out of Your Court. ||3||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਵਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਹਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: eik dhur pavit paavan heh tudh naame laae ||
verses.translation: Some, from the very beginning, are pure and pious; You attach them to Your Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gur sevaa te sukh uoopajai sachai sabadh bujhaae ||4||
verses.translation: Serving the Guru, peace wells up; through the True Word of the Shabad, one comes to understand. ||4||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਕੁਚਲ ਕੁਚੀਲ ਵਿਖਲੀ ਪਤੇ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: eik kuchal kucheel vikhalee pate naavahu aap khuaae ||
verses.translation: Some are crooked, filthy and vicious; the Lord Himself has led them astray from the Name.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਓਨ ਸਿਧਿ ਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੈ ਨ ਸੰਜਮੀ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਉਤਵਤਾਏ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naa on sidh na budh hai na sa(n)jamee fireh utavataae ||5||
verses.translation: They have no intuition, no understanding and no self-discipline; they wander around delirious. ||5||

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: nadhar kare jis aapanee tis no bhaavanee laae ||
verses.translation: He grants faith to those whom He has blessed with His Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਇਹ ਸੰਜਮੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sat sa(n)tokh ieh sa(n)jamee man niramal sabadh sunaae ||6||
verses.translation: This mind finds truth, contentment and self-discipline, hearing the Immaculate Word of the Shabad. ||6||

verses.original: ਲੇਖਾ ਪੜਿ ਨ ਪਹੂਚੀਐ ਕਥਿ ਕਹਣੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: lekhaa paR na pahoocheeaai kath kahanai a(n)t na pai ||
verses.translation: By reading books, one cannot reach Him; by speaking and talking, His limits cannot be found.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gur te keemat paieeaai sach sabadh sojhee pai ||7||
verses.translation: Through the Guru, His value is found; through the True Word of the Shabad, understanding is obtained. ||7||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਸੋਧਿ ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: eih man dhehee sodh too(n) gur sabadh veechaar ||
verses.translation: So reform this mind and body, by contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਸੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥੮॥੧੦॥੩੨॥
verses.translit: naanak is dhehee vich naam nidhaan hai paieeaai gur kai het apaar ||8||10||32||
verses.translation: O Nanak, within this body is the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; it is found through the Love of the Infinite Guru. ||8||10||32||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sach rateeaa sohaaganee jinaa gur kai sabadh seegaar ||
verses.translation: The happy soul-brides are imbued with Truth; they are adorned with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ghar hee so pir paiaa sachai sabadh veechaar ||1||
verses.translation: They find their Husband Lord within their own home, contemplating the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਵਗਣ ਗੁਣੀ ਬਖਸਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: avagan gunee bakhasaiaa har siau liv laiee ||
verses.translation: Through merits, their demerits are forgiven, and they embrace love for the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har var paiaa kaamanee gur mel milaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride then obtains the Lord as her Husband; meeting the Guru, this union comes about. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eik pir hadhoor na jaanan(h)ee dhoojai bharam bhulai ||
verses.translation: Some do not know the Presence of their Husband Lord; they are deluded by duality and doubt.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਪਾਇਨਿੑ ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਦੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kiau paini(h) ddohaaganee dhukhee rain vihai ||2||
verses.translation: How can the forsaken brides meet Him? Their life night passes in pain. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jin kai man sach vasiaa sachee kaar kamai ||
verses.translation: Those whose minds are filled with the True Lord, perform truthful actions.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਹਜ ਸਿਉ ਸਚੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: anadhin seveh sahaj siau sache maeh samai ||3||
verses.translation: Night and day, they serve the Lord with poise, and are absorbed in the True Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈਆ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhohaaganee bharam bhulaieeaa kooR bol bikh khaeh ||
verses.translation: The forsaken brides wander around, deluded by doubt; telling lies, they eat poison.

verses.original: ਪਿਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੁੰਞੀ ਸੇਜ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: pir na jaanan aapanaa su(n)n(j)ee sej dhukh paeh ||4||
verses.translation: They do not know their Husband Lord, and upon their deserted bed, they suffer in misery. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਮਤੁ ਮਨ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa saahib ek hai mat man bharam bhulaeh ||
verses.translation: The True Lord is the One and only; do not be deluded by doubt, O my mind.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਹਿ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: gur poochh sevaa kareh sach niramal ma(n)n vasaeh ||5||
verses.translation: Consult with the Guru, serve the True Lord, and enshrine the Immaculate Truth within your mind. ||5||

verses.original: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sohaaganee sadhaa pir paiaa haumai aap gavai ||
verses.translation: The happy soul-bride always finds her Husband Lord; she banishes egotism and self-conceit.

verses.original: ਪਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗਹਿ ਰਹੀ ਸਚੀ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: pir setee anadhin geh rahee sachee sej sukh pai ||6||
verses.translation: She remains attached to her Husband Lord, night and day, and she finds peace upon His Bed of Truth. ||6||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਗਏ ਪਲੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: meree meree kar ge palai kichh na pai ||
verses.translation: Those who shouted, ""Mine, mine!"" have departed, without obtaining anything.

verses.original: ਮਹਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਈ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: mahal naahee ddohaaganee a(n)t giee pachhutai ||7||
verses.translation: The separated one does not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and departs, repenting in the end. ||7||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: so pir meraa ek hai ekas siau liv lai ||
verses.translation: That Husband Lord of mine is the One and only; I am in love with the One alone.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇ ॥੮॥੧੧॥੩੩॥
verses.translit: naanak je sukh loReh kaamanee har kaa naam ma(n)n vasai ||8||11||33||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if the soul-bride longs for peace, she should enshrine the Lord's Name within her mind. ||8||11||33||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਚਖਾਇਓਨੁ ਰਸੁ ਆਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit jin(h)aa chakhaion ras aaiaa sahaj subhai ||
verses.translation: Those whom the Lord has caused to drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, naturally, intuitively, enjoy the sublime essence.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sachaa veparavaahu hai tis no til na tamai ||1||
verses.translation: The True Lord is care-free; he does not have even an iota of greed. ||1||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਚਾ ਵਰਸਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit sachaa varasadhaa gurmukhaa mukh pai ||
verses.translation: The True Ambrosial Nectar rains down, and trickles into the mouths of the Gurmukhs.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਰੀਆਵਲਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man sadhaa hareeaavalaa sahaje har gun gai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Their minds are forever rejuvenated, and they naturally, intuitively, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਦਰਿ ਖੜੀਆ ਬਿਲਲਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh sadhaa dhohaaganee dhar khaReeaa bilalaeh ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are forever forsaken brides; they cry out and bewail at the Lord's Gate.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jin(h)aa pir kaa suaadh na aaio jo dhur likhiaa suo kamaeh ||2||
verses.translation: Those who do not enjoy the sublime taste of their Husband Lord, act according to their pre-ordained destiny. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੀਜੇ ਸਚੁ ਜਮੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh beeje sach jamai sach naam vaapaar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh plants the seed of the True Name, and it sprouts. He deals in the True Name alone.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਇਤੁ ਲਾਹੈ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਦੇਇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo it laahai laian bhagatee dhei bha(n)ddaar ||3||
verses.translation: Those whom the Lord has attached to this profitable venture, are granted the treasure of devotional worship. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਭੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sadhaa sohaaganee bhai bhagat seegaar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is forever the true, happy soul-bride; she adorns herself with the fear of God and devotion to Him.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਰਖਹਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: anadhin raaveh pir aapanaa sach rakheh ur dhaar ||4||
verses.translation: Night and day, she enjoys her Husband Lord; she keeps Truth enshrined within her heart. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h)aa pir raaviaa aapanaa tin(h)aa viTahu bal jaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who have enjoyed their Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sadhaa pir kai sa(n)g raheh vichahu aap gavai ||5||
verses.translation: They dwell forever with their Husband Lord; they eradicate self-conceit from within. ||5||

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: tan man seetal mukh ujale pir kai bhai piaar ||
verses.translation: Their bodies and minds are cooled and soothed, and their faces are radiant, from the love and affection of their Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sej sukhaalee pir ravai haumai tirasanaa maar ||6||
verses.translation: They enjoy their Husband Lord upon His cozy bed, having conquered their ego and desire. ||6||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa ghar aaiaa gur kai het apaar ||
verses.translation: Granting His Grace, He comes into our homes, through our infinite Love for the Guru.

verses.original: ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਕੇਵਲ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: var paiaa sohaaganee keval ek muraar ||7||
verses.translation: The happy soul-bride obtains the One Lord as her Husband. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਗੁਨਹ ਬਖਸਾਇ ਲਇਓਨੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabhe guneh bakhasai lion mele melanahaar ||
verses.translation: All of her sins are forgiven; the Uniter unites her with Himself.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਜੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੮॥੧੨॥੩੪॥
verses.translit: naanak aakhan aakheeaai je sun dhare piaar ||8||12||34||
verses.translation: O Nanak, chant such chants, that hearing them, He may enshrine love for you. ||8||12||34||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਊਪਜੈ ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur te gun uoopajai jaa prabh melai soi ||
verses.translation: Merit is obtained from the True Guru, when God causes us to meet Him.

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sahaje naam dhiaaieeaai giaan paragaT hoi ||1||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, with intuitive ease and poise, spiritual wisdom is revealed. ||1||

verses.original: ਏ ਮਨ ਮਤ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਵੇਖੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: e man mat jaaneh har dhoor hai sadhaa vekh hadhoor ||
verses.translation: O my mind, do not think of the Lord as being far away; behold Him ever close at hand.

verses.original: ਸਦ ਸੁਣਦਾ ਸਦ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sadh sunadhaa sadh vekhadhaa sabadh rahiaa bharapoor ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is always listening, and always watching over us; the Word of His Shabad is all-pervading everywhere. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh aap pachhaaniaa tin(h)ee ik man dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs understand their own selves; they meditate single-mindedly on the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਰਵਹਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sadhaa raveh pir aapanaa sachai naam sukh paiaa ||2||
verses.translation: They enjoy their Husband Lord continually; through the True Name, they find peace. ||2||

verses.original: ਏ ਮਨ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: e man teraa ko nahee kar vekh sabadh veechaar ||
verses.translation: O my mind, no one belongs to you; contemplate the Shabad, and see this.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜਿ ਪਉ ਪਾਇਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har saranaiee bhaj pau paieh mokh dhuaar ||3||
verses.translation: So run to the Lord's Sanctuary, and find the gate of salvation. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh suneeaai sabadh bujheeaai sach rahai liv lai ||
verses.translation: Listen to the Shabad, and understand the Shabad, and lovingly focus your consciousness on the True One.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਸਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sabadhe haumai maareeaai sachai mahal sukh pai ||4||
verses.translation: Through the Shabad, conquer your ego, and in the True Mansion of the Lord's Presence, you shall find peace. ||4||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੋਭ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: eis jug meh sobhaa naam kee bin naavai sobh na hoi ||
verses.translation: In this age, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is glory; without the Name, there is no glory.

verses.original: ਇਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿਹਾੜੇ ਜਾਦੀ ਬਿਲਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: eeh maiaa kee sobhaa chaar dhihaaRe jaadhee bilam na hoi ||5||
verses.translation: The glory of this Maya lasts for only a few days; it disappears in an instant. ||5||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੇ ਮੁਏ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jinee naam visaariaa se mue mar jaeh ||
verses.translation: Those who forget the Naam are already dead, and they continue dying.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: har ras saadh na aaio bisaTaa maeh samaeh ||6||
verses.translation: They do not enjoy the sublime essence of the Lord's taste; they sink into the manure. ||6||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eik aape bakhas milaian anadhin naame lai ||
verses.translation: Some are forgiven by the Lord; He unites them with Himself, and keeps them attached to the Naam, night and day.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sach kamaaveh sach raheh sache sach samaeh ||7||
verses.translation: They practice Truth, and abide in Truth; being truthful, they merge into Truth. ||7||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਨ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਜਗੁ ਬੋਲਾ ਅੰਨੑਾ ਭਰਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai suneeaai na dhekheeaai jag bolaa a(n)n(h)aa bharamai ||
verses.translation: Without the Shabad, the world does not hear, and does not see; deaf and blind, it wanders around.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: bin naavai dhukh paisee naam milai tisai rajai ||8||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, it obtains only misery; the Naam is received only by His Will. ||8||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin baanee siau chit laiaa se jan niramal paravaan ||
verses.translation: Those persons who link their consciousness with the Word of His Bani, are immaculately pure, and approved by the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੯॥੧੩॥੩੫॥
verses.translit: naanak naam tin(h)aa kadhe na veesarai se dhar sache jaan ||9||13||35||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they never forget the Naam, and in the Court of the Lord, they are known as true. ||9||13||35||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਬਦੌ ਹੀ ਭਗਤ ਜਾਪਦੇ ਜਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabadhau hee bhagat jaapadhe jin(h) kee baanee sachee hoi ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Shabad, the devotees are known; their words are true.

verses.original: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: vichahu aap giaa naau ma(n)niaa sach milaavaa hoi ||1||
verses.translation: They eradicate ego from within themselves; they surrender to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and meet with the True One. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam jan kee pat hoi ||
verses.translation: Through the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, His humble servants obtain honor.

verses.original: ਸਫਲੁ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਕਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਮਾਨੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: safal tin(h)aa kaa janam hai tin(h) maanai sabh koi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: How blessed is their coming into the world! Everyone adores them. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਹੈ ਅਤਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: haumai meraa jaat hai at karodh abhimaan ||
verses.translation: Ego, self-centeredness, excessive anger and pride are the lot of mankind.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਜਾਇ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sabadh marai taa jaat jai jotee jot milai bhagavaan ||2||
verses.translation: If one dies in the Word of the Shabad, then he is rid of this, and his light is merged into the Light of the Lord God. ||2||

verses.original: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: pooraa satigur bheTiaa safal janam hamaaraa ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Perfect True Guru, my life has been blessed.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵੈ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਭਰੇ ਅਖੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naam navai nidh paiaa bhare akhuT bha(n)ddaaraa ||3||
verses.translation: I have obtained the nine treasures of the Naam, and my storehouse is inexhaustible, filled to overflowing. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਵਹਿ ਇਸੁ ਰਾਸੀ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਏ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: aaveh is raasee ke vaapaare'e jin(h)aa naam piaaraa ||
verses.translation: Those who love the Naam come as dealers in the merchandise of the Naam.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai so dhan paae tin(h)aa a(n)tar sabadh veechaaraa ||4||
verses.translation: Those who become Gurmukh obtain this wealth; deep within, they contemplate the Shabad. ||4||

verses.original: ਭਗਤੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: bhagatee saar na jaanan(h)ee manmukh aha(n)kaaree ||
verses.translation: The egotistical, self-willed manmukhs do not appreciate the value of devotional worship.

verses.original: ਧੁਰਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਅਨੁ ਜੂਐ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: dhurahu aap khuaaian jooaai baajee haaree ||5||
verses.translation: The Primal Lord Himself has beguiled them; they lose their lives in the gamble. ||5||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਰੀਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: bin piaarai bhagat na hoviee naa sukh hoi sareer ||
verses.translation: Without loving affection, devotional worship is not possible, and the body cannot be at peace.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤੀ ਮਨ ਧੀਰਿ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: prem padhaarath paieeaai gur bhagatee man dheer ||6||
verses.translation: The wealth of love is obtained from the Guru; through devotion, the mind becomes steady. ||6||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jis no bhagat karaae so kare gur sabadh veechaar ||
verses.translation: He alone performs devotional worship, whom the Lord so blesses; he contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: hiradhai eko naam vasai haumai dhubidhaa maar ||7||
verses.translation: The One Name abides in his heart, and he conquers his ego and duality. ||7||

verses.original: ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਜਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਏਕੋੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhagataa kee jat pat ekuo naam hai aape le savaar ||
verses.translation: The One Name is the social status and honor of the devotees; the Lord Himself adorns them.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਾਰਿ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: sadhaa saranaiee tis kee jiau bhaavai tiau kaaraj saar ||8||
verses.translation: They remain forever in the Protection of His Sanctuary. As it pleases His Will, He arranges their affairs. ||8||

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ਅਲਾਹ ਦੀ ਜਾਪੈ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat niraalee alaeh dhee jaapai gur veechaar ||
verses.translation: The worship of the Lord is unique - it is known only by reflecting upon the Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸੈ ਭੈ ਭਗਤੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥੯॥੧੪॥੩੬॥
verses.translit: naanak naam hiradhai vasai bhai bhagatee naam savaar ||9||14||36||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one whose mind is filled with the Naam, through the Lord's Fear and devotion, is embellished with the Naam. ||9||14||36||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਨ ਰਸ ਮਹਿ ਭੋਲਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੈ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: an ras meh bholaiaa bin naamai dhukh pai ||
verses.translation: He wanders around, engrossed in other pleasures, but without the Naam, he suffers in pain.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਜਿ ਸਚੀ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: satigur purakh na bheTio j sachee boojh bujhai ||1||
verses.translation: He does not meet the True Guru, the Primal Being, who imparts true understanding. ||1||

verses.original: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਵਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਖਿ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: e man mere baavale har ras chakh saadh pai ||
verses.translation: O my insane mind, drink in the sublime essence of the Lord, and savor its taste.

verses.original: ਅਨ ਰਸਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਤੂੰ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: an ras laagaa too(n) fireh birathaa janam gavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Attached to other pleasures, you wander around, and your life wastes away uselessly. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eis jug meh gurmukh niramale sach naam raheh liv lai ||
verses.translation: In this age, the Gurmukhs are pure; they remain absorbed in the love of the True Name.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: vin karamaa kichh paieeaai nahee kiaa kar kahiaa jai ||2||
verses.translation: Without the destiny of good karma, nothing can be obtained; what can we say or do? ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਮਨਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: aap pachhaaneh sabadh mareh manahu taj vikaar ||
verses.translation: He understands his own self, and dies in the Word of the Shabad; he banishes corruption from his mind.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜਿ ਪਏ ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur saranaiee bhaj pe bakhase bakhasanahaar ||3||
verses.translation: He hurries to the Guru's Sanctuary, and is forgiven by the Forgiving Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin naavai sukh na paieeaai naa dhukh vichahu jai ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, peace is not obtained, and pain does not depart from within.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: eih jag maiaa moh viaapiaa dhoojai bharam bhulai ||4||
verses.translation: This world is engrossed in attachment to Maya; it has gone astray in duality and doubt. ||4||

verses.original: ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਪਿਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhohaaganee pir kee saar na jaanahee kiaa kar kareh seegaar ||
verses.translation: The forsaken soul-brides do not know the value of their Husband Lord; how can they decorate themselves?

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਜਲਦੀਆ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸੇਜੈ ਰਵੈ ਨ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: anadhin sadhaa jaladheeaa fireh sejai ravai na bhataar ||5||
verses.translation: Night and day, they continually burn, and they do not enjoy the Bed of their Husband Lord. ||5||

verses.original: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sohaaganee mahal paiaa vichahu aap gavai ||
verses.translation: The happy soul-brides obtain the Mansion of His Presence, eradicating their self-conceit from within.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੀਆ ਅਪਣੇ ਸਹਿ ਲਈਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee seegaareeaa apane seh lieeaa milai ||6||
verses.translation: They decorate themselves with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and their Husband Lord unites them with Himself. ||6||

verses.original: ਮਰਣਾ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: maranaa manahu visaariaa maiaa moh gubaar ||
verses.translation: He has forgotten death, in the darkness of attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਭੀ ਮਰਹਿ ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: manmukh mar mar ja(n)meh bhee mareh jam dhar hoh khuaar ||7||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs die again and again, and are reborn; they die again, and are miserable at the Gate of Death. ||7||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਸੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: aap milaian se mile gur sabadh veechaar ||
verses.translation: They alone are united, whom the Lord unites with Himself; they contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੮॥੨੨॥੧੫॥੩੭॥
verses.translit: naanak naam samaane mukh ujale tit sachai dharabaar ||8||22||15||37||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they are absorbed in the Naam; their faces are radiant, in that True Court. ||8||22||15||37||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa asaTapadheeaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਮਨਾਏ ਪੰਚ ਰੁਸਾਏ ॥ ਪੰਚ ਵਸਾਏ ਪੰਚ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch manaae pa(n)ch rusaae || pa(n)ch vasaae pa(n)ch gavaae ||1||
verses.translation: When the five virtues were reconciled, and the five passions were estranged, I enshrined the five within myself, and cast out the other five. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਨੑ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਗਰੁ ਵੁਠਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ein(h) bidh nagar vuThaa mere bhaiee ||
verses.translation: In this way, the village of my body became inhabited, O my Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਦੁਰਤੁ ਗਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhurat giaa gur giaan dhiraRaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Vice departed, and the Guru's spiritual wisdom was implanted within me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਚ ਧਰਮ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਵਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: saach dharam kee kar dheenee vaar ||
verses.translation: The fence of true Dharmic religion has been built around it.

verses.original: ਫਰਹੇ ਮੁਹਕਮ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: farahe muhakam gur giaan beechaar ||2||
verses.translation: The spiritual wisdom and reflective meditation of the Guru has become its strong gate. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਖੇਤੀ ਬੀਜਹੁ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: naam khetee beejahu bhaiee meet ||
verses.translation: So plant the seed of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O friends, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਸਉਦਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਨੀਤ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saudhaa karahu gur sevahu neet ||3||
verses.translation: Deal only in the constant service of the Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਹਾਟ ॥
verses.translit: saa(n)t sahaj sukh ke sabh haaT ||
verses.translation: With intuitive peace and happiness, all the shops are filled.

verses.original: ਸਾਹ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਏਕੈ ਥਾਟ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: saeh vaapaaree ekai thaaT ||4||
verses.translation: The Banker and the dealers dwell in the same place. ||4||

verses.original: ਜੇਜੀਆ ਡੰਨੁ ਕੋ ਲਏ ਨ ਜਗਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: jejeeaa dda(n)n ko le na jagaat ||
verses.translation: There is no tax on non-believers, nor any fines or taxes at death.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਛਾਪ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: satigur kar dheenee dhur kee chhaap ||5||
verses.translation: The True Guru has set the Seal of the Primal Lord upon these goods. ||5||

verses.original: ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਦਿ ਖੇਪ ਚਲਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: vakhar naam ladh khep chalaavahu ||
verses.translation: So load the merchandise of the Naam, and set sail with your cargo.

verses.original: ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹੁ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: lai laahaa gurmukh ghar aavahu ||6||
verses.translation: Earn your profit, as Gurmukh, and you shall return to your own home. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਿਖ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur saahu sikh vanajaare ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the Banker, and His Sikhs are the traders.

verses.original: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: poo(n)jee naam lekhaa saach samhaare ||7||
verses.translation: Their merchandise is the Naam, and meditation on the True Lord is their account. ||7||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਵਸੈ ਇਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: so vasai it ghar jis gur pooraa sev ||
verses.translation: One who serves the True Guru dwells in this house.

verses.original: ਅਬਿਚਲ ਨਗਰੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਵ ॥੮॥੧॥
verses.translit: abichal nagaree naanak dhev ||8||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Divine City is eternal. ||8||1||

verses.original: ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩
verses.translit: aasaavaree mahalaa panjavaa ghar teejaa
verses.translation: Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehla, Third House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: mere man har siau laagee preet ||
verses.translation: My mind is in love with the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਾਚੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g har har japat niramal saachee reet ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har; my lifestyle is pure and true. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਘਣੀ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan kee piaas ghanee chitavat anik prakaar ||
verses.translation: I have such a great thirst for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; I think of him in so many ways.

verses.original: ਕਰਹੁ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: karahu anugrahu paarabraham har kirapaa dhaar muraar ||1||
verses.translation: So be Merciful, O Supreme Lord; shower Your Mercy upon me, O Lord, Destroyer of pride. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ ਆਇਆ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: man paradhesee aaiaa milio saadh kai sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: My stranger soul has come to join the Saadh Sangat.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਵਖਰ ਕਉ ਚਾਹਤਾ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਓ ਨਾਮਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jis vakhar kau chaahataa so paio naameh ra(n)g ||2||
verses.translation: That commodity, which I longed for, I have found in the Love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੇਤੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jete maiaa ra(n)g ras binas jaeh khin maeh ||
verses.translation: There are so many pleasures and delights of Maya, but they pass away in an instant.

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਭੁੰਚਹਿ ਸਭ ਠਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bhagat rate tere naam siau sukh bhu(n)cheh sabh Thai ||3||
verses.translation: Your devotees are imbued with Your Name; they enjoy peace everywhere. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਚਲਤਉ ਪੇਖੀਐ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabh jag chalatau pekheeaai nihachal har ko naau ||
verses.translation: The entire world is seen to be passing away; only the Lord's Name is lasting and stable.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾਈ ਸਾਧ ਸਿਉ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਠਾਉ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: kar mitraiee saadh siau nihachal paaveh Thaau ||4||
verses.translation: So make friends with the Holy Saints, so that you may obtain a lasting place of rest. ||4||

verses.original: ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪਾ ਕੋਊ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਸਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: meet saajan sut ba(n)dhapaa kouoo hot na saath ||
verses.translation: Friends, acquaintances, children and relatives - none of these shall be your companion.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਨਿਵਾਹੂ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਦੀਨਾ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਥ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: ek nivaahoo raam naam dheenaa kaa prabh naath ||5||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name alone shall go with you; God is the Master of the meek. ||5||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਭਏ ਲਗਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਓ ਤੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal bohith bhe lag saagar tario teh ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Lotus Feet are the Boat; attached to Them, you shall cross over the world-ocean.

verses.original: ਭੇਟਿਓ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸਾਚਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: bheTio pooraa satiguroo saachaa prabh siau neh ||6||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Perfect True Guru, I embrace True Love for God. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਜਾਚਨਾ ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: saadh tere kee jaachanaa visar na saas giraas ||
verses.translation: The prayer of Your Holy Saints is, ""May I never forget You, for even one breath or morsel of food.""

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਲਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਕਾਰਜ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jo tudh bhaavai so bhalaa terai bhaanai kaaraj raas ||7||
verses.translation: Whatever is pleasing to Your Will is good; by Your Sweet Will, my affairs are adjusted. ||7||

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਿਲੇ ਉਪਜੇ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: sukh saagar preetam mile upaje mahaa ana(n)dh ||
verses.translation: I have met my Beloved, the Ocean of Peace, and Supreme Bliss has welled up within me.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਦੁਖ ਮਿਟੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭੇਟੇ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ॥੮॥੧॥੨॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak sabh dhukh miTe prabh bheTe paramaana(n)dh ||8||1||2||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, all my pains have been eradicated, meeting with God, the Lord of Supreme Bliss. ||8||1||2||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਬਿਰਹੜੇ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਛੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਜਤਿ
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa birahaRe ghar chauthhaa chha(n)taa kee jat
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Birharray ~ Songs Of Separation, To Be Sung In The Tune Of The Chhants. Fourth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: paarabraham prabh simareeaai piaare dharasan kau bal jaau ||1||
verses.translation: Remember the Supreme Lord God, O Beloved, and make yourself a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖ ਬੀਸਰਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਤਜਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jis simarat dhukh beesareh piaare so kiau tajanaa jai ||2||
verses.translation: Remembering Him, sorrows are forgotten, O Beloved; how can one forsake Him? ||2||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਵੇਚੀ ਸੰਤ ਪਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: eih tan vechee sa(n)t peh piaare preetam dhei milai ||3||
verses.translation: I would sell this body to the Saint, O Beloved, if he would lead me to my Dear Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੇ ਫੀਕੇ ਤਜਿ ਛੋਡੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sukh seegaar bikhiaa ke feeke taj chhodde meree mai ||4||
verses.translation: The pleasures and adornments of corruption are insipid and useless; I have forsaken and abandoned them, O my Mother. ||4||

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਤਜਿ ਗਏ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lobh taj ge piaare satigur charanee pai ||5||
verses.translation: Lust, anger and greed left me, O Beloved, when I fell at the Feet of the True Guru. ||5||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਰਾਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jo jan raate raam siau piaare anat na kaahoo jai ||6||
verses.translation: Those humble beings who are imbued with the Lord, O Beloved, do not go anywhere else. ||6||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: har ras jin(h)ee chaakhiaa piaare tirapat rahe aaghai ||7||
verses.translation: Those who have tasted the Lord's sublime essence, O Beloved, remain satisfied and satiated. ||7||

verses.original: ਅੰਚਲੁ ਗਹਿਆ ਸਾਧ ਕਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਇ ॥੮॥੧॥੩॥
verses.translit: a(n)chal gahiaa saadh kaa naanak bhai saagar paar parai ||8||1||3||
verses.translation: One who grasps the Hem of the Gown of the Holy Saint, O Nanak, crosses over the terrible world-ocean. ||8||1||3||

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਬ ਭੇਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: janam maran dhukh kaTeeaai piaare jab bheTai har rai ||1||
verses.translation: The pains of birth and death are removed, O Beloved, when the mortal meets with the Lord, the King. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਸੁਘਰੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: su(n)dhar sughar sujaan prabh meraa jeevan dharas dhikhai ||2||
verses.translation: God is so Beautiful, so Refined, so Wise - He is my very life! Reveal to me Your Darshan! ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬੀਛੁਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo jeea tujh te beechhure piaare janam mareh bikh khai ||3||
verses.translation: Those beings who are separated from You, O Beloved, are born only to die; they eat the poison of corruption. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jis too(n) meleh so milai piaare tis kai laagau pai ||4||
verses.translation: He alone meets You, whom You cause to meet, O Beloved; I fall at his feet. ||4||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jo sukh dharasan pekhate piaare mukh te kahan na jai ||5||
verses.translation: That happiness which one receives by beholding Your Darshan, O Beloved, cannot be described in words. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਰਹੀ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: saachee preet na tuTiee piaare jug jug rahee samai ||6||
verses.translation: True Love cannot be broken, O Beloved; throughout the ages, it remains. ||6||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਲਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਅਮਰੁ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jo tudh bhaavai so bhalaa piaare teree amar rajai ||7||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases You is good, O Beloved; Your Will is Eternal. ||7||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੮॥੨॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak ra(n)g rate naarainai piaare maate sahaj subhai ||8||2||4||
verses.translation: Nanak, those who are imbued with the Love of the All-Pervading Lord, O Beloved, remain intoxicated with His Love, in natural ease. ||8||2||4||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਤੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਕਹਉ ਸੁਨਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabh bidh tum hee jaanate piaare kis peh kahau sunai ||1||
verses.translation: You know all about my condition, O Beloved; who can I speak to about it? ||1||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਆ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਪਹਿਰਹਿ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: too(n) dhaataa jeeaa sabhanaa kaa teraa dhitaa pahireh khai ||2||
verses.translation: You are the Giver of all beings; they eat and wear what You give them. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sukh dhukh teree aagiaa piaare dhoojee naahee jai ||3||
verses.translation: Pleasure and pain come by Your Will, O Beloved; they do not come from any other. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਕਰੀ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jo too(n) karaaveh so karee piaare avar kichh karan na jai ||4||
verses.translation: Whatever You cause me to do, that I do, O Beloved; I cannot do anything else. ||4||

verses.original: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਸਭ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: dhin rain sabh suhaavane piaare jit japeeaai har naau ||5||
verses.translation: All my days and nights are blessed, O Beloved, when I chant and meditate on the Lord's Name. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਾਈ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: saiee kaar kamaavanee piaare dhur masatak lekh likhai ||6||
verses.translation: He does the deeds, O Beloved, which are pre-ordained, and inscribed upon his forehead. ||6||

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: eko aap varatadhaa piaare ghaT ghaT rahiaa samai ||7||
verses.translation: The One is Himself prevailing everywhere, O Beloved; He is pervading in each and every heart. ||7||

verses.original: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਉਧਰਿ ਲੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥੮॥੩॥੨੨॥੧੫॥੨॥੪੨॥
verses.translit: sa(n)saar koop te udhar lai piaare naanak har saranai ||8||3||22||15||2||42||
verses.translation: Lift me up out of the deep pit of the world, O Beloved; Nanak has taken to Your Sanctuary. ||8||3||22||15||2||42||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਪਟੀ ਲਿਖੀ
verses.translit: raag aasaa mahalaa pehilaa paTee likhee
verses.translation: Raag Aasaa, First Mehla, Patee Likhee ~ The Poem Of The Alphabet:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਸੈ ਸੋਇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sasai soi sirasaT jin saajee sabhanaa saahib ek bhiaa ||
verses.translation: Sassa: He who created the world, is the One Lord and Master of all.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਤ ਰਹੇ ਚਿਤੁ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਾ ਸਫਲੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sevat rahe chit jin(h) kaa laagaa aaiaa tin(h) kaa safal bhiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Those whose consciousness remains committed to His Service - blessed is their birth and their coming into the world. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਾਹੇ ਭੂਲੇ ਮੂੜ ਮਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: man kaahe bhoole mooR manaa ||
verses.translation: O mind, why forget Him? You foolish mind!

verses.original: ਜਬ ਲੇਖਾ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਬੀਰਾ ਤਉ ਪੜਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jab lekhaa dheveh beeraa tau paRiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: When your account is adjusted, O brother, only then shall you be judged wise. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਈਵੜੀ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: e'eevaRee aadh purakh hai dhaataa aape sachaa soiee ||
verses.translation: Eevree: The Primal Lord is the Giver; He alone is True.

verses.original: ਏਨਾ ਅਖਰਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: enaa akharaa meh jo gurmukh boojhai tis sir lekh na hoiee ||2||
verses.translation: No accounting is due from the Gurmukh who understands the Lord through these letters. ||2||

verses.original: ਊੜੈ ਉਪਮਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਜੈ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: uooRai upamaa taa kee keejai jaa kaa a(n)t na paiaa ||
verses.translation: Ooraa: Sing the Praises of the One whose limit cannot be found.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sevaa kareh seiee fal paaveh jin(h)ee sach kamaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: Those who perform service and practice truth, obtain the fruits of their rewards. ||3||

verses.original: ਙੰਙੈ ਙਿਆਨੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਪੜਿਆ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: n(g)(n)n(g)ai n(g)iaan boojhai je koiee paRiaa pa(n)ddit soiee ||
verses.translation: Nganga: One who understands spiritual wisdom becomes a Pandit, a religious scholar.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sarab jeeaa meh eko jaanai taa haumai kahai na koiee ||4||
verses.translation: One who recognizes the One Lord among all beings does not talk of ego. ||4||

verses.original: ਕਕੈ ਕੇਸ ਪੁੰਡਰ ਜਬ ਹੂਏ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਾਬੂਣੈ ਉਜਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kakai kes pu(n)ddar jab hooe vin saaboonai ujaliaa ||
verses.translation: Kakka: When the hair grows grey, then it shines without shampoo.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਰਾਜੇ ਕੇ ਹੇਰੂ ਆਏ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਲਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jam raaje ke heroo aae maiaa kai sa(n)gal ba(n)dh liaa ||5||
verses.translation: The hunters of the King of Death come, and bind him in the chains of Maya. ||5||

verses.original: ਖਖੈ ਖੁੰਦਕਾਰੁ ਸਾਹ ਆਲਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਖਰੀਦਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: khakhai khu(n)dhakaar saeh aalam kar khareedh jin kharach dheeaa ||
verses.translation: Khakha: The Creator is the King of the world; He enslaves by giving nourishment.

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਅਵਰੀ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan jaa kai sabh jag baadhiaa avaree kaa nahee hukam piaa ||6||
verses.translation: By His Binding, all the world is bound; no other Command prevails. ||6||

verses.original: ਗਗੈ ਗੋਇ ਗਾਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਗਲੀ ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਗਰਬਿ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gagai goi gai jin chhoddee galee gobidh garab bhiaa ||
verses.translation: Gagga: One who renounces the singing of the songs of the Lord of the Universe, becomes arrogant in his speech.

verses.original: ਘੜਿ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਵੀ ਸਾਜੀ ਚਾੜਣ ਵਾਹੈ ਤਈ ਕੀਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: ghaR bhaa(n)dde jin aavee saajee chaaRan vaahai tiee keeaa ||7||
verses.translation: One who has shaped the pots, and made the world the kiln, decides when to put them in it. ||7||

verses.original: ਘਘੈ ਘਾਲ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੇ ਘਾਲੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: ghaghai ghaal sevak je ghaalai sabadh guroo kai laag rahai ||
verses.translation: Ghagha: The servant who performs service, remains attached to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਜੇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਮਤੁ ਰਹੈ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: buraa bhalaa je sam kar jaanai in bidh saahib ramat rahai ||8||
verses.translation: One who recognizes bad and good as one and the same - in this way he is absorbed into the Lord and Master. ||8||

verses.original: ਚਚੈ ਚਾਰਿ ਵੇਦ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜੇ ਚਾਰੇ ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰਿ ਜੁਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: chachai chaar vedh jin saaje chaare khaanee chaar jugaa ||
verses.translation: Chacha: He created the four Vedas, the four sources of creation, and the four ages

verses.original: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਖਾਣੀ ਭੋਗੀ ਪੜਿਆ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਆਪਿ ਥੀਆ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: jug jug jogee khaanee bhogee paRiaa pa(n)ddit aap theeaa ||9||
verses.translation: - through each and every age, He Himself has been the Yogi, the enjoyer, the Pandit and the scholar. ||9||

verses.original: ਛਛੈ ਛਾਇਆ ਵਰਤੀ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਭਰਮੁ ਹੋਆ ॥
verses.translit: chhachhai chhaiaa varatee sabh a(n)tar teraa keeaa bharam hoaa ||
verses.translation: Chhachha: Ignorance exists within everyone; doubt is Your doing, O Lord.

verses.original: ਭਰਮੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਭੁਲਾਈਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: bharam upai bhulaieean aape teraa karam hoaa tin(h) guroo miliaa ||10||
verses.translation: Having created doubt, You Yourself cause them to wander in delusion; those whom You bless with Your Mercy meet with the Guru. ||10||

verses.original: ਜਜੈ ਜਾਨੁ ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਭੀਖ ਭਵਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jajai jaan ma(n)gat jan jaachai lakh chauraaseeh bheekh bhaviaa ||
verses.translation: Jajja: That humble being who begs for wisdom has wandered begging through 8.4 million incarnations.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਲੇਵੈ ਏਕੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਮੈ ਸੁਣਿਆ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: eko levai eko dhevai avar na dhoojaa mai suniaa ||11||
verses.translation: The One Lord takes away, and the One Lord gives; I have not heard of any other. ||11||

verses.original: ਝਝੈ ਝੂਰਿ ਮਰਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੇਣਾ ਸੁ ਦੇ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jhajhai jhoor marahu kiaa praanee jo kichh dhenaa su dhe rahiaa ||
verses.translation: Jhajha: O mortal being, why are you dying of anxiety? Whatever the Lord is to give, He shall keep on giving.

verses.original: ਦੇ ਦੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਏ ਜਿਉ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: dhe dhe vekhai hukam chalaae jiau jeeaa kaa rijak piaa ||12||
verses.translation: He gives, and gives, and watches over us; according to the Orders which He issues, His beings receive nourishment. ||12||

verses.original: ਞੰਞੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਾ ਦੇਖਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: n(j)(n)n(j)ai nadhar kare jaa dhekhaa dhoojaa koiee naahee ||
verses.translation: Nyanya: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then I do not behold any other.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਏਕੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: eko rav rahiaa sabh thaiee ek vasiaa man maahee ||13||
verses.translation: The One Lord is totally pervading everywhere; the One Lord abides within the mind. ||13||

verses.original: ਟਟੈ ਟੰਚੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਘੜੀ ਕਿ ਮੁਹਤਿ ਕਿ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: TaTai Ta(n)ch karahu kiaa praanee ghaRee k muhat k uTh chalanaa ||
verses.translation: Tatta: Why do you practice hypocrisy, O mortal? In a moment, in an instant, you shall have to get up and depart.

verses.original: ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰਹੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਭਾਜਿ ਪੜਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: jooaai janam na haarahu apanaa bhaaj paRahu tum har saranaa ||14||
verses.translation: Don't lose your life in the gamble - hurry to the Lord's Sanctuary. ||14||

verses.original: ਠਠੈ ਠਾਢਿ ਵਰਤੀ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: ThaThai Thaadd varatee tin a(n)tar har charanee jin(h) kaa chit laagaa ||
verses.translation: T'hat'ha: Peace pervades within those who link their consciousness to the Lord's Lotus Feet.

verses.original: ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਨਿਸਤਰੇ ਤਉ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: chit laagaa seiee jan nisatare tau parasaadhee sukh paiaa ||15||
verses.translation: Those humble beings, whose consciousness is so linked, are saved; by Your Grace, they obtain peace. ||15||

verses.original: ਡਡੈ ਡੰਫੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਚਲਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: ddaddai dda(n)f karahu kiaa praanee jo kichh hoaa su sabh chalanaa ||
verses.translation: Dadda: Why do you make such ostentatious shows, O mortal? Whatever exists, shall all pass away.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੈ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: tisai sarevahu taa sukh paavahu sarab nira(n)tar rav rahiaa ||16||
verses.translation: So serve Him, who is contained and pervading among everyone, and you shall obtain peace. ||16||

verses.original: ਢਢੈ ਢਾਹਿ ਉਸਾਰੈ ਆਪੇ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਕਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: ddaddai ddaeh usaarai aape jiau tis bhaavai tivai kare ||
verses.translation: Dhadha: He Himself establishes and disestablishes; as it pleases His Will, so does He act.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: kar kar vekhai hukam chalaae tis nisataare jaa kau nadhar kare ||17||
verses.translation: Having created the creation, He watches over it; He issues His Commands, and emancipates those, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace. ||17||

verses.original: ਣਾਣੈ ਰਵਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: naanai ravat rahai ghaT a(n)tar har gun gaavai soiee ||
verses.translation: Nanna: One whose heart is filled with the Lord, sings His Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: aape aap milaae karataa punarap janam na hoiee ||18||
verses.translation: One whom the Creator Lord unites with Himself, is not consigned to reincarnation. ||18||

verses.original: ਤਤੈ ਤਾਰੂ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tatai taaroo bhavajal hoaa taa kaa a(n)t na paiaa ||
verses.translation: Tatta: The terrible world-ocean is so very deep; its limits cannot be found.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਤਰ ਨਾ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਹਮ ਬੂਡਸਿ ਤਾਰਿ ਲੇਹਿ ਤਾਰਣ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: naa tar naa tulahaa ham booddas taar leh taaran raiaa ||19||
verses.translation: I do not have a boat, or even a raft; I am drowning - save me, O Savior King! ||19||

verses.original: ਥਥੈ ਥਾਨਿ ਥਾਨੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਈ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਆ ॥
verses.translit: thathai thaan thaana(n)tar soiee jaa kaa keeaa sabh hoaa ||
verses.translation: T'hat'ha: In all places and interspaces, He is; everything which exists, is by His doing.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਭਰਮੁ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲਾ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: kiaa bharam kiaa maiaa kaheeaai jo tis bhaavai soiee bhalaa ||20||
verses.translation: What is doubt? What is called Maya? Whatever pleases Him is good. ||20||

verses.original: ਦਦੈ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਊ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੋਸੁ ਕਰੰਮਾ ਆਪਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhadhai dhos na dheuoo kisai dhos kara(n)maa aapaniaa ||
verses.translation: Dadda: Do not blame anyone else; blame instead your own actions.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਮੈ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਦੀਜੈ ਅਵਰ ਜਨਾ ॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: jo mai keeaa so mai paiaa dhos na dheejai avar janaa ||21||
verses.translation: Whatever I did, for that I have suffered; I do not blame anyone else. ||21||

verses.original: ਧਧੈ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਲਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਹਰਿ ਚੀਜੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਰੰਗ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhadhai dhaar kalaa jin chhoddee har cheejee jin ra(n)g keeaa ||
verses.translation: Dhadha: His power established and upholds the earth; the Lord has imparted His color to everything.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਦੀਆ ਸਭਨੀ ਲੀਆ ਕਰਮੀ ਕਰਮੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: tis dhaa dheeaa sabhanee leeaa karamee karamee hukam piaa ||22||
verses.translation: His gifts are received by everyone; all act according to His Command. ||22||

verses.original: ਨੰਨੈ ਨਾਹ ਭੋਗ ਨਿਤ ਭੋਗੈ ਨਾ ਡੀਠਾ ਨਾ ਸੰਮ੍ਹਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: na(n)nai naeh bhog nit bhogai naa ddeeThaa naa sa(n)mhaliaa ||
verses.translation: Nanna: The Husband Lord enjoys eternal pleasures, but He is not seen or understood.

verses.original: ਗਲੀ ਹਉ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਭੈਣੇ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਮੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: galee hau sohaagan bhaine ka(n)t na kabahoo(n) mai miliaa ||23||
verses.translation: I am called the happy soul-bride, O sister, but my Husband Lord has never met me. ||23||

verses.original: ਪਪੈ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਵੇਖਣ ਕਉ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: papai paatisaahu paramesar vekhan kau parapa(n)ch keeaa ||
verses.translation: Pappa: The Supreme King, the Transcendent Lord, created the world, and watches over it.

verses.original: ਦੇਖੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: dhekhai boojhai sabh kichh jaanai a(n)tar baahar rav rahiaa ||24||
verses.translation: He sees and understands, and knows everything; inwardly and outwardly, he is fully pervading. ||24||

verses.original: ਫਫੈ ਫਾਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਫਾਸਾ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਲਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: fafai faahee sabh jag faasaa jam kai sa(n)gal ba(n)dh liaa ||
verses.translation: Faffa: The whole world is caught in the noose of Death, and all are bound by its chains.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੇ ਨਰ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਭਜਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee se nar ubare j har saranaagat bhaj piaa ||25||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, they alone are saved, who hurry to enter the Lord's Sanctuary. ||25||

verses.original: ਬਬੈ ਬਾਜੀ ਖੇਲਣ ਲਾਗਾ ਚਉਪੜਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਚਾਰਿ ਜੁਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: babai baajee khelan laagaa chaupaR keete chaar jugaa ||
verses.translation: Babba: He set out to play the game, on the chess-board of the four ages.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭ ਸਾਰੀ ਕੀਤੇ ਪਾਸਾ ਢਾਲਣਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਗਾ ॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sabh saaree keete paasaa ddaalan aap lagaa ||26||
verses.translation: He made all beings and creatures his chessmen, and He Himself threw the dice. ||26||

verses.original: ਭਭੈ ਭਾਲਹਿ ਸੇ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਭਉ ਪਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhabhai bhaaleh se fal paaveh gur parasaadhee jin(h) kau bhau piaa ||
verses.translation: Bhabha: Those who search, find the fruits of their rewards; by Guru's Grace, they live in the Fear of God.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਫੇਰੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੨੭॥
verses.translit: manmukh fireh na cheteh mooRe lakh chauraaseeh fer piaa ||27||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs wander around, and they do not remember the Lord; the fools are consigned to the cycle of 8.4 million incarnations. ||27||

verses.original: ਮੰਮੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਬ ਚੇਤਵਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)mai moh maran madhusoodhan maran bhiaa tab chetaviaa ||
verses.translation: Mamma: In emotional attachment, he dies; he only thinks of the Lord, the Love of Nectar, when he dies.

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਅਵਰੋ ਪੜਿਆ ਮੰਮਾ ਅਖਰੁ ਵੀਸਰਿਆ ॥੨੮॥
verses.translit: kaiaa bheetar avaro paRiaa ma(n)maa akhar veesariaa ||28||
verses.translation: As long as the body is alive, he reads other things, and forgets the letter 'm', which stands for marnaa - death. ||28||

verses.original: ਯਯੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਕਦ ਹੀ ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: yayai janam na hovee kadh hee je kar sach pachhaanai ||
verses.translation: Yaya: He is never reincarnated again, if he recognizes the True Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਖੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੨੯॥
verses.translit: gurmukh aakhai gurmukh boojhai gurmukh eko jaanai ||29||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh speaks, the Gurmukh understands, and the Gurmukh knows only the One Lord. ||29||

verses.original: ਰਾਰੈ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੇਤੇ ਕੀਏ ਜੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: raarai rav rahiaa sabh a(n)tar jete ke'ee ja(n)taa ||
verses.translation: Rarra: The Lord is contained among all; He created all beings.

verses.original: ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ ਧੰਧੈ ਸਭ ਲਾਏ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ ॥੩੦॥
verses.translit: ja(n)t upai dha(n)dhai sabh laae karam hoaa tin naam liaa ||30||
verses.translation: Having created His beings, He has put them all to work; they alone remember the Naam, upon whom He bestows His Grace. ||30||

verses.original: ਲਲੈ ਲਾਇ ਧੰਧੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: lalai lai dha(n)dhai jin chhoddee meeThaa maiaa moh keeaa ||
verses.translation: Lalla: He has assigned people to their tasks, and made the love of Maya seem sweet to them.

verses.original: ਖਾਣਾ ਪੀਣਾ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਸਹਣਾ ਭਾਣੈ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੩੧॥
verses.translit: khaanaa peenaa sam kar sahanaa bhaanai taa kai hukam piaa ||31||
verses.translation: We eat and drink; we should endure equally whatever occurs, by His Will, by His Command. ||31||

verses.original: ਵਵੈ ਵਾਸੁਦੇਉ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਵੇਖਣ ਕਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਵੇਸੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: vavai vaasudheau paramesar vekhan kau jin ves keeaa ||
verses.translation: Wawa: The all-pervading Transcendent Lord beholds the world; He created the form it wears.

verses.original: ਵੇਖੈ ਚਾਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੩੨॥
verses.translit: vekhai chaakhai sabh kichh jaanai a(n)tar baahar rav rahiaa ||32||
verses.translation: He beholds, tastes, and knows everything; He is pervading and permeating inwardly and outwardly. ||32||

verses.original: ੜਾੜੈ ਰਾੜਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਜਿ ਅਮਰੁ ਹੋਆ ॥ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਹੁ ਓਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਕੀਆ ॥੩੩॥
verses.translit: RaaRai raaR kareh kiaa praanee tiseh dhiaavahu j amar hoaa || tiseh dhiaavahu sach samaavahu os viTahu kurabaan keeaa ||33||
verses.translation: Rarra: Why do you quarrel, O mortal? Meditate on the Imperishable Lord, and be absorbed into the True One. Become a sacrifice to Him. ||33||

verses.original: ਹਾਹੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: haahai hor na koiee dhaataa jeea upai jin rijak dheeaa ||
verses.translation: Haha: There is no other Giver than Him; having created the creatures, He gives them nourishment.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਹੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਆ ॥੩੪॥
verses.translit: har naam dhiaavahu har naam samaavahu anadhin laahaa har naam leeaa ||34||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Lord's Name, be absorbed into the Lord's Name, and night and day, reap the Profit of the Lord's Name. ||34||

verses.original: ਆਇੜੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aaiRai aap kare jin chhoddee jo kichh karanaa su kar rahiaa ||
verses.translation: Airaa: He Himself created the world; whatever He has to do, He continues to do.

verses.original: ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਇਰ ਇਵ ਕਹਿਆ ॥੩੫॥੧॥
verses.translit: kare karaae sabh kichh jaanai naanak sair iv kahiaa ||35||1||
verses.translation: He acts, and causes others to act, and He knows everything; so says Nanak, the poet. ||35||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਪਟੀ
verses.translit: raag aasaa mahalaa teejaa paTee
verses.translation: Raag Aasaa, Third Mehla, Patee - The Alphabet:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਅਯੋ ਅੰਙੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਆਇਆ ਕਾਖੈ ਘੰਙੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ayo a(n)n(g)ai sabh jag aaiaa kaakhai gha(n)n(g)ai kaal bhiaa ||
verses.translation: Ayo, Angai: The whole world which was created - Kaahkai, Ghangai: It shall pass away.

verses.original: ਰੀਰੀ ਲਲੀ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਣੇ ਪੜਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਗੁਣ ਵੀਸਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: reeree lalee paap kamaane paR avagan gun veesariaa ||1||
verses.translation: Reeree, Laalee: People commit sins, and falling into vice, forget virtue. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਐਸਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਤੂੰ ਕੀ ਪੜਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: man aaisaa lekhaa too(n) kee paRiaa ||
verses.translation: O mortal, why have you studied such an account,

verses.original: ਲੇਖਾ ਦੇਣਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: lekhaa dhenaa terai sir rahiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: which shall call you to answer for payment? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਿਧੰਙਾਇਐ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਨੰਨੈ ਨਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sidha(n)n(g)aiaai simareh naahee na(n)nai naa tudh naam liaa ||
verses.translation: Sidhan, Ngaayiyai: You do not remember the Lord. Nanna: You do not take the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਛਛੈ ਛੀਜਹਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਜਮਿ ਪਾਕੜਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: chhachhai chheejeh ahinis mooRe kiau chhooTeh jam paakaRiaa ||2||
verses.translation: Chhachha: You are wearing away, every night and day; you fool, how will you find release? You are held in the grip of death. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਬੈ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੂੜੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: babai boojheh naahee mooRe bharam bhule teraa janam giaa ||
verses.translation: Babba: You do not understand, you fool; deluded by doubt, you are wasting your life.

verses.original: ਅਣਹੋਦਾ ਨਾਉ ਧਰਾਇਓ ਪਾਧਾ ਅਵਰਾ ਕਾ ਭਾਰੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਲਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: anahodhaa naau dharaio paadhaa avaraa kaa bhaar tudh liaa ||3||
verses.translation: Without justification, you call yourself a teacher; thus you take on the loads of others. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਜੈ ਜੋਤਿ ਹਿਰਿ ਲਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਮੂੜੇ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਹਿਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: jajai jot hir liee teree mooRe a(n)t giaa pachhutaavahigaa ||
verses.translation: Jajja: You have been robbed of your Light, you fool; in the end, you shall have to depart, and you shall regret and repent.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਤੂੰ ਚੀਨਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਆਵਹਿਗਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: ek sabadh too(n) cheeneh naahee fir fir joonee aavahigaa ||4||
verses.translation: You have not remembered the One Word of the Shabad, and so you shall have to enter the womb over and over again. ||4||

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਪੜੁ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਅਵਰਾ ਨੋ ਨ ਸਿਖਾਲਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tudh sir likhiaa so paR pa(n)ddit avaraa no na sikhaal bikhiaa ||
verses.translation: Read that which is written on your forehead, O Pandit, and do not teach wickedness to others.

verses.original: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਫਾਹਾ ਪਇਆ ਪਾਧੇ ਪਿਛੋ ਦੇ ਗਲਿ ਚਾਟੜਿਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: pahilaa faahaa piaa paadhe pichho dhe gal chaaTaRiaa ||5||
verses.translation: First, the teacher is tied down, and then, the noose is placed around the pupil's neck. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਸੈ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਗਇਓ ਮੂੜੇ ਏਕੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਕੁਥਾਇ ਲਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sasai sa(n)jam gio mooRe ek dhaan tudh kuthai liaa ||
verses.translation: Sassa: You have lost your self-discipline, you fool, and you have accepted an offering under false pretenses.

verses.original: ਸਾਈ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੀ ਜਜਮਾਨ ਕੀ ਸਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਏਤੁ ਧਾਨਿ ਖਾਧੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: saiee putree jajamaan kee saa teree et dhaan khaadhai teraa janam giaa ||6||
verses.translation: The daughter of the alms-giver is just like your own; by accepting this payment for performing the wedding ceremony, you have cursed your own life. ||6||

verses.original: ਮੰਮੈ ਮਤਿ ਹਿਰਿ ਲਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਮੂੜੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਡਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਪਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)mai mat hir liee teree mooRe haumai vaddaa rog piaa ||
verses.translation: Mamma: You have been cheated out your intellect, you fool, and you are afflicted with the great disease of ego.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰ ਆਤਮੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਿੑਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar aatamai braham na cheeni(h)aa maiaa kaa muhataaj bhiaa ||7||
verses.translation: Within your innermost self, you do not recognize God, and you compromise yourself for the sake of Maya. ||7||

verses.original: ਕਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਭਰਮਿਓਹੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਮਮਤਾ ਲਾਗੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kakai kaam karodh bharamioh mooRe mamataa laage tudh har visariaa ||
verses.translation: Kakka: You wander around in sexual desire and anger, you fool; attached to possessiveness, you have forgotten the Lord.

verses.original: ਪੜਹਿ ਗੁਣਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪੁਕਾਰਹਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਤੂੰ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਆ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: paReh guneh too(n) bahut pukaareh vin boojhe too(n) ddoob muaa ||8||
verses.translation: You read, and reflect, and proclaim out loud, but without understanding, you are drowned to death. ||8||

verses.original: ਤਤੈ ਤਾਮਸਿ ਜਲਿਓਹੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਥਥੈ ਥਾਨ ਭਰਿਸਟੁ ਹੋਆ ॥
verses.translit: tatai taamas jalioh mooRe thathai thaan bharisaT hoaa ||
verses.translation: Tatta: In anger, you are burnt, you fool. T'hat'ha: That place where you live, is cursed.

verses.original: ਘਘੈ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਮੂੜੇ ਦਦੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਨ ਤੁਧੁ ਲਇਆ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: ghaghai ghar ghar fireh too(n) mooRe dhadhai dhaan na tudh liaa ||9||
verses.translation: Ghagha: You go begging from door to door, you fool. Dadda: But still, you do not receive the gift. ||9||

verses.original: ਪਪੈ ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਵਹੀ ਮੂੜੇ ਪਰਪੰਚਿ ਤੂੰ ਪਲਚਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: papai paar na pavahee mooRe parapa(n)ch too(n) palach rahiaa ||
verses.translation: Pappa: You shall not be able to swim across, you fool, since you are engrossed in worldly affairs.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਓਹੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਇਹੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਲੇਖੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: sachai aap khuaaioh mooRe ih sir terai lekh piaa ||10||
verses.translation: The True Lord Himself has ruined you, you fool; this is the destiny written on your forehead. ||10||

verses.original: ਭਭੈ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਡੁਬੋਹੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਲਤਾਨੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhabhai bhavajal dduboh mooRe maiaa vich galataan bhiaa ||
verses.translation: Bhabha: You have drowned in the terrifying world-ocean, you fool, and you have become engrossed in Maya.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਏਕ ਘੜੀ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee eko jaanai ek ghaRee meh paar piaa ||11||
verses.translation: One who comes to know the One Lord, by Guru's Grace, is carried across in an instant. ||11||

verses.original: ਵਵੈ ਵਾਰੀ ਆਈਆ ਮੂੜੇ ਵਾਸੁਦੇਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਵੀਸਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: vavai vaaree aaieeaa mooRe vaasudheau tudh veesariaa ||
verses.translation: Wawa: Your turn has come, you fool, but you have forgotten the Lord of Light.

verses.original: ਏਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਨ ਲਹਸਹਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਤੂੰ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: eh velaa na lahaseh mooRe fir too(n) jam kai vas piaa ||12||
verses.translation: This opportunity shall not come again, you fool; you shall fall under the power of the Messenger of Death. ||12||

verses.original: ਝਝੈ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਝੂਰਹਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਤੂੰ ਵਿਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: jhajhai kadhe na jhooreh mooRe satigur kaa upadhes sun too(n) vikhaa ||
verses.translation: Jhajha: You shall never have to regret and repent, you fool, if you listen to the Teachings of the True Guru, for even an instant.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਨਾਉ ਬੁਰਾ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: satigur baajhahu gur nahee koiee nigure kaa hai naau buraa ||13||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, there is no Guru at all; one who is without a Guru has a bad reputation. ||13||

verses.original: ਧਧੈ ਧਾਵਤ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਖੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhadhai dhaavat varaj rakh mooRe a(n)tar terai nidhaan piaa ||
verses.translation: Dhadha: Restrain your wandering mind, you fool; deep within you the treasure is to be found.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਜੁਗਾ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ਖਾਹਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hoveh taa har ras peeveh jugaa juga(n)tar khaeh piaa ||14||
verses.translation: When one becomes Gurmukh, then he drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord; throughout the ages, he continues to drink it in. ||14||

verses.original: ਗਗੈ ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਗਲੀ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gagai gobidh chit kar mooRe galee kinai na paiaa ||
verses.translation: Gagga: Keep the Lord of the Universe in your mind, you fool; by mere words, no one has ever attained Him.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਇ ਮੂੜੇ ਪਿਛਲੇ ਗੁਨਹ ਸਭ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: gur ke charan hiradhai vasai mooRe pichhale guneh sabh bakhas liaa ||15||
verses.translation: Enshrine the Guru's feet within your heart, you fool, and all your past sins shall be forgiven. ||15||

verses.original: ਹਾਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਬੂਝੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੂੜੇ ਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: haahai har kathaa boojh too(n) mooRe taa sadhaa sukh hoiee ||
verses.translation: Haha: Understand the Lord's Sermon, you fool; only then shall you attain eternal peace.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪੜਹਿ ਤੇਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: manmukh paReh tetaa dhukh laagai vin satigur mukat na hoiee ||16||
verses.translation: The more the self-willed manmukhs read, the more pain they suffer. Without the True Guru, liberation is not obtained. ||16||

verses.original: ਰਾਰੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: raarai raam chit kar mooRe hiradhai jin(h) kai rav rahiaa ||
verses.translation: Rarra: Center your consciousness on the Lord, you fool; abide with those whose hearts are filled with the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਰਾਮੁ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਬੂਝਿ ਲਹਿਆ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee jin(h)ee raam pachhaataa niragun raam tin(h)ee boojh lahiaa ||17||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, those who recognize the Lord, understand the absolute Lord. ||17||

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਿਆ ਅਕਥੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: teraa a(n)t na jaiee lakhiaa akath na jaiee har kathiaa ||
verses.translation: Your limits cannot be known; the indescribable Lord cannot be described.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਨਿਬੜਿਆ ॥੧੮॥੧॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak jin(h) kau satigur miliaa tin(h) kaa lekhaa nibaRiaa ||18||1||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, whose who have met the True Guru, have their accounts settled. ||18||1||2||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: raag aasaa mahalaa pehilaa chha(n)t ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Raag Aasaa, First Mehla, Chhant, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮੁੰਧ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਬਾਲੜੀਏ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਲੀਆਲਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: mu(n)dh joban baalaRe'e meraa pir raleeaalaa raam ||
verses.translation: O beautiful young bride, my Beloved Lord is very playful.

verses.original: ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਨੇਹੁ ਘਣਾ ਰਸਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: dhan pir neh ghanaa ras preet dhiaalaa raam ||
verses.translation: When the bride enshrines great love for her Husband Lord, He becomes merciful, and loves her in return.

verses.original: ਧਨ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਮੇਲਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhan pireh melaa hoi suaamee aap prabh kirapaa kare ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride meets her Husband Lord, when the Lord Master Himself showers His favor upon her.

verses.original: ਸੇਜਾ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਸਾਤ ਸਰ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sejaa suhaavee sa(n)g pir kai saat sar a(n)mirat bhare ||
verses.translation: Her bed is decorated in the company of her Beloved, and her seven pools are filled with ambrosial nectar.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਓ ॥
verses.translit: kar dhiaa miaa dhiaal saache sabadh mil gun gaavo ||
verses.translation: Be kind and compassionate to me, O Merciful True Lord, that I may obtain the Word of the Shabad, and sing Your Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਬਿਗਸੀ ਮੁੰਧ ਮਨਿ ਓਮਾਹਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanakaa har var dhekh bigasee mu(n)dh man omaaho ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, gazing upon her Husband Lord, the soul-bride is delighted, and her mind is filled with joy. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੁੰਧ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਲੋਨੜੀਏ ਇਕ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: mu(n)dh sahaj salonaRe'e ik prem bina(n)tee raam ||
verses.translation: O bride of natural beauty, offer your loving prayers to the Lord.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਮਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: mai man tan har bhaavai prabh sa(n)gam raatee raam ||
verses.translation: The Lord is pleasing to my mind and body; I am intoxicated in my Lord God's Company.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh prem raatee har bina(n)tee naam har kai sukh vasai ||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Love of God, I pray to the Lord, and through the Lord's Name, I abide in peace.

verses.original: ਤਉ ਗੁਣ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਗੁਣਹ ਵਸਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਨਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: tau gun pachhaaneh taa prabh jaaneh guneh vas avagan nasai ||
verses.translation: If you recognize His Glorious Virtues, then you shall come to know God; thus virtue shall dwell in you, and sin shall run away.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝੁ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਾ ਕਹਣਿ ਸੁਨਣਿ ਨ ਧੀਜਏ ॥
verses.translit: tudh baajh ik til reh na saakaa kahan sunan na dheeje ||
verses.translation: Without You, I cannot survive, even for an instant; by merely talking and listening about You, I am not satisfied.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanakaa priau priau kar pukaare rasan ras man bheeje ||2||
verses.translation: Nanak proclaims, ""O Beloved, O Beloved!"" His tongue and mind are drenched with the Lord's sublime essence. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਖੀਹੋ ਸਹੇਲੜੀਹੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sakheeho sahelaReeho meraa pir vanajaaraa raam ||
verses.translation: O my companions and friends, my Husband Lord is the merchant.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋੁ ਵਣੰਜੜਿਆ ਰਸਿ ਮੋਲਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: har naamuo vana(n)jaRiaa ras mol apaaraa raam ||
verses.translation: I have purchased the Lord's Name; its sweetness and value are unlimited.

verses.original: ਮੋਲਿ ਅਮੋਲੋ ਸਚ ਘਰਿ ਢੋਲੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਮੁੰਧ ਭਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: mol amolo sach ghar ddolo prabh bhaavai taa mu(n)dh bhalee ||
verses.translation: His value is invaluable; the Beloved dwells in His true home. If it is pleasing to God, then He blesses His bride.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਕਰਹਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਹਉ ਪੁਕਾਰੀ ਦਰਿ ਖਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: eik sa(n)g har kai kareh raleeaa hau pukaaree dhar khalee ||
verses.translation: Some enjoy sweet pleasures with the Lord, while I stand crying at His door.

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਆਪਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਾਰਏ ॥
verses.translit: karan kaaran samarath sreedhar aap kaaraj saare ||
verses.translation: The Creator, the Cause of causes, the All-powerful Lord Himself arranges our affairs.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਭ ਸਾਧਾਰਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak nadharee dhan sohaagan sabadh abh saadhaare ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, blessed is the soul-bride, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace; she enshrines the Word of the Shabad in her heart. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇਅੜੇ ਮੀਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: ham ghar saachaa sohilaRaa prabh aaiaRe meetaa raam ||
verses.translation: In my home, the true songs of rejoicing resound; the Lord God, my Friend, has come to me.

verses.original: ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੜਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਅੜਾ ਦੀਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: raave ra(n)g raataRiaa man leeaRaa dheetaa raam ||
verses.translation: He enjoys me, and imbued with His Love, I have captivated His heart, and given mine to Him.

verses.original: ਆਪਣਾ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਲੀਆ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: aapanaa man dheeaa har var leeaa jiau bhaavai tiau raave ||
verses.translation: I gave my mind, and obtained the Lord as my Husband; as it pleases His Will, He enjoys me.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਆਗੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਭਾਗੈ ਘਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: tan man pir aagai sabadh sabhaagai ghar a(n)mirat fal paave ||
verses.translation: I have placed my body and mind before my Husband Lord, and through the Shabad, I have been blessed. Within the home of my own self, I have obtained the ambrosial fruit.

verses.original: ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਠਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਹੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈਐ ਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: budh paaTh na paieeaai bahu chaturaieeaai bhai milai man bhaane ||
verses.translation: He is not obtained by intellectual recitation or great cleverness; only by love does the mind obtain Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੀਤ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਹਮ ਨਾਹੀ ਲੋਕਾਣੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak Thaakur meet hamaare ham naahee lokaane ||4||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord Master is my Best Friend; I am not an ordinary person. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਨਹਦੋ ਅਨਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: anahadho anahadh vaajai run jhunakaare raam ||
verses.translation: The unstruck melody of the sound current resounds with the vibrations of the celestial instruments.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਲਾਲ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: meraa mano meraa man raataa laal piaare raam ||
verses.translation: My mind, my mind is imbued with the Love of my Darling Beloved.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸੁੰਨ ਮੰਡਲਿ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin raataa man bairaagee su(n)n ma(n)ddal ghar paiaa ||
verses.translation: Night and day, my detached mind remains absorbed in the Lord, and I obtain my home in the profound trance of the celestial void.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aadh purakh apara(n)par piaaraa satigur alakh lakhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has revealed to me the Primal Lord, the Infinite, my Beloved, the Unseen.

verses.original: ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸਣਿ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aasan baisan thir naarain tit man raataa veechaare ||
verses.translation: The Lord's posture and His seat are permanent; my mind is absorbed in reflective contemplation upon Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਅਨਹਦ ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate bairaagee anahadh run jhunakaare ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the detached ones are imbued with His Name, the unstruck melody, and the celestial vibrations. ||1||

verses.original: ਤਿਤੁ ਅਗਮ ਤਿਤੁ ਅਗਮ ਪੁਰੇ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: tit agam tit agam pure kahu kit bidh jaieeaai raam ||
verses.translation: Tell me, how can I reach that unreachable, that unreachable city?

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੋ ਸਾਰਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sach sa(n)jamo saar gunaa gur sabadh kamaieeaai raam ||
verses.translation: By practicing truthfulness and self-restraint, by contemplating His Glorious Virtues, and living the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: sach sabadh kamaieeaai nij ghar jaieeaai paieeaai gunee nidhaanaa ||
verses.translation: Practicing the True Word of the Shabad, one comes to the home of his own inner being, and obtains the treasure of virtue.

verses.original: ਤਿਤੁ ਸਾਖਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਡਾਲੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: tit saakhaa mool pat nahee ddaalee sir sabhanaa paradhaanaa ||
verses.translation: He has no stems, roots, leaves or branches, but He is the Supreme Lord over the heads of all.

verses.original: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਥਾਕੀ ਹਠਿ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jap tap kar kar sa(n)jam thaakee haTh nigreh nahee paieeaai ||
