verses.translation: Practicing intensive meditation, chanting and self-discipline, people have grown weary; stubbornly practicing these rituals, they still have not found Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sahaj mile jagajeevan satigur boojh bujhaieeaai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through spiritual wisdom, the Lord, the Life of the world, is met; the True Guru imparts this understanding. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੋ ਰਤਨਾਗਰੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਰਤਨ ਘਣੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: gur saagaro ratanaagar tit ratan ghanere raam ||
verses.translation: The Guru is the ocean, the mountain of jewels, overflowing with jewels.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਮਜਨੋ ਸਪਤ ਸਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: kar majano sapat sare man niramal mere raam ||
verses.translation: Take your bath in the seven seas, O my mind, and become pure.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਲਿ ਨੑਾਏ ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਏ ਪੰਚ ਮਿਲੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: niramal jal n(h)aae jaa prabh bhaae pa(n)ch mile veechaare ||
verses.translation: One bathes in the water of purity when it is pleasing to God, and obtains the five virtues by reflective meditation.

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਤਜਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh kapaT bikhiaa taj sach naam ur dhaare ||
verses.translation: Renouncing sexual desire, anger, deceit and corruption, he enshrines the True Name in his heart.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰਿ ਲਬ ਥਾਕੇ ਪਾਏ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: haumai lobh lahar lab thaake paae dheen dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: When the waves of ego, greed and avarice subside, he finds the Lord Master, Merciful to the meek.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak gur samaan teerath nahee koiee saache gur gopaalaa ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, there is no place of pilgrimage comparable to the Guru; the True Guru is the Lord of the world. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਨੁ ਬਨੋ ਦੇਖਿ ਰਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਬਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: hau ban bano dhekh rahee tiran dhekh sabaiaa raam ||
verses.translation: I have searched the jungles and forests, and looked upon all the fields.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੋ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: tirabhavano tujheh keeaa sabh jagat sabaiaa raam ||
verses.translation: You created the three worlds, the entire universe, everything.

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੀਆ ਤੂੰ ਥਿਰੁ ਥੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: teraa sabh keeaa too(n) thir theeaa tudh samaan ko naahee ||
verses.translation: You created everything; You alone are permanent. Nothing is equal to You.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) dhaataa sabh jaachik tere tudh bin kis saalaahee ||
verses.translation: You are the Giver - all are Your beggars; without You, who should we praise?

verses.original: ਅਣਮੰਗਿਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਦਾਤੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: anama(n)giaa dhaan dheejai dhaate teree bhagat bhare bha(n)ddaaraa ||
verses.translation: You bestow Your gifts, even when we do not ask for them, O Great Giver; devotion to You is a treasure over-flowing.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: raam naam bin mukat na hoiee naanak kahai veechaaraa ||4||2||
verses.translation: Without the Lord's Name, there is no liberation; so says Nanak, this is the teaching of the Lord. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: meraa mano meraa man raataa raam piaare raam ||
verses.translation: My mind, my mind is attuned to the Love of my Beloved Lord.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੋ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੋ ਧਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sach saahibo aadh purakh apara(n)paro dhaare raam ||
verses.translation: The True Lord Master, the Primal Being, the Infinite One, is the Support of the earth.

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਧਾਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: agam agochar apar apaaraa paarabraham paradhaano ||
verses.translation: He is unfathomable, unapproachable, infinite and incomparable. He is the Supreme Lord God, the Lord above all.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਸਭੁ ਮਾਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: aadh jugaadhee hai bhee hosee avar jhooThaa sabh maano ||
verses.translation: He is the Lord, from the beginning, throughout the ages, now and forevermore; know that all else is false.

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: karam dharam kee saar na jaanai surat mukat kiau paieeaai ||
verses.translation: If one does not appreciate the value of good deeds and Dharmic faith, how can one obtain clarity of consciousness and liberation?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh sabadh pachhaanai ahinis naam dhiaaieeaai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes the Word of the Shabad; night and day, he meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: meraa mano meraa man maaniaa naam sakhaiee raam ||
verses.translation: My mind, my mind has come to accept, that the Naam is our only Friend.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: haumai mamataa maiaa sa(n)g na jaiee raam ||
verses.translation: Egotism, worldly attachment, and the lures of Maya shall not go with you.

verses.original: ਮਾਤਾ ਪਿਤ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਤ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਸੰਪੈ ਨਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: maataa pit bhaiee sut chaturaiee sa(n)g na sa(n)pai naare ||
verses.translation: Mother, father, famliy, children, cleverness, property and spouses - none of these shall go with you.

verses.original: ਸਾਇਰ ਕੀ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੀ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਚਰਣ ਤਲੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sair kee putree parahar tiaagee charan talai veechaare ||
verses.translation: I have renounced Maya, the daughter of the ocean; reflecting upon reality, I have trampled it under my feet.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਇਕੁ ਚਲਤੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aadh purakh ik chalat dhikhaiaa jeh dhekhaa teh soiee ||
verses.translation: The Primal Lord has revealed this wondrous show; wherever I look, there I see Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak har kee bhagat na chhoddau sahaje hoi su hoiee ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I shall not forsake the Lord's devotional worship; in the natural course, what shall be, shall be. ||2||

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: meraa mano meraa man niramal saach samaale raam ||
verses.translation: My mind, my mind has become immaculately pure, contemplating the True Lord.

verses.original: ਅਵਗਣ ਮੇਟਿ ਚਲੇ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗਮ ਨਾਲੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: avagan meT chale gun sa(n)gam naale raam ||
verses.translation: I have dispelled my vices, and now I walk in the company of the virtuous.

verses.original: ਅਵਗਣ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: avagan parahar karanee saaree dhar sachai sachiaaro ||
verses.translation: Discarding my vices, I do good deeds, and in the True Court, I am judged as true.

verses.original: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਵਣੁ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: aavan jaavan Thaak rahaae gurmukh tat veechaaro ||
verses.translation: My coming and going has come to an end; as Gurmukh, I reflect upon the nature of reality.

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਸਖਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: saajan meet sujaan sakhaa too(n) sach milai vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: O my Dear Friend, You are my all-knowing companion; grant me the glory of Your True Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਐਸੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak naam ratan paragaasiaa aaisee gurmat paiee ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the jewel of the Naam has been revealed to me; such are the Teachings I have received from the Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਅੰਜਨੋ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਾਰਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sach a(n)jano a(n)jan saar nira(n)jan raataa raam ||
verses.translation: I have carefully applied the healing ointment to my eyes, and I am attuned to the Immaculate Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: man tan rav rahiaa jagajeevano dhaataa raam ||
verses.translation: He is permeating my mind and body, the Life of the world, the Lord, the Great Giver.

verses.original: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jagajeevan dhaataa har man raataa sahaj milai melaiaa ||
verses.translation: My mind is imbued with the Lord, the Great Giver, the Life of the world; I have merged and blended with Him, with intuitive ease.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਸਭਾ ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: saadh sabhaa sa(n)taa kee sa(n)gat nadhar prabhoo sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: In the Company of the Holy, and the Saints' Society, by God's Grace, peace is obtained.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਚੂਕੇ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: har kee bhagat rate bairaagee chooke moh piaasaa ||
verses.translation: The renunciates remain absorbed in devotional worship to the Lord; they are rid of emotional attachment and desire.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਤੀਣੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਦਾਸ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak haumai maar pateene virale dhaas udhaasaa ||4||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, how rare is that unattached servant, who conquers his ego, and remains pleased with the Lord. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: raag aasaa mahalaa pehilaa chha(n)t ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Raag Aasaa, First Mehla, Chhant, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ਜਿਥੈ ਹਉ ਜਾਈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) sabhanee thaiee jithai hau jaiee saachaa sirajanahaar jeeau ||
verses.translation: You are everywhere, wherever I go, O True Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਸਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa kaa dhaataa karam bidhaataa dhookh bisaaranahaar jeeau ||
verses.translation: You are the Giver of all, the Architect of Destiny, the Dispeller of distress.

verses.original: ਦੂਖ ਬਿਸਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhookh bisaaranahaar suaamee keetaa jaa kaa hovai ||
verses.translation: The Lord Master is the Dispeller of distress; all that happens is by His doing.

verses.original: ਕੋਟ ਕੋਟੰਤਰ ਪਾਪਾ ਕੇਰੇ ਏਕ ਘੜੀ ਮਹਿ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: koT koTa(n)tar paapaa kere ek ghaRee meh khovai ||
verses.translation: Millions upon millions of sins, He destroys in an instant.

verses.original: ਹੰਸ ਸਿ ਹੰਸਾ ਬਗ ਸਿ ਬਗਾ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: ha(n)s s ha(n)saa bag s bagaa ghaT ghaT kare beechaar jeeau ||
verses.translation: He calls a swan a swan, and a crane a crane; He contemplates each and every heart.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ਜਿਥੈ ਹਉ ਜਾਈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: too(n) sabhanee thaiee jithai hau jaiee saachaa sirajanahaar jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: You are everywhere, wherever I go, O True Creator Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h) ik man dhiaaiaa tin(h) sukh paiaa te virale sa(n)saar jeeau ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on Him single-mindedly obtain peace; how rare are they in this world.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਹਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: tin jam neR na aavai gur sabadh kamaavai kabahu na aaveh haar jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death does not draw near those who live the Guru's Teachings; they never return defeated.

verses.original: ਤੇ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹਾਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਹਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: te kabahu na haareh har har gun saareh tin(h) jam neR na aavai ||
verses.translation: Those who appreciate the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, never suffer defeat; the Messenger of Death does not even approach them.

verses.original: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਕਾ ਚੂਕਾ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: ja(n)man maran tin(h)aa kaa chookaa jo har laage paavai ||
verses.translation: Birth and death are ended for those who are attached to the feet of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat har ras har fal paiaa har har naam ur dhaar jeeau ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, they obtain the sublime essence of the Lord, and the fruit of the Lord; they enshrine the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in their hearts.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jin(h) ik man dhiaaiaa tin(h) sukh paiaa te virale sa(n)saar jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on Him single-mindedly obtain peace; how rare are they in this world. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਸੈ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin jagat upaiaa dha(n)dhai laiaa tisai viTahu kurabaan jeeau ||
verses.translation: He who created the world and assigned all to their tasks - unto Him I am a sacrifice.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੀਜੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: taa kee sev kareejai laahaa leejai har dharageh paieeaai maan jeeau ||
verses.translation: So serve Him, and gather profit, and you shall obtain honor in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: har dharageh maan soiee jan paavai jo nar ek pachhaanai ||
verses.translation: That humble being, who recognizes the One Lord alone, obtains honor in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: oh nav nidh paavai gurmat har dhiaavai nit har gun aakh vakhaanai ||
verses.translation: One who meditates on the Lord, through the Guru's Teachings, obtains the nine treasures; he chants and repeats continually the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਲੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: ahinis naam tisai kaa leejai har uootam purakh paradhaan jeeau ||
verses.translation: Day and night, take the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the most sublime Primal Being.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੈ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jin jagat upaiaa dha(n)dhai laiaa hau tisai viTahu kurabaan jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: The One who created the world and assigned all to their tasks - I am a sacrifice to Him. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਨਿ ਸਿ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਿਣਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam lain s soheh tin sukh fal hoveh maaneh se jin jaeh jeeau ||
verses.translation: Those who chant the Naam look beautiful; they obtain the fruit of peace. Those who believe in the Name win the game of life.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਫਲ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਜੇ ਜੁਗ ਕੇਤੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: tin fal toT na aavai jaa tis bhaavai je jug kete jaeh jeeau ||
verses.translation: Their blessings are not exhausted, if it pleases the Lord, even though numerous ages may pass.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਜੁਗ ਕੇਤੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਨ ਫਲ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: je jug kete jaeh suaamee tin fal toT na aavai ||
verses.translation: Even though numerous ages may pass, O Lord Master, their blessings are not exhausted.

verses.original: ਤਿਨੑ ਜਰਾ ਨ ਮਰਣਾ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਪਰਣਾ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: tin(h) jaraa na maranaa narak na paranaa jo har naam dhiaavai ||
verses.translation: They do not age, they do not die and fall into hell, if they meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਿ ਸੂਕਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੀੜ ਨ ਖਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har kareh s sookeh naahee naanak peeR na khaeh jeeau ||
verses.translation: Those who chant the Lord's Name, Har, Har, do not wither, O Nanak; they are not afflicted by pain.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਨਿੑ ਸਿ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਿਣਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
verses.translit: naam laini(h) s soheh tin(h) sukh fal hoveh maaneh se jin jaeh jeeau ||4||1||4||
verses.translation: Those who chant the Naam look beautiful; they obtain the fruit of peace. Those who believe in the Name win the game of life. ||4||1||4||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa chha(n)t ghar teejaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, First Mehla, Chhant, Third House:

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਣਾ ਕਾਲਿਆ ਕੀ ਵਾੜੀਐ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) sun haranaa kaaliaa kee vaaReeaai raataa raam ||
verses.translation: Listen, O black deer: why are you so attached to the orchard of passion?

verses.original: ਬਿਖੁ ਫਲੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿਨ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: bikh fal meeThaa chaar dhin fir hovai taataa raam ||
verses.translation: The fruit of sin is sweet for only a few days, and then it grows hot and bitter.

verses.original: ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਤਾਤਾ ਖਰਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਰਤਾਪਏ ॥
verses.translit: fir hoi taataa kharaa maataa naam bin parataape ||
verses.translation: That fruit which intoxicated you has now become bitter and painful, without the Naam.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਜੇਵ ਸਾਇਰ ਦੇਇ ਲਹਰੀ ਬਿਜੁਲ ਜਿਵੈ ਚਮਕਏ ॥
verses.translit: oh jev sair dhei laharee bijul jivai chamake ||
verses.translation: It is temporary, like the waves on the sea, and the flash of lightning.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਾਝੁ ਰਾਖਾ ਕੋਇ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੋਇ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: har baajh raakhaa koi naahee soi tujheh bisaariaa ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord, there is no other protector, but you have forgotten Him.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਚੇਤਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਰਹਿ ਹਰਣਾ ਕਾਲਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sach kahai naanak chet re man mareh haranaa kaaliaa ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak speaks the Truth. Reflect upon it, O mind; you shall die, O black deer. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਵਰਾ ਫੂਲਿ ਭਵੰਤਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: bhavaraa fool bhava(n)tiaa dhukh at bhaaree raam ||
verses.translation: O bumble bee, you wander among the flowers, but terrible pain awaits you.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਛਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: mai gur poochhiaa aapanaa saachaa beechaaree raam ||
verses.translation: I have asked my Guru for true understanding.

verses.original: ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੁਝੈ ਪੂਛਿਆ ਭਵਰੁ ਬੇਲੀ ਰਾਤਓ ॥
verses.translit: beechaar satigur mujhai poochhiaa bhavar belee raato ||
verses.translation: I have asked my True Guru for understanding about the bumble bee, who is so involved with the flowers of the garden.

verses.original: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਚੜਿਆ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪੜਿਆ ਤੇਲੁ ਤਾਵਣਿ ਤਾਤਓ ॥
verses.translit: sooraj chaRiaa pi(n)dd paRiaa tel taavan taato ||
verses.translation: When the sun rises, the body will fall, and it will be cooked in hot oil.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਮਗਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਖਾਹਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੇਤਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jam mag baadhaa khaeh choTaa sabadh bin betaaliaa ||
verses.translation: You shall be bound and beaten on the road of Death, without the Word of the Shabad, O madman.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਚੇਤਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਰਹਿ ਭਵਰਾ ਕਾਲਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sach kahai naanak chet re man mareh bhavaraa kaaliaa ||2||
verses.translation: Nanak speaks the Truth. Reflect upon it, O mind; you shall die, O bumble bee. ||2||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅੜਿਆ ਪਰਦੇਸੀਆ ਕਿਤੁ ਪਵਹਿ ਜੰਜਾਲੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: mere jeeaRiaa paradheseeaa kit paveh ja(n)jaale raam ||
verses.translation: O my stranger soul, why do you fall into entanglements?

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਹਿ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: saachaa saahib man vasai kee faaseh jam jaale raam ||
verses.translation: The True Lord abides within your mind; why are you trapped by the noose of Death?

verses.original: ਮਛੁਲੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀ ਨੈਣ ਰੁੰਨੀ ਜਾਲੁ ਬਧਿਕਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: machhulee vichhu(n)nee nain ru(n)nee jaal badhik paiaa ||
verses.translation: The fish leaves the water with tearful eyes, when the fisherman casts his net.

verses.original: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਅੰਤਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)saar maiaa moh meeThaa a(n)t bharam chukaiaa ||
verses.translation: The love of Maya is sweet to the world, but in the end, this delusion is dispelled.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਛੋਡਿ ਮਨਹੁ ਅੰਦੇਸਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat kar chit lai har siau chhodd manahu a(n)dhesiaa ||
verses.translation: So perform devotional worship, link your consciousness to the Lord, and dispel anxiety from your mind.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਚੇਤਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਜੀਅੜਿਆ ਪਰਦੇਸੀਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sach kahai naanak chet re man jeeaRiaa paradheseeaa ||3||
verses.translation: Nanak speaks the Truth; focus your consciousness on the Lord, O my stranger soul. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਦੀਆ ਵਾਹ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ਮੇਲਾ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: nadheeaa vaeh vichhu(n)niaa melaa sa(n)jogee raam ||
verses.translation: The rivers and streams which separate may sometime be united again.

verses.original: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਵਿਸੁ ਭਰੇ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: jug jug meeThaa vis bhare ko jaanai jogee raam ||
verses.translation: In age after age, that which is sweet, is full of poison; how rare is the Yogi who understands this.

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਸਹਜਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਨਿ ਚੇਤਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: koiee sahaj jaanai har pachhaanai satiguroo jin chetiaa ||
verses.translation: That rare person who centers his consciousness on the True Guru, knows intuitively and realizes the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਪਚਹਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਚੇਤਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: bin naam har ke bharam bhoole pacheh mugadh achetiaa ||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the thoughtless fools wander in doubt, and are ruined.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੇ ਅੰਤਿ ਧਾਹੀ ਰੁੰਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: har naam bhagat na ridhai saachaa se a(n)t dhaahee ru(n)niaa ||
verses.translation: Those whose hearts are not touched by devotional worship and the Name of the True Lord, shall weep and wail loudly in the end.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੫॥
verses.translit: sach kahai naanak sabadh saachai mel chiree vichhu(n)niaa ||4||1||5||
verses.translation: Nanak speaks the Truth; through the True Word of the Shabad, those long separated from the Lord, are united once again. ||4||1||5||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa teejaa chha(n)t ghar pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Third Mehla, Chhant, First House:

verses.original: ਹਮ ਘਰੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: ham ghare saachaa sohilaa saachai sabadh suhaiaa raam ||
verses.translation: Within my home, the true wedding songs of rejoicing are sung; my home is adorned with the True Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਮੇਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: dhan pir mel bhiaa prabh aap milaiaa raam ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride has met her Husband Lord; God Himself has consummated this union.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: prabh aap milaiaa sach ma(n)n vasaiaa kaaman sahaje maatee ||
verses.translation: God Himself has consummated this union; the soul-bride enshrines Truth within her mind, intoxicated with peaceful poise.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadh seegaaree sach savaaree sadhaa raave ra(n)g raatee ||
verses.translation: Embellished with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and beautified with Truth, she enjoys her Beloved forever, imbued with His Love.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਏ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aap gavaae har var paae taa har ras ma(n)n vasaiaa ||
verses.translation: Eradicating her ego, she obtains her Husband Lord, and then, the sublime essence of the Lord dwells within her mind.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਸਫਲਿਉ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak gur sabadh savaaree safaliau janam sabaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, fruitful and prosperous is her entire life; she is embellished with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

verses.original: ਦੂਜੜੈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojaRai kaaman bharam bhulee har var na paae raam ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride who has been led astray by duality and doubt, does not attain her Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: kaaman gun naahee birathaa janam gavaae raam ||
verses.translation: That soul-bride has no virtue, and she wastes her life in vain.

verses.original: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਇਆਣੀ ਅਉਗਣਵੰਤੀ ਝੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: birathaa janam gavaae manmukh iaanee aauganava(n)tee jhoore ||
verses.translation: The self-willed, ignorant and disgraceful manmukh wastes her life in vain, and in the end, she comes to grief.

verses.original: ਆਪਣਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਦੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aapanaa satigur sev sadhaa sukh paiaa taa pir miliaa hadhoore ||
verses.translation: But when she serves her True Guru, she obtains peace, and then she meets her Husband Lord, face to face.

verses.original: ਦੇਖਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਵਿਗਸੀ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਸਰਸੀ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhekh pir vigasee a(n)dharahu sarasee sachai sabadh subhaae ||
verses.translation: Beholding her Husband Lord, she blossoms forth; her heart is delighted, and she is beautified by the True Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak vin naavai kaaman bharam bhulaanee mil preetam sukh paae ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the Name, the soul-bride wanders around, deluded by doubt. Meeting her Beloved, she obtains peace. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਿਰੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: pir sa(n)g kaaman jaaniaa gur mel milaiee raam ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride knows that her Husband Lord is with her; the Guru unites her in this union.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar sabadh milee sahaje tapat bujhaiee raam ||
verses.translation: Within her heart, she is merged with the Shabad, and the fire of her desire is easily extinguished.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh tapat bujhaiee a(n)tar saa(n)t aaiee sahaje har ras chaakhiaa ||
verses.translation: The Shabad has quenched the fire of desire, and within her heart, peace and tranquility have come; she tastes the Lord's essence with intuitive ease.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਅਪਣੇ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੇ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: mil preetam apane sadhaa ra(n)g maane sachai sabadh subhaakhiaa ||
verses.translation: Meeting her Beloved, she enjoys His Love continually, and her speech rings with the True Shabad.

verses.original: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੋਨੀ ਥਾਕੇ ਭੇਖੀ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: paR paR pa(n)ddit monee thaake bhekhee mukat na paiee ||
verses.translation: Reading and studying continually, the Pandits, the religious scholars, and the silent sages have grown weary; wearing religious robes, liberation is not obtained.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak bin bhagatee jag bauraanaa sachai sabadh milaiee ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without devotional worship, the world has gone insane; through the True Word of the Shabad, one meets the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: saa dhan man anadh bhiaa har jeeau mel piaare raam ||
verses.translation: Bliss permeates the mind of the soul-bride, who meets her Beloved Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰਸਿ ਰਸੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: saa dhan har kai ras rasee gur kai sabadh apaare raam ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride is enraptured with the sublime essence of the Lord, through the incomparable Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh apaare mile piaare sadhaa gun saare man vase ||
verses.translation: Through the incomparable Word of the Guru's Shabad, she meets her Beloved; she continually contemplates and enshrines His Glorious Virtues in her mind.

verses.original: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਜਾ ਪਿਰਿ ਰਾਵੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਅਵਗਣ ਨਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: sej suhaavee jaa pir raavee mil preetam avagan nase ||
verses.translation: Her bed was adorned when she enjoyed her Husband Lord; meeting with her Beloved, her demerits were erased.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jit ghar naam har sadhaa dhiaaieeaai sohilaRaa jug chaare ||
verses.translation: That house, within which the Lord's Name is continually meditated upon, resounds with the wedding songs of rejoicing, throughout the four ages.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate sadhaa anadh hai har miliaa kaaraj saare ||4||1||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, we are in bliss forever; meeting the Lord, our affairs are resolved. ||4||1||6||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa teejaa chha(n)t ghar teejaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Third Mehla, Chhant, Third House:

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਸਹ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇਹੋ ॥
verses.translit: saajan mere preetamahu tum seh kee bhagat kareho ||
verses.translation: O my beloved friend, dedicate yourself to the devotional worship of your Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਲੇਹੋ ॥
verses.translit: gur sevahu sadhaa aapanaa naam padhaarath leho ||
verses.translation: Serve your Guru constantly, and obtain the wealth of the Naam.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਸਹੈ ਕੇਰੀ ਜੋ ਸਹ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat karahu tum sahai keree jo seh piaare bhaave ||
verses.translation: Dedicate yourself to the worship of your Husband Lord; this is pleasing to your Beloved Husband.

verses.original: ਆਪਣਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਤੁਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਤਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਸਹ ਖੁਸੀ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: aapanaa bhaanaa tum karahu taa fir seh khusee na aave ||
verses.translation: If you walk in accordance with your own will, then your Husband Lord will not be pleased with you.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਵ ਇਹੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਬਿਖੜਾ ਗੁਰ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਕੋ ਪਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat bhaav ih maarag bikhaRaa gur dhuaarai ko paave ||
verses.translation: This path of loving devotional worship is very difficult; how rare are those who find it, through the Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak jis kare kirapaa so har bhagatee chit laave ||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, that one, upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, links his consciousness to the worship of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਆ ਤੂੰ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: mere man bairaageeaa too(n) bairaag kar kis dhikhaaveh ||
verses.translation: O my detached mind, unto whom do you show your detachment?

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਤਿਨੑ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: har sohilaa tin(h) sadh sadhaa jo har gun gaaveh ||
verses.translation: Those who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord live in the joy of the Lord, forever and ever.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਤੂੰ ਛੋਡਿ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਏ ॥
verses.translit: kar bairaag too(n) chhodd paakha(n)dd so sahu sabh kichh jaane ||
verses.translation: So become detached, and renounce hypocrisy; Your Husband Lord knows everything.

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਏ ॥
verses.translit: jal thal maheeal eko soiee gurmukh hukam pachhaane ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is pervading the water, the land and the sky; the Gurmukh realizes the Command of His Will.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹਰੀ ਕੇਰਾ ਸੋਈ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: jin hukam pachhaataa haree keraa soiee sarab sukh paave ||
verses.translation: One who realizes the Lord's Command, obtains all peace and comforts.

verses.original: ਇਵ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੋ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: eiv kahai naanak so bairaagee anadhin har liv laave ||2||
verses.translation: Thus says Nanak: such a detached soul remains absorbed in the Lord's Love, day and night. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਧਾਵਦਾ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: jeh jeh man too(n) dhaavadhaa teh teh har terai naale ||
verses.translation: Wherever you wander, O my mind, the Lord is there with you.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਛੋਡੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: man siaanap chhoddeeaai gur kaa sabadh samaale ||
verses.translation: Renounce your cleverness, O my mind, and reflect upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਾਥਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: saath terai so sahu sadhaa hai ik khin har naam samaalahe ||
verses.translation: Your Husband Lord is always with you, if you remember the Lord's Name, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਪਾਪ ਕਟੇ ਅੰਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: janam janam ke tere paap kaTe a(n)t param padh paavahe ||
verses.translation: The sins of countless incarnations shall be washed away, and in the end, you shall obtain the supreme status.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਗੰਢੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: saache naal teraa ga(n)dd laagai gurmukh sadhaa samaale ||
verses.translation: You shall be linked to the True Lord, and as Gurmukh, remember Him forever.

verses.original: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਹ ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਧਾਵਦਾ ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: eiau kahai naanak jeh man too(n) dhaavadhaa teh har terai sadhaa naale ||3||
verses.translation: Thus says Nanak: wherever you go, O my mind, the Lord is there with you. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਥੰਮਿੑਆ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaai dhaavat tha(n)mi(h)aa nij ghar vasiaa aae ||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, the wandering mind is held steady; it comes to abide in its own home.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਹਾਝੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: naam vihaajhe naam le naam rahe samaae ||
verses.translation: It purchases the Naam, chants the Naam, and remains absorbed in the Naam.

verses.original: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਥੰਮਿੑਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਦਸਵਾ ਦੁਆਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhaavat tha(n)mi(h)aa satigur miliaai dhasavaa dhuaar paiaa ||
verses.translation: The outgoing, wandering soul, upon meeting the True Guru, opens the Tenth Gate.

verses.original: ਤਿਥੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਥੰਮਿੑ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tithai a(n)mirat bhojan sahaj dhun upajai jit sabadh jagat tha(n)mi(h) rahaiaa ||
verses.translation: There, Ambrosial Nectar is food and the celestial music resounds; the world is held spell-bound by the music of the Word.

verses.original: ਤਹ ਅਨੇਕ ਵਾਜੇ ਸਦਾ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: teh anek vaaje sadhaa anadh hai sache rahiaa samaae ||
verses.translation: The many strains of the unstruck melody resound there, as one merges in Truth.

verses.original: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਥੰਮਿੑਆ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਆਏ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: eiau kahai naanak satigur miliaai dhaavat tha(n)mi(h)aa nij ghar vasiaa aae ||4||
verses.translation: Thus says Nanak: by meeting the True Guru, the wandering soul becomes steady, and comes to dwell in the home of its own self. ||4||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਹੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: man too(n) jot saroop hai aapanaa mool pachhaan ||
verses.translation: O my mind, you are the embodiment of the Divine Light - recognize your own origin.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: man har jee terai naal hai gurmatee ra(n)g maan ||
verses.translation: O my mind, the Dear Lord is with you; through the Guru's Teachings, enjoy His Love.

verses.original: ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਤਾਂ ਸਹੁ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਮਰਣ ਜੀਵਣ ਕੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: mool pachhaaneh taa(n) sahu jaaneh maran jeevan kee sojhee hoiee ||
verses.translation: Acknowledge your origin, and then you shall know your Husband Lord, and so understand death and birth.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਤਾਂ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee eko jaaneh taa(n) dhoojaa bhaau na hoiee ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, know the One; then, you shall not love any other.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ਵਜੀ ਵਧਾਈ ਤਾ ਹੋਆ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: man saa(n)t aaiee vajee vadhaiee taa hoaa paravaan ||
verses.translation: Peace comes to the mind, and gladness resounds; then, you shall be acclaimed.

verses.original: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਹੈ ਅਪਣਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: eiau kahai naanak man too(n) jot saroop hai apanaa mool pachhaan ||5||
verses.translation: Thus says Nanak: O my mind, you are the very image of the Luminous Lord; recognize the true origin of your self. ||5||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਗਾਰਬਿ ਅਟਿਆ ਗਾਰਬਿ ਲਦਿਆ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: man too(n) gaarab aTiaa gaarab ladhiaa jaeh ||
verses.translation: O mind, you are so full of pride; loaded with pride, you shall depart.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਭਵਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa mohanee mohiaa fir fir joonee bhavaeh ||
verses.translation: The fascinating Maya has fascinated you, over and over again, and lured you into reincarnation.

verses.original: ਗਾਰਬਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਾਹਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaarab laagaa jaeh mugadh man a(n)t giaa pachhutaavahe ||
verses.translation: Clinging to pride, you shall depart, O foolish mind, and in the end, you shall regret and repent.

verses.original: ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਲਗਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: aha(n)kaar tisanaa rog lagaa birathaa janam gavaavahe ||
verses.translation: You are afflicted with the diseases of ego and desire, and you are wasting your life away in vain.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਗੈ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh mugadh cheteh naahee agai giaa pachhutaavahe ||
verses.translation: The foolish self-willed manmukh does not remember the Lord, and shall regret and repent hereafter.

verses.original: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਗਾਰਬਿ ਅਟਿਆ ਗਾਰਬਿ ਲਦਿਆ ਜਾਵਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: eiau kahai naanak man too(n) gaarab aTiaa gaarab ladhiaa jaavahe ||6||
verses.translation: Thus says Nanak: O mind, you are full of pride; loaded with pride, you shall depart. ||6||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਮਤ ਮਾਣੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿ ਹਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ਹੋਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: man too(n) mat maan kareh j hau kichh jaanadhaa gurmukh nimaanaa hoh ||
verses.translation: O mind, don't be so proud of yourself, as if you know it all; the Gurmukh is humble and modest.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਹਉ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar agiaan hau budh hai sach sabadh mal khoh ||
verses.translation: Within the intellect are ignorance and ego; through the True Word of the Shabad, this filth is washed off.

verses.original: ਹੋਹੁ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਅਗੈ ਮਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੁ ਲਖਾਵਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: hoh nimaanaa satiguroo agai mat kichh aap lakhaavahe ||
verses.translation: So be humble, and surrender to the True Guru; do not attach your identity to your ego.

verses.original: ਆਪਣੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਜਲਿਆ ਮਤ ਤੂੰ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਵਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: aapanai aha(n)kaar jagat jaliaa mat too(n) aapanaa aap gavaavahe ||
verses.translation: The world is consumed by ego and self-identity; see this, lest you lose your own self as well.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਾਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kai bhaanai kareh kaar satigur kai bhaanai laag rahu ||
verses.translation: Make yourself follow the Sweet Will of the True Guru; remain attached to His Sweet Will.

verses.original: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਪੁ ਛਡਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਨ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: eiau kahai naanak aap chhadd sukh paaveh man nimaanaa hoi rahu ||7||
verses.translation: Thus says Nanak: renounce your ego and self-conceit, and obtain peace; let your mind abide in humility. ||7||

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)nu su velaa jit mai satigur miliaa so sahu chit aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Blessed is that time, when I met the True Guru, and my Husband Lord came into my consciousness.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa ana(n)dh sahaj bhiaa man tan sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: I became so very blissful, and my mind and body found such a natural peace.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਇਆ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਅਵਗਣ ਸਭਿ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: so sahu chit aaiaa ma(n)n vasaiaa avagan sabh visaare ||
verses.translation: My Husband Lord came into my consciousness; I enshrined Him within my mind, and I renounced all vice.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਟ ਹੋਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa tis bhaanaa gun paragaT hoe satigur aap savaare ||
verses.translation: When it pleased Him, virtues appeared in me, and the True Guru Himself adorned me.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੋਏ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਿਆ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਾਉ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: se jan paravaan hoe jin(h)ee ik naam dhiRiaa dhuteeaa bhaau chukaiaa ||
verses.translation: Those humble beings become acceptable, who cling to the One Name and renounce the love of duality.

verses.original: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: eiau kahai naanak dha(n)nu su velaa jit mai satigur miliaa so sahu chit aaiaa ||8||
verses.translation: Thus says Nanak: blessed is the time when I met the True Guru, and my Husband Lord came into my consciousness. ||8||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਜੰਤ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: eik ja(n)t bharam bhule tin seh aap bhulaae ||
verses.translation: Some people wander around, deluded by doubt; their Husband Lord Himself has misled them.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai fireh haumai karam kamaae ||
verses.translation: They wander around in the love of duality, and they do their deeds in ego.

verses.original: ਤਿਨਿ ਸਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਕੁਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tin seh aap bhulaae kumaarag paae tin kaa kichh na vasaiee ||
verses.translation: Their Husband Lord Himself has misled them, and put them on the path of evil. Nothing lies in their power.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਅਵਗਤਿ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹ ਰਚਨ ਰਚਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tin kee gat avagat too(n)hai jaaneh jin ieh rachan rachaiee ||
verses.translation: You alone know their ups and downs, You, who created the creation.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਖਰਾ ਭਾਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: hukam teraa kharaa bhaaraa gurmukh kisai bujhaae ||
verses.translation: The Command of Your Will is very strict; how rare is the Gurmukh who understands.

verses.original: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਿਆ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: eiau kahai naanak kiaa ja(n)t vichaare jaa tudh bharam bhulaae ||9||
verses.translation: Thus says Nanak: what can the poor creatures do, when You mislead them into doubt? ||9||

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਸਚੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: sache mere saahibaa sachee teree vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: O My True Lord Master, True is Your glorious greatness.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) paarabraham bea(n)t suaamee teree kudharat kahan na jaiee ||
verses.translation: You are the Supreme Lord God, the Infinite Lord and Master. Your creative power cannot be described.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: sachee teree vaddiaaiee jaa kau tudh ma(n)n vasaiee sadhaa tere gun gaavahe ||
verses.translation: True is Your glorious greatness; when You enshrine it within the mind, one sings Your Glorious Praises forever.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: tere gun gaaveh jaa tudh bhaaveh sache siau chit laavahe ||
verses.translation: He sings Your Glorious Praises, when it is pleasing to You, O True Lord; he centers his consciousness on You.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jis no too(n) aape meleh su gurmukh rahai samaiee ||
verses.translation: One whom You unite with Yourself, as Gurmukh, remains absorbed in You.

verses.original: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਚੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਸਚੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧੦॥੨॥੭॥੫॥੨॥੭॥
verses.translit: eiau kahai naanak sache mere saahibaa sachee teree vaddiaaiee ||10||2||7||5||2||7||
verses.translation: Thus says Nanak: O my True Lord Master, True is Your Glorious Greatness. ||10||2||7||5||2||7||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: raag aasaa chha(n)t mahalaa chauthhaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Raag Aasaa, Chhant, Fourth Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜੀਵਨੋ ਮੈ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: jeevano mai jeevan paiaa gurmukh bhaae raam ||
verses.translation: Life - I have found real life, as Gurmukh, through His Love.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: har naamo har naam dhevai merai praan vasaae raam ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name - He has given me the Lord's Name, and enshrined it within my breath of life.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam merai praan vasaae sabh sa(n)saa dhookh gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: He has enshrined the Name of the Lord, Har, Har within my breath of lfe, and all my doubts and sorrows have departed.

verses.original: ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: adhisaT agochar gur bachan dhiaaiaa pavitr param padh paiaa ||
verses.translation: I have meditated on the invisible and unapproachable Lord, through the Guru's Word, and I have obtained the pure, supreme status.

verses.original: ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਵਾਜੇ ਗਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: anahadh dhun vaajeh nit vaaje gaiee satigur baanee ||
verses.translation: The unstruck melody resounds, and the instruments ever vibrate, singing the Bani of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦਾਤੈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaat karee prabh dhaatai jotee jot samaanee ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, God the Great Giver has given me a gift; He has blended my light into the Light. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਏ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: manmukhaa manmukh mue meree kar maiaa raam ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs die in their self-willed stubbornness, declaring that the wealth of Maya is theirs.

verses.original: ਖਿਨੁ ਆਵੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਜਾਵੈ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਮੜੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: khin aavai khin jaavai dhuraga(n)dh maRai chit laiaa raam ||
verses.translation: They attach their consciousness to the foul-smelling pile of filth, which comes for a moment, and departs in an instant.

verses.original: ਲਾਇਆ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਮੜੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: laiaa dhuraga(n)dh maRai chit laagaa jiau ra(n)g kasu(n)bh dhikhaiaa ||
verses.translation: They attach their consciousness to the foul-smelling pile of filth, which is transitory, like the fading color of the safflower.

verses.original: ਖਿਨੁ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਛਮਿ ਛਾਏ ਜਿਉ ਚਕੁ ਕੁਮਿੑਆਰਿ ਭਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: khin poorab khin pachham chhaae jiau chak kumi(h)aar bhavaiaa ||
verses.translation: One moment, they are facing east, and the next instant, they are facing west; they continue spinning around, like the potter's wheel.

verses.original: ਦੁਖੁ ਖਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੰਚਹਿ ਭੋਗਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਵਧਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh khaaveh dhukh sa(n)cheh bhogeh dhukh kee biradh vadhaiee ||
verses.translation: In sorrow, they eat, and in sorrow, they gather things and try to enjoy them, but they only increase their stores of sorrow.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਤਰੀਐ ਜਾ ਆਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak bikham suhelaa tareeaai jaa aavai gur saranaiee ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one easily crosses over the terrifying world-ocean, when he comes to the Sanctuary of the Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: meraa Thaakuro Thaakur neekaa agam athaahaa raam ||
verses.translation: My Lord, my Lord Master is sublime, unapproachable and unfathomable.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜੀ ਚਾਹੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: har poojee har poojee chaahee mere satigur saahaa raam ||
verses.translation: The wealth of the Lord - I seek the wealth of the Lord, from my True Guru, the Divine Banker.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜੀ ਚਾਹੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਹੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: har poojee chaahee naam bisaahee gun gaavai gun bhaavai ||
verses.translation: I seek the wealth of the Lord, to purchase the Naam; I sing and love the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨੀਦ ਭੂਖ ਸਭ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਸੁੰਨੇ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: needh bhookh sabh parahar tiaagee su(n)ne su(n)n samaavai ||
verses.translation: I have totally renounced sleep and hunger, and through deep meditation, I am absorbed into the Absolute Lord.

verses.original: ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਇਕ ਭਾਤੀ ਆਵਹਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: vanajaare ik bhaatee aaveh laahaa har naam lai jaahe ||
verses.translation: The traders of one kind come and take away the Name of the Lord as their profit.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak man tan arap gur aagai jis praapat so paae ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, dedicate your mind and body to the Guru; one who is so destined, attains it. ||3||

verses.original: ਰਤਨਾ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: ratanaa ratan padhaarath bahu saagar bhariaa raam ||
verses.translation: The great ocean is full of the treasures of jewels upon jewels.

verses.original: ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਹਥਿ ਚੜਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: baanee gurbaanee laage tin(h) hath chaRiaa raam ||
verses.translation: They come into the hands of those who are immersed in the Word of the Guru's Bani.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਹਥਿ ਚੜਿਆ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurbaanee laage tin(h) hath chaRiaa niramolak ratan apaaraa ||
verses.translation: This priceless, incomparable jewel comes into the hands of those who are committed to the Word of the Guru's Bani.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਤੋਲਕੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam atolak paiaa teree bhagat bhare bha(n)ddaaraa ||
verses.translation: They obtain the immeasurable Name of the Lord, Har, Har; their treasure is overflowing with devotional worship.

verses.original: ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਵਿਰੋਲਿ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹਮ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਇਕ ਵਸਤੁ ਅਨੂਪ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: samu(n)dh virol sareer ham dhekhiaa ik vasat anoop dhikhaiee ||
verses.translation: I have churned the ocean of the body, and I have seen the incomparable thing come into view.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੋੁਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੮॥
verses.translit: gur govi(n)dh guovi(n)dh guroo hai naanak bhedh na bhaiee ||4||1||8||
verses.translation: The Guru is God, and God is the Guru, O Nanak; there is no difference between the two, O Siblings of Destiny. ||4||1||8||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਝਿਮਿ ਝਿਮੇ ਝਿਮਿ ਝਿਮਿ ਵਰਸੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: jhim jhime jhim jhim varasai a(n)mirat dhaaraa raam ||
verses.translation: Slowly, slowly, slowly, very slowly, the drops of Ambrosial Nectar trickle down.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukhe gurmukh nadharee raam piaaraa raam ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, the Gurmukh beholds the Lord, the Beloved Lord.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜਗਤ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam piaaraa jagat nisataaraa raam naam vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, the Emancipator of the world, is dear to him; the Name of the Lord is his glory.

verses.original: ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲਘਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kalijug raam naam bohithaa gurmukh paar laghaiee ||
verses.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord's Name is the boat, which carries the Gurmukh across.

verses.original: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: halat palat raam naam suhele gurmukh karanee saaree ||
verses.translation: This world, and the world hereafter, are adorned with the Lord's Name; the Gurmukh's lifestyle is the most excellent.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਤਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaat dhiaa kar dhevai raam naam nisataaree ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, bestowing His kindness, the Lord gives the gift of His emancipating Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਆ ਦੁਖ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਨਾਸ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: raamo raam naam japiaa dhukh kilavikh naas gavaiaa raam ||
verses.translation: I chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, which destroys my sorrows and erases my sins.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਮੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: gur parachai gur parachai dhiaaiaa mai hiradhai raam ravaiaa raam ||
verses.translation: Associating with the Guru, associating with the Guru, I practice meditation; I have enshrined the Lord within my heart.

verses.original: ਰਵਿਆ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਜਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: raviaa raam hiradhai param gat paiee jaa gur saranaiee aae ||
verses.translation: I enshrined the Lord within my heart, and obtained the supreme status, when I came to the Sanctuary of the Guru.

verses.original: ਲੋਭ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਨਾਵ ਡੁਬਦੀ ਨਿਕਲੀ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: lobh vikaar naav ddubadhee nikalee jaa satigur naam dhiRaae ||
verses.translation: My boat was sinking under the weight of greed and corruption, but it was uplifted when the True Guru implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jeea dhaan gur poorai dheeaa raam naam chit laae ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has given me the gift of spiritual life, and I center my consciousness on the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aap kirapaal kirapaa kar dhevai naanak gur saranaae ||2||
verses.translation: The Merciful Lord Himself has mercifully given this gift to me; O Nanak, I take to the Sanctuary of the Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਣੀ ਸਿਧਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: baanee raam naam sunee sidh kaaraj sabh suhaae raam ||
verses.translation: Hearing the Bani of the Lord's Name, all my affairs were brought to perfection and embellished.

verses.original: ਰੋਮੇ ਰੋਮਿ ਰੋਮਿ ਰੋਮੇ ਮੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: rome rom rom rome mai gurmukh raam dhiaae raam ||
verses.translation: With each and every hair, with each and every hair, as Gurmukh, I meditate on the Lord.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਆਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਕਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam dhiaae pavit hoi aae tis roop na rekhiaa kaiee ||
verses.translation: I meditate on the Lord's Name, and become pure; He has no form or shape.

verses.original: ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਭ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੂਖ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: raamo raam raviaa ghaT a(n)tar sabh tirasanaa bhookh gavaiee ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, is permeating my heart deep within, and all of my desire and hunger has disappeared.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: man tan seetal seegaar sabh hoaa gurmat raam pragaasaa ||
verses.translation: My mind and body are totally adorned with peace and tranquility; through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord has been revealed to me.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਹਮ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak aap anugrahu keeaa ham dhaasan dhaasan dhaasaa ||3||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself has shown His kind mercy to Nanak; He has made me the slave of the slaves of His slaves. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂੜ ਅਭਾਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: jinee raamo raam naam visaariaa se manmukh mooR abhaagee raam ||
verses.translation: Those who forget the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, are foolish, unfortunate, self-willed manmukhs.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰੇ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਲਾਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: tin a(n)tare moh viaapai khin khin maiaa laagee raam ||
verses.translation: Within, they are engrossed in emotional attachment; each and every moment, Maya clings to them.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਮੂੜ ਭਏ ਅਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਹ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa mal laagee mooR bhe abhaagee jin raam naam neh bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The filth of Maya clings to them, and they become unfortunate fools - they do not love the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਅਨੇਕ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੋਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: anek karam kareh abhimaanee har raamo naam choraiaa ||
verses.translation: The egotistical and proud perform all sorts of rituals, but they shy away from the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਜਮ ਪੰਥੁ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ਕਾਲੂਖਤ ਮੋਹ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa bikham jam pa(n)th dhuhelaa kaalookhat moh a(n)dhiaaraa ||
verses.translation: The path of Death is very arduous and painful; it is stained with the darkness of emotional attachment.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਾ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh naam dhiaaiaa taa paae mokh dhuaaraa ||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh meditates on the Naam, and finds the gate of salvation. ||4||

verses.original: ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਰਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: raamo raam naam guroo raam gurmukhe jaanai raam ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, and the Lord Guru, are known by the Gurmukh.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਖਿਨੁ ਊਭ ਪਇਆਲੀ ਭਰਮਦਾ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਣੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: eih manooaa khin uoobh piaalee bharamadhaa ikat ghar aanai raam ||
verses.translation: One moment, this mind is in the heavens, and the next, it is in the nether regions; the Guru brings the wandering mind back to one-pointedness.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਣੈ ਸਭ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: man ikat ghar aanai sabh gat mit jaanai har raamo naam rasaae ||
verses.translation: When the mind returns to one-pointedness, one totally understands the value of salvation, and enjoys the subtle essence of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਉਧਾਰਿ ਤਰਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jan kee paij rakhai raam naamaa prahilaadh udhaar taraae ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name preserves the honor of His servant, as He preserved and emancipated Prahlaad.

verses.original: ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਮੋ ਰਮੁ ਊਚਾ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਤਿਆ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: raamo raam ramo ram uoochaa gun kahatiaa a(n)t na paiaa ||
verses.translation: So repeat continually the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam; chanting His Glorious Virtues, His limit cannot be found.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਭੀਨੇ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak raam naam sun bheene raamai naam samaiaa ||5||
verses.translation: Nanak is drenched in happiness, hearing the Name of the Lord; he is merged in the Name of the Lord. ||5||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਨ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਸਭ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: jin a(n)tare raam naam vasai tin chi(n)taa sabh gavaiaa raam ||
verses.translation: Those beings, whose minds are filled with the Lord's Name, forsake all anxiety.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਅਰਥਾ ਸਭਿ ਧਰਮ ਮਿਲੇ ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sabh arathaa sabh dharam mile man chi(n)dhiaa so fal paiaa raam ||
verses.translation: They obtain all wealth, and all Dharmic faith, and the fruits of their minds' desires.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: man chi(n)dhiaa fal paiaa raam naam dhiaaiaa raam naam gun gaae ||
verses.translation: They obtain the fruits of their hearts' desires, meditating on the Lord's Name, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਬੁਧਿ ਗਈ ਸੁਧਿ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhuramat kabudh giee sudh hoiee raam naam man laae ||
verses.translation: Evil-mindedness and duality depart, and their understanding is enlightened. They attach their minds to the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: safal janam sareer sabh hoaa jit raam naam paragaasiaa ||
verses.translation: Their lives and bodies become totally blessed and fruitful; the Lord's Name illumines them.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਿਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak har bhaj sadhaa dhin raatee gurmukh nij ghar vaasiaa ||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by continually vibrating upon the Lord, day and night, the Gurmukhs abide in the home of the inner self. ||6||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਸਰਧਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਦੂਜੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: jin saradhaa raam naam lagee tin(h) dhoojai chit na laiaa raam ||
verses.translation: Those who place their faith in the Lord's Name, do not attach their consciousness to another.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਭ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: je dharatee sabh ka(n)chan kar dheejai bin naavai avar na bhaiaa raam ||
verses.translation: Even if the entire earth were to be transformed into gold, and given to them, without the Naam, they love nothing else.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅੰਤਿ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam man bhaiaa param sukh paiaa a(n)t chaladhiaa naal sakhaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is pleasing to their minds, and they obtain supreme peace; when they depart in the end, it shall go with them as their support.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸੰਚੀ ਨਾ ਡੂਬੈ ਨਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam dhan poo(n)jee sa(n)chee naa ddoobai naa jaiee ||
verses.translation: I have gathered the capital, the wealth of the Lord's Name; it does not sink, and does not depart.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam is jug meh tulahaa jamakaal neR na aavai ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is the only true support in this age; the Messenger of Death does not draw near it.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh raam pachhaataa kar kirapaa aap milaavai ||7||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs recognize the Lord; in His Mercy, He unites them with Himself. ||7||

verses.original: ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤੇ ਸਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: raamo raam naam sate sat gurmukh jaaniaa raam ||
verses.translation: True, True is the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam; the Gurmukh knows the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕੋ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਚੜਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sevako gur sevaa laagaa jin man tan arap chaRaiaa raam ||
verses.translation: The Lord's servant is the one who commits himself to the Guru's service, and dedicates his mind and body as an offering to Him.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿਆ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਰਧਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਕ ਭਾਇ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: man tan arapiaa bahut man saradhiaa gur sevak bhai milaae ||
verses.translation: He dedicates his mind and body to Him, placing great faith in Him; the Guru lovingly unites His servant with Himself.

verses.original: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥੁ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: dheenaa naath jeeaa kaa dhaataa poore gur te paae ||
verses.translation: The Master of the meek, the Giver of souls, is obtained through the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੂ ਸਿਖੁ ਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਏਕੋ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਚਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: guroo sikh sikh guroo hai eko gur upadhes chalaae ||
verses.translation: The Guru's Sikh, and the Sikh's Guru, are one and the same; both spread the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਮੰਤੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੮॥੨॥੯॥
verses.translit: raam naam ma(n)t hiradhai dhevai naanak milan subhaae ||8||2||9||
verses.translation: The Mantra of the Lord's Name is enshrined within the heart, O Nanak, and we merge with the Lord so easily. ||8||2||9||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa chha(n)t mahalaa chauthhaa ghar doojaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Chhant, Fourth Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har karataa dhookh binaasan patit paavan har naam jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Creator Lord, Har, Har, is the Destroyer of distress; the Name of the Lord is the Purifier of sinners.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਾਈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har sevaa bhaiee param gat paiee har uootam har har kaam jeeau ||
verses.translation: One who lovingly serves the Lord, obtains the supreme status. Service to the Lord, Har, Har, is more exalted than anything.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਕਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: har uootam kaam japeeaai har naam har japeeaai asathir hovai ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord is the most exalted occupation; chanting the Name of the Lord, one becomes immortal.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੋਵੈ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran dhovai dhukh meTe sahaje hee sukh sovai ||
verses.translation: The pains of both birth and death are eradicated, and one comes to sleep in peaceful ease.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har kirapaa dhaarahu Thaakur har japeeaai aatam raam jeeau ||
verses.translation: O Lord, O Lord and Master, shower Your Mercy upon me; within my mind, I chant the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har har karataa dhookh binaasan patit paavan har naam jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: The Creator Lord, Har, Har, is the Destroyer of distress; the Name of the Lord is the Purifier of sinners. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har naam padhaarath kalijug uootam har japeeaai satigur bhai jeeau ||
verses.translation: The wealth of the Lord's Name is the most exalted in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; chant the Lord's Name according to the Way of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੜੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਣਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh har paReeaai gurmukh har suneeaai har japat sunat dhukh jai jeeau ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, read of the Lord; as Gurmukh, hear of the Lord. Chanting and listening to the Lord's Name, pain departs.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਨਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam japiaa dhukh binasiaa har naam param sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, pains are removed. Through the Name of the Lord, supreme peace is obtained.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬਲਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur giaan baliaa ghaT chaanan agiaan a(n)dher gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: The spiritual wisdom of the True Guru illumines the heart; this Light dispels the darkness of spiritual ignorance.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨੀ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam tinee aaraadhiaa jin masatak dhur likh pai jeeau ||
verses.translation: They alone meditate on the Lord's Name, Har, Har, upon whose foreheads such destiny is written.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har naam padhaarath kalijug uootam har japeeaai satigur bhai jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: The wealth of the Lord's Name is the most exalted in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; chant the Lord's Name according to the Way of the True Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har man bhaiaa param sukh paiaa har laahaa padh nirabaan jeeau ||
verses.translation: One whose mind loves the Lord, Har, Har, obtains supreme peace. He reaps the profit of the Lord's Name, the state of Nirvaanaa.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਚੂਕਾ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har preet lagaiee har naam sakhaiee bhram chookaa aavan jaan jeeau ||
verses.translation: He embraces love for the Lord, and the Lord's Name becomes his companion. His doubts, and his comings and goings are ended.

verses.original: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aavan jaanaa bhram bhau bhaagaa har har har gun gaiaa ||
verses.translation: His comings and goings, doubts and fears come to an end, and he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਉਤਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: janam janam ke kilavikh dhukh utare har har naam samaiaa ||
verses.translation: The sins and pains of countless incarnations are washed away, and he merges into the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਭਾਗ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin har dhiaaiaa dhur bhaag likh paiaa tin safal janam paravaan jeeau ||
verses.translation: Those who are blessed by such pre-ordained destiny, meditate on the Lord, and their lives become fruitful and approved.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har har man bhaiaa param sukh paiaa har laahaa padh nirabaan jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: One whose mind loves the Lord, Har, Har, obtains supreme peace. He reaps the profit of the Lord's Name, the state of Nirvaanaa. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ ਤੇ ਊਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੋਗ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h) har meeTh lagaanaa te jan paradhaanaa te uootam har har log jeeau ||
verses.translation: Celebrated are those people, unto whom the Lord seems sweet; how exalted are those people of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har naam vaddaiee har naam sakhaiee gur sabadhee har ras bhog jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is their glorious greatness; the Lord's Name is their companion and helper. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they enjoy the sublime essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਮਹਾ ਨਿਰਜੋਗ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har ras bhog mahaa nirajog vaddabhaagee har ras paiaa ||
verses.translation: They enjoy the sublime essence of the Lord, and remain totally detached. By great good fortune, they obtain the sublime essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਵਡੇ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: se dha(n)n vadde sat purakhaa poore jin gurmat naam dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: So very blessed and truly perfect are those, who through Guru's Instruction meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਰੇਣੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਪਗ ਸਾਧੂ ਮਨਿ ਚੂਕਾ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jan naanak ren ma(n)gai pag saadhoo man chookaa sog vijog jeeau ||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of the Holy; his mind is rid of sorrow and separation.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ ਤੇ ਊਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੋਗ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: jin(h) har meeTh lagaanaa te jan paradhaanaa te uootam har har log jeeau ||4||3||10||
verses.translation: Celebrated are those people, unto whom the Lord seems sweet; how exalted are those people of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||3||10||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਸਰੀਰਾ ਪਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਧਰਮੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: satajug sabh sa(n)tokh sareeraa pag chaare dharam dhiaan jeeau ||
verses.translation: In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, everyone embodied contentment and meditation; religion stood upon four feet.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: man tan har gaaveh param sukh paaveh har hiradhai har gun giaan jeeau ||
verses.translation: With mind and body, they sang of the Lord, and attained supreme peace. In their hearts was the spiritual wisdom of the Lord's Glorious Virtues.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਤਾਰਥੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: gun giaan padhaarath har har kirataarath sobhaa gurmukh hoiee ||
verses.translation: Their wealth was the spiritual wisdom of the Lord's Glorious Virtues; the Lord was their success, and to live as Gurmukh was their glory.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar baahar har prabh eko dhoojaa avar na koiee ||
verses.translation: Inwardly and outwardly, they saw only the One Lord God; for them there was no other second.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har liv laiee har naam sakhaiee har dharageh paavai maan jeeau ||
verses.translation: They centered their consciousness lovingly on the Lord, Har, Har. The Lord's Name was their companion, and in the Court of the Lord, they obtained honor.

verses.original: ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਸਰੀਰਾ ਪਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਧਰਮੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: satajug sabh sa(n)tokh sareeraa pag chaare dharam dhiaan jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, everyone embodied contentment and meditation; religion stood upon four feet. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੇਤਾ ਜੁਗੁ ਆਇਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਤੁ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: tetaa jug aaiaa a(n)tar jor paiaa jat sa(n)jam karam kamai jeeau ||
verses.translation: Then came the Silver Age of Trayta Yuga; men's minds were ruled by power, and they practiced celibacy and self-discipline.

verses.original: ਪਗੁ ਚਉਥਾ ਖਿਸਿਆ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਪਗ ਟਿਕਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਜਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: pag chauthaa khisiaa trai pag Tikiaa man hiradhai karodh jalai jeeau ||
verses.translation: The fourth foot of religion dropped off, and three remained. Their hearts and minds were inflamed with anger.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਸਲੋਧੁ ਨਿਰਪ ਧਾਵਹਿ ਲੜਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: man hiradhai karodh mahaa bisalodh nirap dhaaveh laR dhukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Their hearts and minds were filled with the horribly poisonous essence of anger. The kings fought their wars and obtained only pain.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਮਤਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਲਗਾਨਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar mamataa rog lagaanaa haumai aha(n)kaar vadhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Their minds were afflicted with the illness of egotism, and their self-conceit and arrogance increased.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har kirapaa dhaaree merai Thaakur bikh gurmat har naam leh jai jeeau ||
verses.translation: If my Lord, Har, Har, shows His Mercy, my Lord and Master eradicates the poison by the Guru's Teachings and the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਤੇਤਾ ਜੁਗੁ ਆਇਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਤੁ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tetaa jug aaiaa a(n)tar jor paiaa jat sa(n)jam karam kamai jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: Then came the Silver Age of Trayta Yuga; men's minds were ruled by power, and they practiced celibacy and self-discipline. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੁਗੁ ਦੁਆਪੁਰੁ ਆਇਆ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਪੀ ਕਾਨੑੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jug dhuaapur aaiaa bharam bharamaiaa har gopee kaan(h) upai jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Brass Age of Dwaapar Yuga came, and people wandered in doubt. The Lord created the Gopis and Krishna.

verses.original: ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪਨ ਤਾਪਹਿ ਜਗ ਪੁੰਨ ਆਰੰਭਹਿ ਅਤਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: tap taapan taapeh jag pu(n)n aara(n)bheh at kiriaa karam kamai jeeau ||
verses.translation: The penitents practiced penance, they offered sacred feasts and charity, and performed many rituals and religious rites.

verses.original: ਕਿਰਿਆ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਆ ਪਗ ਦੁਇ ਖਿਸਕਾਇਆ ਦੁਇ ਪਗ ਟਿਕੈ ਟਿਕਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: kiriaa karam kamaiaa pag dhui khisakaiaa dhui pag Tikai Tikai jeeau ||
verses.translation: They performed many rituals and religious rites; two legs of religion dropped away, and only two legs remained.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਜੁਧ ਜੋਧ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੑੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa judh jodh bahu keen(h)e vich haumai pachai pachai jeeau ||
verses.translation: So many heroes waged great wars; in their egos they were ruined, and they ruined others as well.

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਲੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal gur saadh milaiaa mil satigur mal leh jai jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Lord, Compassionate to the poor, led them to meet the Holy Guru. Meeting the True Guru, their filth is washed away.

verses.original: ਜੁਗੁ ਦੁਆਪੁਰੁ ਆਇਆ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਪੀ ਕਾਨੑੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jug dhuaapur aaiaa bharam bharamaiaa har gopee kaan(h) upai jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: The Brass Age of Dwaapar Yuga came, and the people wandered in doubt. The Lord created the Gopis and Krishna. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਲਿਜੁਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਪਗ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਖਿਸਕੀਆ ਪਗੁ ਚਉਥਾ ਟਿਕੈ ਟਿਕਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: kalijug har keeaa pag trai khisakeeaa pag chauthaa Tikai Tikai jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Lord ushered in the Dark Age, the Iron Age of Kali Yuga; three legs of religion were lost, and only the fourth leg remained intact.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadh kamaiaa aaukhadh har paiaa har keerat har saa(n)t pai jeeau ||
verses.translation: Acting in accordance with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the medicine of the Lord's Name is obtained. Singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, divine peace is obtained.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਰੁਤਿ ਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਖੇਤੁ ਜਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har keerat rut aaiee har naam vaddaiee har har naam khet jamaiaa ||
verses.translation: The season of singing the Lord's Praise has arrived; the Lord's Name is glorified, and the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, grows in the field of the body.

verses.original: ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਬੀਜੁ ਬੀਜੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kalijug beej beeje bin naavai sabh laahaa mool gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, if one plants any other seed than the Name, all profit and capital is lost.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਖਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jan naanak gur pooraa paiaa man hiradhai naam lakhai jeeau ||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has found the Perfect Guru, who has revealed to him the Naam within his heart and mind.

verses.original: ਕਲਜੁਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਪਗ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਖਿਸਕੀਆ ਪਗੁ ਚਉਥਾ ਟਿਕੈ ਟਿਕਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: kalajug har keeaa pag trai khisakeeaa pag chauthaa Tikai Tikai jeeau ||4||4||11||
verses.translation: The Lord ushered in the Dark Age, the Iron Age of Kali Yuga; three legs of religion were lost, and only the fourth leg remained intact. ||4||4||11||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har keerat man bhaiee param gat paiee har man tan meeTh lagaan jeeau ||
verses.translation: One whose mind is pleased with the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, attains the supreme status; the Lord seems so sweet to her mind and body.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har ras paiaa gurmat har dhiaaiaa dhur masatak bhaag puraan jeeau ||
verses.translation: She obtains the sublime essence of the Lord, Har, Har; through the Guru's Teachings, she meditates on the Lord, and the destiny written on her forehead is fulfilled.

verses.original: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
