verses.translit: dhur masatak bhaag har naam suhaag har naamai har gun gaiaa ||
verses.translation: By that high destiny written on her forehead, she chants the Name of the Lord, her Husband, and through the Name of the Lord, she sings the Lord's Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਮਣੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਹਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: masatak manee preet bahu pragaTee har naamai har sohaiaa ||
verses.translation: The jewel of immense love sparkles on her forehead, and she is adorned with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਨੂਆ ਮਾਨ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jotee jot milee prabh paiaa mil satigur manooaa maan jeeau ||
verses.translation: Her light blends with the Supreme Light, and she obtains God; meeting the True Guru, her mind is satisfied.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har keerat man bhaiee param gat paiee har man tan meeTh lagaan jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: One whose mind is pleased with the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, attains the supreme status; the Lord seems sweet to her mind and body. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਊਤਮ ਜਨ ਪਰਧਾਨ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har jas gaiaa param padh paiaa te uootam jan paradhaan jeeau ||
verses.translation: Those who sing the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, obtain the supreme status; they are the most exalted and acclaimed people.

verses.original: ਤਿਨੑ ਹਮ ਚਰਣ ਸਰੇਵਹ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਗ ਧੋਵਹ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: tin(h) ham charan sareveh khin khin pag dhoveh jin har meeTh lagaan jeeau ||
verses.translation: I bow at their feet; each and every moment, I wash the feet of those, unto whom the Lord seems sweet.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਗਾ ਰਤੀ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har meeThaa laiaa param sukh paiaa mukh bhaagaa ratee chaare ||
verses.translation: The Lord seems sweet to them, and they obtain the supreme status; their faces are radiant and beautiful with good fortune.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਉਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਕੰਠਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat har gaiaa har haar ur paiaa har naamaa ka(n)Th dhaare ||
verses.translation: Under Guru's Instruction, they sing the Lord's Name, and wear the garland of the Lord's Name around their necks; they keep the Lord's Name in their throats.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਮਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ek dhirasaT samat kar dhekhai sabh aatam raam pachhaan jeeau ||
verses.translation: They look upon all with equality, and recognize the Supreme Soul, the Lord, pervading among all.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਊਤਮ ਜਨ ਪਰਧਾਨ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har har jas gaiaa param padh paiaa te uootam jan paradhaan jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: Those who sing the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, obtain the supreme status; they are the most exalted and acclaimed people. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat man bhaiee har rasan rasaiee vich sa(n)gat har ras hoi jeeau ||
verses.translation: One whose mind is pleased with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, savors the sublime essence of the Lord; in the Sangat, is this essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਗਾਸਿਆ ਬੀਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har aaraadhiaa gur sabadh vigaasiaa beejaa avar na koi jeeau ||
verses.translation: He meditates in adoration upon the Lord, Har, Har, and through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he blossoms forth. He plants no other seed.

verses.original: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਆ ਸੋ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: avar na koi har a(n)mrit soi jin peeaa so bidh jaanai ||
verses.translation: There is no Nectar, other than the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar. One who drinks it in, knows the way.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪੂਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਲਗਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dha(n)n guroo pooraa prabh paiaa lag sa(n)gat naam pachhaanai ||
verses.translation: Hail, hail to the Perfect Guru; through Him, God is found. Joining the Sangat, the Naam is understood.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੋ ਸੇਵਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਆਰਾਧੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: naamo sev naamo aaraadhai bin naamai avar na koi jeeau ||
verses.translation: I serve the Naam, and I meditate on the Naam. Without the Naam, there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat man bhaiee har rasan rasaiee vich sa(n)gat har ras hoi jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: One whose mind is pleased with the Sat Sangat, savors the sublime essence of the Lord; in the Sangat, is this essence of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਪਾਖਣ ਹਮ ਤਾਰਹੁ ਕਢਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har dhiaa prabh dhaarahu paakhan ham taarahu kadd levahu sabadh subhai jeeau ||
verses.translation: O Lord God, shower Your Mercy upon me; I am just a stone. Please, carry me across, and lift me up with ease, through the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਮੋਹ ਚੀਕੜਿ ਫਾਥੇ ਨਿਘਰਤ ਹਮ ਜਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਂਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਪਕਰਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: moh cheekaR faathe nigharat ham jaate har baa(n)h prabhoo pakarai jeeau ||
verses.translation: I am stuck in the swamp of emotional attachment, and I am sinking. O Lord God, please, take me by the arm.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਬਾਂਹ ਪਕਰਾਈ ਊਤਮ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਜਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh baa(n)h pakaraiee uootam mat paiee gur charanee jan laagaa ||
verses.translation: God took me by the arm, and I obtained the highest understanding; as His slave, I grasped the Guru's feet.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਆ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam japiaa aaraadhiaa mukh masatak bhaag sabhaagaa ||
verses.translation: I chant and meditate in adoration upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, according to the good destiny written upon my forehead.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har kirapaa dhaaree man har har meeThaa lai jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Lord has showered His Mercy upon servant Nanak, and the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, seems so sweet to his mind.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਪਾਖਣ ਹਮ ਤਾਰਹੁ ਕਢਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: har dhiaa prabh dhaarahu paakhan ham taarahu kadd levahu sabadh subhai jeeau ||4||5||12||
verses.translation: O Lord God, shower Your Mercy upon me; I am just a stone. Please, carry me across, and lift me up with ease, through the Word of the Shabad. ||4||5||12||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: man naam japaanaa har har man bhaanaa har bhagat janaa man chaau jeeau ||
verses.translation: One who chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har in his mind - the Lord is pleasing to his mind. In the mind of the devotees there is a great yearning for the Lord.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੇ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo jan mar jeeve tin(h) a(n)mrit peeve man laagaa gurmat bhaau jeeau ||
verses.translation: Those humble beings who remain dead while yet alive, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar; through the Guru's Teachings, their minds embrace love for the Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਉ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: man har har bhaau gur kare pasaau jeevan mukat sukh hoiee ||
verses.translation: Their minds love the Lord, Har, Har, and the Guru is Merciful to them. They are Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive, and they are at peace.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਣਿ ਮਰਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jeevan maran har naam suhele man har har hiradhai soiee ||
verses.translation: Their birth and death, through the Name of the Lord, are illustrious, and in their hearts and minds, the Lord, Har, Har, abides.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਗਟਾਕ ਪੀਆਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: man har har vasiaa gurmat har rasiaa har har ras gaTaak peeaau jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, abides in their minds, and through the Guru's Teachings, they savor the Lord, Har, Har; they drink in the sublime essence of the Lord with abandon.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: man naam japaanaa har har man bhaanaa har bhagat janaa man chaau jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: One who chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in his mind - the Lord is pleasing to his mind. In the mind of the devotees there is such a great yearning for the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਗਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ਨਿਤ ਆਪੁ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ਮਤ ਜਮੁ ਪਕਰੈ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jag maran na bhaiaa nit aap lukaiaa mat jam pakarai lai jai jeeau ||
verses.translation: The people of the world do not like death; they try to hide from it. They are afraid that the Messenger of Death may catch them and take them away.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਰਖਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har a(n)tar baahar har prabh eko ih jeeaRaa rakhiaa na jai jeeau ||
verses.translation: Inwardly and outwardly, the Lord God is the One and Only; this soul cannot be concealed from Him.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਜੀਉ ਰਖੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਲੋੜੀਜੈ ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਸੋ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: kiau jeeau rakheejai har vasat loReejai jis kee vasat so lai jai jeeau ||
verses.translation: How can one keep one's soul, when the Lord wishes to have it? All things belong to Him, and He shall take them away.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਵ ਕਰਿ ਭਰਮੇ ਸਭਿ ਅਉਖਧ ਦਾਰੂ ਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh karan palaav kar bharame sabh aaukhadh dhaaroo lai jeeau ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs wander around in pathetic lamentation, trying all medicines and remedies.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਏ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jis kee vasat prabh le suaamee jan ubare sabadh kamai jeeau ||
verses.translation: God, the Master, unto whom all things belong, shall take them away; the Lord's servant is redeemed by living the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਜਗਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ਨਿਤ ਆਪੁ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ਮਤ ਜਮੁ ਪਕਰੈ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jag maran na bhaiaa nit aap lukaiaa mat jam pakarai lai jai jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: The people of the world do not like death; they try to hide from it. They are afraid that the Messenger of Death may catch them and take them away. ||2||

verses.original: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਹਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhur maran likhaiaa gurmukh sohaiaa jan ubare har har dhiaan jeeau ||
verses.translation: Death is pre-ordained; the Gurmukhs look beauteous, and the humble beings are saved, meditating on the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧੇ ਜਾਨਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har sobhaa paiee har naam vaddiaaiee har dharageh paidhe jaan jeeau ||
verses.translation: Through the Lord they obtain honor, and through the Lord's Name, glorious greatness. In the Court of the Lord, they are robed in honor.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਸੀਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har dharageh paidhe har naamai seedhe har naamai te sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Robed in honor in the Court of the Lord, in the perfection of the Lord's Name, they obtain peace through the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੋਵੈ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran dhovai dhukh meTe har raamai naam samaiaa ||
verses.translation: The pains of both birth and death are eliminated, and they merge into the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਲਿ ਏਕੋ ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har jan prabh ral eko hoe har jan prabh ek samaan jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Lord's servants meet with God and merge into Oneness. The Lord's servant and God are one and the same.

verses.original: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਹਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhur maran likhaiaa gurmukh sohaiaa jan ubare har har dhiaan jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: Death is pre-ordained; the Gurmukhs look beauteous, and the humble beings are saved, meditating on the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਲਗਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jag upajai binasai binas binaasai lag gurmukh asathir hoi jeeau ||
verses.translation: The people of the world are born, only to perish, and perish, and perish again. Only by attaching oneself to the Lord as Gurmukh, does one become permanent.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਚੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur ma(n)tr dhiraRaae har rasak rasaae har a(n)mrit har mukh choi jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Guru implants His Mantra within the heart, and one savors the sublime essence of the Lord; the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord trickles into his mouth.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੁਆ ਜੀਵਾਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: har a(n)mirat ras paiaa muaa jeevaiaa fir baahuR maran na hoiee ||
verses.translation: Obtaining the Ambrosial Essence of the Lord, the dead are restored to life, and do not die again.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮਰ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam amar padh paiaa har naam samaavai soiee ||
verses.translation: Through the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, one obtains the immortal status, and merges into the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam adhaar Tek hai bin naavai avar na koi jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the only Support and Anchor of servant Nanak; without the Naam, there is nothing else at all.

verses.original: ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਲਗਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: jag upajai binasai binas binaasai lag gurmukh asathir hoi jeeau ||4||6||13||
verses.translation: The people of the world are born, only to perish, and perish, and perish again. Only by attaching oneself to the Lord as Gurmukh, does one become permanent. ||4||6||13||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਛੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa chauthhaa chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fourth Mehla, Chhant:

verses.original: ਵਡਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਆਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaa meraa govi(n)dh agam agochar aadh nira(n)jan nira(n)kaar jeeau ||
verses.translation: My Lord of the Universe is great, unapproachable, unfathomable, primal, immaculate and formless.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਅਮਿਤਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: taa kee gat kahee na jaiee amit vaddiaaiee meraa govi(n)dh alakh apaar jeeau ||
verses.translation: His condition cannot be described; His Glorious Greatness is immeasurable. My Lord of the Universe is invisible and infinite.

verses.original: ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਆਪੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: govi(n)dh alakh apaar apara(n)par aap aapanaa jaanai ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the Universe is invisible, infinite and unlimited. He Himself knows Himself.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਇਹ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa ieh ja(n)t vichaare kahe'eeh jo tudh aakh vakhaanai ||
verses.translation: What should these poor creatures say? How can they speak of and describe You?

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਅਪਣੀ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jis no nadhar kareh too(n) apanee so gurmukh kare veechaar jeeau ||
verses.translation: That Gurmukh who is blessed by Your Glance of Grace contemplates You.

verses.original: ਵਡਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਆਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: vaddaa meraa govi(n)dh agam agochar aadh nira(n)jan nira(n)kaar jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: My Lord of the Universe is great, unapproachable, unfathomable, primal, immaculate and formless. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) aadh purakh apara(n)par karataa teraa paar na paiaa jai jeeau ||
verses.translation: You, O Lord, O Primal Being, are the Limitless Creator; Your limits cannot be found.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) ghaT ghaT a(n)tar sarab nira(n)tar sabh meh rahiaa samai jeeau ||
verses.translation: You are pervading and permeating each and every heart, everywhere, You are contained in all.

verses.original: ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT a(n)tar paarabraham paramesar taa kaa a(n)t na paiaa ||
verses.translation: Within the heart is the Transcendent, Supreme Lord God, whose limits cannot be found.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tis roop na rekh adhisaT agochar gurmukh alakh lakhaiaa ||
verses.translation: He has no form or shape; He is unseen and unknown. The Gurmukh sees the unseen Lord.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa ana(n)dh rahai dhin raatee sahaje naam samai jeeau ||
verses.translation: He remains in continual ecstasy, day and night, and is spontaneously absorbed into the Naam.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: too(n) aadh purakh apara(n)par karataa teraa paar na paiaa jai jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: You, O Lord, O Primal Being, are the Limitless Creator; Your limits cannot be found. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਸਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) sat paramesar sadhaa abinaasee har har gunee nidhaan jeeau ||
verses.translation: You are the True, Transcendent Lord, forever imperishable. The Lord, Har, Har, is the treasure of virtue.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har prabh eko avar na koiee too(n) aape purakh sujaan jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Lord God, Har, Har, is the One and only; there is no other at all. You Yourself are the all-knowing Lord.

verses.original: ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ਤੂੰ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: purakh sujaan too(n) paradhaan tudh jevadd avar na koiee ||
verses.translation: You are the all-knowing Lord, the most exalted and auspicious; there is no other as great as You.

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: teraa sabadh sabh too(n)hai varateh too(n) aape kareh su hoiee ||
verses.translation: The Word of Your Shabad is pervading in all; whatever You do, comes to pass.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har sabh meh raviaa eko soiee gurmukh lakhiaa har naam jeeau ||
verses.translation: The One Lord God is permeating all; the Gurmukh comes to understand the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਸਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: too(n) sat paramesar sadhaa abinaasee har har gunee nidhaan jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: You are the True, Transcendent Lord, forever imperishable. The Lord, Har, Har, is the treasure of virtue. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabh too(n)hai karataa sabh teree vaddiaaiee jiau bhaavai tivai chalai jeeau ||
verses.translation: You are the Creator of all, and all greatness is Yours. As it pleases Your Will, so do we act.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: tudh aape bhaavai tivai chalaaveh sabh terai sabadh samai jeeau ||
verses.translation: As it pleases Your Will, so do we act. All are merged into Your Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਜਾਂ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh sabadh samaavai jaa(n) tudh bhaavai terai sabadh vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: When it pleases Your Will, we obtain greatness through Your Shabad.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh budh paieeaai aap gavaieeaai sabadhe rahiaa samaiee ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh obtains wisdom, and eliminates his self-conceit, and remains absorbed in the Shabad.

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: teraa sabadh agochar gurmukh paieeaai naanak naam samai jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh obtains Your incomprehensible Shabad; O Nanak, he remains merged in the Naam.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: sabh too(n)hai karataa sabh teree vaddiaaiee jiau bhaavai tivai chalai jeeau ||4||7||14||
verses.translation: You are the Creator of all, and all greatness is Yours. As it pleases Your Will, so do we act. ||4||7||14||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa chauthhaa chha(n)t ghar chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fourth Mehla, Chhant, Fourth House:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਿੰਨੇ ਲੋਇਣਾ ਮਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਰਤੰਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: har a(n)mirat bhi(n)ne loinaa man prem rata(n)naa raam raaje ||
verses.translation: My eyes are wet with the Nectar of the Lord, and my mind is imbued with His Love, O Lord King.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮਿ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਇਆ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਸੋਵਿੰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: man raam kasavaTee laiaa ka(n)chan sovi(n)naa ||
verses.translation: The Lord applied His touch-stone to my mind, and found it one hundred per cent gold.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੋ ਭਿੰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh ra(n)g chalooliaa meraa man tano bhi(n)naa ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, I am dyed in the deep red of the poppy, and my mind and body are drenched with His Love.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੁਸਕਿ ਝਕੋਲਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak musak jhakoliaa sabh janam dhan dha(n)naa ||1||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is drenched with His Fragrance; blessed, blessed is his entire life. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਅਣੀਆਲੇ ਅਣੀਆ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: har prem baanee man maariaa aneeaale aneeaa raam raaje ||
verses.translation: The Bani of the Lord's Love is the pointed arrow, which has pierced my mind, O Lord King.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਪੀਰ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕੀ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: jis laagee peer pira(n)m kee so jaanai jareeaa ||
verses.translation: Only those who feel the pain of this love, know how to endure it.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਮਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: jeevan mukat so aakheeaai mar jeevai mareeaa ||
verses.translation: Those who die, and remain dead while yet alive, are said to be Jivan Mukta, liberated while yet alive.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਗੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak satigur mel har jag dhutar tareeaa ||2||
verses.translation: O Lord, unite servant Nanak with the True Guru, that he may cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਮਿਲੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਰੰਗਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: ham moorakh mugadh saranaagatee mil govi(n)dh ra(n)gaa raam raaje ||
verses.translation: I am foolish and ignorant, but I have taken to His Sanctuary; may I merge in the Love of the Lord of the Universe, O Lord King.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਇਕ ਮੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai har paiaa har bhagat ik ma(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: Through the Perfect Guru, I have obtained the Lord, and I beg for the one blessing of devotion to the Lord.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਗਾਸਿਆ ਜਪਿ ਅਨਤ ਤਰੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: meraa man tan sabadh vigaasiaa jap anat tara(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: My mind and body blossom forth through the Word of the Shabad; I meditate on the Lord of infinite waves.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਸੰਗਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mil sa(n)t janaa har paiaa naanak satasa(n)gaa ||3||
verses.translation: Meeting with the humble Saints, Nanak finds the Lord, in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal sun benatee har prabh har raiaa raam raaje ||
verses.translation: O Merciful to the meek, hear my prayer, O Lord God; You are my Master, O Lord King.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਮਾਗਉ ਸਰਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau maagau saran har naam kee har har mukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: I beg for the Sanctuary of the Lord's Name, Har, Har; please, place it in my mouth.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਜ ਰਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat vachhal har biradh hai har laaj rakhaiaa ||
verses.translation: It is the Lord's natural way to love His devotees; O Lord, please preserve my honor!

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: jan naanak saranaagatee har naam taraiaa ||4||8||15||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has entered His Sanctuary, and has been saved by the Name of the Lord. ||4||8||15||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਢੂੰਢਿ ਢੂਢੇਦਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਲਧਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh ddoo(n)dd ddooddedhiaa har sajan ladhaa raam raaje ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, I searched and searched, and found the Lord, my Friend, my Sovereign Lord King.

verses.original: ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟ ਗੜ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: ka(n)chan kaiaa koT gaR vich har har sidhaa ||
verses.translation: Within the walled fortress of my golden body, the Lord, Har, Har, is revealed.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹੀਰਾ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਵਿਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har heeraa ratan hai meraa man tan vidhaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, is a jewel, a diamond; my mind and body are pierced through.

verses.original: ਧੁਰਿ ਭਾਗ ਵਡੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਸਿ ਗੁਧਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhur bhaag vadde har paiaa naanak ras gudhaa ||1||
verses.translation: By the great good fortune of pre-ordained destiny, I have found the Lord. Nanak is permeated with His sublime essence. ||1||

verses.original: ਪੰਥੁ ਦਸਾਵਾ ਨਿਤ ਖੜੀ ਮੁੰਧ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਬਾਲੀ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)th dhasaavaa nit khaRee mu(n)dh joban baalee raam raaje ||
verses.translation: I stand by the roadside, and ask the way; I am just a youthful bride of the Lord King.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਾਇ ਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam chetai gur har maarag chaalee ||
verses.translation: The Guru has caused me to remember the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; I follow the Path to Him.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: merai man tan naam aadhaar hai haumai bikh jaalee ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Support of my mind and body; I have burnt away the poison of ego.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਬਨਵਾਲੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak satigur mel har har miliaa banavaalee ||2||
verses.translation: O True Guru, unite me with the Lord, unite me with the Lord, adorned with garlands of flowers. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੁ ਮੈ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh piaare aai mil mai chiree vichhu(n)ne raam raaje ||
verses.translation: O my Love, come and meet me as Gurmukh; I have been separated from You for so long, Lord King.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬੈਰਾਗਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨੈਣ ਰਸਿ ਭਿੰਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: meraa man tan bahut bairaagiaa har nain ras bhi(n)ne ||
verses.translation: My mind and body are sad; my eyes are wet with the Lord's sublime essence.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਦਸਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਮੰਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: mai har prabh piaaraa dhas gur mil har man ma(n)ne ||
verses.translation: Show me my Lord God, my Love, O Guru; meeting the Lord, my mind is pleased.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਈਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਮੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: hau moorakh kaarai laieeaa naanak har ka(n)me ||3||
verses.translation: I am just a fool, O Nanak, but the Lord has appointed me to perform His service. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਿੰਨੀ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬੁਰਕੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur a(n)mirat bhi(n)nee dhehuree a(n)mrit burake raam raaje ||
verses.translation: The Guru's body is drenched with Ambrosial Nectar; He sprinkles it upon me, O Lord King.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਛਕਿ ਛਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa gurbaanee man bhaieeaa a(n)mirat chhak chhake ||
verses.translation: Those whose minds are pleased with the Word of the Guru's Bani, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar again and again.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੁਠੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਚੂਕੇ ਧਕ ਧਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur tuThai har paiaa chooke dhak dhake ||
verses.translation: As the Guru is pleased, the Lord is obtained, and you shall not be pushed around any more.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਇਆ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਇਕੇ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: har jan har har hoiaa naanak har ike ||4||9||16||
verses.translation: The Lord's humble servant becomes the Lord, Har, Har; O Nanak, the Lord and His servant are one and the same. ||4||9||16||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: har a(n)mirat bhagat bha(n)ddaar hai gur satigur paase raam raaje ||
verses.translation: The treasure of Ambrosial Nectar, the Lord's devotional service, is found through the Guru, the True Guru, O Lord King.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਸਿਖ ਦੇਇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur satigur sachaa saahu hai sikh dhei har raase ||
verses.translation: The Guru, the True Guru, is the True Banker, who gives to His Sikh the capital of the Lord.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਵਣਜੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਬਾਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dha(n)n vanajaaraa vanaj hai gur saahu saabaase ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is the trader and the trade; how wonderful is the Banker, the Guru!

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਲਿਲਾਟਿ ਲਿਖਾਸੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak gur tin(h)ee paiaa jin dhur likhat lilaaT likhaase ||1||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, they alone obtain the Guru, who have such pre-ordained destiny written upon their foreheads. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਧਣੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: sach saahu hamaaraa too(n) dhanee sabh jagat vanajaaraa raam raaje ||
verses.translation: You are my True Banker, O Lord; the whole world is Your trader, O Lord King.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਤੁਧੈ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਥਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh bhaa(n)dde tudhai saajiaa vich vasat har thaaraa ||
verses.translation: You fashioned all vessels, O Lord, and that which dwells within is also Yours.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਾ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਕਿਆ ਕੋਈ ਕਰੇ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo paaveh bhaa(n)dde vich vasat saa nikalai kiaa koiee kare vechaaraa ||
verses.translation: Whatever You place in that vessel, that alone comes out again. What can the poor creatures do?

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kau har bakhasiaa har bhagat bha(n)ddaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord has given the treasure of His devotional worship to servant Nanak. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਿਥਰਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੂੰ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: ham kiaa gun tere vithareh suaamee too(n) apar apaaro raam raaje ||
verses.translation: What Glorious Virtues of Yours can I describe, O Lord and Master? You are the most infinite of the infinite, O Lord King.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਹ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਏਹਾ ਆਸ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: har naam saalaaheh dhin raat ehaa aas aadhaaro ||
verses.translation: I praise the Lord's Name, day and night; this alone is my hope and support.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਿਛੂਅ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਾ ਕਿਵ ਪਾਵਹ ਪਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: ham moorakh kichhooa na jaanahaa kiv paaveh paaro ||
verses.translation: I am a fool, and I know nothing. How can I find Your limits?

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har kaa dhaas hai har dhaas panihaaro ||3||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is the slave of the Lord, the water-carrier of the slaves of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੈ ਹਮ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਏ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: jiau bhaavai tiau raakh lai ham saran prabh aae raam raaje ||
verses.translation: As it pleases You, You save me; I have come seeking Your Sanctuary, O God, O Lord King.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਭੂਲਿ ਵਿਗਾੜਹ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਜ ਰਖਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: ham bhool vigaaReh dhinas raat har laaj rakhaae ||
verses.translation: I am wandering around, ruining myself day and night; O Lord, please save my honor!

verses.original: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਹੈ ਦੇ ਮਤਿ ਸਮਝਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: ham baarik too(n) gur pitaa hai dhe mat samajhaae ||
verses.translation: I am just a child; You, O Guru, are my father. Please give me understanding and instruction.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਂਢਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਏ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: jan naanak dhaas har kaa(n)ddiaa har paij rakhaae ||4||10||17||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is known as the Lord's slave; O Lord, please preserve his honor! ||4||10||17||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: jin masatak dhur har likhiaa tinaa satigur miliaa raam raaje ||
verses.translation: Those who have the blessed pre-ordained destiny of the Lord written on their foreheads, meet the True Guru, the Lord King.

verses.original: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਕਟਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਘਟਿ ਬਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: agiaan a(n)dheraa kaTiaa gur giaan ghaT baliaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru removes the darkness of ignorance, and spiritual wisdom illuminates their hearts.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਲਧਾ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੋ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਚਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: har ladhaa ratan padhaaratho fir bahuR na chaliaa ||
verses.translation: They find the wealth of the jewel of the Lord, and then, they do not wander any longer.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam aaraadhiaa aaraadh har miliaa ||1||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and in meditation, he meets the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਸੇ ਕਾਹੇ ਜਗਿ ਆਏ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: jinee aaisaa har naam na chetio se kaahe jag aae raam raaje ||
verses.translation: Those who have not kept the Lord's Name in their consciousness - why did they bother to come into the world, O Lord King?

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: eih maanas janam dhula(n)bh hai naam binaa birathaa sabh jaae ||
verses.translation: It is so difficult to obtain this human incarnation, and without the Naam, it is all futile and useless.

verses.original: ਹੁਣਿ ਵਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਬੀਜਿਓ ਅਗੈ ਭੁਖਾ ਕਿਆ ਖਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: hun vatai har naam na beejio agai bhukhaa kiaa khaae ||
verses.translation: Now, in this most fortunate season, he does not plant the seed of the Lord's Name; what will the hungry soul eat, in the world hereafter?

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: manmukhaa no fir janam hai naanak har bhaae ||2||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are born again and again. O Nanak, such is the Lord's Will. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) har teraa sabh ko sabh tudh upaae raam raaje ||
verses.translation: You, O Lord, belong to all, and all belong to You. You created all, O Lord King.

verses.original: ਕਿਛੁ ਹਾਥਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਭਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਚਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kichh haath kisai dhai kichh naahee sabh chaleh chalaae ||
verses.translation: Nothing is in anyone's hands; all walk as You cause them to walk.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h) too(n) meleh piaare se tudh mileh jo har man bhaae ||
verses.translation: They alone are united with You, O Beloved, whom You cause to be so united; they alone are pleasing to Your Mind.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jan naanak satigur bheTiaa har naam taraae ||3||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has met the True Guru, and through the Lord's Name, he has been carried across. ||3||

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਾਗੀ ਨਾਦੀ ਬੇਦੀ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: koiee gaavai raagee naadhee bedhee bahu bhaat kar nahee har har bheejai raam raaje ||
verses.translation: Some sing of the Lord, through musical Ragas and the sound current of the Naad, through the Vedas, and in so many ways. But the Lord, Har, Har, is not pleased by these, O Lord King.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨਾ ਰੋਇ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa a(n)tar kapaT vikaar hai tinaa roi kiaa keejai ||
verses.translation: Those who are filled with fraud and corruption within - what good does it do for them to cry out?

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਰੋਗ ਹਥੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: har karataa sabh kichh jaanadhaa sir rog hath dheejai ||
verses.translation: The Creator Lord knows everything, although they may try to hide their sins and the causes of their diseases.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦਾ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: jinaa naanak gurmukh hiradhaa sudh hai har bhagat har leejai ||4||11||18||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those Gurmukhs whose hearts are pure, obtain the Lord, Har, Har, by devotional worship. ||4||11||18||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਸੁਘੜ ਸਿਆਣੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: jin a(n)tar har har preet hai te jan sughaR siaane raam raaje ||
verses.translation: Those whose hearts are filled with the love of the Lord, Har, Har, are the wisest and most clever people, O Lord King.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਭੁਲਿ ਚੁਕਿ ਬੋਲਦੇ ਭੀ ਖਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: je baaharahu bhul chuk boladhe bhee khare har bhaane ||
verses.translation: Even if they misspeak outwardly, they are still very pleasing to the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਾ ਨੋ ਹੋਰੁ ਥਾਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: har sa(n)taa no hor thaau naahee har maan nimaane ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Saints have no other place. The Lord is the honor of the dishonored.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਣੁ ਸਤਾਣੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam dheebaan hai har taan sataane ||1||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Royal Court for servant Nanak; the Lord's power is his only power. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਜਾਇ ਬਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: jithai jai bahai meraa satiguroo so thaan suhaavaa raam raaje ||
verses.translation: Wherever my True Guru goes and sits, that place is beautiful, O Lord King.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਂੀ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਭਾਲਿਆ ਲੈ ਧੂਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: gursikha(n)ee so thaan bhaaliaa lai dhoor mukh laavaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru's Sikhs seek out that place; they take the dust and apply it to their faces.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੀ ਘਾਲ ਥਾਇ ਪਈ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: gursikhaa kee ghaal thai piee jin har naam dhiaavaa ||
verses.translation: The works of the Guru's Sikhs, who meditate on the Lord's Name, are approved.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਜਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਵਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jin(h) naanak satigur poojiaa tin har pooj karaavaa ||2||
verses.translation: Those who worship the True Guru, O Nanak - the Lord causes them to be worshipped in turn. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: gursikhaa man har preet hai har naam har teree raam raaje ||
verses.translation: The Guru's Sikh keeps the Love of the Lord, and the Name of the Lord, in his mind. He loves You, O Lord, O Lord King.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਭੁਖ ਜਾਇ ਲਹਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kar seveh pooraa satiguroo bhukh jai leh meree ||
verses.translation: He serves the Perfect True Guru, and his hunger and self-conceit are eliminated.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੀ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਗਈ ਤਿਨ ਪਿਛੈ ਹੋਰ ਖਾਇ ਘਨੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: gursikhaa kee bhukh sabh giee tin pichhai hor khai ghaneree ||
verses.translation: The hunger of the Gursikh is totally eliminated; indeed, many others are satisfied through them.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬੀਜਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਪੁੰਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har pu(n)n beejiaa fir toT na aavai har pu(n)n keree ||3||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has planted the Seed of the Lord's Goodness; this Goodness of the Lord shall never be exhausted. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਧਾਈਆ ਜਿਨ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਡਿਠਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: gursikhaa man vaadhaieeaa jin meraa satiguroo ddiThaa raam raaje ||
verses.translation: The minds of the Gursikhs rejoice, because they have seen my True Guru, O Lord King.

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਕਰਿ ਗਲ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਸੋ ਲਗੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਮਨਿ ਮਿਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: koiee kar gal sunaavai har naam kee so lagai gursikhaa man miThaa ||
verses.translation: If someone recites to them the story of the Lord's Name, it seems so sweet to the mind of those Gursikhs.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪੈਨਾਈਅਹਿ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: har dharageh gursikh painaie'eeh jin(h)aa meraa satigur tuThaa ||
verses.translation: The Gursikhs are robed in honor in the Court of the Lord; my True Guru is very pleased with them.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har har hoiaa har har man vuThaa ||4||12||19||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has become the Lord, Har, Har; the Lord, Har, Har, abides within his mind. ||4||12||19||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h)aa bheTiaa meraa pooraa satiguroo tin har naam dhiraRaavai raam raaje ||
verses.translation: Those who meet my Perfect True Guru - He implants within them the Name of the Lord, the Lord King.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: tis kee tirasanaa bhukh sabh utarai jo har naam dhiaavai ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the Lord's Name have all of their desire and hunger removed.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo har har naam dhiaaidhe tin(h) jam neR na aavai ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har - the Messenger of Death cannot even approach them.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਜਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kau har kirapaa kar nit japai har naam har naam taraavai ||1||
verses.translation: O Lord, shower Your Mercy upon servant Nanak, that he may ever chant the Name of the Lord; through the Name of the Lord, he is saved. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: jinee gurmukh naam dhiaaiaa tinaa fir bighan na hoiee raam raaje ||
verses.translation: Those who, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Naam, meet no obstacles in their path, O Lord King.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਨਾਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਪੂਜੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jinee satigur purakh manaiaa tin pooje sabh koiee ||
verses.translation: Those who are pleasing to the almighty True Guru are worshipped by everyone.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਦ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h)ee satigur piaaraa seviaa tin(h)aa sukh sadh hoiee ||
verses.translation: Those who serve their Beloved True Guru obtain eternal peace.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jin(h)aa naanak satigur bheTiaa tin(h)aa miliaa har soiee ||2||
verses.translation: Those who meet the True Guru, O Nanak - the Lord Himself meets them. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਣਹਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h)aa a(n)tar gurmukh preet hai tin(h) har rakhanahaaraa raam raaje ||
verses.translation: Those Gurmukhs, who are filled with His Love, have the Lord as their Saving Grace, O Lord King.

verses.original: ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: tin(h) kee ni(n)dhaa koiee kiaa kare jin(h) har naam piaaraa ||
verses.translation: How can anyone slander them? The Lord's Name is dear to them.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਸਭ ਦੁਸਟ ਝਖ ਮਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin har setee man maaniaa sabh dhusaT jhakh maaraa ||
verses.translation: Those whose minds are in harmony with the Lord - all their enemies attack them in vain.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam dhiaaiaa har rakhanahaaraa ||3||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Lord Protector. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਭਗਤ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: har jug jug bhagat upaiaa paij rakhadhaa aaiaa raam raaje ||
verses.translation: In each and every age, He creates His devotees and preserves their honor, O Lord King.

verses.original: ਹਰਣਾਖਸੁ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: haranaakhas dhusaT har maariaa prahalaadh taraiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord killed the wicked Harnaakhash, and saved Prahlaad.

verses.original: ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀਆ ਨਿੰਦਕਾ ਪਿਠਿ ਦੇਇ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aha(n)kaareeaa ni(n)dhakaa piTh dhei naamadheau mukh laiaa ||
verses.translation: He turned his back on the egotists and slanderers, and showed His Face to Naam Dayv.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਅੰਤਿ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: jan naanak aaisaa har seviaa a(n)t le chhaddaiaa ||4||13||20||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has so served the Lord, that He will deliver him in the end. ||4||13||20||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੫
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa chauthhaa chha(n)t ghar panjavaa
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fourth Mehla, Chhant, Fifth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ ਵੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਆਉ ਘਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: mere man paradhesee ve piaare aau ghare ||
verses.translation: O my dear beloved stranger mind, please come home!

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har guroo milaavahu mere piaare ghar vasai hare ||
verses.translation: Meet with the Lord-Guru, O my dear beloved, and He will dwell in the home of your self.

verses.original: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g raleeaa maanahu mere piaare har kirapaa kare ||
verses.translation: Revel in His Love, O my dear beloved, as the Lord bestows His Mercy.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur naanak tuThaa mere piaare mele hare ||1||
verses.translation: As Guru Nanak is pleased, O my dear beloved, we are united with the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਨ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਭਾਉ ਕਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: mai prem na chaakhiaa mere piaare bhaau kare ||
verses.translation: I have not tasted divine love, O my dear beloved, within my heart.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨ ਬੁਝੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਆਸ ਕਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: man tirasanaa na bujhee mere piaare nit aas kare ||
verses.translation: The mind's desires are not quenched, O my dear beloved, but I still hold out hope.

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਜਾਵੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਮੁ ਸਾਸ ਹਿਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: nit joban jaavai mere piaare jam saas hire ||
verses.translation: Youth is passing away, O my dear beloved, and death is stealing away the breath of life.

verses.original: ਭਾਗ ਮਣੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhaag manee sohaagan mere piaare naanak har ur dhaare ||2||
verses.translation: The virtuous bride realizes the good fortune of her destiny, O my dear beloved; O Nanak, she enshrines the Lord within her heart. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਿਰ ਰਤਿਅੜੇ ਮੈਡੇ ਲੋਇਣ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਜਿਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: pir ratiaRe maidde loin mere piaare chaatirak boo(n)dh jivai ||
verses.translation: My eyes are drenched with the Love of my Husband Lord, O my dear beloved, like the song-bird with the rain drop.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਪੀਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: man seetal hoaa mere piaare har boo(n)dh peevai ||
verses.translation: My mind is cooled and soothed, O my dear beloved, by drinking in the rain drops of the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਨਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਜਗਾਵੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਪਵੈ ਕਿਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: tan birahu jagaavai mere piaare needh na pavai kivai ||
verses.translation: Separation from my Lord keeps my body awake, O my dear beloved; I cannot sleep at all.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਲਧਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਿਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har sajan ladhaa mere piaare naanak guroo livai ||3||
verses.translation: Nanak has found the Lord, the True Friend, O my dear beloved, by loving the Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਚੜਿ ਚੇਤੁ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਭਲੀਅ ਰੁਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: chaR chet basa(n)t mere piaare bhaleea rute ||
verses.translation: In the month of Chayt, O my dear beloved, the pleasant season of spring begins.

verses.original: ਪਿਰ ਬਾਝੜਿਅਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਆਂਗਣਿ ਧੂੜਿ ਲੁਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: pir baajhaRiahu mere piaare aa(n)gan dhooR lute ||
verses.translation: But without my Husband Lord, O my dear beloved, my courtyard is filled with dust.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਉਡੀਣੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦੁਇ ਨੈਨ ਜੁਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: man aas uddeenee mere piaare dhui nain jute ||
verses.translation: But my sad mind is still hopeful, O my dear beloved; my eyes are both fixed upon Him.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਮਾਤ ਸੁਤੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gur naanak dhekh vigasee mere piaare jiau maat sute ||4||
verses.translation: Beholding the Guru, Nanak is filled with wondrous joy, like a child, gazing upon his mother. ||4||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਕਥਾ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਣਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: har keeaa kathaa kahaaneeaa mere piaare satiguroo sunaieeaa ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has preached the sermon of the Lord, O my dear beloved.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਵਿਟੜਿਅਹੁ ਹਉ ਘੋਲੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur viTaRiahu hau gholee mere piaare jin har melaieeaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Guru, O my dear beloved, who has united me with the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਆਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਅੜਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh aasaa har pooreeaa mere piaare man chi(n)dhiaRaa fal paiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord has fulfilled all my hopes, O my dear beloved; I have obtained the fruits of my heart's desires.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਠੜਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: har tuThaRaa mere piaare jan naanak naam samaiaa ||5||
verses.translation: When the Lord is pleased, O my dear beloved, servant Nanak is absorbed into the Naam. ||5||

verses.original: ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਨ ਖੇਲਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: piaare har bin prem na khelasaa ||
verses.translation: Without the Beloved Lord, there is no play of love.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਦੇਖਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: kiau paiee gur jit lag piaaraa dhekhasaa ||
verses.translation: How can I find the Guru? Grasping hold of Him, I behold my Beloved.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤੜੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: har dhaataRe mel guroo mukh gurmukh melasaa ||
verses.translation: O Lord, O Great Giver, let me meet the Guru; as Gurmukh, may I merge with You.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਸਾ ॥੬॥੧੪॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: gur naanak paiaa mere piaare dhur masatak lekh saa ||6||14||21||
verses.translation: Nanak has found the Guru, O my dear beloved; such was the destiny inscribed upon his forehead. ||6||14||21||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: raag aasaa mahalaa panjavaa chha(n)t ghar pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Chhant, First House:

verses.original: ਅਨਦੋ ਅਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ ਮੈ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡੀਠਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: anadho anadh ghanaa mai so prabh ddeeThaa raam ||
verses.translation: Joy - great joy! I have seen the Lord God!

verses.original: ਚਾਖਿਅੜਾ ਚਾਖਿਅੜਾ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: chaakhiaRaa chaakhiaRaa mai har ras meeThaa raam ||
verses.translation: Tasted - I have tasted the sweet essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਵੂਠਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੂਠਾ ਸਹਜੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har ras meeThaa man meh vooThaa satigur tooThaa sahaj bhiaa ||
verses.translation: The sweet essence of the Lord has rained down in my mind; by the pleasure of the True Guru, I have attained peaceful ease.

verses.original: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਵਸਿ ਆਇਆ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਪੰਚ ਦੁਸਟ ਓਇ ਭਾਗਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: girahu vas aaiaa ma(n)gal gaiaa pa(n)ch dhusaT oi bhaag giaa ||
verses.translation: I have come to dwell in the home of my own self, and I sing the songs of joy; the five villains have fled.

verses.original: ਸੀਤਲ ਆਘਾਣੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੇ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਬਸੀਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: seetal aaghaane a(n)mirat baane saajan sa(n)t baseeThaa ||
verses.translation: I am soothed and satisfied with the Ambrosial Bani of His Word; the friendly Saint is my advocate.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੈਣੀ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak har siau man maaniaa so prabh nainee ddeeThaa ||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, my mind is in harmony with the Lord; I have seen God with my eyes. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੋਹਿਅੜੇ ਸੋਹਿਅੜੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਬੰਕ ਦੁਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sohiaRe sohiaRe mere ba(n)k dhuaare raam ||
verses.translation: Adorned - adorned are my beauteous gates, O Lord.

verses.original: ਪਾਹੁਨੜੇ ਪਾਹੁਨੜੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: paahunaRe paahunaRe mere sa(n)t piaare raam ||
verses.translation: Guests - my guests are the Beloved Saints, O Lord.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਾਰੇ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਲਗੇ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t piaare kaaraj saare namasakaar kar lage sevaa ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Saints have resolved my affairs; I humbly bowed to them, and committed myself to their service.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਞੀ ਆਪੇ ਮਾਞੀ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਪਿ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape jaan(j)ee aape maan(j)ee aap suaamee aap dhevaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the groom's party, and He Himself the bride's party; He Himself is the Lord and Master; He Himself is the Divine Lord.

verses.original: ਅਪਣਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਧਾਰਨ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: apanaa kaaraj aap savaare aape dhaaran dhaare ||
verses.translation: He Himself resolves His own affairs; He Himself sustains the Universe.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹੁ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਬੈਠਾ ਸੋਹੇ ਬੰਕ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak sahu ghar meh baiThaa sohe ba(n)k dhuaare ||2||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, my Bridegroom is sitting in my home; the gates of my body are beautifully adorned. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਵ ਨਿਧੇ ਨਉ ਨਿਧੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: nav nidhe nau nidhe mere ghar meh aaiee raam ||
verses.translation: The nine treasures - the nine treasures come into my home, Lord.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh mai sabh kichh paiaa naam dhiaaiee raam ||
verses.translation: Everything - I obtain everything, meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਖਾਈ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਈ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: naam dhiaaiee sadhaa sakhaiee sahaj subhaiee govi(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Naam, the Lord of the Universe becomes one's eternal companion, and he dwells in peaceful ease.

verses.original: ਗਣਤ ਮਿਟਾਈ ਚੂਕੀ ਧਾਈ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: ganat miTaiee chookee dhaiee kadhe na viaapai man chi(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: His calculations are ended, his wanderings cease, and his mind is no longer afflicted with anxiety.

verses.original: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਵਾਜੇ ਅਚਰਜ ਸੋਭ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: govi(n)dh gaaje anahadh vaaje acharaj sobh banaiee ||
verses.translation: When the Lord of the Universe reveals Himself, and the unstruck melody of the sound current vibrates, the drama of wondrous splendor is enacted.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਰੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਤਾ ਮੈ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak pir merai sa(n)ge taa mai nav nidh paiee ||3||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, when my Husband Lord is with me, I obtain the nine treasures. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਰਸਿਅੜੇ ਸਰਸਿਅੜੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਸਭ ਮੀਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sarasiaRe sarasiaRe mere bhaiee sabh meetaa raam ||
verses.translation: Over-joyed - over-joyed are all my brothers and friends.

verses.original: ਬਿਖਮੋ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਅਖਾੜਾ ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੀਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: bikhamo bikham akhaaRaa mai gur mil jeetaa raam ||
verses.translation: Meeting the Guru, I have won the most arduous battle in the arena of life.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੀਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੂਟੀ ਭੀਤਾ ਭਰਮ ਗੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur mil jeetaa har har keetaa tooTee bheetaa bharam gaRaa ||
verses.translation: Meeting the Guru, I am victorious; praising the Lord, Har, Har, the walls of the fortress of doubt have been destroyed.

verses.original: ਪਾਇਆ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ਸਾਣਥ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਪਿ ਖੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: paiaa khajaanaa bahut nidhaanaa saanath meree aap khaRaa ||
verses.translation: I have obtained the wealth of so many treasures; the Lord Himself has stood by my side.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਸੁਗਿਆਨਾ ਸੋ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਕੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: soiee sugiaanaa so paradhaanaa jo prabh apanaa keetaa ||
verses.translation: He is the man of spiritual wisdom, and he is the leader, whom God has made His own.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਂ ਵਲਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਾ ਸਰਸੇ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak jaa(n) val suaamee taa sarase bhaiee meetaa ||4||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, when the Lord and Master is on my side, then my brothers and friends rejoice. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਕਥਾ ਹਰਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: akathaa har akath kathaa kichh jai na jaanee raam ||
verses.translation: Inexpressible is the sermon of the inexpressible Lord; it cannot be known at all.

verses.original: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸਹਜਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sur nar sur nar mun jan sahaj vakhaanee raam ||
verses.translation: The demi-gods, mortal beings, angels and silent sages express it in their peaceful poise.

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਵਖਾਣੀ ਅਮਿਉ ਬਾਣੀ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sahaje vakhaanee amiau baanee charan kamal ra(n)g laiaa ||
verses.translation: In their poise, they recite the Ambrosial Bani of the Lord's Word; they embrace love for the Lord's Lotus Feet.

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਏਕੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jap ek alakh prabh nira(n)jan man chi(n)dhiaa fal paiaa ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the One incomprehensible and immaculate Lord, they obtain the fruits of their heart's desires.

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: taj maan moh vikaar dhoojaa jotee jot samaanee ||
verses.translation: Renouncing self-conceit, emotional attachment, corruption and duality, their light merges into the Light.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak gur prasaadhee sadhaa har ra(n)g maanee ||1||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, by Guru's Grace, one enjoys the Lord's Love forever. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਸਜਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: har sa(n)taa har sa(n)t sajan mere meet sahaiee raam ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Saints - the Lord's Saints are my friends, my best friends and helpers.

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee vaddabhaagee satasa(n)gat paiee raam ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, by great good fortune, I have obtained the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਲਾਥੇ ਦੂਖ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee paae naam dhiaae laathe dhookh sa(n)taapai ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, I obtained it, and I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; my pains and sufferings have been taken away.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੇ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਆਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur charanee laage bhram bhau bhaage aap miTaiaa aapai ||
verses.translation: I have grasped the Guru's Feet, and my doubts and fears are gone. He Himself has erased my self-conceit.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa mele prabh apunai vichhuR kateh na jaiee ||
verses.translation: Granting His Grace, God has united me with Himself; no longer do I suffer the pains of separation, and I shall not have to go anywhere.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak dhaas teraa sadhaa har saranaiee ||2||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, I am forever Your slave, Lord; I seek Your Sanctuary. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: har dhare har dhar sohan tere bhagat piaare raam ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Gate - at the Lord's Gate, Your beloved devotees look beautiful.

verses.original: ਵਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਵਾਰੀ ਜਾਵਾ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: vaaree tin vaaree jaavaa sadh balihaare raam ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, again and again a sacrifice to them.

verses.original: ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਭੇਟਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sadh balihaare kar namasakaare jin bheTat prabh jaataa ||
verses.translation: I am forever a sacrifice, and I humbly bow to them; meeting them, I know God.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT rav rahiaa sabh thaiee pooran purakh bidhaataa ||
verses.translation: The Perfect and All-powerful Lord, the Architect of Destiny, is contained in each and every heart, everywhere.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur pooraa paiaa naam dhiaaiaa jooaai janam na haare ||
verses.translation: Meeting the Perfect Guru, we meditate on the Naam, and do not lose this life in the gamble.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak saran teree raakh kirapaa dhaare ||3||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, I seek Your Sanctuary; please, shower Your Mercy upon me, and protect me. ||3||

verses.original: ਬੇਅੰਤਾ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੇਤਕ ਗਾਵਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: bea(n)taa bea(n)t gun tere ketak gaavaa raam ||
verses.translation: Innumerable - innumerable are Your Glorious Virtues; how many of them can I sing?

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਚਰਣਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਚਰਣ ਧੂੜਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਵਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: tere charanaa tere charan dhooR vaddabhaagee paavaa raam ||
verses.translation: The dust of Your feet, of Your feet, I have obtained, by great good fortune.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧੂੜੀ ਨੑਾਈਐ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥੇ ॥
verses.translit: har dhooRee n(h)aieeaai mail gavaieeaai janam maran dhukh laathe ||
verses.translation: Bathing in the Lord's dust, my filth has been washed away, and the pains of birth and death have departed.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰੇ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਥੇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar baahar sadhaa hadhoore paramesar prabh saathe ||
verses.translation: Inwardly and outwardly, the Transcendent Lord God is ever-present, always with us.

verses.original: ਮਿਟੇ ਦੂਖ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: miTe dhookh kaliaan keeratan bahuR jon na paavaa ||
verses.translation: Suffering departs, and there is peace; singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, one is not consigned to reincarnation again.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਤਰੀਐ ਆਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak gur saran tareeaai aapane prabh bhaavaa ||4||2||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, in the Guru's Sanctuary, one swims across, and is pleasing to God. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪
verses.translit: aasaa chha(n)t mahalaa panjavaa ghar chauthhaa
verses.translation: Aasaa, Chhant, Fifth Mehla, Fourth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਨ ਨ ਮੀਠਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: har charan kamal man bedhiaa kichh aan na meeThaa raam raaje ||
verses.translation: My mind is pierced by the Lord's Lotus Feet; He alone is sweet to my mind, the Lord King.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟੇ ਡੀਠਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: mil sa(n)tasa(n)gat aaraadhiaa har ghaT ghaTe ddeeThaa raam raaje ||
verses.translation: Joining the Society of the Saints, I meditate on the Lord in adoration; I behold the Lord King in each and every heart.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟੇ ਡੀਠਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੋੁ ਵੂਠਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਠੇ ॥
verses.translit: har ghaT ghaTe ddeeThaa a(n)mrituo vooThaa janam maran dhukh naaThe ||
verses.translation: I behold the Lord in each and every heart, and the Ambrosial Nectar rains down upon me; the pains of birth and death are gone.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਦੂਖ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਗਾਠੇ ॥
verses.translit: gun nidh gaiaa sabh dhookh miTaiaa haumai binasee gaaThe ||
verses.translation: Singing the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of virtue, all my pains are erased, and the knot of ego has been untied.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਈ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: priau sahaj subhaiee chhodd na jaiee man laagaa ra(n)g majeeThaa ||
verses.translation: My Beloved shall not leave me to go anywhere - this is His natural way; my mind is imbued with the lasting color of the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੇਧੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਨ ਨ ਮੀਠਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har naanak bedhe charan kamal kichh aan na meeThaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Lotus Feet of the Lord have pierced Nanak's mind, and now, nothing else seems sweet to him. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਲਿ ਮਾਛੁਲੀ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: jiau raatee jal maachhulee tiau raam ras maate raam raaje ||
verses.translation: Just like the fish which revels in water, I am intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord, my Lord King.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਜੀਵਨ ਗਤਿ ਭਾਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai upadhesiaa jeevan gat bhaate raam raaje ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has instructed me, and blessed me with salvation in my life; I love the Lord, my King.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਨ ਗਤਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਆਪਿ ਲੀਏ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jeevan gat suaamee a(n)tarajaamee aap le'ee laR laae ||
verses.translation: The Lord Master, the Searcher of hearts, blesses me with salvation in my life; He Himself attaches me to His Love.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥੋ ਪਰਗਟੋ ਪੂਰਨੋ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: har ratan padhaaratho paragaTo poorano chhodd na katahoo jaae ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the treasure of jewels, the perfect manifestation; He shall not forsake us to go anywhere else.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੁਘਰੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਮਿਟੈ ਨ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh sughar saroop sujaan suaamee taa kee miTai na dhaate ||
verses.translation: God, the Lord Master, is so accomplished, beauteous, and all-knowing; His gifts are never exhausted.

verses.original: ਜਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਾਛੁਲੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jal sa(n)g raatee maachhulee naanak har maate ||2||
verses.translation: As the fish is enraptured by the water, so is Nanak intoxicated by the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਬੂੰਦ ਜਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: chaatirak jaachai boo(n)dh jiau har praan adhaaraa raam raaje ||
verses.translation: As the song-bird yearns for the rain-drop, the Lord, the Lord my King, is the Support of my breath of life.

verses.original: ਮਾਲੁ ਖਜੀਨਾ ਸੁਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਮੀਤ ਸਭਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: maal khajeenaa sut bhraat meet sabhahoo(n) te piaaraa raam raaje ||
verses.translation: My Lord King is more beloved than all wealth, treasure, children, siblings and friends.

verses.original: ਸਭਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਾਰਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: sabhahoo(n) te piaaraa purakh niraaraa taa kee gat nahee jaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: The absolute Lord, the Primal Being, is more beloved than all; His condition cannot be known.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: har saas giraas na bisarai kabahoo(n) gur sabadhee ra(n)g maaneeaai ||
verses.translation: I shall never forget the Lord, for an instant, for a single breath; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I enjoy His Love.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੋ ਸੰਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਨੋ ਜਪਿ ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਦੁਖ ਡਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh purakh jagajeevano sa(n)t ras peevano jap bharam moh dhukh ddaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Primal Lord God is the Life of the Universe; His Saints drink in the Lord's sublime essence. Meditating on Him, doubts, attachments and pains are shaken off.

verses.original: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਬੂੰਦ ਜਿਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: chaatirak jaachai boo(n)dh jiau naanak har piaaraa ||3||
verses.translation: As the song-bird yearns for the rain-drop, so does Nanak love the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਿਲੇ ਨਰਾਇਣ ਆਪਣੇ ਮਾਨੋਰਥੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: mile narain aapane maanoratho pooraa raam raaje ||
verses.translation: Meeting the Lord, my Lord King, my desires are fulfilled.

verses.original: ਢਾਠੀ ਭੀਤਿ ਭਰੰਮ ਕੀ ਭੇਟਤ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੂਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: ddaaThee bheet bhara(n)m kee bheTat gur sooraa raam raaje ||
verses.translation: The walls of doubt have been torn down, meeting the Brave Guru, O Lord King.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਏ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਾਏ ਸਭ ਨਿਧਿ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: pooran gur paae purab likhaae sabh nidh dheen dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru is obtained by perfect pre-ordained destiny; God is the Giver of all treasures - He is merciful to the meek.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: aadh madh a(n)t prabh soiee su(n)dhar gur gopaalaa ||
verses.translation: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, is God, the most beautiful Guru, the Sustainer of the World.

verses.original: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sookh sahaj aana(n)dh ghanere patit paavan saadhoo dhooraa ||
verses.translation: The dust of the feet of the Holy purifies sinners, and brings great joy, bliss and ecstasy.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਨਰਾਇਣ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਮਾਨੋਰਥੋੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
verses.translit: har mile narain naanakaa maanorathuo pooraa ||4||1||3||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Infinite Lord, has met with Nanak, and his desires are fulfilled. ||4||1||3||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੬
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa chha(n)t ghar chhayvaa
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Chhant, Sixth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਈ ਜਪਾਤ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau bhe kirapaal prabh har har seiee japaat ||
verses.translation: Those beings, unto whom the Lord God shows His Mercy, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਭੇਟਤ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਾਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak preet lagee tin(h) raam siau bheTat saadh sa(n)gaat ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they embrace love for the Lord, meeting the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

verses.original: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Chhant:

verses.original: ਜਲ ਦੁਧ ਨਿਆਈ ਰੀਤਿ ਅਬ ਦੁਧ ਆਚ ਨਹੀ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jal dhudh niaaiee reet ab dhudh aach nahee man aaisee preet hare ||
verses.translation: Just like water, which loves milk so much that it will not let it burn - O my mind, so love the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਬ ਉਰਝਿਓ ਅਲਿ ਕਮਲੇਹ ਬਾਸਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਮਗਨ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਭੀ ਨਾਹਿ ਟਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: ab urajhio al kamaleh baasan maeh magan ik khin bhee naeh Tarai ||
verses.translation: The bumble bee becomes enticed by the lotus, intoxicated by its fragrance, and does not leave it, even for a moment.

verses.original: ਖਿਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਟਰੀਐ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਰੀਐ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਹਭਿ ਰਸ ਅਰਪੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: khin naeh Tareeaai preet hareeaai seegaar habh ras arapeeaai ||
verses.translation: Do not let up your love for the Lord, even for an instant; dedicate all your decorations and pleasures to Him.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਦੂਖੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਜਮ ਪੰਥੁ ਭਣੀਐ ਤਹ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਡਰਪੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jeh dhookh suneeaai jam pa(n)th bhaneeaai teh saadhasa(n)g na ddarapeeaai ||
verses.translation: Where painful cries are heard, and the Way of Death is shown, there, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall not be afraid.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਣੀਐ ਸਗਲ ਪ੍ਰਾਛਤ ਦੁਖ ਹਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kar keerat govi(n)dh guneeaai sagal praachhat dhukh hare ||
verses.translation: Sing the Kirtan, the Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and all sins and sorrows shall depart.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਛੰਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਕਰੇਹੁ ਐਸੀ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak chha(n)t govi(n)dh har ke man har siau neh kareh aaisee man preet hare ||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, chant the Hymns of the Lord, the Lord of the Universe, O mind, and enshrine love for the Lord; love the Lord this way in your mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੈਸੀ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਨੀਰ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਭੀ ਨਾ ਧੀਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਕਰੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaisee machhulee neer ik khin bhee naa dheere man aaisaa neh kareh ||
verses.translation: As the fish loves the water, and is not content even for an instant outside it, O my mind, love the Lord in this way.

verses.original: ਜੈਸੀ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਪਿਆਸ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਬੂੰਦ ਚਵੈ ਬਰਸੁ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ਮੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaisee chaatirak piaas khin khin boo(n)dh chavai baras suhaave meh ||
verses.translation: Like the song-bird, thirsting for the rain-drops, chirping each and every moment to the beautiful rain clouds.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰੀਜੈ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਅਤਿ ਲਾਈਐ ਚਿਤੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: har preet kareejai ih man dheejai at laieeaai chit muraaree ||
verses.translation: So love the Lord, and give to Him this mind of yours; totally focus your consciousness on the Lord.

verses.original: ਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੀਜੈ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: maan na keejai saran pareejai dharasan kau balihaaree ||
verses.translation: Do not take pride in yourself, but seek the Sanctuary of the Lord, and make yourself a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੇ ਮਿਲੁ ਨਾਹ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੇ ਧਨ ਦੇਦੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਨੇਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur suprasa(n)ne mil naeh vichhu(n)ne dhan dhedhee saach sanehaa ||
verses.translation: When the Guru is totally pleased, the separated soul-bride is re-united with her Husband Lord; she sends the message of her true love.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਛੰਤ ਅਨੰਤ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਕੀਜੈ ਨੇਹਾ ਮਨ ਐਸਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਕਰੇਹੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak chha(n)t ana(n)t Thaakur ke har siau keejai nehaa man aaisaa neh kareh ||2||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, chant the Hymns of the Infinite Lord Master; O my mind, love Him and enshrine such love for Him. ||2||

verses.original: ਚਕਵੀ ਸੂਰ ਸਨੇਹੁ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਆਸ ਘਣੀ ਕਦਿ ਦਿਨੀਅਰੁ ਦੇਖੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: chakavee soor saneh chitavai aas ghanee kadh dhineear dhekheeaai ||
verses.translation: The chakvi bird is in love with the sun, and thinks of it constantly; her greatest longing is to behold the dawn.

verses.original: ਕੋਕਿਲ ਅੰਬ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਚਵੈ ਸੁਹਾਵੀਆ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਕੀਜੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: kokil a(n)b pareet chavai suhaaveeaa man har ra(n)g keejeeaai ||
verses.translation: The cuckoo is in love with the mango tree, and sings so sweetly. O my mind, love the Lord in this way.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰੀਜੈ ਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਇਕ ਰਾਤੀ ਕੇ ਹਭਿ ਪਾਹੁਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: har preet kareejai maan na keejai ik raatee ke habh paahuniaa ||
verses.translation: Love the Lord, and do not take pride in yourself; everyone is a guest for a single night.

verses.original: ਅਬ ਕਿਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇਓ ਮੋਹੁ ਰਚਾਇਓ ਨਾਗੇ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: ab kiaa ra(n)g laio moh rachaio naage aavan jaavaniaa ||
verses.translation: Now, why are you entangled in pleasures, and engrossed in emotional attachment? Naked we come, and naked we go.

verses.original: ਥਿਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣੀ ਪੜੀਐ ਚਰਣੀ ਅਬ ਟੂਟਸਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਜੁ ਕਿਤੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: thir saadhoo saranee paReeaai charanee ab TooTas mohu ju kiteeaai ||
verses.translation: Seek the eternal Sanctuary of the Holy and fall at their feet, and the attachments which you feel shall depart.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਛੰਤ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਇ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਕਬ ਦਿਨੀਅਰੁ ਦੇਖੀਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak chha(n)t dhiaal purakh ke man har lai pareet kab dhineear dhekheeaai ||3||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, chant the Hymns of the Merciful Lord God, and enshrine love for the Lord, O my mind; otherwise, how will you come to behold the dawn? ||3||

verses.original: ਨਿਸਿ ਕੁਰੰਕ ਜੈਸੇ ਨਾਦ ਸੁਣਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਹੀਉ ਡਿਵੈ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: nis kura(n)k jaise naadh sun sravanee heeau ddivai man aaisee preet keejai ||
verses.translation: Like the deer in the night, who hears the sound of the bell and gives his heart - O my mind, love the Lord in this way.

verses.original: ਜੈਸੀ ਤਰੁਣਿ ਭਤਾਰ ਉਰਝੀ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਸਿਵੈ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਲ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaisee tarun bhataar urajhee pireh sivai ih man laal dheejai ||
verses.translation: Like the wife, who is bound by love to her husband, and serves her beloved - like this, give your heart to the Beloved Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਲਾਲਹਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਭੋਗ ਕਰੀਜੈ ਹਭਿ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: man laaleh dheejai bhog kareejai habh khuseeaa ra(n)g maane ||
verses.translation: Give your heart to your Beloved Lord, and enjoy His bed, and enjoy all pleasure and bliss.

verses.original: ਪਿਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਅਤਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਰਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: pir apanaa paiaa ra(n)g laal banaiaa at milio mitr chiraane ||
verses.translation: I have obtained my Husband Lord, and I am dyed in the deep crimson color of His Love; after such a long time, I have met my Friend.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਥੀਆ ਸਾਖੀ ਤਾ ਡਿਠਮੁ ਆਖੀ ਪਿਰ ਜੇਹਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur theeaa saakhee taa ddiTham aakhee pir jehaa avar na dheesai ||
verses.translation: When the Guru became my advocate, then I saw the Lord with my eyes. No one else looks like my Beloved Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਛੰਤ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੋਹਨ ਕੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਗਹੀਜੈ ਐਸੀ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak chha(n)t dhiaal mohan ke man har charan gaheejai aaisee man preet keejai ||4||1||4||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, chant the Hymns of the merciful and fascinating Lord, O mind. Grasp the lotus feet of the Lord, and enshrine such love for Him in your mind. ||4||1||4||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਬਨੁ ਬਨੁ ਫਿਰਤੀ ਖੋਜਤੀ ਹਾਰੀ ਬਹੁ ਅਵਗਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: ban ban firatee khojatee haaree bahu avagaeh ||
verses.translation: From forest to forest, I wandered searching; I am so tired of taking baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਾਧ ਜਬ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak bheTe saadh jab har paiaa man maeh ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, when I met the Holy Saint, I found the Lord within my mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਛੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Chhant:
