verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਅਸੰਖ ਮੁਨੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਤਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau khojeh asa(n)kh munee anek tape ||
verses.translation: Countless silent sages and innumerable ascetics seek Him;

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਾਪ ਜਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: brahame koT araadheh giaanee jaap jape ||
verses.translation: millions of Brahmas meditate and adore Him; the spiritual teachers meditate and chant His Name.

verses.original: ਜਪ ਤਾਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਪੂਜਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਸੋਧਨ ਬੰਦਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jap taap sa(n)jam kiriaa poojaa anik sodhan ba(n)dhanaa ||
verses.translation: Through chanting, deep meditation, strict and austere self-discipline, religious rituals, sincere worship, endless purifications and humble salutations,

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਗਵਨੁ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਤੀਰਥਹ ਮਜਨੁ ਮਿਲਨ ਕਉ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: kar gavan basudhaa teeratheh majan milan kau nira(n)janaa ||
verses.translation: wandering all over the earth and bathing at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, people seek to meet the Pure Lord.

verses.original: ਮਾਨੁਖ ਬਨੁ ਤਿਨੁ ਪਸੂ ਪੰਖੀ ਸਗਲ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: maanukh ban tin pasoo pa(n)khee sagal tujheh araadhate ||
verses.translation: Mortals, forests, blades of grass, animals and birds all meditate on You.

verses.original: ਦਇਆਲ ਲਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਗਤੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhiaal laal gobi(n)dh naanak mil saadhasa(n)gat hoi gate ||1||
verses.translation: The Merciful Beloved Lord, the Lord of the Universe is found; O Nanak, joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, salvation is attained. ||1||

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਸਨ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਸੰਕਰ ਜਟਾਧਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: koT bisan avataar sa(n)kar jaTaadhaar ||
verses.translation: Millions of incarnations of Vishnu and Shiva, with matted hair

verses.original: ਚਾਹਹਿ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਦਇਆਰ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰੁਚ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: chaaheh tujheh dhiaar man tan ruch apaar ||
verses.translation: yearn for You, O Merciful Lord; their minds and bodies are filled with infinite longing.

verses.original: ਅਪਾਰ ਅਗਮ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਗਲ ਪੂਰਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: apaar agam gobi(n)dh Thaakur sagal poorak prabh dhanee ||
verses.translation: The Lord Master, the Lord of the Universe, is infinite and unapproachable; God is the all-pervading Lord of all.

verses.original: ਸੁਰ ਸਿਧ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਜਖ ਕਿੰਨਰ ਗੁਣ ਭਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: sur sidh gan ga(n)dharab dhiaaveh jakh ki(n)nar gun bhanee ||
verses.translation: The angels,the Siddhas,the beings of spiritual perfection,the heavenly heralds and celestial singers meditate on You. The Yakhsha demons,the guards of the divine treasures,and the Kinnars, the dancers of the god of wealth chant Your Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਅਨੇਕ ਦੇਵਾ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: koT i(n)dhr anek dhevaa japat suaamee jai jai kaar ||
verses.translation: Millions of Indras and countless gods and super-human beings meditate on the Lord Master and celebrate His Praises.

verses.original: ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥ ਦਇਆਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਉਧਾਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: anaath naath dhiaal naanak saadhasa(n)gat mil udhaar ||2||
verses.translation: The Merciful Lord is the Master of the masterless, O Nanak; joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one is saved. ||2||

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਦੇਵੀ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਲਖਿਮੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: koT dhevee jaa kau seveh lakhimee anik bhaat ||
verses.translation: Millions of gods and goddesses of wealth serve Him in so many ways.

verses.original: ਗੁਪਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: gupat pragaT jaa kau araadheh paun paanee dhinas raat ||
verses.translation: The invisible and visible beings worship Him in adoration, along with wind and water, day and night.

verses.original: ਨਖਿਅਤ੍ਰ ਸਸੀਅਰ ਸੂਰ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਬਸੁਧ ਗਗਨਾ ਗਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: nakhiatr saseear soor dhiaaveh basudh gaganaa gaave ||
verses.translation: The stars, the moon and the sun meditate on Him; the earth and the sky sing to Him.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਖਾਣੀ ਸਗਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: sagal khaanee sagal baanee sadhaa sadhaa dhiaave ||
verses.translation: All the sources of creation, and all languages meditate on Him, forever and ever.

verses.original: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਚਤੁਰ ਬੇਦਹ ਖਟੁ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਜਪਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: simirat puraan chatur bedheh khaT saasatr jaa kau japaat ||
verses.translation: The Simritees, the Puraanas, the four Vedas and the six Shaastras meditate on Him.

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਤਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: patit paavan bhagat vachhal naanak mileeaai sa(n)g saat ||3||
verses.translation: He is the Purifier of sinners, the Lover of His Saints; O Nanak, He is met in the Society of the Saints. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੇਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਜਨਾਈ ਰਸਨਾ ਤੇਤ ਭਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: jetee prabhoo janaiee rasanaa tet bhanee ||
verses.translation: As much as God has revealed to us, that much we can speak with our tongues.

verses.original: ਅਨਜਾਨਤ ਜੋ ਸੇਵੈ ਤੇਤੀ ਨਹ ਜਾਇ ਗਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: anajaanat jo sevai tetee neh jai ganee ||
verses.translation: Those unknown ones who serve You cannot be counted.

verses.original: ਅਵਿਗਤ ਅਗਨਤ ਅਥਾਹ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਗਲ ਮੰਝੇ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: avigat aganat athaeh Thaakur sagal ma(n)jhe baaharaa ||
verses.translation: Imperishable, incalculable, and unfathomable is the Lord and Master; He is everywhere, inside and out.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਏਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਹ ਦੂਰਿ ਸੰਗੀ ਜਾਹਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sarab jaachik ek dhaataa neh dhoor sa(n)gee jaaharaa ||
verses.translation: We are all beggars, He is the One and only Giver; He is not far away, but is with us, ever-present.

verses.original: ਵਸਿ ਭਗਤ ਥੀਆ ਮਿਲੇ ਜੀਆ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਿਤ ਗਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: vas bhagat theeaa mile jeeaa taa kee upamaa kit ganee ||
verses.translation: He is in the power of His devotees; those whose souls are united with Him - how can their praises be sung?

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਾਏ ਸੀਸੁ ਸਾਧਹ ਧਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੫॥
verses.translit: eih dhaan maan naanak paae sees saadheh dhar charanee ||4||2||5||
verses.translation: May Nanak receive this gift and honor, of placing his head on the feet of the Holy Saints. ||4||2||5||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla,

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: audham karahu vaddabhaageeho simarahu har har rai ||
verses.translation: Make the effort, O very fortunate ones, and meditate on the Lord, the Lord King.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak jis simarat sabh sukh hoveh dhookh dharadh bhram jai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, remembering Him in meditation, you shall obtain total peace, and your pains and troubles and doubts shall depart. ||1||

verses.original: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Chhant:

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਹ ਅਲਸਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: naam japat gobi(n)dh neh alasaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe; don't be lazy.

verses.original: ਭੇਟਤ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਨਹ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: bheTat saadhoo sa(n)g jam pur neh jaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall not have to go to the City of Death.

verses.original: ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਨ ਭਉ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਦ ਸੁਖੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhookh dharadh na bhau biaapai naam simarat sadh sukhee ||
verses.translation: Pain, trouble and fear will not afflict you; meditating on the Naam, a lasting peace is found.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖੀ ॥
verses.translit: saas saas araadh har har dhiaai so prabh man mukhee ||
verses.translation: With each and every breath, worship the Lord in adoration; meditate on the Lord God in your mind and with your mouth.

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਰਸਾਲ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaal dhiaal rasaal gun nidh kar dhiaa sevaa laieeaai ||
verses.translation: O kind and compassionate Lord, O treasure of sublime essence, treasure of excellence, please link me to Your service.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਚਰਣ ਜੰਪੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਹ ਅਲਸਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak pia(n)pai charan ja(n)pai naam japat gobi(n)dh neh alasaieeaai ||1||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak: may I meditate on the Lord's lotus feet, and not be lazy in chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਾਵਨ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: paavan patit puneet naam nira(n)janaa ||
verses.translation: The Purifier of sinners is the Naam, the Pure Name of the Immaculate Lord.

verses.original: ਭਰਮ ਅੰਧੇਰ ਬਿਨਾਸ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਜਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: bharam a(n)dher binaas giaan gur a(n)janaa ||
verses.translation: The darkness of doubt is removed by the healing ointment of the Guru's spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur giaan a(n)jan prabh nira(n)jan jal thal maheeal pooriaa ||
verses.translation: By the healing ointment of the Guru's spiritual wisdom, one meets the Immaculate Lord God, who is totally pervading the water, the land and the sky.

verses.original: ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਿਟੇ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਵਿਸੂਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: eik nimakh jaa kai ridhai vasiaa miTe tiseh visooriaa ||
verses.translation: If He dwells within the heart, for even an instant, sorrows are forgotten.

verses.original: ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਬ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: agaadh bodh samarath suaamee sarab kaa bhau bha(n)janaa ||
verses.translation: The wisdom of the all-powerful Lord and Master is incomprehensible; He is the Destroyer of the fears of all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਚਰਣ ਜੰਪੈ ਪਾਵਨ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak pia(n)pai charan ja(n)pai paavan patit puneet naam nira(n)janaa ||2||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, I meditate on the Lord's lotus feet. The Purifier of sinners is the Naam, the Pure Name of the Immaculate Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧੇ ॥
verses.translit: oT gahee gopaal dhiaal kirapaa nidhe ||
verses.translation: I have grasped the protection of the merciful Lord, the Sustainer of the Universe, the treasure of grace.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਆਸਰ ਤੁਅ ਚਰਨ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਿਧੇ ॥
verses.translit: moh aasar tua charan tumaaree saran sidhe ||
verses.translation: I take the support of Your lotus feet, and in the protection of Your Sanctuary, I attain perfection.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har charan kaaran karan suaamee patit udharan har hare ||
verses.translation: The Lord's lotus feet are the cause of causes; the Lord Master saves even the sinners.

verses.original: ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਭਵ ਉਤਾਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਬਹੁ ਤਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: saagar sa(n)saar bhav utaar naam simarat bahu tare ||
verses.translation: So many are saved; they cross over the terrifying world-ocean, contemplating the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਸੁਨੀ ਉਧਰਨ ਸੰਤਸੰਗ ਬਿਧੇ ॥
verses.translit: aadh a(n)t bea(n)t khojeh sunee udharan sa(n)tasa(n)g bidhe ||
verses.translation: In the beginning and in the end, countless are those who seek the Lord. I have heard that the Society of the Saints is the way to salvation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਚਰਨ ਜੰਪੈ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak pia(n)pai charan ja(n)pai oT gahee gopaal dhiaal kirapaa nidhe ||3||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, I meditate on the Lord's lotus feet, and grasp the protection of the Lord of the Universe, the merciful, the ocean of kindness. ||3||

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਆਪਿ ਬਨਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat vachhal har biradh aap banaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the Lover of His devotees; this is His natural way.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਸੰਤ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jeh jeh sa(n)t araadheh teh teh pragaTaiaa ||
verses.translation: Wherever the Saints worship the Lord in adoration, there He is revealed.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਲੀਏ ਸਮਾਇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਭਗਤ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: prabh aap le'ee samai sahaj subhai bhagat kaaraj saariaa ||
verses.translation: God blends Himself with His devotees in His natural way, and resolves their affairs.

verses.original: ਆਨੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਜਸ ਮਹਾ ਮੰਗਲ ਸਰਬ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aana(n)dh har jas mahaa ma(n)gal sarab dhookh visaariaa ||
verses.translation: In the ecstasy of the Lord's Praises, they obtain supreme joy, and forget all their sorrows.
